      (restrictedA (A := A) H) (restrictedB (B := B) H)) :=
    HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty _ _ _
  let d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair H
      (restrictedA (A := A) H) (restrictedB (B := B) H) :=
    Classical.choice inferInstance
  let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv psi d) y
  have hwy : w.toReducedWord.prod psi = y :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv psi d).symm_apply_apply y
  have hmapped :
      (mapRestrictedReducedWord (A := A) (B := B) H w.toReducedWord).prod phi ∈
        MonoidHom.range (HNNExtension.of (A := A) (B := B) (φ := phi)) := by
    rw [mapRestrictedReducedWord_prod H hphi, hwy]
    exact hy
  have hnilmap :=
    HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range phi
      (mapRestrictedReducedWord (A := A) (B := B) H w.toReducedWord) hmapped
  have hnil : w.toList = [] := by
    simpa [mapRestrictedReducedWord] using hnilmap
  refine ⟨w.head, ?_⟩
  rw [← hwy]
  simp [HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hnil]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.restrictedEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem restrictedEmbedding_injective (H : Subgroup G)
    (hphi : ∀ a : A, (a : G) ∈ H ↔ (phi a : G) ∈ H) :
    Function.Injective (restrictedEmbedding H hphi)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one (restrictedEmbedding H hphi)).mpr
  intro y hy
  have hybase : restrictedEmbedding H hphi y ∈
      MonoidHom.range
        (HNNExtension.of (A := A) (B := B) (φ := phi)) := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simpa using hy.symm
  rcases restrictedEmbedding_preimage_base H hphi y hybase with ⟨h, rfl⟩
  rw [restrictedEmbedding_of] at hy
  have hh : (h : G) = 1 := by
    apply HNNExtension.of_injective phi
    simpa using hy
  have hH : h = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hh
  simp [hH]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable_coe (H : Subgroup G)
    (hphi : ∀ a : A, (a : G) ∈ H ↔ (phi a : G) ∈ H)
    (x : HNNExtension H (restrictedA (A := A) H)
      (restrictedB (B := B) H) (restrictedPhi H hphi)) :
    ((restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable H hphi x :
        generatedWithStable (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) H) :
      HNNExtension G A B phi) = restrictedEmbedding H hphi x
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable,
    MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply, MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.generatedWithStable_inf_base
statement:
theorem generatedWithStable_inf_base
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hphi : ∀ a : A, (a : G) ∈ H ↔ (phi a : G) ∈ H) :
    generatedWithStable (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) H ⊓
        MonoidHom.range (HNNExtension.of (A := A) (B := B) (φ := phi)) =
      H.map (HNNExtension.of (A := A) (B := B) (φ := phi))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxg : x ∈ generatedWithStable (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) H := hx.1
    rw [← restrictedEmbedding_range H hphi] at hxg
    rcases hxg with ⟨y, hy⟩
    rcases restrictedEmbedding_preimage_base H hphi y (hy ▸ hx.2) with ⟨h, rfl⟩
    rw [restrictedEmbedding_of] at hy
    exact ⟨h, h.property, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      exact Or.inl ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨g, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.exists_reducedWord_of_mem_generatedWithStable
statement:
theorem exists_reducedWord_of_mem_generatedWithStable
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hphi : ∀ a : A, (a : G) ∈ H ↔ (phi a : G) ∈ H)
    {x : HNNExtension G A B phi}
    (hx : x ∈ generatedWithStable (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) H) :
    ∃ w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G A B,
      w.prod phi = x ∧ w.head ∈ H ∧ ∀ p ∈ w.toList, p.2 ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictedEmbedding_range H hphi] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  let psi := restrictedPhi H hphi
  let : Nonempty (HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair H
      (restrictedA (A := A) H) (restrictedB (B := B) H)) :=
    HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty _ _ _
  let d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair H
      (restrictedA (A := A) H) (restrictedB (B := B) H) :=
    Classical.choice inferInstance
  let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv psi d) y
  let wm := mapRestrictedReducedWord (A := A) (B := B) H w.toReducedWord
  refine ⟨wm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mapRestrictedReducedWord_prod H hphi]
    exact congrArg (restrictedEmbedding H hphi)
      ((HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv psi d).symm_apply_apply y)
  · exact w.head.property
  · intro p hp
    dsimp [wm, mapRestrictedReducedWord] at hp
    rw [List.mem_map] at hp
    rcases hp with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact q.2.property

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff
statement:
theorem centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff (C : Subgroup G) (g : G) :
    Commute (centralizerOf C g) (centralizerStable C) ↔ g ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcomm
    let w₁ : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G C C :=
      { head := g
        toList := [(1, 1)]
        chain := List.isChain_singleton _ }
    let w₂ : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G C C :=
      { head := 1
        toList := [(1, g)]
        chain := List.isChain_singleton _ }
    have hprod : w₁.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = w₂.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) := by
      simpa [w₁, w₂, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,
        centralizerOf, centralizerStable] using hcomm.eq
    have hcoset :=
      (HNNExtension.ReducedWord.map_fst_eq_and_of_prod_eq
        (MulEquiv.refl C) hprod).2 (1 : ℤˣ) (by simp [w₁])
    have hinv : g⁻¹ ∈ C := by simpa [w₁, w₂] using hcoset
    simpa using C.inv_mem hinv
  · intro hg
    let c : C := ⟨g, hg⟩
    have h := HNNExtension.t_mul_of (φ := MulEquiv.refl C) c
    show centralizerOf C g * centralizerStable C =
      centralizerStable C * centralizerOf C g
    simpa [centralizerOf, centralizerStable, c] using h.symm

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedEmbedding_of
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugatedEmbedding]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedEmbedding_t
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugatedEmbedding]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedEmbedding_range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    induction y using HNNExtension.induction_on with
    | of a =>
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        exact Or.inl ⟨a, a.property, by simp⟩
    | t =>
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        exact Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _)
    | mul x y hx hy => simpa using Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
    | inv x hx => simpa using Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx
  · unfold generatedWith
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x (hx | rfl)
    · rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨HNNExtension.of (⟨a, ha⟩ : A), by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨HNNExtension.t, by simp⟩

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_generatedWith_reducedWord
statement:
private theorem centralizer_generatedWith_reducedWord
    (C D : Subgroup G) {x : CentralizerHNN G C}
    (hx : x ∈ generatedWith (D.map (centralizerOf C)) (centralizerStable C)) :
    ∃ w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G C C,
      w.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = x ∧ w.head ∈ D ∧
        ∀ p ∈ w.toList, p.2 ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  have hphi : ∀ c : C,
      (c : G) ∈ D ↔ ((MulEquiv.refl C) c : G) ∈ D := by simp
  apply exists_reducedWord_of_mem_generatedWithStable D hphi
  simpa [generatedWith, generatedWithStable, centralizerOf, centralizerStable]
    using hx

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedStable_zpow_unit
statement:
private lemma conjugatedStable_zpow_unit (C : Subgroup G) (P : G) (u : ℤˣ) :
    conjugatedStable C P ^ (u : ℤ) =
      centralizerOf C P⁻¹ * centralizerStable C ^ (u : ℤ) *
        centralizerOf C P
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [conjugatedStable, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedList_prod
statement:
private lemma conjugatedList_prod (A C : Subgroup G) (P : G)
    (l : List (ℤˣ × A)) (hl : l ≠ []) :
    ((conjugatedList P l).map
        (fun p => centralizerStable C ^ (p.1 : ℤ) * centralizerOf C p.2)).prod =
      centralizerOf C P * conjugatedEmbedding A C P
        ((l.map (fun p => HNNExtension.t ^ (p.1 : ℤ) * HNNExtension.of p.2)).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          simp [conjugatedList, conjugatedEmbedding, conjugatedStable_zpow_unit,
            map_mul, mul_assoc]
      | cons y ys =>
          have htail : y :: ys ≠ [] := by simp
          simp only [conjugatedList, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
          rw [ih htail]
          simp [conjugatedEmbedding, conjugatedStable_zpow_unit, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugated_toSubgroup_self
statement:
private lemma conjugated_toSubgroup_self {E : Type*} [Group E]
    (K : Subgroup E) (u : ℤˣ) :
    HNNExtension.toSubgroup K K u = K
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedList_chain
statement:
private lemma conjugatedList_chain (A C : Subgroup G) (P : G)
    (l : List (ℤˣ × A))
    (hchain : l.IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup (conjugatePullback A C P)
        (conjugatePullback A C P) a.1 → a.1 = b.1)) :
    (conjugatedList P l).IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup C C a.1 → a.1 = b.1)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.isChain_nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          change [(x.1, P * (x.2 : G))].IsChain (fun a b =>
            a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup C C a.1 → a.1 = b.1)
          exact List.isChain_singleton _
      | cons y ys =>
          apply List.IsChain.cons
          · exact ih (List.isChain_cons.1 hchain).2
          · intro z hz hmem
            have hzfst : z.1 = y.1 := by
              cases ys <;> simp [conjugatedList] at hz
              · exact (congrArg Prod.fst hz).symm
              · exact (congrArg Prod.fst hz).symm
            have hxmem : x.2 ∈ conjugatePullback A C P := by
              change P * (x.2 : G) * P⁻¹ ∈ C
              rw [← conjugated_toSubgroup_self C x.1]
              exact hmem
            have hxmem' : x.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup
                (conjugatePullback A C P) (conjugatePullback A C P) x.1 := by
              simpa [conjugated_toSubgroup_self] using hxmem
            have hxy := (List.isChain_cons.1 hchain).1 y (by simp) hxmem'
            exact hxy.trans hzfst.symm

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedReducedWord_prod
statement:
private lemma conjugatedReducedWord_prod (A C : Subgroup G) (P : G)
    (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord A
      (conjugatePullback A C P) (conjugatePullback A C P))
    (hne : w.toList ≠ []) :
    (conjugatedReducedWord A C P w).prod (MulEquiv.refl C) =
      conjugatedEmbedding A C P (w.prod (MulEquiv.refl (conjugatePullback A C P)))
proof:
:= by
  change
    centralizerOf C (((w.head : A) : G) * P⁻¹) *
        ((conjugatedList P w.toList).map
          (fun p => centralizerStable C ^ (p.1 : ℤ) * centralizerOf C p.2)).prod =
      conjugatedEmbedding A C P
        (HNNExtension.of w.head *
          (w.toList.map
            (fun p => HNNExtension.t ^ (p.1 : ℤ) * HNNExtension.of p.2)).prod)
  rw [conjugatedList_prod A C P w.toList hne]
  simp [conjugatedEmbedding, centralizerOf, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedEmbedding_preimage_base
statement:
private theorem conjugatedEmbedding_preimage_base
    (A C : Subgroup G) (P : G)
    (y : CentralizerHNN A (conjugatePullback A C P))
    (hy : conjugatedEmbedding A C P y ∈
      MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C)) :
    ∃ a : A, y = HNNExtension.of a
proof:
:= by
  let K := conjugatePullback A C P
  let : Nonempty (HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair A K K) :=
    HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty _ _ _
  let d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair A K K :=
    Classical.choice inferInstance
  let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d) y
  have hwy : w.toReducedWord.prod (MulEquiv.refl K) = y :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d).symm_apply_apply y
  by_cases hnil : w.toList = []
  · refine ⟨w.head, ?_⟩
    rw [← hwy]
    simp [HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hnil]
  · let wm := conjugatedReducedWord A C P w.toReducedWord
    have hwm : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = conjugatedEmbedding A C P y := by
      dsimp [wm]
      rw [conjugatedReducedWord_prod A C P w.toReducedWord hnil, hwy]
    have hwbase : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) ∈
        MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) := by
      rwa [hwm]
    have hwempty :=
      HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
        (MulEquiv.refl C) wm hwbase
    have : w.toList = [] := by
      cases hlist : w.toList with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons q qs =>
          exfalso
          rcases q with ⟨u, a⟩
          dsimp [wm, conjugatedReducedWord] at hwempty
          rw [hlist] at hwempty
          cases qs <;> simp [conjugatedList] at hwempty
    exact (hnil this).elim

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.generatedWith_conjugatedStable_inf_base
statement:
theorem generatedWith_conjugatedStable_inf_base
    (A C : Subgroup G) (P : G) :
    generatedWith (A.map (centralizerOf C)) (conjugatedStable C P) ⊓
        MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) =
      A.map (centralizerOf C)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxleft := hx.1
    rw [← conjugatedEmbedding_range A C P] at hxleft
    rcases hxleft with ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hybase : conjugatedEmbedding A C P y ∈
        MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) := by
      simpa [hy] using hx.2
    rcases conjugatedEmbedding_preimage_base A C P y hybase with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [conjugatedEmbedding_of] at hy
    exact ⟨a, a.property, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      exact Or.inl ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedStable_not_mem_base
statement:
theorem conjugatedStable_not_mem_base (C : Subgroup G) (q : G) :
    conjugatedStable C q ∉ MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbase
  let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G C C :=
    { head := q⁻¹
      toList := [(1, q)]
      chain := List.isChain_singleton _ }
  have hwprod : w.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = conjugatedStable C q := by
    simp [w, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, conjugatedStable,
      centralizerOf, centralizerStable, mul_assoc]
  have hwbase : w.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) ∈
      MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) := by
    rwa [hwprod]
  have hnil :=
    HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
      (MulEquiv.refl C) w hwbase
  simp [w] at hnil

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugatedStable_mem_generatedWith_imp_doubleCoset
statement:
theorem conjugatedStable_mem_generatedWith_imp_doubleCoset
    (A C : Subgroup G) (P Q : G)
    (hQ : conjugatedStable C Q ∈
      generatedWith (A.map (centralizerOf C)) (conjugatedStable C P)) :
    ∃ c : C, ∃ a : A, P = (c : G) * Q * (a : G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← conjugatedEmbedding_range A C P] at hQ
  rcases hQ with ⟨y, hy⟩
  let K := conjugatePullback A C P
  let : Nonempty (HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair A K K) :=
    HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty _ _ _
  let d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair A K K :=
    Classical.choice inferInstance
  let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d) y
  have hwy : w.toReducedWord.prod (MulEquiv.refl K) = y :=
    (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d).symm_apply_apply y
  have hne : w.toList ≠ [] := by
    intro hnil
    have hybase : conjugatedEmbedding A C P y ∈
        MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) := by
      refine ⟨(w.head : A), ?_⟩
      rw [← hwy]
      simp only [HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hnil,
        List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, mul_one]
      exact (conjugatedEmbedding_of A C P w.head).symm
    exact conjugatedStable_not_mem_base C Q (hy ▸ hybase)
  let wm := conjugatedReducedWord A C P w.toReducedWord
  let qword : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G C C :=
    { head := Q⁻¹
      toList := [(1, Q)]
      chain := List.isChain_singleton _ }
  have hwm : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) =
      conjugatedEmbedding A C P y := by
    dsimp [wm]
    rw [conjugatedReducedWord_prod A C P w.toReducedWord hne, hwy]
  have hqword : qword.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = conjugatedStable C Q := by
    simp [qword, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,
      conjugatedStable, centralizerOf, centralizerStable, mul_assoc]
  have hprod : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) =
      qword.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) := hwm.trans (hy.trans hqword.symm)
  have hcompare := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.map_fst_eq_and_of_prod_eq
    (MulEquiv.refl C) hprod
  cases hlist : w.toList with
  | nil => exact (hne hlist).elim
  | cons p xs =>
      rcases p with ⟨u, aTail⟩
      have hu : u ∈ Option.map Prod.fst wm.toList.head? := by
        dsimp [wm, conjugatedReducedWord]
        rw [hlist]
        cases xs <;> simp [conjugatedList]
      have hdelta' := hcompare.2 u hu
      have hdelta : (((w.head : A) : G) * P⁻¹)⁻¹ * Q⁻¹ ∈ C := by
        simpa [qword, wm, conjugatedReducedWord, conjugated_toSubgroup_self]
          using hdelta'
      let c : C := ⟨(((w.head : A) : G) * P⁻¹)⁻¹ * Q⁻¹, hdelta⟩
      refine ⟨c, w.head, ?_⟩
      dsimp [c]
      simp [mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_of_mul_tpow
statement:
private lemma centralizer_of_mul_tpow (Delta : Subgroup G) (u : ℤˣ) (d : Delta) :
    (HNNExtension.of (d : G) : CentralizerHNN G Delta) *
        HNNExtension.t ^ (u : ℤ) =
      HNNExtension.t ^ (u : ℤ) * HNNExtension.of (d : G)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl
  · simpa using HNNExtension.of_mul_t (φ := MulEquiv.refl Delta) d
  · simpa using HNNExtension.of_mul_inv_t (φ := MulEquiv.refl Delta) d

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_tail_prod_eq
statement:
private lemma centralizer_tail_prod_eq (Delta : Subgroup G)
    (g₁ g₂ a b : G) (u : ℤˣ) (l₁ l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G))
    (c₁ : ((u, a) :: l₁).IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta a.1 → a.1 = b.1))
    (c₂ : ((u, b) :: l₂).IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta a.1 → a.1 = b.1))
    (hd : g₁⁻¹ * g₂ ∈ Delta)
    (heq :
      (centralizerReducedWord Delta g₁ ((u, a) :: l₁) c₁).prod
          (MulEquiv.refl Delta) =
        (centralizerReducedWord Delta g₂ ((u, b) :: l₂) c₂).prod
          (MulEquiv.refl Delta)) :
    (centralizerReducedWord Delta a l₁ (List.isChain_cons.1 c₁).2).prod
        (MulEquiv.refl Delta) =
      (centralizerReducedWord Delta ((g₁⁻¹ * g₂) * b) l₂
        (List.isChain_cons.1 c₂).2).prod (MulEquiv.refl Delta)
proof:
:= by
  let d : Delta := ⟨g₁⁻¹ * g₂, hd⟩
  have hc := centralizer_of_mul_tpow Delta u d
  dsimp [centralizerReducedWord, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod] at heq ⊢
  have heq' := congrArg
    (fun x : CentralizerHNN G Delta =>
      (HNNExtension.of g₁ * HNNExtension.t ^ (u : ℤ))⁻¹ * x) heq
  simp only [mul_inv_rev] at heq'
  simp [mul_assoc] at heq'
  rw [← mul_assoc (HNNExtension.of g₁)⁻¹ (HNNExtension.of g₂) _] at heq'
  rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul] at heq'
  rw [← mul_assoc (HNNExtension.of (g₁⁻¹ * g₂))
    (HNNExtension.t ^ (u : ℤ)) _] at heq'
  rw [hc] at heq'
  change _ = HNNExtension.of ((d : G) * b) * _
  simpa [mul_assoc] using heq'

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_toSubgroup_self
statement:
private lemma centralizer_toSubgroup_self (Delta : Subgroup G) (u : ℤˣ) :
    HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta u = Delta
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_reduced_coefficients
statement:
private lemma centralizer_reduced_coefficients
    (Delta L B₀ C : Subgroup G)
    (hinter : (L : Set G) ∩ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ = (C : Set G))
    (g₁ g₂ : G) (l₁ l₂ : List (ℤˣ × G))
    (c₁ : l₁.IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta a.1 → a.1 = b.1))
    (c₂ : l₂.IsChain (fun a b =>
      a.2 ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta a.1 → a.1 = b.1))
    (hprod : (centralizerReducedWord Delta g₁ l₁ c₁).prod
        (MulEquiv.refl Delta) =
      (centralizerReducedWord Delta g₂ l₂ c₂).prod
        (MulEquiv.refl Delta))
    (hg₁ : g₁ ∈ L) (hl₁ : ∀ x ∈ l₁, x.2 ∈ L)
    (hg₂ : g₂ ∈ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀)
    (hl₂ : ∀ x ∈ l₂, x.2 ∈ B₀) :
    g₁ ∈ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ l₁, x.2 ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing g₁ g₂ l₂ with
  | nil =>
      have hmaps :=
        (HNNExtension.ReducedWord.map_fst_eq_and_of_prod_eq
          (MulEquiv.refl Delta) hprod).1
      cases l₂ with
      | cons q qs => simp [centralizerReducedWord] at hmaps
      | nil =>
          have heqOf : HNNExtension.of g₁ =
              (HNNExtension.of g₂ : CentralizerHNN G Delta) := by
            simpa [centralizerReducedWord,
              HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod] using hprod
          have hg : g₁ = g₂ := HNNExtension.of_injective
            (A := Delta) (B := Delta) (φ := MulEquiv.refl Delta) heqOf
          have hdc : g₁ ∈ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ := by
            simpa [hg] using hg₂
          have hgC : g₁ ∈ C :=
            (Set.ext_iff.mp hinter g₁).mp ⟨hg₁, hdc⟩
          exact ⟨hgC, by simp⟩
  | cons p ps ih =>
      have hcompare := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.map_fst_eq_and_of_prod_eq
        (MulEquiv.refl Delta) hprod
      cases l₂ with
      | nil => simp [centralizerReducedWord] at hcompare
      | cons q qs =>
          rcases p with ⟨u, a⟩
          rcases q with ⟨v, b⟩
          have hmaps := hcompare.1
          change u :: ps.map Prod.fst = v :: qs.map Prod.fst at hmaps
          have huv : u = v := (List.cons.inj hmaps).1
          subst v
          have hd : g₁⁻¹ * g₂ ∈ Delta := by
            have hd' := hcompare.2 u (by simp [centralizerReducedWord])
            change g₁⁻¹ * g₂ ∈
              HNNExtension.toSubgroup Delta Delta (-u) at hd'
            simpa [centralizer_toSubgroup_self] using hd'
          let d : Delta := ⟨g₁⁻¹ * g₂, hd⟩
          have hdc : g₁ ∈ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ := by
            rcases hg₂ with ⟨d₁, hd₁, b₀, hb₀, d₂, hd₂, rfl⟩
            refine ⟨d₁, hd₁, b₀, hb₀, d₂ * d⁻¹,
              Delta.mul_mem hd₂ (Delta.inv_mem hd), ?_⟩
            dsimp [d]
            simp [mul_assoc]
          have hgC : g₁ ∈ C :=
            (Set.ext_iff.mp hinter g₁).mp ⟨hg₁, hdc⟩
          have hc₁tail := (List.isChain_cons.1 c₁).2
          have hc₂tail := (List.isChain_cons.1 c₂).2
          have htailprod := centralizer_tail_prod_eq Delta
            g₁ g₂ a b u ps qs c₁ c₂ hd hprod
          have haL : a ∈ L := hl₁ (u, a) (by simp)
          have hbB : b ∈ B₀ := hl₂ (u, b) (by simp)
          have htailHead : (d : G) * b ∈ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ :=
            ⟨d, hd, b, hbB, 1, Delta.one_mem, by simp⟩
          have htail := ih a ((d : G) * b) qs hc₁tail hc₂tail htailprod haL
            (by
              intro x hx
              exact hl₁ x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
            htailHead
            (by
              intro x hx
              exact hl₂ x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
          refine ⟨hgC, ?_⟩
          intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
          · exact htail.1
          · exact htail.2 x hx

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.exists_reducedWord_for_generatedWith
statement:
private lemma exists_reducedWord_for_generatedWith
    (Delta H : Subgroup G)
    {x : CentralizerHNN G Delta}
    (hx : x ∈ generatedWith (H.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta)) :
    ∃ w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G Delta Delta,
      w.prod (MulEquiv.refl Delta) = x ∧ w.head ∈ H ∧
        ∀ p ∈ w.toList, p.2 ∈ H
proof:
:=
  centralizer_generatedWith_reducedWord Delta H hx

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.reducedWord_prod_mem_generatedWith
statement:
private lemma reducedWord_prod_mem_generatedWith
    (Delta H : Subgroup G)
    (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord G Delta Delta)
    (hhead : w.head ∈ H) (hlist : ∀ p ∈ w.toList, p.2 ∈ H) :
    w.prod (MulEquiv.refl Delta) ∈
      generatedWith (H.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta)
proof:
:= by
  let K := generatedWith (H.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta)
  have hof : HNNExtension.of w.head ∈ K := by
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    exact Or.inl ⟨w.head, hhead, rfl⟩
  have ht : (HNNExtension.t : CentralizerHNN G Delta) ∈ K := by
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    exact Or.inr rfl
  have hprodListAux : ∀ l : List (ℤˣ × G),
      (∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ∈ H) →
      (l.map (fun p => HNNExtension.t ^ (p.1 : ℤ) * HNNExtension.of p.2)).prod ∈ K := by
    intro l hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [K]
    | cons p ps ih =>
        rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
        apply K.mul_mem
        · apply K.mul_mem
          · exact K.zpow_mem ht _
          · apply Subgroup.subset_closure
            exact Or.inl ⟨p.2, hl p (by simp), rfl⟩
        · exact ih (by
            intro q hq
            exact hl q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))
  exact K.mul_mem hof (hprodListAux w.toList hlist)

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.generatedWith_mono
statement:
private lemma generatedWith_mono (Delta : Subgroup G) {H K : Subgroup G}
    (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    generatedWith (H.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta) ≤
      generatedWith (K.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta)
proof:
:= by
  unfold generatedWith
  apply Subgroup.closure_mono
  exact Set.union_subset_union (Subgroup.map_mono hHK) Set.Subset.rfl

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.centralizer_intersection
statement:
theorem centralizer_intersection
    (Delta L B₀ C : Subgroup G)
    (hCL : C ≤ L) (hCB₀ : C ≤ B₀) (_hCDelta : C ≤ Delta)
    (hinter : (L : Set G) ∩ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ = (C : Set G)) :
    generatedWith (L.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta) ⊓
        generatedWith (B₀.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta) =
      generatedWith (C.map (centralizerOf Delta)) (centralizerStable Delta)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases exists_reducedWord_for_generatedWith Delta L hx.1 with
      ⟨wL, hwL, hwLhead, hwLlist⟩
    rcases exists_reducedWord_for_generatedWith Delta B₀ hx.2 with
      ⟨wB, hwB, hwBhead, hwBlist⟩
    have hwBhead' : wB.head ∈ deltaDoubleCoset Delta B₀ :=
      ⟨1, Delta.one_mem, wB.head, hwBhead, 1, Delta.one_mem, by simp⟩
    have hcoeff := centralizer_reduced_coefficients Delta L B₀ C
      hinter
      wL.head wB.head wL.toList wB.toList wL.chain wB.chain
      (hwL.trans hwB.symm) hwLhead hwLlist hwBhead' hwBlist
    have hm := reducedWord_prod_mem_generatedWith Delta C wL hcoeff.1 hcoeff.2
    rwa [hwL] at hm
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨generatedWith_mono Delta hCL hx, generatedWith_mono Delta hCB₀ hx⟩

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.conjugated_doubleCoset_intersection
statement:
theorem conjugated_doubleCoset_intersection
    (A C B₀ C₀ : Subgroup G)
    (hAB : A ≤ B₀) (hCB : C ≤ B₀) (hC₀C : C₀ ≤ C)
    (P : G) (hP : P ∉ B₀) :
    ((generatedWith (C₀.map (centralizerOf C)) (centralizerStable C) :
        Subgroup (CentralizerHNN G C)) : Set (CentralizerHNN G C)) ∩
        deltaDoubleCoset
          (generatedWith (A.map (centralizerOf C)) (conjugatedStable C P))
          (B₀.map (centralizerOf C)) =
      (C₀.map (centralizerOf C) : Set (CentralizerHNN G C))
proof:
:= by
  let L : Subgroup (CentralizerHNN G C) :=
    generatedWith (C₀.map (centralizerOf C)) (centralizerStable C)
  let Delta : Subgroup (CentralizerHNN G C) :=
    generatedWith (A.map (centralizerOf C)) (conjugatedStable C P)
  let B₀' : Subgroup (CentralizerHNN G C) := B₀.map (centralizerOf C)
  let Wide : Subgroup (CentralizerHNN G C) :=
    generatedWith (B₀.map (centralizerOf C)) (conjugatedStable C P)
  have hDeltaWide : Delta ≤ Wide := by
    unfold Delta Wide generatedWith
    apply Subgroup.closure_mono
    exact Set.union_subset_union (Subgroup.map_mono hAB) Set.Subset.rfl
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxL, hxdc⟩
    have hxWide : x ∈ Wide := by
      rcases hxdc with ⟨d₁, hd₁, b, hb, d₂, hd₂, rfl⟩
      exact Wide.mul_mem
        (Wide.mul_mem (hDeltaWide hd₁) (by
          apply Subgroup.subset_closure
          exact Or.inl hb))
        (hDeltaWide hd₂)
    have hxRange : x ∈ MonoidHom.range (conjugatedEmbedding B₀ C P) := by
      rw [conjugatedEmbedding_range B₀ C P]
      exact hxWide
    rcases hxRange with ⟨y, hyx⟩
    let K := conjugatePullback B₀ C P
    let : Nonempty (HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair B₀ K K) :=
      HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty _ _ _
    let d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair B₀ K K :=
      Classical.choice inferInstance
    let w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d :=
      (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d) y
    have hwy : w.toReducedWord.prod (MulEquiv.refl K) = y :=
      (HNNExtension.NormalWord.equiv (MulEquiv.refl K) d).symm_apply_apply y
    by_cases hnil : w.toList = []
    · have hybase : y = HNNExtension.of w.head := by
        rw [← hwy]
        simp [HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hnil]
      have hxbase : x ∈ MonoidHom.range (centralizerOf C) := by
        refine ⟨(w.head : B₀), ?_⟩
        rw [← hyx, hybase]
        simp [conjugatedEmbedding_of]
      have hcompat : ∀ c : C,
          (c : G) ∈ C₀ ↔ ((MulEquiv.refl C) c : G) ∈ C₀ := by simp
      have hinter := generatedWithStable_inf_base
        (A := C) (B := C) (phi := MulEquiv.refl C) C₀ hcompat
      have hxC₀' : x ∈ C₀.map
          (HNNExtension.of (A := C) (B := C) (φ := MulEquiv.refl C)) := by
        rw [← hinter]
        constructor
        · simpa [L, generatedWith, generatedWithStable,
            centralizerOf, centralizerStable] using hxL
        · exact hxbase
      simpa [centralizerOf] using hxC₀'
    · rcases exists_reducedWord_for_generatedWith C C₀ hxL with
        ⟨wL, hwL, hwLhead, hwLlist⟩
      let wm := conjugatedReducedWord B₀ C P w.toReducedWord
      have hwm : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = conjugatedEmbedding B₀ C P y := by
        dsimp [wm]
        rw [conjugatedReducedWord_prod B₀ C P w.toReducedWord hnil, hwy]
      have hprod : wm.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) = wL.prod (MulEquiv.refl C) := by
        rw [hwm, hyx, hwL]
      have hcompare := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.map_fst_eq_and_of_prod_eq
        (MulEquiv.refl C) hprod
      cases hlist : w.toList with
      | nil => exact (hnil hlist).elim
      | cons q qs =>
          rcases q with ⟨u, b⟩
          have hu : u ∈ Option.map Prod.fst wm.toList.head? := by
            dsimp [wm, conjugatedReducedWord]
            rw [hlist]
            cases qs <;> simp [conjugatedList]
          have hd' := hcompare.2 u hu
          have hd : (((w.head : B₀) : G) * P⁻¹)⁻¹ * wL.head ∈ C := by
            change wm.head⁻¹ * wL.head ∈ C
            simpa [centralizer_toSubgroup_self] using hd'
          have hPin : P ∈ B₀ := by
            have hm := B₀.mul_mem
              (B₀.mul_mem (hCB hd) (B₀.inv_mem (hCB (hC₀C hwLhead))))
              w.head.property
            simpa [mul_assoc] using hm
          exact (hP hPin).elim
  · intro hxC₀
    constructor
    · apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      exact Or.inl hxC₀
    · refine ⟨1, Delta.one_mem, x, ?_, 1, Delta.one_mem, by simp⟩
      exact Subgroup.map_mono (hC₀C.trans hCB) hxC₀

name: Undecidability.MultipleHNN.ReducedWord.eval_not_mem_stageOne
statement:
theorem eval_not_mem_stageOne (w : ReducedWord A B phi)
    (hsecond : w.ContainsSecond) :
    w.eval ∉ MonoidHom.range (stageTwoOf A B phi)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbase
  have hnil :=
    HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
      (mappedEquiv A B phi) w.toOuter hbase
  have : w.toList = [] := by
    simpa [toOuter] using hnil
  exact hsecond this

name: Undecidability.MultipleHNN.ReducedWord.eval_not_mem_base
statement:
theorem eval_not_mem_base (w : ReducedWord A B phi)
    (hstable : w.ContainsStable) :
    w.eval ∉ MonoidHom.range (baseEmbedding A B phi)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbase
  rcases hbase with ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hstageOne : w.eval ∈ MonoidHom.range (stageTwoOf A B phi) :=
    ⟨stageOneOf A B phi g, by simpa [baseEmbedding] using hg⟩
  by_cases hsecond : w.ContainsSecond
  · exact eval_not_mem_stageOne (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) w
      hsecond hstageOne
  · have hfirst : w.ContainsFirstInHead := hstable.resolve_left hsecond
    have houterNil : w.toList = [] := not_ne_iff.mp hsecond
    have heq :
        stageTwoOf A B phi (w.head.prod phi) =
          stageTwoOf A B phi (stageOneOf A B phi g) := by
      simpa [eval, toOuter, houterNil, baseEmbedding,
        stageTwoOf, stageOneOf,
        HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod] using hg.symm
    have hinner : w.head.prod phi = stageOneOf A B phi g :=
      (HNNExtension.of_injective (mappedEquiv A B phi)) heq
    have hinnerBase :
        w.head.prod phi ∈ MonoidHom.range (stageOneOf A B phi) :=
      ⟨g, hinner.symm⟩
    have hnil :=
      HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
        phi w.head hinnerBase
    exact hfirst hnil

name: Undecidability.MultipleHNN.ReducedWord.eval_ne_one
statement:
theorem eval_ne_one (w : ReducedWord A B phi)
    (hstable : w.ContainsStable) :
    w.eval ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hOne
  apply eval_not_mem_base (A := A) (B := B) (phi := phi) w hstable
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp [hOne]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.inverse_commutator_eq_one_iff
statement:
private theorem inverse_commutator_eq_one_iff {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (a b : G) :
    a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b = 1 ↔ a * b = b * a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = (a * b)⁻¹ :=
      mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp (by simpa [mul_assoc] using h)
    have hi := congrArg Inv.inv h'
    simpa only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using hi.symm
  · intro h
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h]
    simp

name: Undecidability.Borisov.commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one
statement:
private theorem commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {a b : G} (h : a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b = 1) :
    Commute a b
proof:
:=
  (inverse_commutator_eq_one_iff a b).mp h

name: Undecidability.Borisov.pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {a b c : G} (h : a * b = b * c) (n : ℕ) :
    a ^ n * b = b * c ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, ih, ← mul_assoc, h, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']

name: Undecidability.Borisov.evalPositive_append
statement:
private theorem evalPositive_append {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (s₁ s₂ : G) (u v : List (Fin 2)) :
    Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (u ++ v) =
      Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ v
proof:
:= by
  simp [Thue.evalPositive]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.evalPositive_commute
statement:
private theorem evalPositive_commute {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (s₁ s₂ c : G) (h₁ : Commute s₁ c) (h₂ : Commute s₂ c)
    (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    Commute (Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ w) c
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons a w ih =>
      change Commute
        ((if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ w) c
      apply Commute.mul_left
      · by_cases ha : a = 0 <;> simp [ha, h₁, h₂]
      · exact ih

name: Undecidability.Borisov.d_transport
statement:
private theorem d_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (d s₁ s₂ : G)
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ ({s₁, s₂} : Set G), d ^ 4 * s = s * d)
    (u : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) :
    d ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length) * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u =
      Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u * d ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons a u ih =>
      have hs : d ^ 4 * (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) =
          (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) * d := by
        by_cases ha : a = 0
        · simpa [ha] using hd s₁ (by simp)
        · simpa [ha] using hd s₂ (by simp)
      have hexp : i * 4 ^ (a :: u).length = 4 * (i * 4 ^ u.length) := by
        simp only [List.length_cons, pow_succ]
        ac_rfl
      calc
        d ^ (i * 4 ^ (a :: u).length) *
              Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (a :: u) =
            (d ^ 4) ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length) *
              ((if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
                Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u) := by
          rw [hexp, pow_mul]
          rfl
        _ = ((d ^ 4) ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length) *
              (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂)) *
                Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u := by rw [← mul_assoc]
        _ = ((if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
              d ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length)) *
                Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u := by
          rw [pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hs]
        _ = (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
              (d ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length) *
                Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
              (Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u * d ^ i) := by rw [ih]
        _ = Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (a :: u) * d ^ i := by
          simp only [Thue.evalPositive, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.e_transport
statement:
private theorem e_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (e s₁ s₂ : G)
    (he : ∀ s ∈ ({s₁, s₂} : Set G), e * s = s * e ^ 4)
    (u : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) :
    e ^ i * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u =
      Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u * e ^ (i * 4 ^ u.length)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons a u ih =>
      have hs : e * (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) =
          (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) * e ^ 4 := by
        by_cases ha : a = 0
        · simpa [ha] using he s₁ (by simp)
        · simpa [ha] using he s₂ (by simp)
      have hexp : 4 * i * 4 ^ u.length = i * 4 ^ (a :: u).length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons, pow_succ]
        ac_rfl
      calc
        e ^ i * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (a :: u) =
            (e ^ i * (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂)) *
              Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u := by
          simp only [Thue.evalPositive, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]
        _ = ((if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) * (e ^ 4) ^ i) *
              Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u := by
          rw [pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hs]
        _ = (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
              (e ^ (4 * i) * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u) := by
          rw [pow_mul, mul_assoc]
        _ = (if a = 0 then s₁ else s₂) *
              (Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ u *
                e ^ (4 * i * 4 ^ u.length)) := by rw [ih]
        _ = Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (a :: u) *
              e ^ (i * 4 ^ (a :: u).length) := by
          rw [hexp]
          simp only [Thue.evalPositive, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.commute_conjugate_iff_of_commute
statement:
private theorem commute_conjugate_iff_of_commute {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {g x k : G} (hgk : Commute g k) :
    Commute (g * x * g⁻¹) k ↔ Commute x k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hgk.mul_inv_cancel] using
    (Commute.conj_iff (a := x) (b := k) g)

name: Undecidability.Borisov.test_conjugate_repack
statement:
private theorem test_conjugate_repack {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (d e t q : G) (I J : ℕ) (htd : Commute t d) :
    e ^ J * ((d ^ I * q * e ^ J)⁻¹ * t * (d ^ I * q * e ^ J)) *
          (e ^ J)⁻¹ =
      q⁻¹ * t * q
proof:
:= by
  have hdt : (d ^ I)⁻¹ * t * d ^ I = t :=
    (htd.pow_right I).symm.inv_mul_cancel
  simp [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun x => x * q) hdt

name: Undecidability.Borisov.test_repack_commute_iff
statement:
private theorem test_repack_commute_iff {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (d e t k q : G) (I J : ℕ) (htd : Commute t d)
    (hke : Commute k e) :
    Commute (q⁻¹ * t * q) k ↔
      Commute ((d ^ I * q * e ^ J)⁻¹ * t * (d ^ I * q * e ^ J)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← test_conjugate_repack d e t q I J htd]
  exact commute_conjugate_iff_of_commute (hke.symm.pow_left J)

name: Undecidability.Borisov.simulation_conjugate
statement:
private theorem simulation_conjugate {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (c t A B : G) (hAB : c⁻¹ * A * c = B) (htc : Commute t c) :
    B⁻¹ * t * B = c⁻¹ * (A⁻¹ * t * A) * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hAB]
  have hct : c * t * c⁻¹ = t := htc.symm.mul_inv_cancel
  have hh := congrArg (fun x => c⁻¹ * A⁻¹ * x * A * c) hct
  simpa only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc] using hh

name: Undecidability.Borisov.simulation_preserves_commute
statement:
private theorem simulation_preserves_commute {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (c t k A B : G) (hAB : c⁻¹ * A * c = B)
    (htc : Commute t c) (hkc : Commute k c) :
    Commute (A⁻¹ * t * A) k ↔ Commute (B⁻¹ * t * B) k
proof:
:= by
  have hck : Commute c⁻¹ k := Commute.inv_left_iff.mpr hkc.symm
  rw [simulation_conjugate c t A B hAB htc]
  simpa only [inv_inv] using
    (commute_conjugate_iff_of_commute
      (g := c⁻¹) (x := A⁻¹ * t * A) (k := k) hck).symm

name: Undecidability.Borisov.pack_context
statement:
private theorem pack_context {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (dI dn en L X R eJ : G) (hd : dI * L = L * dn)
    (he : en * R = R * eJ) :
    dI * (L * X * R) * eJ = L * (dn * X * en) * R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    dI * (L * X * R) * eJ = (dI * L) * X * (R * eJ) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = (L * dn) * X * (en * R) := by rw [hd, ← he]
    _ = L * (dn * X * en) * R := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.conjugate_context
statement:
private theorem conjugate_context {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (c L X Y R : G) (hL : Commute L c) (hR : Commute R c)
    (hXY : c⁻¹ * X * c = Y) :
    c⁻¹ * (L * X * R) * c = L * Y * R
proof:
:= by
  have hcL : c⁻¹ * L = L * c⁻¹ :=
    (Commute.inv_left_iff.mpr hL.symm).eq
  calc
    c⁻¹ * (L * X * R) * c = (c⁻¹ * L) * X * (R * c) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = (L * c⁻¹) * X * (c * R) := by rw [hcL, hR.eq]
    _ = L * (c⁻¹ * X * c) * R := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = L * Y * R := by rw [hXY]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.relation_of_relator
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.relator_eq_one i
  rw [hi] at h
  change Word.eval (fun j => PresentedGroup.of j) (Word.relation lhs rhs) = 1 at h
  exact (Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff _ lhs rhs).mp h

name: Undecidability.Borisov.eval_positiveWord
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem eval_positiveWord {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin 7 → G) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    Word.eval x (positiveWord w) = Thue.evalPositive (x 2) (x 3) w
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveWord, Thue.evalPositive, s1Word, s2Word]

name: Undecidability.Borisov.presented_relation
statement:
private theorem presented_relation (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (i : Fin 14)
    (lhs rhs : BorisovWord)
    (hi : (presentation datum).relator i = Word.relation lhs rhs) :
    Word.eval (gen datum) lhs = Word.eval (gen datum) rhs
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FP.evalWord] using
    relation_of_relator (presentation datum) i lhs rhs hi

name: Undecidability.Borisov.d_letter_relations
statement:
private theorem d_letter_relations (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    let d := gen datum 0
    let s₁ := gen datum 2
    let s₂ := gen datum 3
    d ^ 4 * s₁ = s₁ * d ∧ d ^ 4 * s₂ = s₂ * d
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h₁ := presented_relation datum 0
    (Word.product [Word.inverse s1Word, Word.pow dWord 4, s1Word]) dWord
    (by simp [presentation, s_d_relator])
  have h₂ := presented_relation datum 2
    (Word.product [Word.inverse s2Word, Word.pow dWord 4, s2Word]) dWord
    (by simp [presentation, s_d_relator])
  have h₁' : (gen datum 2)⁻¹ * (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 2 = gen datum 0 := by
    simpa [dWord, s1Word, mul_assoc] using h₁
  have h₂' : (gen datum 3)⁻¹ * (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 3 = gen datum 0 := by
    simpa [dWord, s2Word, mul_assoc] using h₂
  constructor
  · calc
      (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 2 =
          gen datum 2 * ((gen datum 2)⁻¹ * (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 2) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = gen datum 2 * gen datum 0 := by rw [h₁']
  · calc
      (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 3 =
          gen datum 3 * ((gen datum 3)⁻¹ * (gen datum 0) ^ 4 * gen datum 3) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = gen datum 3 * gen datum 0 := by rw [h₂']

name: Undecidability.Borisov.e_letter_relations
statement:
private theorem e_letter_relations (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    let e := gen datum 1
    let s₁ := gen datum 2
    let s₂ := gen datum 3
    e * s₁ = s₁ * e ^ 4 ∧ e * s₂ = s₂ * e ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h₁ := presented_relation datum 1
    (Word.product [Word.inverse s1Word, eWord, s1Word]) (Word.pow eWord 4)
    (by simp [presentation, s_e_relator])
  have h₂ := presented_relation datum 3
    (Word.product [Word.inverse s2Word, eWord, s2Word]) (Word.pow eWord 4)
    (by simp [presentation, s_e_relator])
  have h₁' : (gen datum 2)⁻¹ * gen datum 1 * gen datum 2 =
      (gen datum 1) ^ 4 := by
    simpa [eWord, s1Word, mul_assoc] using h₁
  have h₂' : (gen datum 3)⁻¹ * gen datum 1 * gen datum 3 =
      (gen datum 1) ^ 4 := by
    simpa [eWord, s2Word, mul_assoc] using h₂
  constructor
  · calc
      gen datum 1 * gen datum 2 =
          gen datum 2 * ((gen datum 2)⁻¹ * gen datum 1 * gen datum 2) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = gen datum 2 * (gen datum 1) ^ 4 := by rw [h₁']
  · calc
      gen datum 1 * gen datum 3 =
          gen datum 3 * ((gen datum 3)⁻¹ * gen datum 1 * gen datum 3) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = gen datum 3 * (gen datum 1) ^ 4 := by rw [h₂']

name: Undecidability.Borisov.presented_relator_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FP.evalWord] using (presentation datum).relator_eq_one i

name: Undecidability.Borisov.c_letter_relations
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := presented_relator_eq_one datum 4
  have h₂ := presented_relator_eq_one datum 5
  have hr₁ : (presentation datum).relator 4 =
      Word.commutator s1Word cWord := by simp [presentation]
  have hr₂ : (presentation datum).relator 5 =
      Word.commutator s2Word cWord := by simp [presentation]
  rw [hr₁] at h₁
  rw [hr₂] at h₂
  have h₁' : (gen datum 2)⁻¹ * (gen datum 4)⁻¹ *
      gen datum 2 * gen datum 4 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Word.eval_commutator, s1Word, cWord,
      Word.eval_generator, ← mul_assoc] using h₁
  have h₂' : (gen datum 3)⁻¹ * (gen datum 4)⁻¹ *
      gen datum 3 * gen datum 4 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Word.eval_commutator, s2Word, cWord,
      Word.eval_generator, ← mul_assoc] using h₂
  exact ⟨commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h₁',
    commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h₂'⟩

name: Undecidability.Borisov.fixed_commutations
statement:
private theorem fixed_commutations (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    Commute (gen datum 5) (gen datum 4) ∧
    Commute (gen datum 5) (gen datum 0) ∧
    Commute (gen datum 6) (gen datum 4) ∧
    Commute (gen datum 6) (gen datum 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htc := presented_relator_eq_one datum 9
  have htd := presented_relator_eq_one datum 10
  have hkc := presented_relator_eq_one datum 11
  have hke := presented_relator_eq_one datum 12
  simp only [presentation] at htc htd hkc hke
  simp only [tWord, cWord, dWord, kWord, eWord] at htc htd hkc hke
  exact ⟨commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one htc,
    commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one htd,
    commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one hkc,
    commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one hke⟩

name: Undecidability.Borisov.simulation_relation_semantic
statement:
private theorem simulation_relation_semantic (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    let exponent := i.val + 1
    let d := gen datum 0
    let e := gen datum 1
    let s₁ := gen datum 2
    let s₂ := gen datum 3
    let c := gen datum 4
    c⁻¹ * d ^ exponent * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (datum.F i) *
        e ^ exponent * c =
      d ^ exponent * Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (datum.E i) *
        e ^ exponent
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  fin_cases i
  · have h := presented_relation datum 6
      (Word.product [Word.inverse cWord, Word.pow dWord 1,
        positiveWord (datum.F 0), Word.pow eWord 1, cWord])
      (Word.product [Word.pow dWord 1, positiveWord (datum.E 0),
        Word.pow eWord 1])
      (by simp [presentation, simulationRelator])
    simpa [dWord, eWord, cWord, mul_assoc] using h
  · have h := presented_relation datum 7
      (Word.product [Word.inverse cWord, Word.pow dWord 2,
        positiveWord (datum.F 1), Word.pow eWord 2, cWord])
      (Word.product [Word.pow dWord 2, positiveWord (datum.E 1),
        Word.pow eWord 2])
      (by simp [presentation, simulationRelator])
    simpa [dWord, eWord, cWord, mul_assoc] using h
  · have h := presented_relation datum 8
      (Word.product [Word.inverse cWord, Word.pow dWord 3,
        positiveWord (datum.F 2), Word.pow eWord 3, cWord])
      (Word.product [Word.pow dWord 3, positiveWord (datum.E 2),
        Word.pow eWord 3])
      (by simp [presentation, simulationRelator])
    simpa [dWord, eWord, cWord, mul_assoc] using h

name: Undecidability.Borisov.target_commutes
statement:
private theorem target_commutes (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    Commute
      ((Thue.evalPositive (gen datum 2) (gen datum 3) datum.P)⁻¹ *
        gen datum 5 * Thue.evalPositive (gen datum 2) (gen datum 3) datum.P)
      (gen datum 6)
proof:
:= by
  have h := presented_relator_eq_one datum 13
  have hr : (presentation datum).relator 13 =
      Word.commutator kWord (pWord datum) := by simp [presentation]
  rw [hr] at h
  have h' : (gen datum 6)⁻¹ *
      (Word.eval (gen datum) (pWord datum))⁻¹ * gen datum 6 *
      Word.eval (gen datum) (pWord datum) = 1 := by
    simpa only [Word.eval_commutator, kWord, Word.eval_generator,
      ← mul_assoc] using h
  have hc := (commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h').symm
  simpa [pWord, tWord, mul_assoc] using hc

name: Undecidability.Borisov.rule_preserves_testCommutes
statement:
private theorem rule_preserves_testCommutes (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (l r : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    testCommutes datum (l ++ datum.F i ++ r) ↔
      testCommutes datum (l ++ datum.E i ++ r)
proof:
:= by
  let d := gen datum 0
  let e := gen datum 1
  let s₁ := gen datum 2
  let s₂ := gen datum 3
  let c := gen datum 4
  let t := gen datum 5
  let k := gen datum 6
  let exponent := i.val + 1
  let L := Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ l
  let R := Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ r
  let F := Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (datum.F i)
  let E := Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (datum.E i)
  let qF := L * F * R
  let qE := L * E * R
  let I := exponent * 4 ^ l.length
  let J := exponent * 4 ^ r.length
  obtain ⟨hd₁, hd₂⟩ := d_letter_relations datum
  obtain ⟨he₁, he₂⟩ := e_letter_relations datum
  obtain ⟨hc₁, hc₂⟩ := c_letter_relations datum
  obtain ⟨htc, htd, hkc, hke⟩ := fixed_commutations datum
  have hd : ∀ s ∈ ({s₁, s₂} : Set (presentation datum).Group),
      d ^ 4 * s = s * d := by
    intro s hs
    rcases hs with (rfl | hs)
    · exact hd₁
    · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hs ▸ hd₂
  have he : ∀ s ∈ ({s₁, s₂} : Set (presentation datum).Group),
      e * s = s * e ^ 4 := by
    intro s hs
    rcases hs with (rfl | hs)
    · exact he₁
    · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hs ▸ he₂
  have hDL : d ^ I * L = L * d ^ exponent :=
    d_transport d s₁ s₂ hd l exponent
  have hER : e ^ exponent * R = R * e ^ J :=
    e_transport e s₁ s₂ he r exponent
  have hpackF : d ^ I * qF * e ^ J =
      L * (d ^ exponent * F * e ^ exponent) * R :=
    pack_context (d ^ I) (d ^ exponent) (e ^ exponent)
      L F R (e ^ J) hDL hER
  have hpackE : d ^ I * qE * e ^ J =
      L * (d ^ exponent * E * e ^ exponent) * R :=
    pack_context (d ^ I) (d ^ exponent) (e ^ exponent)
      L E R (e ^ J) hDL hER
  have hsim : c⁻¹ * (d ^ exponent * F * e ^ exponent) * c =
      d ^ exponent * E * e ^ exponent := by
    simpa [exponent, d, e, s₁, s₂, c, F, E, mul_assoc] using
      simulation_relation_semantic datum i
  have hAB : c⁻¹ * (d ^ I * qF * e ^ J) * c = d ^ I * qE * e ^ J := by
    rw [hpackF, hpackE]
    exact conjugate_context c L
      (d ^ exponent * F * e ^ exponent)
      (d ^ exponent * E * e ^ exponent) R
      (evalPositive_commute s₁ s₂ c hc₁ hc₂ l)
      (evalPositive_commute s₁ s₂ c hc₁ hc₂ r) hsim
  have hqF : Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.F i ++ r) = qF := by
    simp [qF, L, F, R, evalPositive_append, mul_assoc]
  have hqE : Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.E i ++ r) = qE := by
    simp [qE, L, E, R, evalPositive_append, mul_assoc]
  change Commute
      ((Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.F i ++ r))⁻¹ * t *
        Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.F i ++ r)) k ↔
    Commute
      ((Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.E i ++ r))⁻¹ * t *
        Thue.evalPositive s₁ s₂ (l ++ datum.E i ++ r)) k
  rw [hqF, hqE]
  rw [test_repack_commute_iff d e t k qF I J htd hke,
    test_repack_commute_iff d e t k qE I J htd hke]
  exact simulation_preserves_commute c t k
    (d ^ I * qF * e ^ J) (d ^ I * qE * e ^ J) hAB htc hkc

name: Undecidability.Borisov.thueStep_preserves_testCommutes
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, r, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, huv⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  rcases huv with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact rule_preserves_testCommutes datum l r i
  · exact (rule_preserves_testCommutes datum l r i).symm

name: Undecidability.Borisov.thueEq_preserves_testCommutes
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.trans (thueStep_preserves_testCommutes datum hstep)

name: Undecidability.Borisov.criterion_forward
statement:
theorem criterion_forward
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) :
    ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q datum.P →
      (presentation datum).wordProblem (testWord Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro hQP
  have hcomm : testCommutes datum Q :=
    (thueEq_preserves_testCommutes datum hQP).mpr (target_commutes datum)
  let q := Thue.evalPositive (gen datum 2) (gen datum 3) Q
  let a := q⁻¹ * gen datum 5 * q
  have hcomm' : Commute a (gen datum 6) := by
    simpa [testCommutes, q, a] using hcomm
  have hone : a⁻¹ * (gen datum 6)⁻¹ * a * gen datum 6 = 1 :=
    (inverse_commutator_eq_one_iff a (gen datum 6)).mpr hcomm'
  rw [(presentation datum).wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one]
  change Word.eval (gen datum) (testWord Q) = 1
  simpa [testWord, tWord, kWord, q, a, mul_assoc] using hone

name: Undecidability.Borisov.criterion_converse
statement:
theorem criterion_converse
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) :
    (presentation datum).wordProblem (testWord Q) →
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q datum.P
proof:
:=
  BorisovModFiveSparsity.criterion_converse datum Q

name: Undecidability.Borisov.criterion
statement:
theorem criterion
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) :
    ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q datum.P ↔
      (presentation datum).wordProblem (testWord Q)
proof:
:=
  ⟨criterion_forward datum Q, criterion_converse datum Q⟩

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.init_represents
statement:
private theorem init_represents {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q] (input : List Bool) :
    Represents (TM0.init input) (init input : PostMachine.Config (Phase Q))
proof:
:= by
  cases input with
  | nil =>
      exact ⟨default, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons a right =>
      exact ⟨default, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.respects
statement:
theorem respects {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q] (M : TM0.Machine Bool Q) :
    StateTransition.Respects (TM0.step M) (PostMachine.step (machine M))
      Represents
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hcd
  rcases hcd with ⟨q, hdq, hcq, htape⟩
  rcases c with ⟨qc, tape⟩
  rcases d with ⟨phase, left, a, right⟩
  change phase = Phase.normal q at hdq
  change qc = q at hcq
  subst phase
  subst qc
  change tape = Turing.Tape.mk₂ left (a :: right) at htape
  subst tape
  cases htrans : M q a with
  | none =>
      simp [TM0.step, Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.mk',
        PostMachine.step, machine, htrans]
  | some cmd =>
      rcases cmd with ⟨q', stmt⟩
      cases stmt with
      | move dir =>
          simp only [TM0.step, Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.mk',
            Turing.ListBlank.head_mk, List.headI_cons, htrans, Option.map_some]
          cases dir with
          | left =>
              cases left with
              | nil =>
                  refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', [], false, a :: right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                      simp [Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.move, Turing.Tape.mk']⟩
                  · exact Relation.TransGen.single (by
                      simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans])
              | cons b left =>
                  refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', left, b, a :: right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                      simp [Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.move, Turing.Tape.mk']⟩
                  · exact Relation.TransGen.single (by
                      simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans])
          | right =>
              cases right with
              | nil =>
                  refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', a :: left, false, []⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                      simp [Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.move, Turing.Tape.mk']⟩
                  · exact Relation.TransGen.single (by
                      simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans])
              | cons b right =>
                  refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', a :: left, b, right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                      simp [Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.move, Turing.Tape.mk']⟩
                  · exact Relation.TransGen.single (by
                      simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans])
      | write b =>
          simp only [TM0.step, Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.mk',
            Turing.ListBlank.head_mk, List.headI_cons, htrans, Option.map_some]
          cases right with
          | nil =>
              refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', left, b, [false]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
              · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                  simp only [Turing.Tape.write, Turing.Tape.mk₂,
                    Turing.Tape.mk', Turing.ListBlank.head_mk,
                    Turing.ListBlank.tail_mk, List.headI_cons,
                    List.tail_cons]
                  congr 1
                  exact Quotient.sound' (Or.inl ⟨1, rfl⟩)⟩
              ·
                have h₁ :
                    ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, false, []⟩ ∈
                      PostMachine.step (machine M)
                        ⟨Phase.normal q, left, a, []⟩ := by
                  simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans]
                have h₂ :
                    ⟨Phase.normal q', left, b, [false]⟩ ∈
                      PostMachine.step (machine M)
                        ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, false, []⟩ := by
                  simp [PostMachine.step, machine]
                have path₁ : StateTransition.Reaches₁
                    (PostMachine.step (machine M))
                    ⟨Phase.normal q, left, a, []⟩
                    ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, false, []⟩ :=
                  Relation.TransGen.single h₁
                exact path₁.tail h₂
          | cons x right =>
              refine ⟨⟨Phase.normal q', left, b, x :: right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
              · exact ⟨q', rfl, rfl, by
                  simp [Turing.Tape.mk₂, Turing.Tape.write, Turing.Tape.mk']⟩
              ·
                have h₁ :
                    ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, x, right⟩ ∈
                      PostMachine.step (machine M)
                        ⟨Phase.normal q, left, a, x :: right⟩ := by
                  simp [PostMachine.step, machine, htrans]
                have h₂ :
                    ⟨Phase.normal q', left, b, x :: right⟩ ∈
                      PostMachine.step (machine M)
                        ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, x, right⟩ := by
                  simp [PostMachine.step, machine]
                have path₁ : StateTransition.Reaches₁
                    (PostMachine.step (machine M))
                    ⟨Phase.normal q, left, a, x :: right⟩
                    ⟨Phase.returnLeft q', b :: left, x, right⟩ :=
                  Relation.TransGen.single h₁
                exact path₁.tail h₂

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem eval_dom_iff {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q]
    (M : TM0.Machine Bool Q) (input : List Bool) :
    (StateTransition.eval (PostMachine.step (machine M)) (init input)).Dom ↔
      (TM0.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [TM0.eval]
  simpa using StateTransition.tr_eval_dom (respects M) (init_represents input)

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.terminates_iff_tm0_eval_dom
statement:
theorem terminates_iff_tm0_eval_dom {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q]
    (M : TM0.Machine Bool Q) (input : List Bool) :
    MachineThue.Terminates (PostMachine.step (machine M)) (init input) ↔
      (TM0.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:=
  MachineThue.terminates_iff_eval_dom.trans (eval_dom_iff M input)

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.thue_iff_tm0_eval_dom
statement:
theorem thue_iff_tm0_eval_dom {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q]
    (M : TM0.Machine Bool Q) (input : List Bool) :
    ThueEq (PostMachine.system (machine M))
        (PostMachine.encode (init input))
        (PostMachine.target : List (PostMachine.Symbol (Phase Q))) ↔
      (TM0.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:=
  (PostMachine.terminates_iff (machine M) (init input)).symm.trans
    (terminates_iff_tm0_eval_dom M input)

name: Undecidability.TM0PostAdapter.thue_system_finite
statement:
theorem thue_system_finite {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q] [Finite Q]
    (M : TM0.Machine Bool Q) :
    Set.Finite (PostMachine.system (machine M))
proof:
:=
  PostMachine.system_finite _

name: Undecidability.SupportedTM1Thue.binaryStart_computable
statement:
private theorem binaryStart_computable {Q : Type*} [Inhabited Q] [Finite Q]
    [Primcodable (PostMachine.Symbol (TM0PostAdapter.Phase Q))] :
    Computable (@binaryStart Q inferInstance)
proof:
:= by
  let tape : Bool → PostMachine.Symbol (TM0PostAdapter.Phase Q) :=
    PostMachine.Symbol.tape
  have htape : Computable tape :=
    (Primrec.dom_finite tape).to_comp
  have hhead : Computable fun input : List Bool => tape input.headI :=
    htape.comp Primrec.list_headI.to_comp
  have htail : Computable fun input : List Bool =>
      input.tail.map tape :=
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_tail
      ((Primrec.dom_finite tape).comp₂ Primrec₂.right)).to_comp
  have hprefix : Computable fun input : List Bool =>
      [PostMachine.Symbol.leftMarker, tape input.headI,
        PostMachine.Symbol.state (TM0PostAdapter.Phase.normal (default : Q))] :=
    Computable.list_cons.comp
      (Computable.const PostMachine.Symbol.leftMarker)
      (Computable.list_cons.comp hhead
        (Computable.const
          [PostMachine.Symbol.state
            (TM0PostAdapter.Phase.normal (default : Q))]))
  have hsuffix : Computable fun input : List Bool =>
      input.tail.map tape ++ [PostMachine.Symbol.rightMarker] :=
    Computable.list_append.comp htail
      (Computable.const [PostMachine.Symbol.rightMarker])
  exact (Computable.list_append.comp hprefix hsuffix).of_eq fun input => by
    cases input <;>
      simp [binaryStart, TM0PostAdapter.init, PostMachine.encode,
        PostMachine.encodeTape, tape]

name: Undecidability.SupportedTM1Thue.start_computable
statement:
theorem start_computable (B : TM1BinaryAdapter.Code Γ)
    (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ) (hS : TM1.Supports M S)
    [Primcodable Γ] [Primcodable (Alphabet B M S)] :
    Computable (start B M S hS)
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited (State B M S) :=
    TM1BinaryAdapter.finiteStateInhabited B M S hS
  exact (binaryStart_computable (Q := State B M S)).comp
    (TM1BinaryAdapter.encodeInput_computable B)

name: Undecidability.SupportedTM1Thue.thue_iff_eval_dom
statement:
theorem thue_iff_eval_dom (B : TM1BinaryAdapter.Code Γ)
    (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ) (hS : TM1.Supports M S)
    (input : List Γ) :
    ThueEq (PostMachine.system (postMachine B M S hS))
        (start B M S hS input)
        (PostMachine.target : List (Alphabet B M S)) ↔
      (TM1.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited (State B M S) :=
    TM1BinaryAdapter.finiteStateInhabited B M S hS
  exact (TM0PostAdapter.thue_iff_tm0_eval_dom
    (TM1BinaryAdapter.finiteMachine B M S hS)
    (TM1BinaryAdapter.encodeInput B input)).trans
      (TM1BinaryAdapter.finite_eval_dom_iff B M S hS input)

name: Undecidability.SupportedTM1Thue.system_finite
statement:
theorem system_finite (B : TM1BinaryAdapter.Code Γ)
    (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ) (hS : TM1.Supports M S) :
    Set.Finite (PostMachine.system (postMachine B M S hS))
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited (State B M S) :=
    TM1BinaryAdapter.finiteStateInhabited B M S hS
  exact TM0PostAdapter.thue_system_finite
    (TM1BinaryAdapter.finiteMachine B M S hS)

name: Undecidability.fixedUniversalEval_partrec
statement: theorem fixedUniversalEval_partrec : Partrec fixedUniversalEval
proof:
:=
  Nat.Partrec.Code.eval_part.comp
    ((Computable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code).comp Computable.id)
    (Computable.const 0)

name: Undecidability.exists_fixed_universal_code
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_universal_code :
    ∃ c : ToPartrec.Code, ∀ n,
      (c.eval [n]).Dom ↔ (fixedUniversalEval n).Dom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ToPartrec.Code.exists_code
    (Nat.Partrec'.part_iff₁.mpr fixedUniversalEval_partrec)
  refine ⟨c, fun n => ?_⟩
  have h := hc (n ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil)
  have hv : (n ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil).1 = [n] := by rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  simpa using congrArg Part.Dom h

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.tm2_eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem tm2_eval_dom_iff (c : ToPartrec.Code) (n : ℕ) :
    letI : Inhabited State :=
      ⟨PartrecToTM2.trNormal c PartrecToTM2.Cont'.halt⟩
    (TM2.eval PartrecToTM2.tr PartrecToTM2.K'.main
      (PartrecToTM2.trList [n])).Dom ↔
      (c.eval [n]).Dom
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited State :=
    ⟨PartrecToTM2.trNormal c PartrecToTM2.Cont'.halt⟩
  have hinit :
      TM2.init PartrecToTM2.K'.main (PartrecToTM2.trList [n]) =
        PartrecToTM2.init c [n] := by
    unfold TM2.init PartrecToTM2.init
    congr 1
    funext k
    cases k <;> rfl
  unfold TM2.eval
  rw [hinit, PartrecToTM2.tr_eval]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.trNum_bit
statement:
private theorem trNum_bit (b : Bool) (n : Num)
    (h : b = true ∨ n ≠ 0) :
    PartrecToTM2.trNum (Num.bit b n) =
      (if b then PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1 else PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0) ::
        PartrecToTM2.trNum n
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_or] at h
    cases n with
    | zero => exact (h rfl).elim
    | pos p => rfl
  · cases n <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.trNat_bit
statement:
private theorem trNat_bit (b : Bool) (n : ℕ)
    (h : b = true ∨ n ≠ 0) :
    PartrecToTM2.trNat (Nat.bit b n) =
      (if b then PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1 else PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0) ::
        PartrecToTM2.trNat n
proof:
:= by
  unfold PartrecToTM2.trNat
  change PartrecToTM2.trNum (Num.ofNat' (Nat.bit b n)) =
    _ :: PartrecToTM2.trNum (Num.ofNat' n)
  rw [Num.ofNat'_bit]
  exact trNum_bit b n <| h.imp_right fun hn hcast => hn <| by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : Num => (x : ℕ)) hcast

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.trNat_computable
statement: theorem trNat_computable : Computable PartrecToTM2.trNat
proof:
:= by
  let g : Unit → List (List Symbol) → Option (List Symbol) := fun _ ih =>
    ih.length.casesOn (some []) fun k =>
      some ((if (k + 1).bodd then PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1
        else PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0) :: ih.getI (k + 1).div2)
  have hsym : Computable₂ fun (_ : Unit × List (List Symbol)) (k : ℕ) =>
      if (k + 1).bodd then PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1 else PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0 := by
    unfold Computable₂
    exact (Computable.cond
      (Computable.nat_bodd.comp (Computable.succ.comp
        (Computable.snd : Computable (fun p :
          (Unit × List (List Symbol)) × ℕ => p.2))))
      (Computable.const PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1)
      (Computable.const PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0)).of_eq fun p => by
        simp only [Nat.add_one, Nat.bodd_succ]
        cases p.2.bodd <;> rfl
  have hget : Computable₂ fun (p : Unit × List (List Symbol)) (k : ℕ) =>
      p.2.getI (k + 1).div2 :=
    (Primrec.list_getI.to_comp.comp
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)
      (Computable.nat_div2.comp (Computable.succ.comp Computable.snd))).to₂
  have htail : Computable₂ fun (p : Unit × List (List Symbol)) (k : ℕ) =>
      some ((if (k + 1).bodd then PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit1
        else PartrecToTM2.Γ'.bit0) ::
          p.2.getI (k + 1).div2) :=
    Computable.option_some.comp₂ (Computable.list_cons.comp₂ hsym hget)
  have hg : Computable₂ g := by
    unfold Computable₂
    dsimp only [g]
    apply Computable.nat_casesOn
    · exact Computable.list_length.comp Computable.snd
    · exact Computable.const (some [])
    · exact htail
  have hrec := Computable.nat_strong_rec
    (fun _ n => PartrecToTM2.trNat n) hg
  have hspec : ∀ (_ : Unit) n,
      g Unit.unit ((List.range n).map PartrecToTM2.trNat) =
        some (PartrecToTM2.trNat n) := by
    intro _ n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [g, PartrecToTM2.trNat_zero]
    | succ n =>
      have hlt : (n + 1).div2 < n + 1 :=
        Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by decide)
      have hb : (n + 1).bodd = true ∨ (n + 1).div2 ≠ 0 := by
        by_cases hzero : (n + 1).div2 = 0
        · left
          have hn : n = 0 := by
            rw [Nat.div2_val] at hzero
            omega
          subst n
          rfl
        · exact Or.inr hzero
      simp only [g, List.length_map, List.length_range]
      rw [List.getI_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map,
        List.getElem?_range hlt]
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
      rw [← trNat_bit (n + 1).bodd (n + 1).div2 hb,
        Nat.bit_bodd_div2]
  exact (hrec hspec).comp (Computable.const Unit.unit) Computable.id

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.trSingleton_computable
statement:
theorem trSingleton_computable :
    Computable fun n => PartrecToTM2.trList [n]
proof:
:=
  (Computable.list_append.comp trNat_computable
    (Computable.const [PartrecToTM2.Γ'.cons])).of_eq fun n => by
      simp

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.trInit_main_computable
statement:
theorem trInit_main_computable :
    Computable (fun L : List Symbol =>
      @TM2to1.trInit Stack (fun _ : Stack => Symbol)
        inferInstance PartrecToTM2.K'.main L)
proof:
:= by
  let putMain : Symbol → TapeSymbol := fun a =>
    (false, Function.update (fun _ : Stack => none)
      PartrecToTM2.K'.main (some a))
  have hputMain : Computable putMain :=
    (Primrec.dom_finite putMain).to_comp
  have hencoded : Computable fun L : List Symbol =>
      L.reverse.map putMain :=
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
      ((Primrec.dom_finite putMain).comp₂ Primrec₂.right)).to_comp.comp
        Computable.list_reverse
  have hhead : Computable fun L : List Symbol =>
      (L.reverse.map putMain).headI.2 :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Primrec.list_headI.to_comp.comp hencoded)
  have hfirst : Computable fun L : List Symbol =>
      (true, (L.reverse.map putMain).headI.2) :=
    (Computable.const true).pair hhead
  have htail : Computable fun L : List Symbol =>
      (L.reverse.map putMain).tail :=
    Primrec.list_tail.to_comp.comp hencoded
  exact (Computable.list_cons.comp hfirst htail).of_eq fun L => by
    rfl

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.postInput_computable
statement: theorem postInput_computable : Computable postInput
proof:
:=
  trInit_main_computable.comp trSingleton_computable

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.postInput_encode_computable
statement:
theorem postInput_encode_computable :
    Computable fun p : Nat.Partrec.Code => postInput (Encodable.encode p)
proof:
:=
  postInput_computable.comp Computable.encode

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.post_eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem post_eval_dom_iff (c : ToPartrec.Code) (n : ℕ) :
    @Part.Dom (ListBlank TapeSymbol)
      (@TM0.eval TapeSymbol PostState (postStateInhabited c) inferInstance
        (postMachine c) (postInput n)) ↔ (c.eval [n]).Dom
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited State := stateInhabited c
  let : Inhabited OneTapeState := oneTapeStateInhabited c
  let : Inhabited PostState := postStateInhabited c
  rw [postMachine, TM1to0.tr_eval]
  exact (TM2to1.tr_eval_dom PartrecToTM2.tr
    PartrecToTM2.K'.main (PartrecToTM2.trList [n])).trans
      (tm2_eval_dom_iff c n)

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.oneTapeProgram_supports
proof:
:= by
  let : Inhabited State := stateInhabited c
  let : Inhabited OneTapeState := oneTapeStateInhabited c
  apply TM2to1.tr_supports
  exact PartrecToTM2.tr_supports c PartrecToTM2.Cont'.halt

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.post_halting_not_computable
statement:
theorem post_halting_not_computable (c : ToPartrec.Code)
    (hc : ∀ n, (c.eval [n]).Dom ↔ (fixedUniversalEval n).Dom) :
    ¬ ComputablePred fun input : List TapeSymbol =>
      (@TM0.eval TapeSymbol PostState (postStateInhabited c) inferInstance
        (postMachine c) input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  intro hhalting
  have hencoded : ComputablePred fun p : Nat.Partrec.Code =>
      (@TM0.eval TapeSymbol PostState (postStateInhabited c) inferInstance
        (postMachine c) (postInput (Encodable.encode p))).Dom :=
    ComputablePred.computable_of_manyOneReducible
      ⟨fun p => postInput (Encodable.encode p), postInput_encode_computable,
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩ hhalting
  apply ComputablePred.halting_problem 0
  exact hencoded.of_eq fun p => by
    rw [post_eval_dom_iff, hc]
    simp [fixedUniversalEval]

name: Undecidability.FixedMachine.oneTape_halting_not_computable
statement:
theorem oneTape_halting_not_computable (c : ToPartrec.Code)
    (hc : ∀ n, (c.eval [n]).Dom ↔ (fixedUniversalEval n).Dom) :
    ¬ ComputablePred fun input : List TapeSymbol =>
      (@TM1.eval TapeSymbol OneTapeState (Option Symbol)
        (oneTapeStateInhabited c) inferInstance inferInstance
        oneTapeProgram input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  intro hhalting
  apply post_halting_not_computable c hc
  exact hhalting.of_eq fun input => by
    let : Inhabited OneTapeState := oneTapeStateInhabited c
    let : Inhabited PostState := postStateInhabited c
    rw [postMachine, TM1to0.tr_eval]

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.terminates_of_halted
statement:
theorem terminates_of_halted {C : Type*} {step : C → Option C} {c : C}
    (h : step c = none) : Terminates step c
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, by simp [iterate, h]⟩

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.terminates_of_step
statement:
theorem terminates_of_step {C : Type*} {step : C → Option C} {c d : C}
    (hcd : step c = some d) (hd : Terminates step d) : Terminates step c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hd
  exact ⟨n + 1, by simp [iterate, hcd, hn]⟩

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.terminates_after_step
statement:
theorem terminates_after_step {C : Type*} {step : C → Option C} {c d : C}
    (hcd : step c = some d) (hc : Terminates step c) : Terminates step d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hc
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [iterate] at hn
  | succ n =>
      exact ⟨n, by simpa [iterate, hcd] using hn⟩

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.terminates_iff_reaches_halt
statement:
theorem terminates_iff_reaches_halt {C : Type*} {step : C → Option C} {c : C} :
    Terminates step c ↔
      ∃ h, StateTransition.Reaches step c h ∧ step h = none
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    induction n generalizing c with
    | zero => simp [iterate] at hn
    | succ n ih =>
        cases hc : step c with
        | none => exact ⟨c, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hc⟩
        | some d =>
            have hd : iterate step n d = none := by
              simpa [iterate, hc] using hn
            obtain ⟨h, hdh, hh⟩ := ih hd
            exact ⟨h, Relation.ReflTransGen.head hc hdh, hh⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hch, hh⟩
    induction hch using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
    | refl => exact terminates_of_halted hh
    | head hcd _ ih => exact terminates_of_step hcd ih

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.terminates_iff_eval_dom
statement:
theorem terminates_iff_eval_dom {C : Type*} {step : C → Option C} {c : C} :
    Terminates step c ↔ (StateTransition.eval step c).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [terminates_iff_reaches_halt, Part.dom_iff_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hreach, hhalt⟩
    exact ⟨h, StateTransition.mem_eval.mpr ⟨hreach, hhalt⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, heval⟩
    obtain ⟨hreach, hhalt⟩ := StateTransition.mem_eval.mp heval
    exact ⟨h, hreach, hhalt⟩

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.Coding.simulation
statement:
theorem simulation {c : C} :
    Terminates K.step c → ThueEq K.system (K.encode c) K.target
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp [iterate] at hn
  | succ n ih =>
      cases hstep : K.step c with
      | none => exact K.simulate_halt hstep
      | some d =>
          have hd : iterate K.step n d = none := by
            simpa [iterate, hstep] using hn
          exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (K.simulate_step hstep)).trans
            (ih hd)

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.Coding.inverse_simulation
statement:
theorem inverse_simulation {c : C} :
    ThueEq K.system (K.encode c) K.target → Terminates K.step c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let motive := fun (w : List α) (_ : ThueEq K.system w K.target) =>
    ∀ c, w = K.encode c → Terminates K.step c
  have hall : motive (K.encode c) h := by
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on (motive := motive) h
    · intro c hc
      exact (K.target_ne_encode c hc).elim
    · intro x y hxy hyz ih c hc
      subst x
      cases hstep : K.step c with
      | none => exact terminates_of_halted hstep
      | some d =>
          rcases K.classify hstep hxy with hforward | ⟨p, hback, hp⟩
          · subst hforward
            exact terminates_of_step hstep (ih d rfl)
          · subst hback
            exact terminates_after_step hp (ih p rfl)
  exact hall c rfl

name: Undecidability.MachineThue.Coding.terminates_iff
statement:
theorem terminates_iff {c : C} :
    Terminates K.step c ↔ ThueEq K.system (K.encode c) K.target
proof:
:=
  ⟨K.simulation, K.inverse_simulation⟩

name: Undecidability.TM0FiniteRestriction.liftState_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftState_coe (M : TM0.Machine Gamma Q) (S : Finset Q)
    (hS : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Q)) {q : Q} (hq : q ∈ S) :
    (liftState M S hS q : Q) = q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [liftState, hq]

name: Undecidability.TM0FiniteRestriction.step_map
statement:
theorem step_map (M : TM0.Machine Gamma Q) (S : Finset Q)
    (hS : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Q)) (c : TM0.Cfg Gamma S) :
    Option.map (includeCfg S)
        (@TM0.step Gamma S (supportedInhabited M S hS) inferInstance
          (machine M S hS) c) =
      TM0.step M (includeCfg S c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases c with ⟨q, tape⟩
  simp only [TM0.step, includeCfg]
  cases h : M q.1 tape.head with
  | none => simp [machine, h]
  | some cmd =>
      rcases cmd with ⟨q', stmt⟩
      have hq' : q' ∈ S := hS.2 h q.2
      cases stmt <;>
        simp [machine, h, includeCfg, liftState_coe M S hS hq']

name: Undecidability.TM0FiniteRestriction.respects
statement:
theorem respects (M : TM0.Machine Gamma Q) (S : Finset Q)
    (hS : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Q)) :
    StateTransition.Respects
      (@TM0.step Gamma S (supportedInhabited M S hS) inferInstance
        (machine M S hS))
      (TM0.step M)
      (fun c d => includeCfg S c = d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [StateTransition.fun_respects]
  intro c
  cases h : @TM0.step Gamma S (supportedInhabited M S hS) inferInstance
      (machine M S hS) c with
  | none =>
      have hm := step_map M S hS c
      simp [h] at hm
      exact hm.symm
  | some d =>
      have hm := step_map M S hS c
      rw [h] at hm
      exact Relation.TransGen.single (by simpa using hm.symm)

name: Undecidability.TM0FiniteRestriction.init_include
statement:
theorem init_include (M : TM0.Machine Gamma Q) (S : Finset Q)
    (hS : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Q)) (input : List Gamma) :
    includeCfg S
        (@TM0.init Gamma S (supportedInhabited M S hS) inferInstance input) =
      TM0.init input
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.TM0FiniteRestriction.eval_dom_iff
statement:
