theorem eval_dom_iff (M : TM0.Machine Gamma Q) (S : Finset Q)
    (hS : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Q)) (input : List Gamma) :
    (@TM0.eval Gamma S (supportedInhabited M S hS) inferInstance
        (machine M S hS) input).Dom ↔
      (TM0.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  unfold TM0.eval
  simpa using (StateTransition.tr_eval_dom (respects M S hS)
    (init_include M S hS input)).symm

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.exists_code
statement: theorem exists_code (Γ : Type*) [Inhabited Γ] [Finite Γ] : Nonempty (Code Γ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, enc, dec, hblank, hinv⟩ := TM1to1.exists_enc_dec (Γ := Γ)
  exact ⟨⟨n, enc, dec, hblank, hinv⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.encodeInput_computable
statement:
theorem encodeInput_computable [Primcodable Γ] [Finite Γ] (B : Code Γ) :
    Computable (encodeInput B)
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id
    ((Primrec.dom_finite (fun a : Γ => (B.enc a).toList)).comp₂
      Primrec₂.right)).to_comp

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.trCfg_init
proof:
:= by
  simp [TM1to1.trCfg, TM1.init, TM1to1.trTape, TM1to1.trTape',
    Turing.Tape.mk₁, Turing.Tape.mk₂, encodeInput]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.program_eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem program_eval_dom_iff (B : Code Γ) (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ)
    (input : List Γ) :
    (TM1.eval (program B M) (encodeInput B input)).Dom ↔
      (TM1.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  unfold TM1.eval
  simpa [program, trCfg_init (Λ := Λ) (σ := σ) B input] using
    StateTransition.tr_eval_dom
      (TM1to1.tr_respects (enc := B.enc) B.dec M
        (enc0 := B.enc_blank) B.dec_enc)
      (show TM1to1.trCfg B.enc B.enc_blank
          (TM1.init input : TM1.Cfg Γ Λ σ) =
          TM1.init (encodeInput B input) from
            trCfg_init (Λ := Λ) (σ := σ) B input)

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem eval_dom_iff (B : Code Γ) (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ)
    (input : List Γ) :
    (TM0.eval (machine B M) (encodeInput B input)).Dom ↔
      (TM1.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [machine, TM1to0.tr_eval]
  exact program_eval_dom_iff B M input

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.machine_supports
statement:
theorem machine_supports [Fintype Γ] [Fintype σ]
    (B : Code Γ) (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hS : TM1.Supports M S) :
    TM0.Supports (machine B M) (support B M S : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  apply TM1to0.tr_supports
  exact TM1to1.tr_supports B.enc B.dec M hS

name: Undecidability.TM1BinaryAdapter.finite_eval_dom_iff
statement:
theorem finite_eval_dom_iff [Fintype Γ] [Fintype σ]
    (B : Code Γ) (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hS : TM1.Supports M S) (input : List Γ) :
    (@TM0.eval Bool (support B M S) (finiteStateInhabited B M S hS)
        inferInstance (finiteMachine B M S hS) (encodeInput B input)).Dom ↔
      (TM1.eval M input).Dom
proof:
:=
  (TM0FiniteRestriction.eval_dom_iff
    (machine B M) (support B M S) (machine_supports B M S hS)
    (encodeInput B input)).trans (eval_dom_iff B M input)

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.system_finite
statement:
theorem system_finite {Q : Type*} [Finite Q] (M : Machine Q) :
    Set.Finite (system M)
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ := Set.range (@haltPair Q)
  let S₁ := Set.range (@eraseLeftPair Q)
  let S₂ := Set.range (@eraseRightPair Q)
  let S₃ := Set.range (@moveLeftBoundaryPair Q)
  let S₄ := Set.range (@moveLeftPair Q)
  let S₅ := Set.range (@moveRightBoundaryPair Q)
  let S₆ := Set.range (@moveRightPair Q)
  have hf : Set.Finite (S₀ ∪ S₁ ∪ S₂ ∪ S₃ ∪ S₄ ∪ S₅ ∪ S₆) :=
    ((((((Set.finite_range _).union (Set.finite_range _)).union
      (Set.finite_range _)).union (Set.finite_range _)).union
      (Set.finite_range _)).union (Set.finite_range _)).union
      (Set.finite_range _)
  refine hf.subset ?_
  intro p hp
  rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
  change Rule M x y at hp
  cases hp with
  | @halt q a h =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.leftMarker, Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q, Symbol.rightMarker],
            [Symbol.rightMarker, Symbol.leftMarker]) ∈ S₀ :=
        ⟨(q, a), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or]
  | @eraseLeft q a h b =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.tape b, Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q],
            [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q]) ∈ S₁ :=
        ⟨(q, a, b), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or, or_true]
  | @eraseRight q a h b =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q, Symbol.tape b],
            [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q]) ∈ S₂ :=
        ⟨(q, a, b), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or, or_true]
  | @moveLeftBoundary q a q' a' h =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.leftMarker, Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q],
            [Symbol.leftMarker, Symbol.tape false, Symbol.state q', Symbol.tape a']) ∈ S₃ :=
        ⟨(q, a, q', a'), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or, or_true]
  | @moveLeft q a q' a' h b =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.tape b, Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q],
            [Symbol.tape b, Symbol.state q', Symbol.tape a']) ∈ S₄ :=
        ⟨(q, a, q', a', b), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or, or_true]
  | @moveRightBoundary q a q' a' h =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q, Symbol.rightMarker],
            [Symbol.tape a', Symbol.tape false, Symbol.state q', Symbol.rightMarker]) ∈ S₅ :=
        ⟨(q, a, q', a'), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, true_or, or_true]
  | @moveRight q a q' a' h b =>
      have hs :
          ([Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q, Symbol.tape b],
            [Symbol.tape a', Symbol.tape b, Symbol.state q']) ∈ S₆ :=
        ⟨(q, a, q', a', b), rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_union, hs, or_true]

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.rule_step
proof:
:=
  ⟨l, r, x, y, hxy, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.simulation_step
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨q, left, a, right⟩
  simp only [step] at hcd
  split at hcd
  next h => contradiction
  next cmd hcmd =>
    rcases cmd with ⟨q', a', move⟩
    cases move with
    | left =>
        cases left with
        | nil =>
            simp only at hcd
            injection hcd with hd
            subst d
            simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse] using
              rule_step (Rule.moveLeftBoundary hcmd) ([] : List (Symbol Q))
                (encodeTape right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker])
        | cons b left =>
            simp only at hcd
            injection hcd with hd
            subst d
            simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse, List.reverse_cons,
              List.map_append, List.append_assoc] using
              rule_step (Rule.moveLeft hcmd b)
                (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape left.reverse)
                (encodeTape right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker])
    | right =>
        cases right with
        | nil =>
            simp only at hcd
            injection hcd with hd
            subst d
            simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse, List.append_assoc] using
              rule_step (Rule.moveRightBoundary hcmd)
                (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape left.reverse)
                ([] : List (Symbol Q))
        | cons b right =>
            simp only at hcd
            injection hcd with hd
            subst d
            simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse, List.append_assoc] using
              rule_step (Rule.moveRight hcmd b)
                (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape left.reverse)
                (encodeTape right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker])

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.erase_left
statement:
private theorem erase_left {Q : Type*} (M : Machine Q)
    (q : Q) (a : Bool) (right left : List Bool) (hhalt : M q a = none) :
    ThueEq (system M) (encode ⟨q, left, a, right⟩)
      (encode ⟨q, [], a, right⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction left with
  | nil => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | cons b left ih =>
      have hs := rule_step (Rule.eraseLeft hhalt b)
        (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape left.reverse)
        (encodeTape right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker])
      have hs' : ThueStep (system M) (encode ⟨q, b :: left, a, right⟩)
          (encode ⟨q, left, a, right⟩) := by
        simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse, List.reverse_cons,
          List.map_append, List.append_assoc] using hs
      exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hs').trans ih

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.erase_right
statement:
private theorem erase_right {Q : Type*} (M : Machine Q)
    (q : Q) (a : Bool) (left right : List Bool) (hhalt : M q a = none) :
    ThueEq (system M) (encode ⟨q, left, a, right⟩)
      (encode ⟨q, left, a, []⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction right with
  | nil => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | cons b right ih =>
      have hs := rule_step (Rule.eraseRight hhalt b)
        (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape left.reverse)
        (encodeTape right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker])
      have hs' : ThueStep (system M) (encode ⟨q, left, a, b :: right⟩)
          (encode ⟨q, left, a, right⟩) := by
        simpa [encode, encodeTape, List.map_reverse, List.append_assoc] using hs
      exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hs').trans ih

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.simulation_halt
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨q, left, a, right⟩
  have hhalt : M q a = none := by
    cases h : M q a with
    | none => rfl
    | some cmd => simp [step, h] at hc
  refine (erase_left M q a right left hhalt).trans
    ((erase_right M q a [] right hhalt).trans ?_)
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single <| by
    simpa [encode, encodeTape, target] using
      rule_step (Rule.halt hhalt) ([] : List (Symbol Q)) []

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.target_ne_encode
statement:
theorem target_ne_encode {Q : Type*} (c : Config Q) :
    (target : List (Symbol Q)) ≠ encode c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg List.head? h
  simp [target, encode] at this

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.state_not_mem_encodeTape
statement:
private theorem state_not_mem_encodeTape {Q : Type*} (q : Q) (w : List Bool) :
    Symbol.state q ∉ (encodeTape w : List (Symbol Q))
proof:
:= by
  simp [encodeTape]

proof:
:= by

proof:

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.stateCount_state_cons

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.stateCount_encodeTape
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
      change stateCount (Symbol.tape b :: encodeTape w) = 0

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.stateCount_append
proof:

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.stateCount_encode
proof:
:= by
  have stateCount_nil : stateCount ([] : List (Symbol Q)) = 0 := rfl
  simp only [encode, stateCount_append, stateCount_encodeTape,
    stateCount_leftMarker_cons, stateCount_tape_cons, stateCount_state_cons,
    stateCount_rightMarker_cons, stateCount_nil]

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.append_state_unique
proof:
:= by
  induction A generalizing B with
  | nil =>
      cases B with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append] at h
          injection h with hq hRS
          injection hq with hqq
          exact ⟨rfl, hqq, hRS⟩
      | cons b B =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
          injection h with hb _
          have hm : Symbol.state q ∈ b :: B := by simp [← hb]
          exact (hB q hm).elim
  | cons a A ih =>
      cases B with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h
          injection h with ha _
          have hm : Symbol.state q' ∈ a :: A := by simp [ha]
          exact (hA q' hm).elim
      | cons b B =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at h
          injection h with hab htail
          subst b
          have hAt : ∀ p, Symbol.state p ∉ A := by
            intro p hp
            exact hA p (by simp [hp])
          have hBt : ∀ p, Symbol.state p ∉ B := by
            intro p hp
            exact hB p (by simp [hp])
          obtain ⟨hAB, hqq, hRS⟩ := ih hAt hBt htail
          exact ⟨by simp [hAB], hqq, hRS⟩

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.encode_eq_tape_state
statement:
private theorem encode_eq_tape_state {Q : Type*} (c : Config Q)
    (u v : List (Symbol Q)) (a : Bool) (q : Q)
    (h : encode c = u ++ [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++ v) :
    c.head = a ∧ c.state = q ∧
      u = Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape c.left.reverse ∧
      v = encodeTape c.right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker]
proof:
:= by
  let A : List (Symbol Q) :=
    Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape c.left.reverse ++ [Symbol.tape c.head]
  let B : List (Symbol Q) := u ++ [Symbol.tape a]
  have h' : A ++ Symbol.state c.state ::
      (encodeTape c.right ++ [Symbol.rightMarker]) =
      B ++ Symbol.state q :: v := by
    calc
      _ = encode c := by simp [A, encode, List.append_assoc]
      _ = u ++ [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++ v := h
      _ = _ := by simp [B, List.append_assoc]
  have hA : ∀ p, Symbol.state p ∉ A := by
    intro p
    simp [A, state_not_mem_encodeTape]
  have hcount := congrArg stateCount h
  have hu0 : stateCount u = 0 := by
    have stateCount_nil : stateCount ([] : List (Symbol Q)) = 0 := rfl
    simp only [stateCount_encode, stateCount_append, stateCount_tape_cons,
      stateCount_state_cons, stateCount_nil] at hcount
    omega
  have hB : ∀ p, Symbol.state p ∉ B := by
    intro p
    simp only [B, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    rintro (hp | hp)
    · have hz := (List.countP_eq_zero.mp hu0) (Symbol.state p) hp
      simp [isState] at hz
    · simp at hp
  obtain ⟨hAB, hstate, hv⟩ := append_state_unique hA hB h'
  have htail :
      (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape c.left.reverse) ++
          [Symbol.tape c.head] = u ++ [Symbol.tape a] := by
    simpa [A, B, List.append_assoc] using hAB
  have hlast := congrArg List.reverse htail
  have hhead : c.head = a := by
    simp only [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_singleton] at hlast
    injection hlast with htape _
    injection htape
  subst a
  have hu : u = Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape c.left.reverse := by
    apply List.append_cancel_right
    exact htail.symm
  exact ⟨rfl, hstate, hu, hv.symm⟩

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.append_leftMarker_ne_encodeTape
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing u with
  | nil => simp [encodeTape]
  | cons b w ih =>
      cases u with
      | nil => simp [encodeTape]
      | cons x u =>
          simp only [encodeTape, List.map_cons, List.cons_append]
          intro h
          injection h with _ ht
          exact ih u ht

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.append_leftMarker_eq
statement:
private theorem append_leftMarker_eq {Q : Type*}
    (u : List (Symbol Q)) (w : List Bool)
    (h : u ++ [Symbol.leftMarker] =
      Symbol.leftMarker :: (encodeTape w : List (Symbol Q))) :
    u = [] ∧ w = []
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil =>
      simp [encodeTape] at h
      exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
  | cons b w =>
      cases u with
      | nil => simp [encodeTape] at h
      | cons x u =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at h
          injection h with _ ht
          exact (append_leftMarker_ne_encodeTape u (b :: w) ht).elim

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.append_tape_eq_left
statement:
private theorem append_tape_eq_left {Q : Type*}
    (u : List (Symbol Q)) (left : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (h : u ++ [Symbol.tape b] =
      Symbol.leftMarker :: (encodeTape left.reverse : List (Symbol Q))) :
    ∃ rest, left = b :: rest ∧
      u = Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape rest.reverse
proof:
:= by
  cases left with
  | nil =>
      cases u <;> simp [encodeTape] at h
  | cons b' rest =>
      have htail : u ++ [Symbol.tape b] =
          (Symbol.leftMarker :: encodeTape rest.reverse) ++
            [Symbol.tape b'] := by
        simpa [encodeTape, List.reverse_cons, List.map_append,
          List.append_assoc] using h
      have hlast := congrArg List.reverse htail
      have hb : b = b' := by
        simp only [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_singleton] at hlast
        injection hlast with htape _
        injection htape
      subst b'
      refine ⟨rest, rfl, ?_⟩
      apply List.append_cancel_right
      exact htail

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.rightMarker_cons_eq
statement:
private theorem rightMarker_cons_eq {Q : Type*}
    (r : List (Symbol Q)) (w : List Bool)
    (h : Symbol.rightMarker :: r =
      (encodeTape w : List (Symbol Q)) ++ [Symbol.rightMarker]) :
    r = [] ∧ w = []
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil =>
      simp [encodeTape] at h
      exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
  | cons b w => simp [encodeTape] at h

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.tape_cons_eq_right
statement:
private theorem tape_cons_eq_right {Q : Type*}
    (r : List (Symbol Q)) (right : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (h : Symbol.tape b :: r =
      (encodeTape right : List (Symbol Q)) ++ [Symbol.rightMarker]) :
    ∃ rest, right = b :: rest ∧
      r = encodeTape rest ++ [Symbol.rightMarker]
proof:
:= by
  cases right with
  | nil => simp [encodeTape] at h
  | cons b' rest =>
      simp only [encodeTape, List.map_cons, List.cons_append] at h
      injection h with hb hr
      injection hb with hbb
      exact ⟨rest, by simp [hbb], hr⟩

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.markers_encode
proof:
:= by
  have markers_nil : markers ([] : List (Symbol Q)) = [] := rfl
  simp only [encode, markers_append, markers_encodeTape,
    markers_leftMarker_cons, markers_tape_cons, markers_state_cons,

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.markers_target
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.target_not_occurs
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm : [false, true] = markers l ++ [true, false] ++ markers r := by
    simpa only [markers_encode, markers_append, markers_target] using
      congrArg markers h
  have hlen := congrArg List.length hm
  have hl : (markers l).length = 0 := by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_append] at hlen
    omega
  have hr : (markers r).length = 0 := by
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_append] at hlen
    omega
  have hlnil : markers l = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
  have hrnil : markers r = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hr
  simp [hlnil, hrnil] at hm

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.forward_rule_of_step
proof:
:= by
  cases hrule with
  | @halt q a hhalt =>
      have ho : encode c = (l ++ [Symbol.leftMarker]) ++
          [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++
          (Symbol.rightMarker :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, -, -⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      have hc : M c.state c.head = none := by simpa [ha, hq] using hhalt
      simp [step, hc] at hstep
  | @eraseLeft q a hhalt b =>
      have ho : encode c = (l ++ [Symbol.tape b]) ++
          [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++ r := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, -, -⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      have hc : M c.state c.head = none := by simpa [ha, hq] using hhalt
      simp [step, hc] at hstep
  | @eraseRight q a hhalt b =>
      have ho : encode c = l ++ [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++
          (Symbol.tape b :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, -, -⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      have hc : M c.state c.head = none := by simpa [ha, hq] using hhalt
      simp [step, hc] at hstep
  | @moveLeftBoundary q a q' a' hcmd =>
      have ho : encode c = (l ++ [Symbol.leftMarker]) ++
          [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++ r := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      obtain ⟨hl, hleftrev⟩ := append_leftMarker_eq l c.left.reverse hp
      have hleft : c.left = [] := by simpa using hleftrev
      have hc : M c.state c.head = some ⟨q', a', Direction.left⟩ := by
        simpa [ha, hq] using hcmd
      have hd : d = ⟨q', [], false, a' :: c.right⟩ := by
        simpa [step, hc, hleft] using hstep.symm
      subst d
      rw [hl, hs]
      simp [encode, encodeTape]
  | @moveLeft q a q' a' hcmd b =>
      have ho : encode c = (l ++ [Symbol.tape b]) ++
          [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++ r := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      obtain ⟨left, hleft, hl⟩ := append_tape_eq_left l c.left b hp
      have hc : M c.state c.head = some ⟨q', a', Direction.left⟩ := by
        simpa [ha, hq] using hcmd
      have hd : d = ⟨q', left, b, a' :: c.right⟩ := by
        simpa [step, hc, hleft] using hstep.symm
      subst d
      rw [hl, hs]
      simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]
  | @moveRightBoundary q a q' a' hcmd =>
      have ho : encode c = l ++ [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++
          (Symbol.rightMarker :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      obtain ⟨hr, hright⟩ := rightMarker_cons_eq r c.right hs
      have hc : M c.state c.head = some ⟨q', a', Direction.right⟩ := by
        simpa [ha, hq] using hcmd
      have hd : d = ⟨q', a' :: c.left, false, []⟩ := by
        simpa [step, hc, hright] using hstep.symm
      subst d
      rw [hp, hr]
      simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]
  | @moveRight q a q' a' hcmd b =>
      have ho : encode c = l ++ [Symbol.tape a, Symbol.state q] ++
          (Symbol.tape b :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ := encode_eq_tape_state c _ _ a q ho
      obtain ⟨right, hright, hr⟩ := tape_cons_eq_right r c.right b hs
      have hc : M c.state c.head = some ⟨q', a', Direction.right⟩ := by
        simpa [ha, hq] using hcmd
      have hd : d = ⟨q', a' :: c.left, b, right⟩ := by
        simpa [step, hc, hright] using hstep.symm
      subst d
      rw [hp, hr]
      simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.backward_rule_of_step
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩
  cases hrule with
  | @halt q a hhalt =>
      have ht : encode (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q) =
          l ++ (target : List (Symbol Q)) ++ r := by
        simpa [target, List.append_assoc] using hsource
      exact (target_not_occurs ⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ l r ht).elim
  | @eraseLeft q a hhalt b =>
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, -, -⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          l r a q (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource)
      change a₀ = a at ha
      change qc = q at hq
      have hc : M qc a₀ = none := by simpa [ha, hq] using hhalt
      simp [step, hc] at hstep
  | @eraseRight q a hhalt b =>
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, -, -⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          l r a q (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource)
      change a₀ = a at ha
      change qc = q at hq
      have hc : M qc a₀ = none := by simpa [ha, hq] using hhalt
      simp [step, hc] at hstep
  | @moveLeftBoundary q a q' a' hcmd =>
      have ho : encode (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q) =
          (l ++ [Symbol.leftMarker]) ++
            [Symbol.tape false, Symbol.state q'] ++
            (Symbol.tape a' :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state
          (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          _ _ false q' ho
      change a₀ = false at ha
      change qc = q' at hq
      obtain ⟨hl, hleftrev⟩ := append_leftMarker_eq l left₀.reverse hp
      have hleft : left₀ = [] := by simpa using hleftrev
      obtain ⟨right, hright, hr⟩ :=
        tape_cons_eq_right r right₀ a' hs
      subst qc
      subst a₀
      subst left₀
      subst right₀
      refine ⟨⟨q, [], a, right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hl, hr]
        simp [encode, encodeTape]
      · simp [step, hcmd]
  | @moveLeft q a q' a' hcmd b =>
      have ho : encode (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q) =
          l ++ [Symbol.tape b, Symbol.state q'] ++
            (Symbol.tape a' :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state
          (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          _ _ b q' ho
      change a₀ = b at ha
      change qc = q' at hq
      obtain ⟨right, hright, hr⟩ :=
        tape_cons_eq_right r right₀ a' hs
      subst qc
      subst a₀
      subst right₀
      refine ⟨⟨q, b :: left₀, a, right⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hp, hr]
        simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]
      · simp [step, hcmd]
  | @moveRightBoundary q a q' a' hcmd =>
      have ho : encode (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q) =
          (l ++ [Symbol.tape a']) ++
            [Symbol.tape false, Symbol.state q'] ++
            (Symbol.rightMarker :: r) := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state
          (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          _ _ false q' ho
      change a₀ = false at ha
      change qc = q' at hq
      obtain ⟨left, hleft, hl⟩ := append_tape_eq_left l left₀ a' hp
      obtain ⟨hr, hright⟩ := rightMarker_cons_eq r right₀ hs
      subst qc
      subst a₀
      subst left₀
      subst right₀
      refine ⟨⟨q, left, a, []⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hl, hr]
        simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]
      · simp [step, hcmd]
  | @moveRight q a q' a' hcmd b =>
      have ho : encode (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q) =
          (l ++ [Symbol.tape a']) ++
            [Symbol.tape b, Symbol.state q'] ++ r := by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hsource
      obtain ⟨ha, hq, hp, hs⟩ :=
        encode_eq_tape_state
          (⟨qc, left₀, a₀, right₀⟩ : Config Q)
          _ _ b q' ho
      change a₀ = b at ha
      change qc = q' at hq
      obtain ⟨left, hleft, hl⟩ := append_tape_eq_left l left₀ a' hp
      subst qc
      subst a₀
      subst left₀
      refine ⟨⟨q, left, a, b :: right₀⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hl, hs]
        simp [encode, encodeTape, List.append_assoc]
      · simp [step, hcmd]

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.classify_step
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrew with ⟨l, r, x, y, hrule, h⟩
  change Rule M x y at hrule
  rcases h with ⟨hsource, htarget⟩ | ⟨hsource, htarget⟩
  · exact Or.inl <| htarget.trans (forward_rule_of_step hrule hsource hstep)
  · right
    obtain ⟨p, hpword, hpstep⟩ :=
      backward_rule_of_step hrule hsource hstep
    exact ⟨p, htarget.trans hpword, hpstep⟩

name: Undecidability.PostMachine.terminates_iff
statement:
theorem terminates_iff {Q : Type*} (M : Machine Q) (c : Config Q) :
    MachineThue.Terminates (step M) c ↔
      ThueEq (system M) (encode c) (target : List (Symbol Q))
proof:
:=
  @MachineThue.Coding.terminates_iff (Config Q) (Symbol Q) (coding M) c

name: Undecidability.CoprodIWordLength.singletonWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] private theorem singletonWord_prod {i : ι} (m : M i)
    (hm : m ≠ 1) :
    (singletonWord m hm : CoprodI.Word M).prod = CoprodI.of m
proof:
:= by
  change CoprodI.of m * 1 = CoprodI.of m
  exact mul_one _

name: Undecidability.CoprodIWordLength.twoWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] private theorem twoWord_prod {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (d : M i) (e : M j) (hd : d ≠ 1) (he : e ≠ 1) :
    (twoWord hij d e hd he : CoprodI.Word M).prod =
      CoprodI.of d * CoprodI.of e
proof:
:= by
  simp [twoWord, CoprodI.Word.prod_cons]

name: Undecidability.CoprodIWordLength.normalForm_length_mul_of_of_le_two
statement:
theorem normalForm_length_mul_of_of_le_two {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (d : M i) (e : M j) :
    (CoprodI.Word.equiv (CoprodI.of d * CoprodI.of e)).toList.length ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 1
  · subst d
    by_cases he : e = 1
    · subst e
      simp [CoprodI.Word.equiv, CoprodI.Word.empty]
    · have hword :
          CoprodI.Word.equiv (CoprodI.of (1 : M i) * CoprodI.of e) =
            singletonWord e he := by
        apply CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm.injective
        change _ = (singletonWord e he).prod
        simp
      rw [hword]
      change 1 ≤ 2
      decide
  · by_cases he : e = 1
    · subst e
      have hword :
          CoprodI.Word.equiv (CoprodI.of d * CoprodI.of (1 : M j)) =
            singletonWord d hd := by
        apply CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm.injective
        change _ = (singletonWord d hd).prod
        simp
      rw [hword]
      change 1 ≤ 2
      decide
    · have hword :
          CoprodI.Word.equiv (CoprodI.of d * CoprodI.of e) =
            twoWord hij d e hd he := by
        apply CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm.injective
        change _ = (twoWord hij d e hd he).prod
        simp
      rw [hword]
      change 2 ≤ 2
      exact le_rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.twistLetter_chain
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.isChain_map]
  exact hletters.imp fun x y hxy ↦ by simpa using hxy

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.c5_rulePower_ne_one
statement:
private theorem c5_rulePower_ne_one (i : Fin 3) :
    BorisovModFiveQuotient.c5Generator ^ (i.val + 1) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.rulePair_ne_one
statement:
private theorem rulePair_ne_one (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    ∀ x ∈ rulePair rules i, x.2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [rulePair, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl
  · exact c5_rulePower_ne_one i
  · exact twistLetter_ne_one (rules i).length
      ⟨1, BorisovModFiveQuotient.c5Generator ^ (i.val + 1)⟩
      (c5_rulePower_ne_one i)

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.baseLetters_ne_one
statement:
theorem baseLetters_ne_one (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    ∀ x ∈ baseLetters rules letters, x.2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [baseLetters]
  | cons q rest ih =>
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          simp only [baseLetters, List.mem_map]
          rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact twistLetter_ne_one 1 y (ih y hy)
      | inr i =>
          intro x hx
          rw [baseLetters, List.mem_append] at hx
          rcases hx with hx | hx
          · exact rulePair_ne_one rules i x hx
          · rcases List.mem_map.1 hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
            exact twistLetter_ne_one (rules i).length y (ih y hy)

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.baseLetters_head_fst
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [baseLetters]
  | cons q rest ih =>
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          rw [baseLetters, List.head?_map]
          intro x hx
          rcases Option.mem_map.1 hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          simpa using ih y hy
      | inr i => simp [baseLetters, rulePair]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.baseLetters_chain_ne
statement:
theorem baseLetters_chain_ne (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    (baseLetters rules letters).IsChain fun x y ↦ x.1 ≠ y.1
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [baseLetters]
  | cons q rest ih =>
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          simpa [baseLetters] using twistLetter_chain 1 ih
      | inr i =>
          rw [baseLetters]
          apply List.IsChain.append
          · simp [rulePair]
          · exact twistLetter_chain (rules i).length ih
          · intro x hx y hy
            have hxeq :
                (⟨1, (invertC5 ^ (rules i).length)
                  (BorisovModFiveQuotient.c5Generator ^ (i.val + 1))⟩ :
                    BaseLetter) = x := by
              simpa [rulePair] using hx
            have hx1 : x.1 = 1 := by
              rw [← hxeq]
            rw [List.head?_map] at hy
            rcases Option.mem_map.1 hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
            have hz0 : z.1 = 0 := baseLetters_head_fst rules rest z hz
            simp only [twistLetter_fst, hx1, hz0]
            decide

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.baseWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseWord_prod (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    (baseWord rules letters).prod = letterProd (baseLetters rules letters)
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.normalForm_letterProd
statement:
theorem normalForm_letterProd (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    CoprodI.Word.equiv (letterProd (baseLetters rules letters)) =
      baseWord rules letters
proof:
:= by
  apply CoprodI.Word.equiv.symm.injective
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change letterProd (baseLetters rules letters) =
    (baseWord rules letters).prod
  exact (baseWord_prod rules letters).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.normalForm_letterProd_length
statement:
theorem normalForm_letterProd_length (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    (CoprodI.Word.equiv
      (letterProd (baseLetters rules letters))).toList.length =
        2 * basisRuleCount letters
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalForm_letterProd]
  exact baseLetters_length rules letters

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveWordLength.normalForm_length_factor_zero_one_le_two
statement:
theorem normalForm_length_factor_zero_one_le_two (d e : C5) :
    (CoprodI.Word.equiv
      (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (0 : Fin 2)) d *
        CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (1 : Fin 2)) e)).toList.length ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  CoprodIWordLength.normalForm_length_mul_of_of_le_two
    (M := Factor5) (i := (0 : Fin 2)) (j := (1 : Fin 2)) (by decide) d e

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.invertFactorsHom_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem invertFactorsHom_of (i : Fin 2) (x : C5) :
    invertFactorsHom (Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := i) x) =
      Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := i) x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [invertFactorsHom, c5Inverse]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.invertFactorsHom_involutive
statement:
theorem invertFactorsHom_involutive (x : ModFiveBase) :
    invertFactorsHom (invertFactorsHom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Monoid.CoprodI.induction_on with
  | one => simp
  | of i x => simp
  | mul x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.invertFactors_modD
statement: @[simp] theorem invertFactors_modD : invertFactors modD = modD⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [invertFactors, modD]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.invertFactors_modE
statement: @[simp] theorem invertFactors_modE : invertFactors modE = modE⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [invertFactors, modE]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.inversionAction_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem inversionAction_one :
    inversionAction (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) = invertFactors
proof:
:= by
  simp [inversionAction]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.quotientStable_mul_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientStable_mul_base (x : ModFiveBase) :
    quotientStable * quotientBase x =
      quotientBase (invertFactors x) * quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext <;> simp [quotientStable, quotientBase]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.baseModFive_d
statement: @[simp] theorem baseModFive_d : baseModFive d = modD
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseModFive, d]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.baseModFive_e
statement: @[simp] theorem baseModFive_e : baseModFive e = modE
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseModFive, e]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.modD_pow_four
statement: theorem modD_pow_four : modD ^ 4 = modD⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [show modD = Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := (0 : Fin 2)) c5Generator by rfl,
    ← map_pow, ← map_inv]
  apply congrArg (Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := (0 : Fin 2)))
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (4 : ZMod 5) = -1
  decide

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.modE_pow_four
statement: theorem modE_pow_four : modE ^ 4 = modE⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [show modE = Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := (1 : Fin 2)) c5Generator by rfl,
    ← map_pow, ← map_inv]
  apply congrArg (Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := (1 : Fin 2)))
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (4 : ZMod 5) = -1
  decide

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.baseModFive_beta_eq_invert_alpha
statement:
theorem baseModFive_beta_eq_invert_alpha (x : Base) :
    baseModFive (beta x) = invertFactors (baseModFive (alpha x))
proof:
:= by
  let lhs : Base →* ModFiveBase := baseModFive.comp beta
  let rhs : Base →* ModFiveBase :=
    invertFactors.toMonoidHom.comp (baseModFive.comp alpha)
  have h : lhs = rhs := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change modD ^ 4 = invertFactors modD
      rw [modD_pow_four, invertFactors_modD]
    · change modE = invertFactors (modE ^ 4)
      rw [map_pow, invertFactors_modE, inv_pow, modE_pow_four, inv_inv]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.stable_power_relation
statement:
theorem stable_power_relation (x : Base) :
    quotientStable * baseToQuotient (alpha x) =
      baseToQuotient (beta x) * quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  change quotientStable * quotientBase (baseModFive (alpha x)) =
    quotientBase (baseModFive (beta x)) * quotientStable
  rw [quotientStable_mul_base, baseModFive_beta_eq_invert_alpha]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.firstLiftCondition
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := inA0.surjective a
  simpa using stable_power_relation x

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.stageOneToQuotient_of0
statement:
@[simp] theorem stageOneToQuotient_of0 (x : Base) :
    stageOneToQuotient (of0 x) = baseToQuotient x
proof:
:= by
  simp [stageOneToQuotient, of0]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.stageOneToQuotient_s1
statement:
@[simp] theorem stageOneToQuotient_s1 :
    stageOneToQuotient s1 = quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  simp [stageOneToQuotient, s1]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.secondLiftCondition
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a0, rfl⟩ := inA1.surjective a
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := inA0.surjective a0
  simpa [stageOneToQuotient, of0] using stable_power_relation x

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.gamma3ToQuotient_of1
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_of1 (x : Stage1) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (of1 x) = stageOneToQuotient x
proof:
:= by
  simp [gamma3ToQuotient, of1]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.gamma3ToQuotient_d3
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_d3 :
    gamma3ToQuotient d3 = quotientBase modD
proof:
:= by
  simp [d3, baseToQuotient, quotientBase]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.gamma3ToQuotient_e3
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_e3 :
    gamma3ToQuotient e3 = quotientBase modE
proof:
:= by
  simp [e3, baseToQuotient, quotientBase]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.gamma3ToQuotient_s1
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_s1 :
    gamma3ToQuotient s1_3 = quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  simp [s1_3]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveQuotient.gamma3ToQuotient_s2
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_s2 :
    gamma3ToQuotient s2_3 = quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  simp [gamma3ToQuotient, s2_3]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.invertFactors_pow_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem invertFactors_pow_of (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) (x : C5) :
    (invertFactors ^ n) (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) x) =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) ((invertC5 ^ n) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      change (invertFactors ^ n)
          (invertFactors (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) x)) =
        CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) ((invertC5 ^ n) (invertC5 x))
      rw [show invertFactors (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) x) =
        CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) x⁻¹ by simp [invertFactors]]
      rw [ih (x⁻¹)]
      rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.twistLetter_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem twistLetter_fst (n : ℕ) (x : BaseLetter) :
    (twistLetter n x).1 = x.1
proof: := by cases x; rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.twistLetter_ne_one
statement:
theorem twistLetter_ne_one (n : ℕ) (x : BaseLetter) (hx : x.2 ≠ 1) :
    (twistLetter n x).2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
  change (invertC5 ^ n) x ≠ 1
  intro h
  apply hx
  apply (invertC5 ^ n).injective
  simpa using h

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.letterProd_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem letterProd_cons (x : BaseLetter) (xs : List BaseLetter) :
    letterProd (x :: xs) =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := x.1) x.2 * letterProd xs
proof:
:= by
  simp [letterProd]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.letterProd_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem letterProd_append (xs ys : List BaseLetter) :
    letterProd (xs ++ ys) = letterProd xs * letterProd ys
proof:
:= by
  simp [letterProd, List.map_append]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.invertFactors_pow_letterProd
statement:
@[simp] theorem invertFactors_pow_letterProd (n : ℕ)
    (letters : List BaseLetter) :
    (invertFactors ^ n) (letterProd letters) =
      letterProd (letters.map (twistLetter n))
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [letterProd]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
      rw [letterProd_cons, map_mul, invertFactors_pow_of, ih]
      simp [letterProd]
      rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.baseLetters_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseLetters_length (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2))
    (letters : List Basis) :
    (baseLetters rules letters).length = 2 * basisRuleCount letters
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q rest ih =>
      cases q with
      | inl beta => simp [baseLetters, basisRuleCount, ih]
      | inr i => simp [baseLetters, basisRuleCount, rulePair, ih, Nat.mul_add]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientStable_pow_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientStable_pow_left (n : ℕ) :
    (quotientStable ^ n).left = 1
proof:
:= by
  let g : Multiplicative ℤ := Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
  have hp : (SemidirectProduct.inr g : QuotientGroup) ^ n =
      SemidirectProduct.inr (g ^ n) :=
    (map_pow (SemidirectProduct.inr : Multiplicative ℤ →* QuotientGroup) g n).symm
  change ((SemidirectProduct.inr g : QuotientGroup) ^ n).left = 1
  rw [hp]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientStable_pow_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientStable_pow_right (n : ℕ) :
    (quotientStable ^ n).right = Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, SemidirectProduct.mul_right, ih]
      apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
      simp [quotientStable]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBase_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBase_left (x : ModFiveBase) :
    (quotientBase x).left = x
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBase_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBase_right (x : ModFiveBase) :
    (quotientBase x).right = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBase_pow_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBase_pow_right (x : ModFiveBase) (n : ℕ) :
    (quotientBase x ^ n).right = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (SemidirectProduct.inl x : QuotientGroup) ^ n =
      SemidirectProduct.inl (x ^ n) :=
    (map_pow (SemidirectProduct.inl : ModFiveBase →* QuotientGroup) x n).symm
  change ((SemidirectProduct.inl x : QuotientGroup) ^ n).right = _
  rw [hp]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.inversionAction_nat
statement:
@[simp] theorem inversionAction_nat (n : ℕ) :
    inversionAction (Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : ℤ)) = invertFactors ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [inversionAction]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.invertFactors_pow_modE
statement:
@[simp] theorem invertFactors_pow_modE (n : ℕ) :
    (invertFactors ^ n) modE =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (1 : Fin 2))
        ((invertC5 ^ n) c5Generator)
proof:
:= by
  simp [modE]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBasis_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBasis_right
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (q : Basis) :
    (quotientBasis rules q).right =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (stableWeight rules q : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta => simp [quotientBasis, stableWeight, quotientStable]
  | inr i =>
      simp only [quotientBasis, SemidirectProduct.mul_right,
        quotientBase_right, quotientStable_pow_right,
        one_mul, mul_one, stableWeight]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBasis_left_stable
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBasis_left_stable
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (beta : Fin 2) :
    (quotientBasis rules (.inl beta)).left = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientBasis, quotientStable]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientBasis_left_rule
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBasis_left_rule
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    (quotientBasis rules (.inr i)).left = letterProd (rulePair rules i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientBasis, SemidirectProduct.mul_left,
    quotientBase_left, quotientBase_right,
    quotientStable_pow_left]
  simp [rulePair, letterProd, invertFactors_pow_modE, modD, map_pow]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientEval_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientEval_left
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (letters : List Basis) :
    (quotientEval rules letters).left = letterProd (baseLetters rules letters)
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q rest ih =>
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          change (quotientBasis rules (.inl beta) *
            quotientEval rules rest).left = _
          rw [SemidirectProduct.mul_left, quotientBasis_left_stable,
            quotientBasis_right, ih, one_mul]
          simp only [stableWeight, baseLetters]
          simpa using (invertFactors_pow_letterProd 1 (baseLetters rules rest))
      | inr i =>
          change (quotientBasis rules (.inr i) *
            quotientEval rules rest).left = _
          rw [SemidirectProduct.mul_left, quotientBasis_left_rule,
            quotientBasis_right, ih]
          simp only [stableWeight, inversionAction_nat,
            baseLetters, letterProd_append]
          rw [invertFactors_pow_letterProd]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_stable3
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_stable3 (beta : Fin 2) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (stable3 beta) = quotientStable
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta <;> simp [stable3]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_positive3
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_positive3 (word : List (Fin 2)) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (positive3 word) = quotientStable ^ word.length
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons beta word ih =>
      have hcons : positive3 (beta :: word) =
          stable3 beta * positive3 word := by
        simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive, stable3]
      rw [hcons, map_mul, gamma3ToQuotient_stable3, ih,
        List.length_cons, pow_succ']

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_uBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_uBasis
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (uBasis datum q) = quotientBasis datum.F q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta => simp [uBasis, quotientBasis]
  | inr i =>
      simp [uBasis, a3, quotientBasis, map_mul, map_pow]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_vBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToQuotient_vBasis
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (vBasis datum q) = quotientBasis datum.E q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta => simp [vBasis, quotientBasis]
  | inr i =>
      simp [vBasis, b3, quotientBasis, map_mul, map_pow]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_uLift_of_allPositive
statement:
theorem gamma3ToQuotient_uLift_of_allPositive
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (hpositive : AllPositive w.toWord) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (uLift datum w) =
      quotientEval datum.F (w.toWord.map Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gamma3ToQuotient (uLift datum w) =
        gamma3ToQuotient (uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord)) := by
      rw [FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
    _ = quotientEval datum.F (w.toWord.map Prod.fst) := by
      simp only [uLift, FreeGroup.lift_mk, map_list_prod, List.map_map,
        quotientEval]
      apply congrArg List.prod
      apply List.map_congr_left
      rintro ⟨q, sign⟩ hmem
      have hsign : sign = true :=
        (allPositive_iff_forall_sign w.toWord).mp hpositive
          (q, sign) hmem
      subst sign
      simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.gamma3ToQuotient_vLift_of_allPositive
statement:
theorem gamma3ToQuotient_vLift_of_allPositive
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (hpositive : AllPositive w.toWord) :
    gamma3ToQuotient (vLift datum w) =
      quotientEval datum.E (w.toWord.map Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gamma3ToQuotient (vLift datum w) =
        gamma3ToQuotient (vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord)) := by
      rw [FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
    _ = quotientEval datum.E (w.toWord.map Prod.fst) := by
      simp only [vLift, FreeGroup.lift_mk, map_list_prod, List.map_map,
        quotientEval]
      apply congrArg List.prod
      apply List.map_congr_left
      rintro ⟨q, sign⟩ hmem
      have hsign : sign = true :=
        (allPositive_iff_forall_sign w.toWord).mp hpositive
          (q, sign) hmem
      subst sign
      simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.basisRuleCount_map_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisRuleCount_map_fst
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) :
    basisRuleCount (letters.map Prod.fst) = ruleCount letters
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
      cases q <;> simp [basisRuleCount, ruleCount, ih]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.quotientBase_zpow_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBase_zpow_left (x : ModFiveBase) (n : ℤ) :
    (quotientBase x ^ n).left = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_zpow]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.quotientBase_zpow_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientBase_zpow_right (x : ModFiveBase) (n : ℤ) :
    (quotientBase x ^ n).right = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_zpow]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.quotient_coefficient_left
statement:
theorem quotient_coefficient_left
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) :
    (gamma3ToQuotient (d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r)).left =
      modD ^ f * (invertFactors ^ Q.length) (modE ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_mul, map_zpow, gamma3ToQuotient_d3,
    gamma3ToQuotient_positive3, gamma3ToQuotient_e3,
    SemidirectProduct.mul_left, SemidirectProduct.mul_right,
    quotientBase_zpow_left, quotientBase_zpow_right,
    quotientStable_pow_left, quotientStable_pow_right,
    inversionAction_nat, one_mul]
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.modD_zpow_as_letter
statement:
theorem modD_zpow_as_letter (f : ℤ) :
    modD ^ f =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (0 : Fin 2)) (c5Generator ^ f)
proof:
:= by
  change (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (0 : Fin 2))
      c5Generator) ^ f = _
  rw [← map_zpow]

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.twisted_modE_zpow_as_letter
statement:
theorem twisted_modE_zpow_as_letter (n : ℕ) (r : ℤ) :
    (invertFactors ^ n) (modE ^ r) =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (1 : Fin 2))
        ((invertC5 ^ n) (c5Generator ^ r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show modE = CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := (1 : Fin 2))
    c5Generator by rfl, ← map_zpow]
  exact invertFactors_pow_of n (1 : Fin 2) (c5Generator ^ r)

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.coefficient_normalForm_length_le_two
statement:
theorem coefficient_normalForm_length_le_two
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) :
    (CoprodI.Word.equiv
      (modD ^ f * (invertFactors ^ Q.length) (modE ^ r))).toList.length ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [modD_zpow_as_letter, twisted_modE_zpow_as_letter]
  exact normalForm_length_factor_zero_one_le_two
    (c5Generator ^ f) ((invertC5 ^ Q.length) (c5Generator ^ r))

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.u_ruleCount_le_one
statement:
theorem u_ruleCount_le_one
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : uLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r) :
    ruleCount w.toWord ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpositive :=
    u_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq datum Q f r w heval
  have hquot := congrArg gamma3ToQuotient heval
  rw [gamma3ToQuotient_uLift_of_allPositive datum w hpositive] at hquot
  have hleft := congrArg SemidirectProduct.left hquot
  rw [quotientEval_left, quotient_coefficient_left] at hleft
  have hlength := congrArg
    (fun x : ModFiveBase ↦
      (CoprodI.Word.equiv x).toList.length) hleft
  rw [normalForm_letterProd_length, basisRuleCount_map_fst] at hlength
  have hright := coefficient_normalForm_length_le_two Q f r
  omega

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.v_ruleCount_le_one
statement:
theorem v_ruleCount_le_one
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : vLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r) :
    ruleCount w.toWord ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpositive :=
    v_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq datum Q f r w heval
  have hquot := congrArg gamma3ToQuotient heval
  rw [gamma3ToQuotient_vLift_of_allPositive datum w hpositive] at hquot
  have hleft := congrArg SemidirectProduct.left hquot
  rw [quotientEval_left, quotient_coefficient_left] at hleft
  have hlength := congrArg
    (fun x : ModFiveBase ↦
      (CoprodI.Word.equiv x).toList.length) hleft
  rw [normalForm_letterProd_length, basisRuleCount_map_fst] at hlength
  have hright := coefficient_normalForm_length_le_two Q f r
  omega

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveEvalBridge.Undecidability.BorisovModFiveSparsity.criterion_converse
statement:
theorem criterion_converse
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) :
    (Borisov.presentation datum).wordProblem (Borisov.testWord Q) →
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q datum.P
proof:
:=
  BorisovConditionalConverse.criterion_converse_of_sparse_parsers datum
    (u_ruleCount_le_one datum) (v_ruleCount_le_one datum) Q

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.eq_stableLetters_of_ruleCount_zero
statement:
theorem eq_stableLetters_of_ruleCount_zero
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hpositive : AllPositive letters) (hzero : ruleCount letters = 0) :
    ∃ stable : List (Fin 2), letters = stableLetters stable
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons x rest ih =>
      rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
      have hsign : sign = true := hpositive.1
      subst sign
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          rcases ih hpositive.2 (by simpa [ruleCount] using hzero) with
            ⟨stable, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨beta :: stable, rfl⟩
      | inr i => simp [ruleCount] at hzero

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.letters_eq_stable_or_oneRule
statement:
theorem letters_eq_stable_or_oneRule
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hpositive : AllPositive letters) (hsparse : ruleCount letters ≤ 1) :
    (∃ stable : List (Fin 2), letters = stableLetters stable) ∨
      ∃ (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3),
        letters = oneRuleLetters left right i
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons x rest ih =>
      rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
      have hsign : sign = true := hpositive.1
      subst sign
      cases q with
      | inl beta =>
          have hsparseRest : ruleCount rest ≤ 1 := by
            simpa [ruleCount] using hsparse
          rcases ih hpositive.2 hsparseRest with
            ⟨stable, rfl⟩ | ⟨left, right, i, rfl⟩
          · exact Or.inl ⟨beta :: stable, rfl⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨beta :: left, right, i, by
              simp [oneRuleLetters, stableLetters]⟩
      | inr i =>
          have hzero : ruleCount rest = 0 := by
            simp only [ruleCount] at hsparse
            omega
          rcases eq_stableLetters_of_ruleCount_zero rest hpositive.2 hzero with
            ⟨right, rfl⟩
          exact Or.inr ⟨[], right, i, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.uLift_mk_stableLetters
statement:
@[simp] theorem uLift_mk_stableLetters
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (stableLetters w)) = positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  rw [uLift, FreeGroup.lift_mk]
  unfold positive3 Thue.evalPositive stableLetters
  rw [List.map_map]
  congr 1

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.vLift_mk_stableLetters
statement:
@[simp] theorem vLift_mk_stableLetters
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (stableLetters w)) = positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  rw [vLift, FreeGroup.lift_mk]
  unfold positive3 Thue.evalPositive stableLetters
  rw [List.map_map]
  congr 1

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.uLift_mk_oneRuleLetters
statement:
@[simp] theorem uLift_mk_oneRuleLetters
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (oneRuleLetters left right i)) =
      positive3 left * a3 datum i * positive3 right
proof:
:= by
  rw [show oneRuleLetters left right i =
      stableLetters left ++ ((.inr i, true) :: stableLetters right) by
        simp [oneRuleLetters]]
  rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, map_mul, uLift_mk_stableLetters]
  rw [show ((.inr i, true) :: stableLetters right) =
      [(.inr i, true)] ++ stableLetters right by rfl]
  rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, map_mul, uLift_mk_stableLetters]
  simp [uLift, uBasis, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.vLift_mk_oneRuleLetters
statement:
@[simp] theorem vLift_mk_oneRuleLetters
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (oneRuleLetters left right i)) =
      positive3 left * b3 datum i * positive3 right
proof:
:= by
  rw [show oneRuleLetters left right i =
      stableLetters left ++ ((.inr i, true) :: stableLetters right) by
        simp [oneRuleLetters]]
  rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, map_mul, vLift_mk_stableLetters]
  rw [show ((.inr i, true) :: stableLetters right) =
      [(.inr i, true)] ++ stableLetters right by rfl]
  rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, map_mul, vLift_mk_stableLetters]
  simp [vLift, vBasis, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.canonicalCoefficientWordShape_of_positive_sparse
statement:
theorem canonicalCoefficientWordShape_of_positive_sparse

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.sourceCoefficientShape_of_preimage
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficientShape_of_preimage
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : uLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r)
    (hshape : CanonicalCoefficientWordShape w) :
    SourceCoefficientShape datum Q f r
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : FreeGroup.mk w.toWord = w := FreeGroup.mk_toWord
  rcases hshape with ⟨stable, hword⟩ | ⟨left, right, i, hword⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨stable, ?_⟩
    calc
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = uLift datum w := heval.symm
      _ = uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord) := by rw [hmk]
      _ = uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (stableLetters stable)) := by rw [hword]
      _ = positive3 stable := uLift_mk_stableLetters datum stable
  · right
    refine ⟨left, right, i, ?_⟩
    calc
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = uLift datum w := heval.symm
      _ = uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord) := by rw [hmk]
      _ = uLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (oneRuleLetters left right i)) := by
        rw [hword]
      _ = positive3 left * a3 datum i * positive3 right :=
        uLift_mk_oneRuleLetters datum left right i

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.targetCoefficientShape_of_preimage
statement:
theorem targetCoefficientShape_of_preimage
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : vLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r)
    (hshape : CanonicalCoefficientWordShape w) :
    TargetCoefficientShape datum Q f r
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : FreeGroup.mk w.toWord = w := FreeGroup.mk_toWord
  rcases hshape with ⟨stable, hword⟩ | ⟨left, right, i, hword⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨stable, ?_⟩
    calc
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = vLift datum w := heval.symm
      _ = vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord) := by rw [hmk]
      _ = vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (stableLetters stable)) := by rw [hword]
      _ = positive3 stable := vLift_mk_stableLetters datum stable
  · right
    refine ⟨left, right, i, ?_⟩
    calc
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = vLift datum w := heval.symm
      _ = vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk w.toWord) := by rw [hmk]
      _ = vLift datum (FreeGroup.mk (oneRuleLetters left right i)) := by
        rw [hword]
      _ = positive3 left * b3 datum i * positive3 right :=
        vLift_mk_oneRuleLetters datum left right i

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientShapes.sourceCoefficientShape_of_parser
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficientShape_of_parser
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hparse : ∀ (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) (w : FreeGroup Basis),
      uLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r →

      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ U datum →
        SourceCoefficientShape datum Q f r

  rcases hmem with ⟨w, heval⟩
  exact sourceCoefficientShape_of_preimage datum Q f r w heval
    (hparse Q f r w heval)

statement:
@[simp] theorem dExponent_d :

name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.eExponent_alpha
statement:
@[simp] theorem eExponent_alpha (x : Base) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (eExponent (alpha x)) =
      4 * Multiplicative.toAdd (eExponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hhom : eExponent.comp alpha = scaleFour.comp eExponent := by
    rw [alpha_eq_lift]
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [scaleFour, eExponent, d, e]
    all_goals apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    all_goals norm_num
  exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (DFunLike.congr_fun hhom x)

name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.dExponent_beta
statement:
@[simp] theorem dExponent_beta (x : Base) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (dExponent (beta x)) =
      4 * Multiplicative.toAdd (dExponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hhom : dExponent.comp beta = scaleFour.comp dExponent := by
    rw [beta_eq_lift]
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [scaleFour, dExponent, d, e]
    all_goals apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    all_goals norm_num
  exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (DFunLike.congr_fun hhom x)

proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hm := congrArg (fun z => Multiplicative.toAdd (eExponent z)) hx
