name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIVBoundary.pos_neg_factor_eq
statement:
private theorem pos_neg_factor_eq
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (qx qy : Basis)
    (hstable :
      lastStable rules hne (qx, true) = firstStable rules hne (qy, false))
    (hmem : boundaryCoefficient (qx, true) (qy, false) ∈ A0) :
    qx = qy
proof:
:= by
  cases qx with
  | inl beta =>
      cases qy with
      | inl gamma =>
          simpa [lastStable, firstStable] using hstable
      | inr j =>
          have heNeg : BorisovHNNModel.e ^ (-rulePower j) ∈ A0 := by
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix] using hmem
          have hePos : BorisovHNNModel.e ^ rulePower j ∈ A0 := by
            have := A0.inv_mem heNeg
            simpa using this
          exact (e_rule_power_not_mem_A0 j (by simpa [rulePower] using hePos)).elim
  | inr i =>
      cases qy with
      | inl gamma =>
          have hePos : BorisovHNNModel.e ^ rulePower i ∈ A0 := by
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix] using hmem
          exact (e_rule_power_not_mem_A0 i (by simpa [rulePower] using hePos)).elim
      | inr j =>
          have hdiff :
              BorisovHNNModel.e ^ (rulePower i - rulePower j) ∈ A0 := by
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix, zpow_sub] using hmem
          have hij := e_rule_difference_mem_A0_imp_eq i j
            (by simpa [rulePower] using hdiff)
          exact congrArg Sum.inr hij

name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIVBoundary.neg_pos_factor_eq
statement:
private theorem neg_pos_factor_eq
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (qx qy : Basis)
    (hstable :
      lastStable rules hne (qx, false) = firstStable rules hne (qy, true))
    (hmem : boundaryCoefficient (qx, false) (qy, true) ∈ B0) :
    qx = qy
proof:
:= by
  cases qx with
  | inl beta =>
      cases qy with
      | inl gamma =>
          simpa [lastStable, firstStable] using hstable
      | inr j =>
          have hdPos : BorisovHNNModel.d ^ rulePower j ∈ B0 := by
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix] using hmem
          exact (d_rule_power_not_mem_B0 j (by simpa [rulePower] using hdPos)).elim
  | inr i =>
      cases qy with
      | inl gamma =>
          have hdNeg : BorisovHNNModel.d ^ (-rulePower i) ∈ B0 := by
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix] using hmem
          have hdPos : BorisovHNNModel.d ^ rulePower i ∈ B0 := by
            have := B0.inv_mem hdNeg
            simpa using this
          exact (d_rule_power_not_mem_B0 i (by simpa [rulePower] using hdPos)).elim
      | inr j =>
          have hsum :
              BorisovHNNModel.d ^
                (-rulePower i + rulePower j) ∈ B0 := by
            rw [zpow_add]
            simpa [boundaryCoefficient, suffix, factorPrefix] using hmem
          have hdiff :
              BorisovHNNModel.d ^ (rulePower j - rulePower i) ∈ B0 := by
            simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hsum
          have hji := d_rule_difference_mem_B0_imp_eq j i
            (by simpa [rulePower] using hdiff)
          exact congrArg Sum.inr hji.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIVBoundary.boundary_pinch_forces_same_factor
statement:
theorem boundary_pinch_forces_same_factor
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x y : Basis × Bool)
    (hsign : x.2 ≠ y.2)
    (hstable : lastStable rules hne x = firstStable rules hne y)
    (hmem : boundaryCoefficient x y ∈ associatedForSign x.2) :
    x.1 = y.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨qx, sx⟩
  rcases y with ⟨qy, sy⟩
  cases sx <;> cases sy
  · exact (hsign rfl).elim
  · apply neg_pos_factor_eq rules hne qx qy hstable
    simpa [associatedForSign] using hmem
  · apply pos_neg_factor_eq rules hne qx qy hstable
    simpa [associatedForSign] using hmem
  · exact (hsign rfl).elim

name: Undecidability.BorisovPowerArithmetic.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIVBoundary.no_boundary_pinch_of_reduced_pair
statement:
theorem no_boundary_pinch_of_reduced_pair
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x y : Basis × Bool)
    (hreduced : x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2)
    (hsign : x.2 ≠ y.2)
    (hstable : lastStable rules hne x = firstStable rules hne y) :
    boundaryCoefficient x y ∉ associatedForSign x.2
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  exact hsign (hreduced
    (boundary_pinch_forces_same_factor rules hne x y hsign hstable hmem))

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.stable3_mul_d
statement:
private theorem stable3_mul_d (beta : Fin 2) :
    stable3 beta * d3 = d3 ^ 4 * stable3 beta
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta
  · simpa [stable3] using gamma3_d_four_mul_s1.symm
  · simpa [stable3] using gamma3_s2_mul_d

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.e_mul_stable3
statement:
private theorem e_mul_stable3 (beta : Fin 2) :
    e3 * stable3 beta = stable3 beta * e3 ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta
  · simpa [stable3] using gamma3_e_mul_s1
  · simpa [stable3] using gamma3_e_mul_s2

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.stable3_mul_d_zpow
statement:
theorem stable3_mul_d_zpow (beta : Fin 2) (n : ℤ) :
    stable3 beta * d3 ^ n = d3 ^ (4 * n) * stable3 beta
proof:
:= by
  have hconj :
      stable3 beta * d3 * (stable3 beta)⁻¹ = d3 ^ 4 := by
    calc
      stable3 beta * d3 * (stable3 beta)⁻¹ =
          (d3 ^ 4 * stable3 beta) * (stable3 beta)⁻¹ := by
            rw [stable3_mul_d]
      _ = d3 ^ 4 := by simp
  have hzpow :
      stable3 beta * d3 ^ n * (stable3 beta)⁻¹ =
        (stable3 beta * d3 * (stable3 beta)⁻¹) ^ n := by
    simp
  calc
    stable3 beta * d3 ^ n =
        (stable3 beta * d3 ^ n * (stable3 beta)⁻¹) * stable3 beta := by
          group
    _ = (stable3 beta * d3 * (stable3 beta)⁻¹) ^ n * stable3 beta := by
          rw [hzpow]
    _ = (d3 ^ 4) ^ n * stable3 beta := by rw [hconj]
    _ = d3 ^ (4 * n) * stable3 beta :=
      congrArg (fun x => x * stable3 beta) (zpow_mul d3 4 n).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.e_zpow_mul_stable3
statement:
theorem e_zpow_mul_stable3 (beta : Fin 2) (n : ℤ) :
    e3 ^ n * stable3 beta = stable3 beta * e3 ^ (4 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hconj :
      (stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 * stable3 beta = e3 ^ 4 := by
    calc
      (stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 * stable3 beta =
          (stable3 beta)⁻¹ * (stable3 beta * e3 ^ 4) := by
            simp only [mul_assoc]
            rw [← e_mul_stable3]
      _ = e3 ^ 4 := by simp
  have hzpow :
      (stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 ^ n * stable3 beta =
        ((stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 * stable3 beta) ^ n := by
    simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using
      (map_zpow (MulAut.conj (stable3 beta)⁻¹) e3 n)
  calc
    e3 ^ n * stable3 beta = stable3 beta *
        ((stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 ^ n * stable3 beta) := by
          group
    _ = stable3 beta *
        (((stable3 beta)⁻¹ * e3 * stable3 beta) ^ n) := by
          rw [hzpow]
    _ = stable3 beta * (e3 ^ 4) ^ n := by rw [hconj]
    _ = stable3 beta * e3 ^ (4 * n) :=
      congrArg (fun x => stable3 beta * x) (zpow_mul e3 4 n).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positive3_mul_d_zpow
statement:
theorem positive3_mul_d_zpow (w : List (Fin 2)) (n : ℤ) :
    positive3 w * d3 ^ n =
      d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ w.length * n) * positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil => simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons beta w ih =>
      have hcons : positive3 (beta :: w) = stable3 beta * positive3 w := by
        fin_cases beta <;> simp [positive3, stable3, Thue.evalPositive]
      rw [hcons, mul_assoc, ih, ← mul_assoc,
        stable3_mul_d_zpow, mul_assoc]
      congr 2
      simp only [List.length_cons, pow_succ]
      ring

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.e_zpow_mul_positive3
statement:
theorem e_zpow_mul_positive3 (w : List (Fin 2)) (n : ℤ) :
    e3 ^ n * positive3 w =
      positive3 w * e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ w.length * n)
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing n with
  | nil => simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons beta w ih =>
      have hcons : positive3 (beta :: w) = stable3 beta * positive3 w := by
        fin_cases beta <;> simp [positive3, stable3, Thue.evalPositive]
      rw [hcons, ← mul_assoc, e_zpow_mul_stable3, mul_assoc, ih (4 * n),
        ← mul_assoc]
      congr 2
      simp only [List.length_cons, pow_succ]
      ring

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positive3_mul_d_pow
statement:
theorem positive3_mul_d_pow (w : List (Fin 2)) (n : ℕ) :
    positive3 w * d3 ^ n =
      d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ w.length * (n : ℤ)) * positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zpow_natCast] using
    positive3_mul_d_zpow w (n : ℤ)

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.e_pow_mul_positive3
statement:
theorem e_pow_mul_positive3 (w : List (Fin 2)) (n : ℕ) :
    e3 ^ n * positive3 w =
      positive3 w * e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ w.length * (n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zpow_natCast] using
    e_zpow_mul_positive3 w (n : ℤ)

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.coe_sourceBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_sourceBasis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (q : RuleBasis) :
    ((sourceBasis datum q : U datum) : Gamma3) = uBasis datum q
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.coe_targetBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_targetBasis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (q : RuleBasis) :
    ((targetBasis datum q : V datum) : Gamma3) = vBasis datum q
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.coe_sourcePositive
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_sourcePositive (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    ((sourcePositive datum w : U datum) : Gamma3) = positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons beta w ih =>
      change
        (((if beta = 0 then sourceBasis datum (.inl 0)
            else sourceBasis datum (.inl 1)) * sourcePositive datum w : U datum) :
          Gamma3) =
        (if beta = 0 then s1_3 else s2_3) * positive3 w
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, ih]
      fin_cases beta <;> simp [sourceBasis, uBasis, stable3]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.coe_targetPositive
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_targetPositive (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    ((targetPositive datum w : V datum) : Gamma3) = positive3 w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons beta w ih =>
      change
        (((if beta = 0 then targetBasis datum (.inl 0)
            else targetBasis datum (.inl 1)) * targetPositive datum w : V datum) :
          Gamma3) =
        (if beta = 0 then s1_3 else s2_3) * positive3 w
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, ih]
      fin_cases beta <;> simp [targetBasis, vBasis, stable3]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.cEquiv_sourceBasis
statement:
theorem cEquiv_sourceBasis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (q : RuleBasis) :
    cEquiv datum hfree (sourceBasis datum q) = targetBasis datum q
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [sourceBasis, targetBasis]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.cEquiv_sourcePositive
statement:
theorem cEquiv_sourcePositive (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    cEquiv datum hfree (sourcePositive datum w) = targetPositive datum w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [sourcePositive, targetPositive, Thue.evalPositive]
  | cons beta w ih =>
      change cEquiv datum hfree
          ((if beta = 0 then sourceBasis datum (.inl 0)
            else sourceBasis datum (.inl 1)) * sourcePositive datum w) =
        (if beta = 0 then targetBasis datum (.inl 0)
          else targetBasis datum (.inl 1)) * targetPositive datum w
      rw [map_mul, ih]
      fin_cases beta <;> simp [cEquiv_sourceBasis]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.cEquiv_symm_targetPositive
statement:
theorem cEquiv_symm_targetPositive (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    (cEquiv datum hfree).symm (targetPositive datum w) =
      sourcePositive datum w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cEquiv_sourcePositive datum hfree w]
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.cEquiv_symm_targetBasis
statement:
theorem cEquiv_symm_targetBasis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (q : RuleBasis) :
    (cEquiv datum hfree).symm (targetBasis datum q) =
      sourceBasis datum q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cEquiv_sourceBasis datum hfree q]
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positive3_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem positive3_append (u v : List (Fin 2)) :
    positive3 (u ++ v) = positive3 u * positive3 v
proof:
:= by
  simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive, List.map_append]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positiveFree_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveFree_append (u v : List (Fin 2)) :
    positiveFree (u ++ v) = positiveFree u * positiveFree v
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveFree, List.map_append, FreeGroup.mul_mk]

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positive_word_eq_of_source_one_rule
statement:
theorem positive_word_eq_of_source_one_rule
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q left right : List (Fin 2))
    (f r : ℤ) (i : Fin 3)
    (hshape :
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r =
        positive3 left * a3 datum i * positive3 right) :
    Q = left ++ datum.F i ++ right
proof:
:= by
  have hproj := congrArg stableProjection3 hshape
  have hfree : positiveFree Q =
      positiveFree (left ++ datum.F i ++ right) := by
    simpa [a3, positiveFree_append, stableProjection3_positive,
      mul_assoc] using hproj
  exact positiveFree_injective hfree

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.positive_word_eq_of_target_one_rule
statement:
theorem positive_word_eq_of_target_one_rule
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q left right : List (Fin 2))
    (f r : ℤ) (i : Fin 3)
    (hshape :
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r =
        positive3 left * b3 datum i * positive3 right) :
    Q = left ++ datum.E i ++ right
proof:
:= by
  have hproj := congrArg stableProjection3 hshape
  have hfree : positiveFree Q =
      positiveFree (left ++ datum.E i ++ right) := by
    simpa [b3, positiveFree_append, stableProjection3_positive,
      mul_assoc] using hproj
  exact positiveFree_injective hfree

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.source_one_rule_transport_value
statement:
theorem source_one_rule_transport_value
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((cEquiv datum hfree
      (sourcePositive datum left * sourceBasis datum (.inr i) *
        sourcePositive datum right) : V datum) : Gamma3) =
      d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)) *
        positive3 (left ++ datum.E i ++ right) *
          e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, cEquiv_sourcePositive, cEquiv_sourceBasis,
    cEquiv_sourcePositive]
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, coe_targetPositive, coe_targetBasis]
  simp only [vBasis]
  rw [b3]
  calc
    positive3 left *
          (d3 ^ (i.val + 1) * positive3 (datum.E i) * e3 ^ (i.val + 1)) *
        positive3 right =
      (positive3 left * d3 ^ (i.val + 1)) * positive3 (datum.E i) *
        (e3 ^ (i.val + 1) * positive3 right) := by group
    _ =
      (d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
          positive3 left) * positive3 (datum.E i) *
        (positive3 right *
          e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) := by
            rw [positive3_mul_d_pow, e_pow_mul_positive3]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [positive3_append, Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_one]
      group

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.target_one_rule_transport_value
statement:
theorem target_one_rule_transport_value
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm
      (targetPositive datum left * targetBasis datum (.inr i) *
        targetPositive datum right) : U datum) : Gamma3) =
      d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)) *
        positive3 (left ++ datum.F i ++ right) *
          e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, cEquiv_symm_targetPositive,
    cEquiv_symm_targetBasis, cEquiv_symm_targetPositive]
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, coe_sourcePositive, coe_sourceBasis]
  simp only [uBasis]
  rw [a3]
  calc
    positive3 left *
          (d3 ^ (i.val + 1) * positive3 (datum.F i) * e3 ^ (i.val + 1)) *
        positive3 right =
      (positive3 left * d3 ^ (i.val + 1)) * positive3 (datum.F i) *
        (e3 ^ (i.val + 1) * positive3 right) := by group
    _ =
      (d3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
          positive3 left) * positive3 (datum.F i) *
        (positive3 right *
          e3 ^ ((4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) := by
            rw [positive3_mul_d_pow, e_pow_mul_positive3]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [positive3_append, Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_one]
      group

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.source_classification_one_rule
statement:
theorem source_classification_one_rule
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3)
    (hmem : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ U datum)
    (hshape :
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r =
        positive3 left * a3 datum i * positive3 right) :
    ∃ (Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f' r' : ℤ),
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q Q' ∧
      ((cEquiv datum hfree
        ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : V datum) : Gamma3) =
        d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' * e3 ^ r'
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Q = left ++ datum.F i ++ right :=
    positive_word_eq_of_source_one_rule datum Q left right f r i hshape
  let f' : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)
  let r' : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)
  refine ⟨left ++ datum.E i ++ right, f', r', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQ]
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (thueStep_rule_forward datum left right i)
  · let coefficient : U datum :=
      ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩
    have hcoefficient : coefficient =
        sourcePositive datum left * sourceBasis datum (.inr i) *
          sourcePositive datum right := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [coefficient, uBasis] using hshape
    change ((cEquiv datum hfree coefficient : V datum) : Gamma3) = _
    rw [hcoefficient]
    exact source_one_rule_transport_value datum hfree left right i

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.target_classification_one_rule
statement:
theorem target_classification_one_rule
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (left right : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3)
    (hmem : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ V datum)
    (hshape :
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r =
        positive3 left * b3 datum i * positive3 right) :
    ∃ (Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f' r' : ℤ),
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q Q' ∧
      (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm
        ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : U datum) : Gamma3) =
        d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' * e3 ^ r'
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Q = left ++ datum.E i ++ right :=
    positive_word_eq_of_target_one_rule datum Q left right f r i hshape
  let f' : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ left.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)
  let r' : ℤ := (4 : ℤ) ^ right.length * ((i.val : ℤ) + 1)
  refine ⟨left ++ datum.F i ++ right, f', r', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQ]
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (thueStep_rule_backward datum left right i)
  · let coefficient : V datum :=
      ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩
    have hcoefficient : coefficient =
        targetPositive datum left * targetBasis datum (.inr i) *
          targetPositive datum right := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [coefficient, vBasis] using hshape
    change (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm coefficient : U datum) : Gamma3) = _
    rw [hcoefficient]
    exact target_one_rule_transport_value datum hfree left right i

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.source_classification_stable_shape
statement:
theorem source_classification_stable_shape
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) (w : List (Fin 2))
    (hmem : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ U datum)
    (hshape : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = positive3 w) :
    ∃ (Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f' r' : ℤ),
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q Q' ∧
      ((cEquiv datum hfree
        ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : V datum) : Gamma3) =
        d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' * e3 ^ r'
proof:
:= by
  have hproj := congrArg stableProjection3 hshape
  have hQ : Q = w := positiveFree_injective (by
    simpa [stableProjection3_positive] using hproj)
  refine ⟨w, 0, 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQ]
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  · let coefficient : U datum :=
      ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩
    have hcoefficient : coefficient = sourcePositive datum w := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [coefficient] using hshape
    change ((cEquiv datum hfree coefficient : V datum) : Gamma3) = _
    rw [hcoefficient, cEquiv_sourcePositive]
    simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.target_classification_stable_shape
statement:
theorem target_classification_stable_shape
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) (w : List (Fin 2))
    (hmem : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ V datum)
    (hshape : d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r = positive3 w) :
    ∃ (Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f' r' : ℤ),
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q Q' ∧
      (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm
        ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : U datum) : Gamma3) =
        d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' * e3 ^ r'
proof:
:= by
  have hproj := congrArg stableProjection3 hshape
  have hQ : Q = w := positiveFree_injective (by
    simpa [stableProjection3_positive] using hproj)
  refine ⟨w, 0, 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQ]
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  · let coefficient : V datum :=
      ⟨d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r, hmem⟩
    have hcoefficient : coefficient = targetPositive datum w := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [coefficient] using hshape
    change (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm coefficient : U datum) : Gamma3) = _
    rw [hcoefficient, cEquiv_symm_targetPositive]
    simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovPinchCoefficientClassification.pinchClassification_of_shapes
statement:
theorem pinchClassification_of_shapes
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hsource : ∀ (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ),
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ U datum →
        SourceCoefficientShape datum Q f r)
    (htarget : ∀ (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ),
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r ∈ V datum →
        TargetCoefficientShape datum Q f r) :
    BorisovLemma4Pinch.PinchClassification datum hfree
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Q f r hmem
    rcases hsource Q f r hmem with ⟨w, hshape⟩ | ⟨left, right, i, hshape⟩
    · exact source_classification_stable_shape
        datum hfree Q f r w hmem hshape
    · exact source_classification_one_rule
        datum hfree Q f r left right i hmem hshape
  · intro Q f r hmem
    rcases htarget Q f r hmem with ⟨w, hshape⟩ | ⟨left, right, i, hshape⟩
    · exact target_classification_stable_shape
        datum hfree Q f r w hmem hshape
    · exact target_classification_one_rule
        datum hfree Q f r left right i hmem hshape

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.chain_replace_last_coefficient
statement:
private theorem chain_replace_last_coefficient
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (u : ℤˣ) (a x : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (hchain : (pre ++ [(u, a)]).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree)) :
    (pre ++ [(u, x)]).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.isChain_append] at hchain ⊢
  refine ⟨hchain.1, by simp, ?_⟩
  intro p hp q hq
  have hq' : q = (u, x) := by simpa using hq.symm
  subst q
  have hold := hchain.2.2 p hp (u, a) (by simp)
  exact hold

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.combined_chain
statement:
private theorem combined_chain
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (u : ℤˣ) (a x : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (v : ℤˣ) (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (hleft : (pre ++ [(u, a)]).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree))
    (hright : ((v, b) :: tail).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree))
    (hboundary : x ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup (U datum) (V datum) u → u = v) :
    (pre ++ (u, x) :: (v, b) :: tail).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show pre ++ (u, x) :: (v, b) :: tail =
      (pre ++ [(u, x)]) ++ ((v, b) :: tail) by simp]
  apply List.IsChain.append
  · exact chain_replace_last_coefficient datum hfree pre u a x hleft
  · exact hright
  · intro p hp q hq
    have hp' : p = (u, x) := by simpa using hp.symm
    have hq' : q = (v, b) := by simpa using hq.symm
    subst p
    subst q
    exact hboundary

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.lemma4_boundary_pinch
statement:
theorem lemma4_boundary_pinch
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (P Q : List (Fin 2))
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree) (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (heq : Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q L R)
    (hpositive : contextComplexity datum hfree L R ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
      (u : ℤˣ) (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (v : ℤˣ) (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)),
      L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)] ∧
      R.word.toList = (v, b) :: tail ∧
      a * positive3 Q * R.word.head ∈
        HNNExtension.toSubgroup (U datum) (V datum) u ∧
      v = -u
proof:
:= by
  have hLne : L.word.toList ≠ [] := by
    intro hLnil
    by_cases hRnil : R.word.toList = []
    · apply hpositive
      simp [contextComplexity, hLnil, hRnil]
    · let combined : CReducedWord datum hfree :=
        { head := (positive3 P)⁻¹ * L.word.head * positive3 Q * R.word.head
          toList := R.word.toList
          chain := R.word.chain }
      have hprod : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) = 1 := by
        simpa [combined, Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue, rightValue,
          HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hLnil, of3, map_mul,
          map_inv, mul_assoc] using heq
      have hbase : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) ∈
          MonoidHom.range (of3 datum hfree) := ⟨1, by simp [hprod, of3]⟩
      have hnil := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
        (cEquiv datum hfree) combined hbase
      exact hRnil (by simpa [combined] using hnil)
  have hRne : R.word.toList ≠ [] := by
    intro hRnil
    cases hrev : L.word.toList.reverse with
    | nil =>
      apply hLne
      exact List.reverse_eq_nil_iff.mp hrev
    | cons last revPre =>
      let pre := revPre.reverse
      have hLlist : L.word.toList = pre ++ [last] := by
        dsimp [pre]
        rw [← List.reverse_inj]
        simp [hrev]
      let combined : CReducedWord datum hfree :=
        { head := (positive3 P)⁻¹ * L.word.head
          toList := pre ++
            [(last.1, last.2 * positive3 Q * R.word.head)]
          chain := chain_replace_last_coefficient datum hfree pre last.1
            last.2 (last.2 * positive3 Q * R.word.head) (by
              simpa [hLlist] using L.word.chain) }
      have hprod : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) = 1 := by
        simpa [combined, pre, Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue, rightValue,
          HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hLlist, hRnil, of3,
          List.map_append, map_mul, map_inv, mul_assoc] using heq
      have hbase : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) ∈
          MonoidHom.range (of3 datum hfree) := ⟨1, by simp [hprod, of3]⟩
      have hnil := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
        (cEquiv datum hfree) combined hbase
      have : combined.toList ≠ [] := by simp [combined]
      exact this hnil
  cases hLrev : L.word.toList.reverse with
  | nil =>
    apply (hLne ?_).elim
    exact List.reverse_eq_nil_iff.mp hLrev
  | cons last revPre =>
    rcases last with ⟨u, a⟩
    let pre := revPre.reverse
    have hLlist : L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)] := by
      dsimp [pre]
      rw [← List.reverse_inj]
      simp [hLrev]
    cases hRlist : R.word.toList with
    | nil => exact (hRne hRlist).elim
    | cons first tail =>
      rcases first with ⟨v, b⟩
      let middle := a * positive3 Q * R.word.head
      have hcontra
          (hboundary : middle ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup
            (U datum) (V datum) u → u = v) : False := by
        let combined : CReducedWord datum hfree :=
          { head := (positive3 P)⁻¹ * L.word.head
            toList := pre ++ (u, middle) :: (v, b) :: tail
            chain := combined_chain datum hfree pre u a middle v b tail
              (by simpa [hLlist] using L.word.chain)
              (by simpa [hRlist] using R.word.chain) hboundary }
        have hprod : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) = 1 := by
          simpa [combined, middle, Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue,
            rightValue, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hLlist,
            hRlist, of3, List.map_append, map_mul, map_inv, mul_assoc] using heq
        have hbase : combined.prod (cEquiv datum hfree) ∈
            MonoidHom.range (of3 datum hfree) := ⟨1, by simp [hprod, of3]⟩
        have hnil := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range
          (cEquiv datum hfree) combined hbase
        have : combined.toList ≠ [] := by simp [combined]
        exact this hnil
      have hmem : middle ∈
          HNNExtension.toSubgroup (U datum) (V datum) u := by
        by_contra hm
        exact hcontra (fun hx => (hm hx).elim)
      have hne : u ≠ v := by
        intro huv
        exact hcontra (fun _ => huv)
      refine ⟨pre, u, a, v, b, tail, hLlist, by simp, hmem, ?_⟩
      exact Int.units_ne_iff_eq_neg.mp hne.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.lemma4_boundary_pinch_power_form
statement:
theorem lemma4_boundary_pinch_power_form
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (P Q : List (Fin 2))
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree) (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (heq : Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q L R)
    (hpositive : contextComplexity datum hfree L R ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (f r : ℤ)
      (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
      (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)),
      (L.word.toList = pre ++ [(1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)] ∧
        R.word.toList = (-1, b) :: tail ∧
        R.word.head = BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∧
        BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
            BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∈ U datum) ∨
      (L.word.toList = pre ++ [(-1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)] ∧
        R.word.toList = (1, b) :: tail ∧
        R.word.head = BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∧
        BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
            BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∈ V datum)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lemma4_boundary_pinch datum hfree P Q L R heq hpositive with
    ⟨pre, u, a, v, b, tail, hL, hR, hmem, hv⟩
  have ha : a ∈ dCyclic := L.coeff_mem (u, a) (by simp [hL])
  have hr : R.word.head ∈ eCyclic := R.head_mem
  rcases Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mp ha with ⟨f, hf⟩
  rcases Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mp hr with ⟨r, hr⟩
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨f, r, pre, b, tail, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_, hr.symm, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [hf] using hL
    · simpa [hv] using hR
    · simpa [hf, hr, HNNExtension.toSubgroup_one] using hmem
  · refine ⟨f, r, pre, b, tail, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_, hr.symm, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [hf] using hL
    · simpa [hv] using hR
    · simpa [hf, hr, HNNExtension.toSubgroup_neg_one] using hmem

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.prefix_chain
statement:
private theorem prefix_chain
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (u : ℤˣ) (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (hlist : L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)]) :
    pre.IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  have hchain : (pre ++ [(u, a)]).IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree) := by
    simpa [hlist] using L.word.chain
  exact (List.isChain_append.mp hchain).1

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.prefix_coeff_mem
statement:
private theorem prefix_coeff_mem
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (u : ℤˣ) (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (hlist : L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)]) :
    ∀ p ∈ pre, p.2 ∈ dCyclic
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact L.coeff_mem p (by rw [hlist]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hp)

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.exists_left_absorb
statement:
private theorem exists_left_absorb
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (u : ℤˣ) (a x : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (hlist : L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)]) (hx : x ∈ dCyclic) :
    ∃ L' : LeftContext datum hfree,
      L'.word.toList.length = pre.length ∧
      leftValue datum hfree L' =
        prefixValue datum hfree L.word.head pre * of3 datum hfree x
proof:
:= by
  have hprechain := prefix_chain datum hfree L pre u a hlist
  have hpremem := prefix_coeff_mem datum hfree L pre u a hlist
  cases hrev : pre.reverse with
  | nil =>
      have hpre : pre = [] := List.reverse_eq_nil_iff.mp hrev
      subst pre
      let L' : LeftContext datum hfree :=
        { word :=
            { head := L.word.head * x
              toList := []
              chain := List.isChain_nil }
          head_mem := dCyclic.mul_mem L.head_mem hx
          coeff_mem := by simp }
      refine ⟨L', by simp [L'], ?_⟩
      simp [L', leftValue, prefixValue, listValue,
        HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, of3, map_mul]
  | cons last revRest =>
      rcases last with ⟨w, z⟩
      let rest := revRest.reverse
      have hpre : pre = rest ++ [(w, z)] := by
        dsimp [rest]
        rw [← List.reverse_inj]
        simp [hrev]
      have hrestchain : (rest ++ [(w, z)]).IsChain
          (ChainRel datum hfree) := by simpa [hpre] using hprechain
      let L' : LeftContext datum hfree :=
        { word :=
            { head := L.word.head
              toList := rest ++ [(w, z * x)]
              chain := chain_replace_last_coefficient datum hfree rest w z
                (z * x) hrestchain }
          head_mem := L.head_mem
          coeff_mem := by
            intro p hp
            rw [List.mem_append] at hp
            rcases hp with hp | hp
            · exact hpremem p (by rw [hpre]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hp)
            · have hp' : p = (w, z * x) := by simpa using hp
              subst p
              apply dCyclic.mul_mem
              · exact hpremem (w, z) (by simp [hpre])
              · exact hx }
      refine ⟨L', by simp [L', hpre], ?_⟩
      simp [L', leftValue, prefixValue, listValue,
        HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hpre, List.map_append,
        of3, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.exists_right_absorb
statement:
private theorem exists_right_absorb
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (v : ℤˣ) (b y : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (hlist : R.word.toList = (v, b) :: tail) (hy : y ∈ eCyclic) :
    ∃ R' : RightContext datum hfree,
      R'.word.toList.length = tail.length ∧
      rightValue datum hfree R' =
        of3 datum hfree y * of3 datum hfree b *
          listValue datum hfree tail
proof:
:= by
  have htailchain : tail.IsChain (ChainRel datum hfree) := by
    have := R.word.chain
    rw [hlist, List.isChain_cons] at this
    exact this.2
  let R' : RightContext datum hfree :=
    { word :=
        { head := y * b
          toList := tail
          chain := htailchain }
      head_mem := eCyclic.mul_mem hy
        (R.coeff_mem (v, b) (by simp [hlist]))
      coeff_mem := by
        intro p hp
        exact R.coeff_mem p (by rw [hlist]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp) }
  refine ⟨R', rfl, ?_⟩
  simp [R', rightValue, listValue,
    HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, of3, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.source_pinch_reduces
statement:
private theorem source_pinch_reduces
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (P Q Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f r f' r' : ℤ)
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree) (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (hL : L.word.toList =
      pre ++ [(1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)])
    (hR : R.word.toList = (-1, b) :: tail)
    (hRhead : R.word.head = BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r)
    (hmem : BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
      BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∈ U datum)
    (htransport :
      ((cEquiv datum hfree
        ⟨BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
          BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : V datum) :
            BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) =
        BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' *
          BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r')
    (heq : Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q L R) :
    ∃ (L' : LeftContext datum hfree) (R' : RightContext datum hfree),
      Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q' L' R' ∧
      contextComplexity datum hfree L' R' <
        contextComplexity datum hfree L R
proof:
:= by
  have hdf : BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' ∈ dCyclic := by
    rw [dCyclic, Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton]
    exact ⟨f', rfl⟩
  have her : BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r' ∈ eCyclic := by
    rw [eCyclic, Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton]
    exact ⟨r', rfl⟩
  rcases exists_left_absorb datum hfree L pre 1
      (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)
      (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f') hL hdf with
    ⟨L', hLlen, hLval⟩
  rcases exists_right_absorb datum hfree R (-1) b
      (BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r') tail hR her with
    ⟨R', hRlen, hRval⟩
  refine ⟨L', R', ?_, ?_⟩
  · let middle := BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
        BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r
    have hconj :
        (HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree) *
            of3 datum hfree middle * HNNExtension.t⁻¹ =
          of3 datum hfree
            (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' *
              BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r') := by
      have h := (HNNExtension.equiv_eq_conj
        (φ := cEquiv datum hfree) ⟨middle, hmem⟩).symm
      simpa [middle, htransport, of3] using h
    have hnorm :
        (positive2 datum hfree P)⁻¹ *
            prefixValue datum hfree L.word.head pre *
            ((HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree) *
              of3 datum hfree middle * HNNExtension.t⁻¹) *
            of3 datum hfree b * listValue datum hfree tail = 1 := by
      simpa [middle, Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue, rightValue, prefixValue,
        listValue, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hL, hR,
        List.map_append, hRhead, of3, map_mul, map_inv, mul_assoc] using heq
    rw [hconj] at hnorm
    change (positive2 datum hfree P)⁻¹ * leftValue datum hfree L' *
      positive2 datum hfree Q' * rightValue datum hfree R' = 1
    rw [hLval, hRval]
    simpa [Lemma4Equation, positive2, of3, map_mul, mul_assoc] using hnorm
  · simp only [contextComplexity, hLlen, hRlen]
    have hLlength : L.word.toList.length = pre.length + 1 := by simp [hL]
    have hRlength : R.word.toList.length = tail.length + 1 := by simp [hR]
    omega

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.target_pinch_reduces
statement:
private theorem target_pinch_reduces
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (P Q Q' : List (Fin 2)) (f r f' r' : ℤ)
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree) (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
    (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
    (hL : L.word.toList =
      pre ++ [(-1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)])
    (hR : R.word.toList = (1, b) :: tail)
    (hRhead : R.word.head = BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r)
    (hmem : BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
      BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∈ V datum)
    (htransport :
      (((cEquiv datum hfree).symm
        ⟨BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
          BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r, hmem⟩ : U datum) :
            BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) =
        BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' *
          BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r')
    (heq : Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q L R) :
    ∃ (L' : LeftContext datum hfree) (R' : RightContext datum hfree),
      Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q' L' R' ∧
      contextComplexity datum hfree L' R' <
        contextComplexity datum hfree L R
proof:
:= by
  have hdf : BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' ∈ dCyclic := by
    rw [dCyclic, Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton]
    exact ⟨f', rfl⟩
  have her : BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r' ∈ eCyclic := by
    rw [eCyclic, Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton]
    exact ⟨r', rfl⟩
  rcases exists_left_absorb datum hfree L pre (-1)
      (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)
      (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f') hL hdf with
    ⟨L', hLlen, hLval⟩
  rcases exists_right_absorb datum hfree R 1 b
      (BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r') tail hR her with
    ⟨R', hRlen, hRval⟩
  refine ⟨L', R', ?_, ?_⟩
  · let middle := BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
        BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r
    have hconj :
        (HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree)⁻¹ *
            of3 datum hfree middle * HNNExtension.t =
          of3 datum hfree
            (BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f' * positive3 Q' *
              BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r') := by
      have h := (HNNExtension.equiv_symm_eq_conj
        (φ := cEquiv datum hfree) ⟨middle, hmem⟩).symm
      simpa [middle, htransport, of3] using h
    have hnorm :
        (positive2 datum hfree P)⁻¹ *
            prefixValue datum hfree L.word.head pre *
            ((HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree)⁻¹ *
              of3 datum hfree middle * HNNExtension.t) *
            of3 datum hfree b * listValue datum hfree tail = 1 := by
      simpa [middle, Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue, rightValue,
        prefixValue, listValue, HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,
        hL, hR, List.map_append, hRhead, of3, map_mul, map_inv,
        mul_assoc] using heq
    rw [hconj] at hnorm
    change (positive2 datum hfree P)⁻¹ * leftValue datum hfree L' *
      positive2 datum hfree Q' * rightValue datum hfree R' = 1
    rw [hLval, hRval]
    simpa [Lemma4Equation, positive2, of3, map_mul, mul_assoc] using hnorm
  · simp only [contextComplexity, hLlen, hRlen]
    have hLlength : L.word.toList.length = pre.length + 1 := by simp [hL]
    have hRlength : R.word.toList.length = tail.length + 1 := by simp [hR]
    omega

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.pinchReduction_of_classification
statement:
theorem pinchReduction_of_classification
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hclass : PinchClassification datum hfree) :
    PinchReduction datum hfree
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q L R heq
  by_cases hzero : contextComplexity datum hfree L R = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  · right
    rcases lemma4_boundary_pinch_power_form datum hfree P Q L R heq hzero with
      ⟨f, r, pre, b, tail, hsource | htarget⟩
    · rcases hsource with ⟨hL, hR, hRhead, hmem⟩
      rcases hclass.source Q f r hmem with
        ⟨Q', f', r', hQQ', htransport⟩
      rcases source_pinch_reduces datum hfree P Q Q' f r f' r' L R
          pre b tail hL hR hRhead hmem htransport heq with
        ⟨L', R', heq', hlt⟩
      exact ⟨Q', L', R', hQQ', heq', hlt⟩
    · rcases htarget with ⟨hL, hR, hRhead, hmem⟩
      rcases hclass.target Q f r hmem with
        ⟨Q', f', r', hQQ', htransport⟩
      rcases target_pinch_reduces datum hfree P Q Q' f r f' r' L R
          pre b tail hL hR hRhead hmem htransport heq with
        ⟨L', R', heq', hlt⟩
      exact ⟨Q', L', R', hQQ', heq', hlt⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovLemma4Pinch.borisovLemma4_of_classification
statement:
theorem borisovLemma4_of_classification
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hclass : PinchClassification datum hfree) :
    BorisovLemma4 datum hfree
proof:
:=
  borisovLemma4_of_pinchReduction datum hfree
    (pinchReduction_of_classification datum hfree hclass)

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.run_color_map
statement:
theorem run_color_map (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    (run colors hne u lastCoeff).map
        MultipleHNNFlat.Syllable.color = colors
proof:
:= by
  unfold run
  rw [List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_singleton]
  have hdrop : colors.dropLast.map
      (MultipleHNNFlat.Syllable.color ∘ fun color =>
        ({ color := color, sign := u, coeff := 1 } : FlatSyllable)) =
      colors.dropLast := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id' colors.dropLast]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro color _
    rfl
  rw [hdrop]
  exact List.dropLast_append_getLast hne

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.run_contains_color
statement:
theorem run_contains_color (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) {color : Fin 2}
    (hcolor : color ∈ colors) :
    ∃ s ∈ run colors hne u lastCoeff, s.color = color
proof:
:= by
  have hmapped : color ∈
      (run colors hne u lastCoeff).map
        MultipleHNNFlat.Syllable.color := by
    rw [run_color_map]
    exact hcolor
  simpa only [List.mem_map] using hmapped

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.factorRun_contains_color
statement:
theorem factorRun_contains_color
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x : Basis × Bool) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base)
    {color : Fin 2}
    (hcolor : color ∈ factorColors rules x) :
    ∃ s ∈ factorRun rules hne x lastCoeff, s.color = color
proof:
:=
  run_contains_color _ _ _ _ hcolor

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.expansionTail_contains_color
statement:
theorem expansionTail_contains_color
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) (x : Basis × Bool)
    (hx : x ∈ letters) {color : Fin 2}
    (hcolor : color ∈ factorColors rules x) :
    ∃ s ∈ expansionTail rules hne letters, s.color = color
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
      rw [expansionTail]
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · rcases factorRun_contains_color rules hne x
          (suffix x * nextPrefix ys) hcolor with ⟨s, hs, hc⟩
        exact ⟨s, List.mem_append_left _ hs, hc⟩
      · rcases ih hx with ⟨s, hs, hc⟩
        exact ⟨s, List.mem_append_right _ hs, hc⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.expansionTail_contains_of_usesStable
statement:
theorem expansionTail_contains_of_usesStable
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (hsupport : ∀ i, Thue.ContainsBoth (rules i))
    (w : FreeGroup Basis) (gamma : Fin 2)
    (huses : UsesStable w gamma) :
    ∃ s ∈ expansionTail rules hne w.toWord, s.color = gamma
proof:
:= by
  rcases huses with ⟨⟨q, sign⟩, hletter, hq⟩
  apply expansionTail_contains_color rules hne w.toWord (q, sign) hletter
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      change beta = gamma at hq
      subst beta
      cases sign <;> simp [factorColors]
  | inr i =>
      have hgamma : gamma ∈ rules i := by
        fin_cases gamma
        · exact (hsupport i).1
        · exact (hsupport i).2
      cases sign <;> simpa [factorColors] using hgamma

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.uExpansion_contains_of_usesStable
statement:
theorem uExpansion_contains_of_usesStable
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis) (gamma : Fin 2)
    (huses : UsesStable w gamma) :
    ∃ s ∈ (uExpansion datum w).toList, s.color = gamma
proof:
:= by
  simpa [uExpansion, expansionWord] using
    expansionTail_contains_of_usesStable datum.F datum.F_nonempty
      datum.F_support w gamma huses

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.vExpansion_contains_of_usesStable
statement:
theorem vExpansion_contains_of_usesStable
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis) (gamma : Fin 2)
    (huses : UsesStable w gamma) :
    ∃ s ∈ (vExpansion datum w).toList, s.color = gamma
proof:
:= by
  simpa [vExpansion, expansionWord] using
    expansionTail_contains_of_usesStable datum.E datum.E_nonempty
      datum.E_support w gamma huses

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.toHNN_mem_base_of_mem_DE
statement:
theorem toHNN_mem_base_of_mem_DE {x : G0} (hx : x ∈ DE) :
    toHNN x ∈
      MonoidHom.range (MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0)
proof:
:= by
  let H := (MonoidHom.range
    (MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0)).comap toHNN
  have hle : DE ≤ H := by
    unfold DE
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨BorisovHNNModel.d, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨BorisovHNNModel.e, rfl⟩
  exact hle hx

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.not_usesStable_of_mem_DE
statement:
private theorem not_usesStable_of_mem_DE
    (M : ExpansionWitness) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (hmem : FreeGroup.lift M.basis w ∈ DE)
    (gamma : Fin 2) : ¬ UsesStable w gamma
proof:
:= by
  intro huses
  have hnonempty : (M.word w).toList ≠ [] := by
    intro hempty
    rcases M.contains w gamma huses with ⟨s, hs, _⟩
    simp [hempty] at hs
  have hnot := MultipleHNNFlat.eval_not_mem_base A0 B0 phi0
    (M.word w) hnonempty
  apply hnot
  rw [M.eval]
  exact toHNN_mem_base_of_mem_DE hmem

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.not_uses_one_of_mem_J_zero
statement:
private theorem not_uses_one_of_mem_J_zero
    (M : ExpansionWitness) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (hmem : FreeGroup.lift M.basis w ∈ J 0) :
    ¬ UsesStable w 1
proof:
:= by
  intro huses
  have hcolor := M.contains w 1 huses
  have hnot := MultipleHNNFlat.eval_not_mem_stageOne_of_contains_color_one
    A0 B0 phi0 (M.word w) hcolor
  apply hnot
  rw [M.eval]
  exact toHNN_mem_stageOne_of_mem_J_zero hmem

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_toHNN
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapHNN_toHNN (x : G0) :
    swapHNN (toHNN x) = swappedToHNN x
proof:
:= by
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun fromHNN_comp_toHNN x
  change fromHNN (toHNN x) = x at h
  change swappedToHNN (fromHNN (toHNN x)) = swappedToHNN x
  rw [h]

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_hnnD
statement: @[simp] theorem swapHNN_hnnD : swapHNN hnnD = hnnD
proof:
:= by
  change swappedToHNN (fromHNN hnnD) = hnnD
  rw [fromHNN_hnnD, presentedD_eq_of, swappedToHNN_of]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_hnnE
statement: @[simp] theorem swapHNN_hnnE : swapHNN hnnE = hnnE
proof:
:= by
  change swappedToHNN (fromHNN hnnE) = hnnE
  rw [fromHNN_hnnE, presentedE_eq_of, swappedToHNN_of]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_hnnS1
statement: @[simp] theorem swapHNN_hnnS1 : swapHNN hnnS1 = hnnS2
proof:
:= by
  change swappedToHNN (fromHNN hnnS1) = hnnS2
  rw [fromHNN_hnnS1, presentedS1_eq_of, swappedToHNN_of]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_hnnS2
statement: @[simp] theorem swapHNN_hnnS2 : swapHNN hnnS2 = hnnS1
proof:
:= by
  change swappedToHNN (fromHNN hnnS2) = hnnS1
  rw [fromHNN_hnnS2, presentedS2_eq_of, swappedToHNN_of]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_comp_baseToG0HNN
statement:
private theorem swapHNN_comp_baseToG0HNN :
    swapHNN.comp baseToG0HNN = baseToG0HNN
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change swapHNN hnnD = hnnD
    exact swapHNN_hnnD
  · change swapHNN hnnE = hnnE
    exact swapHNN_hnnE

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_baseEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapHNN_baseEmbedding (g : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    swapHNN (MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 g) =
      MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 g
proof:
:= by
  change swapHNN (baseToG0HNN g) = baseToG0HNN g
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun swapHNN_comp_baseToG0HNN g

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapColor_injective
statement: theorem swapColor_injective : Function.Injective swapColor
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y <;> simp [swapColor] at h ⊢

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapHNN_stableLetter
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapHNN_stableLetter (color : Fin 2) :
    swapHNN (MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color) =
      MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 (swapColor color)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases color
  · exact swapHNN_hnnS1
  · exact swapHNN_hnnS2

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapFlatWord_eval
statement:
theorem swapFlatWord_eval (w : FlatWord) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (swapFlatWord w) =
      swapHNN (MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold MultipleHNNFlat.eval
  simp only [swapFlatWord]
  rw [map_mul, swapHNN_baseEmbedding, map_list_prod]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.prod
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro s _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, swapSyllable, map_mul, map_zpow,
    swapHNN_stableLetter, swapHNN_baseEmbedding]

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swapFlatWord_contains_one_of_contains_zero
statement:
theorem swapFlatWord_contains_one_of_contains_zero (w : FlatWord)
    (hzero : ∃ s ∈ w.toList, s.color = 0) :
    ∃ s ∈ (swapFlatWord w).toList, s.color = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hzero with ⟨s, hs, hcolor⟩
  refine ⟨swapSyllable s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change swapSyllable s ∈ w.toList.map swapSyllable
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  · simp [swapSyllable, swapColor, hcolor]

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.swappedExpansion_eval
statement:
private theorem swappedExpansion_eval (M : ExpansionWitness)
    (w : FreeGroup Basis) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0
        (swapFlatWord (M.word w)) =
      swappedToHNN (FreeGroup.lift M.basis w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [swapFlatWord_eval, M.eval, swapHNN_toHNN]

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.not_uses_zero_of_mem_J_one
statement:
private theorem not_uses_zero_of_mem_J_one
    (M : ExpansionWitness) (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (hmem : FreeGroup.lift M.basis w ∈ J 1) :
    ¬ UsesStable w 0
proof:
:= by
  intro huses
  have hzero := M.contains w 0 huses
  have hone := swapFlatWord_contains_one_of_contains_zero
    (M.word w) hzero
  have hnot := MultipleHNNFlat.eval_not_mem_stageOne_of_contains_color_one
    A0 B0 phi0 (swapFlatWord (M.word w)) hone
  apply hnot
  rw [swappedExpansion_eval]
  exact swappedToHNN_mem_stageOne_of_mem_J_one hmem

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.not_uses_of_mem_J
statement:
private theorem not_uses_of_mem_J
    (M : ExpansionWitness) (w : FreeGroup Basis) (beta gamma : Fin 2)
    (hmem : FreeGroup.lift M.basis w ∈ J beta) (hne : gamma ≠ beta) :
    ¬ UsesStable w gamma
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta <;> fin_cases gamma
  · exact (hne rfl).elim
  · exact not_uses_one_of_mem_J_zero M w hmem
  · exact not_uses_zero_of_mem_J_one M w hmem
  · exact (hne rfl).elim

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.assertionV
statement:
theorem assertionV (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hIV : AssertionIV datum) :
    AssertionV datum hIV
proof:
:= by
  exact
    { u_mem_J := not_uses_of_mem_J (uWitness datum)
      v_mem_J := not_uses_of_mem_J (vWitness datum)
      u_mem_DE := not_usesStable_of_mem_DE (uWitness datum)
      v_mem_DE := not_usesStable_of_mem_DE (vWitness datum) }

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.assertionV_canonical
statement:
theorem assertionV_canonical (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    AssertionV datum (BorisovAssertionIV.assertionIV datum)
proof:
:=
  assertionV datum (BorisovAssertionIV.assertionIV datum)

name: Undecidability.BorisovAssertionV.Undecidability.BorisovLemmaFourTwo.lemma4_2
statement:
theorem lemma4_2 (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    (∀ beta : Fin 2,
      Uc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta ∧
      Vc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta) ∧
    Uc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥ ∧ Vc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥
proof:
:=
  BorisovIntersections.lemma4_2 datum
    (BorisovAssertionIV.assertionIV datum)
    (BorisovAssertionV.assertionV_canonical datum)

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.positiveCoefficientWord_signature
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveCoefficientWord_signature
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.signature A0 B0 (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) =
      Q.map (fun beta ↦ (beta, (1 : ℤˣ)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hQ : Q = []
  · simp [positiveCoefficientWord, hQ, MultipleHNNFlat.signature]
  · simp only [positiveCoefficientWord, hQ, ↓reduceDIte,
      MultipleHNNFlat.signature]
    unfold run
    rw [List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_singleton]
    change Q.dropLast.map (fun beta ↦ (beta, (1 : ℤˣ))) ++
        [(Q.getLast hQ, (1 : ℤˣ))] =
      Q.map (fun beta ↦ (beta, (1 : ℤˣ)))
    have hsplit := congrArg
      (List.map (fun beta ↦ (beta, (1 : ℤˣ))))
      (List.dropLast_append_getLast hQ)
    simpa [List.map_append] using hsplit

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.positiveCoefficientWord_eval
statement:
theorem positiveCoefficientWord_eval
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) =
      d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r
proof:
:= by
  change MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0
      (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) =
    hnnD ^ f * modelPositive Q * hnnE ^ r
  by_cases hQ : Q = []
  · subst Q
    simp [positiveCoefficientWord, MultipleHNNFlat.eval, map_mul, map_zpow,
      modelPositive, Thue.evalPositive]
    rfl
  · simp only [positiveCoefficientWord, hQ, ↓reduceDIte,
      MultipleHNNFlat.eval]
    rw [run_eval Q hQ 1 (e ^ r), stableProduct_one]
    simp [map_zpow, mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.allPositive_iff_forall_sign
statement:
theorem allPositive_iff_forall_sign (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) :
    AllPositive letters ↔ ∀ x ∈ letters, x.2 = true
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [AllPositive]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [AllPositive, ih]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.factorRun_has_own_sign
statement:
theorem factorRun_has_own_sign
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x : Basis × Bool)
    (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    ∃ s ∈ factorRun rules hne x lastCoeff,
      s.sign = signedUnit x.2
proof:
:= by
  let s := (factorRun rules hne x lastCoeff).head
    (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x lastCoeff)
  refine ⟨s, List.head_mem (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x lastCoeff), ?_⟩
  exact factorRun_head_sign rules hne x lastCoeff

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.expansionTail_has_factor_sign
statement:
theorem expansionTail_has_factor_sign
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (x : Basis × Bool) (hx : x ∈ letters) :
    ∃ s ∈ expansionTail rules hne letters,
      s.sign = signedUnit x.2
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
      rw [expansionTail]
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · rcases factorRun_has_own_sign rules hne x
          (suffix x * nextPrefix ys) with ⟨s, hs, hsign⟩
        exact ⟨s, List.mem_append_left _ hs, hsign⟩
      · rcases ih hx with ⟨s, hs, hsign⟩
        exact ⟨s, List.mem_append_right _ hs, hsign⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.allPositive_of_expansion_signature
statement:
theorem allPositive_of_expansion_signature
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hreduced : letters.IsChain
      (fun x y ↦ x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2))
    (Q : List (Fin 2))
    (hsignature :
      MultipleHNNFlat.signature A0 B0
          (expansionWord rules hne letters hreduced) =
        Q.map (fun beta ↦ (beta, (1 : ℤˣ)))) :
    AllPositive letters
proof:
:= by
  rw [allPositive_iff_forall_sign]
  intro x hx
  rcases expansionTail_has_factor_sign rules hne letters x hx with
    ⟨s, hs, hsSign⟩
  have hpair : (s.color, s.sign) ∈
      MultipleHNNFlat.signature A0 B0
        (expansionWord rules hne letters hreduced) :=
    List.mem_map.2 ⟨s, by simpa [expansionWord] using hs, rfl⟩
  rw [hsignature] at hpair
  rcases List.mem_map.1 hpair with ⟨beta, _, hp⟩
  have hsOne : s.sign = 1 := (congrArg Prod.snd hp).symm
  rw [hsSign] at hsOne
  cases hxsign : x.2
  · simp [signedUnit, hxsign] at hsOne
  · rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.u_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem u_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : uLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r) :
    AllPositive w.toWord
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (uExpansion datum w) =
      MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) := by
    rw [uExpansion_eval, positiveCoefficientWord_eval,
      ← g0Equiv_apply, g0Equiv_uLift, heval]
  have hsig := signature_eq_of_eval_eq A0 B0 phi0
    (uExpansion datum w) (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) hflat
  rw [positiveCoefficientWord_signature] at hsig
  exact allPositive_of_expansion_signature datum.F datum.F_nonempty w.toWord
    (FreeGroup.isReduced_toWord (x := w)) Q (by
      simpa [uExpansion] using hsig)

name: Undecidability.BorisovCoefficientSignComparison.v_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem v_allPositive_of_coefficient_eq
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (Q : List (Fin 2)) (f r : ℤ)
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (heval : vLift datum w = d3 ^ f * positive3 Q * e3 ^ r) :
    AllPositive w.toWord
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (vExpansion datum w) =
      MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0 (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) := by
    rw [vExpansion_eval, positiveCoefficientWord_eval,
      ← g0Equiv_apply, g0Equiv_vLift, heval]
  have hsig := signature_eq_of_eval_eq A0 B0 phi0
    (vExpansion datum w) (positiveCoefficientWord Q f r) hflat
  rw [positiveCoefficientWord_signature] at hsig
  exact allPositive_of_expansion_signature datum.E datum.E_nonempty w.toWord
    (FreeGroup.isReduced_toWord (x := w)) Q (by
      simpa [vExpansion] using hsig)

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.baseEmbedding_eq_lift
statement:
theorem baseEmbedding_eq_lift :
    of1.comp of0 = FreeGroup.lift ![d3, e3]
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.DE3_eq_range_baseEmbedding
statement:
theorem DE3_eq_range_baseEmbedding :
    DE3 = MonoidHom.range (of1.comp of0)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : Set.range ![d3, e3] = ({d3, e3} : Set Gamma3) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · have hx' : x = e3 := by simpa using hx
        exact ⟨1, hx'.symm⟩
  rw [DE3, baseEmbedding_eq_lift, FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure, hset]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.signedUnit_true
statement: @[simp] theorem signedUnit_true : signedUnit true = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorColors_ne_nil
statement:
theorem factorColors_ne_nil
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x : Basis × Bool) : factorColors rules x ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
  cases q with
  | inl beta => simp [factorColors]
  | inr i =>
      cases sign <;> simp [factorColors, hne i]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.run_ne_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_ne_nil (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    run colors hne u lastCoeff ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  simp [run]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.isChain_of_constant_sign
statement:
private theorem isChain_of_constant_sign
    (u : ℤˣ) (l : List FlatSyllable)
    (hsign : ∀ s ∈ l, s.sign = u) :
    l.IsChain (MultipleHNNFlat.Rel A0 B0)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp
      | cons y ys =>
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
          constructor
          · intro _ _
            rw [hsign x (by simp), hsign y (by simp)]
          · apply ih
            intro z hz
            exact hsign z (by simp [hz])

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.run_chain
statement:
theorem run_chain (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    (run colors hne u lastCoeff).IsChain (MultipleHNNFlat.Rel A0 B0)
proof:
:= by
  apply isChain_of_constant_sign u
  intro s hs
  simp only [run, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨color, hcolor, rfl⟩ | rfl <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.run_getLast
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_getLast (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    (run colors hne u lastCoeff).getLast (run_ne_nil colors hne u lastCoeff) =
      { color := colors.getLast hne, sign := u, coeff := lastCoeff }
proof:
:= by
  simp [run]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.run_head_color
statement:

  | cons c cs =>
      cases cs with
      | nil => simp [run]

statement:

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorRun_chain

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorColors_head
statement:
theorem factorColors_head
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x : Basis × Bool) :
    (factorColors rules x).head (factorColors_ne_nil rules hne x) =
      firstStable rules hne x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
  cases q with
  | inl beta => cases sign <;> simp [factorColors, firstStable]
  | inr i =>
      cases sign
      · simp [factorColors, firstStable, ruleLast]
      · simp [factorColors, firstStable, ruleFirst]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorColors_getLast

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factor_boundary_rel
statement:
private theorem factor_boundary_rel
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x y : Basis × Bool)
    (hreduced : x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2)
    (nextLastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.Rel A0 B0
      ((factorRun rules hne x (boundaryCoefficient x y)).getLast
        (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x (boundaryCoefficient x y)))
      ((factorRun rules hne y nextLastCoeff).head
        (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne y nextLastCoeff))
proof:
:= by
  intro hcolor hmem
  rw [factorRun_getLast_sign, factorRun_head_sign]
  by_cases hsign : x.2 = y.2
  · rw [hsign]
  · exfalso
    have hstable : lastStable rules hne x = firstStable rules hne y := by
      rw [← factorRun_getLast_color rules hne x (boundaryCoefficient x y),
        ← factorRun_head_color rules hne y nextLastCoeff]
      exact hcolor
    have hnot := no_boundary_pinch_of_reduced_pair
      rules hne x y hreduced hsign hstable
    apply hnot
    have hmem' : boundaryCoefficient x y ∈
        HNNExtension.toSubgroup A0 B0 (signedUnit x.2) := by
      simpa only [factorRun_getLast_coeff, factorRun_getLast_sign] using hmem
    cases hx : x.2 <;>
      simpa [associatedForSign, signedUnit, hx] using hmem'

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.expansionTail_chain
statement:
theorem expansionTail_chain
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hreduced : letters.IsChain (fun x y ↦ x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2)) :
    (expansionTail rules hne letters).IsChain
      (MultipleHNNFlat.Rel A0 B0)
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => simp [expansionTail]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hxs : xs.IsChain (fun x y ↦ x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2) :=
        (List.isChain_cons.1 hreduced).2
      apply List.IsChain.append
        (factorRun_chain rules hne x (suffix x * nextPrefix xs))
        (ih hxs)
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp [expansionTail]
      | cons y ys =>
          intro a ha b hb
          have haeq : a =
              (factorRun rules hne x (boundaryCoefficient x y)).getLast
                (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x (boundaryCoefficient x y)) := by
            rw [List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil
              (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x (suffix x * nextPrefix (y :: ys)))] at ha
            simpa [nextPrefix, boundaryCoefficient] using ha.symm
          have hbeq : b =
              (factorRun rules hne y (suffix y * nextPrefix ys)).head
                (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne y (suffix y * nextPrefix ys)) := by
            rw [expansionTail] at hb
            rw [List.head?_append_of_ne_nil
              (factorRun rules hne y (suffix y * nextPrefix ys))
              (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne y (suffix y * nextPrefix ys))] at hb
            rw [List.head?_eq_some_head
              (factorRun_ne_nil rules hne y (suffix y * nextPrefix ys))] at hb
            simpa using hb.symm
          subst a
          subst b
          apply factor_boundary_rel rules hne x y
          exact (List.isChain_cons.1 hreduced).1 y (by simp)

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.flat_baseEmbedding
statement:

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.flat_d_rulePower
statement:
theorem flat_d_rulePower (i : Fin 3) :
    MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0
        (BorisovHNNModel.d ^ rulePower i) = hnnD ^ (i.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [flat_baseEmbedding, map_zpow, baseToG0HNN_d]
  change hnnD ^ rulePower i = hnnD ^ (i.val + 1)
  rw [show rulePower i = ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by simp [rulePower]]
  exact zpow_natCast _ _

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.flat_e_rulePower
statement:
theorem flat_e_rulePower (i : Fin 3) :

        (BorisovHNNModel.e ^ rulePower i) = hnnE ^ (i.val + 1)
proof:
