name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.run_eval
statement:
theorem run_eval (colors : List (Fin 2)) (hne : colors ≠ [])
    (u : ℤˣ) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    ((run colors hne u lastCoeff).map fun s ↦
      MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 s.color ^ (s.sign : ℤ) *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 s.coeff).prod =
      stableProduct colors u *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 lastCoeff
proof:
:= by
  let letter : Fin 2 → MultipleHNN.Extension A0 B0 phi0 := fun color ↦
    MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color ^ (u : ℤ)
  have hletters :
      (colors.dropLast.map letter).prod * letter (colors.getLast hne) =
        stableProduct colors u := by
    unfold stableProduct
    change (colors.dropLast.map letter).prod * letter (colors.getLast hne) =
      (colors.map letter).prod
    calc
      _ = (colors.dropLast.map letter ++
          [letter (colors.getLast hne)]).prod := by
        rw [List.prod_append]
        simp
      _ = (colors.map letter).prod := by
        apply congrArg List.prod
        rw [← List.map_singleton, ← List.map_append,
          List.dropLast_append_getLast hne]
  rw [show run colors hne u lastCoeff =
      colors.dropLast.map (fun color ↦
        { color := color, sign := u, coeff := 1 }) ++
      [{ color := colors.getLast hne, sign := u, coeff := lastCoeff }] from rfl]
  rw [List.map_append, List.prod_append]
  simp only [List.map_map, List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton]
  have hdrop :
      colors.dropLast.map
          ((fun s ↦
            MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 s.color ^ (s.sign : ℤ) *
              MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 s.coeff) ∘
            fun color ↦ ({ color := color, sign := u, coeff := 1 } : FlatSyllable)) =
        colors.dropLast.map letter := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro color _
    change MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color ^ (u : ℤ) *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 1 = letter color
    rw [flat_baseEmbedding_one, mul_one]
  rw [hdrop]
  change (colors.dropLast.map letter).prod *
      (letter (colors.getLast hne) *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 lastCoeff) =
    stableProduct colors u *
      MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 lastCoeff
  rw [← mul_assoc, hletters]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.stableProduct_one
statement:
theorem stableProduct_one (colors : List (Fin 2)) :
    stableProduct colors 1 = modelPositive colors
proof:
:= by
  simp only [stableProduct, modelPositive, Thue.evalPositive]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro color hcolor
  fin_cases color <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.stableProduct_reverse_neg_one
statement:
theorem stableProduct_reverse_neg_one (colors : List (Fin 2)) :
    stableProduct colors.reverse (-1) = (stableProduct colors 1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : ((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) = -1 := by norm_num
  have hone : ((1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) = 1 := by norm_num
  simp only [stableProduct, hneg, hone, zpow_neg, zpow_one]
  rw [List.prod_inv_reverse]
  rw [List.map_reverse]
  have hmap :
      colors.map (fun color ↦
          (MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color)⁻¹) =
        (colors.map fun color ↦
          MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color).map (fun x ↦ x⁻¹) := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [hmap]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.stableProduct_singleton_one
statement:
theorem stableProduct_singleton_one (color : Fin 2) :
    stableProduct [color] 1 =
      MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color
proof:
:= by
  simp [stableProduct]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.stableProduct_singleton_neg_one
statement:
theorem stableProduct_singleton_neg_one (color : Fin 2) :
    stableProduct [color] (-1) =
      (MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 color)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : ((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) = -1 := by norm_num
  simp [stableProduct, hneg]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.toHNN_stable_flat
statement:
theorem toHNN_stable_flat (beta : Fin 2) :
    toHNN (stable beta) =
      MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 beta
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorModel_positive_u
statement:
theorem factorModel_positive_u (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    factorModel datum.F (q, true) = toHNN (uBasis datum q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      rw [factorModel, factorPrefix, suffix, factorColors, signedUnit_true,
        stableProduct_singleton_one, uBasis, toHNN_stable_flat]
      simp only [flat_baseEmbedding_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  | inr i =>
      rw [factorModel, factorPrefix, suffix, factorColors, signedUnit_true,
        stableProduct_one, flat_d_rulePower, flat_e_rulePower]
      change _ = toHNN (a datum i)
      exact (toHNN_a datum i).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorModel_positive_v
statement:
theorem factorModel_positive_v (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    factorModel datum.E (q, true) = toHNN (vBasis datum q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      rw [factorModel, factorPrefix, suffix, factorColors, signedUnit_true,
        stableProduct_singleton_one, vBasis, toHNN_stable_flat]
      simp only [flat_baseEmbedding_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  | inr i =>
      rw [factorModel, factorPrefix, suffix, factorColors, signedUnit_true,
        stableProduct_one, flat_d_rulePower, flat_e_rulePower]
      change _ = toHNN (b datum i)
      exact (toHNN_b datum i).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorModel_negative
statement:
theorem factorModel_negative
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (q : Basis) :
    factorModel rules (q, false) = (factorModel rules (q, true))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      change
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 1 *
            stableProduct [beta] (-1) *
              MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 1 =
          (MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 1 *
              stableProduct [beta] 1 *
                MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 1)⁻¹
      rw [stableProduct_singleton_neg_one, stableProduct_singleton_one]
      simp only [flat_baseEmbedding_one]
      group
  | inr i =>
      change
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0
              (BorisovHNNModel.e ^ (-rulePower i)) *
            stableProduct (rules i).reverse (-1) *
              MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0
                (BorisovHNNModel.d ^ (-rulePower i)) =
          (MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0
                (BorisovHNNModel.d ^ rulePower i) *
              stableProduct (rules i) 1 *
                MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0
                  (BorisovHNNModel.e ^ rulePower i))⁻¹
      rw [stableProduct_reverse_neg_one]
      simp only [map_zpow, zpow_neg, map_inv]
      group

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorModel_u
statement:
theorem factorModel_u (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (x : Basis × Bool) :
    factorModel datum.F x =
      if x.2 then toHNN (uBasis datum x.1)
      else (toHNN (uBasis datum x.1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
  cases sign
  · rw [factorModel_negative, factorModel_positive_u]
    rfl
  · simpa using factorModel_positive_u datum q

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorModel_v
statement:
theorem factorModel_v (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (x : Basis × Bool) :
    factorModel datum.E x =
      if x.2 then toHNN (vBasis datum x.1)
      else (toHNN (vBasis datum x.1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨q, sign⟩
  cases sign
  · rw [factorModel_negative, factorModel_positive_v]
    rfl
  · simpa using factorModel_positive_v datum q

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorRun_eval
statement:
theorem factorRun_eval
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (x : Basis × Bool) (lastCoeff : BorisovHNNModel.Base) :
    ((factorRun rules hne x lastCoeff).map fun s ↦
      MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 s.color ^ (s.sign : ℤ) *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 s.coeff).prod =
      stableProduct (factorColors rules x) (signedUnit x.2) *
        MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 lastCoeff
proof:
:=
  run_eval _ _ _ _

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.expansion_eval
statement:
theorem expansion_eval
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) :
    MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 (expansionHead letters) *
        ((expansionTail rules hne letters).map fun s ↦
          MultipleHNNFlat.stableLetter A0 B0 phi0 s.color ^ (s.sign : ℤ) *
            MultipleHNN.baseEmbedding A0 B0 phi0 s.coeff).prod =
      (letters.map (factorModel rules)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil =>
      simp only [expansionHead, expansionTail, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil,
        flat_baseEmbedding_one, one_mul]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [expansionHead, expansionTail, List.map_append, List.prod_append,
        factorRun_eval]
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          simp only [nextPrefix, factorModel, expansionTail, List.map_nil,
            List.prod_nil, List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton, mul_one]
          exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      | cons y ys =>
          simp only [expansionHead, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons] at ih ⊢
          rw [map_mul]
          rw [← ih]
          simp only [nextPrefix, factorModel]
          group

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.expansionTail_ne_nil
statement:
theorem expansionTail_ne_nil
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) (hletters : letters ≠ []) :
    expansionTail rules hne letters ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  cases letters with
  | nil => exact (hletters rfl).elim
  | cons x xs =>
      intro happ
      have hfirst := (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp happ).1
      exact factorRun_ne_nil rules hne x _ hfirst

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.expansionWord_eval
statement:
theorem expansionWord_eval
    (rules : Fin 3 → List (Fin 2)) (hne : ∀ i, rules i ≠ [])
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hreduced : letters.IsChain (fun x y ↦ x.1 = y.1 → x.2 = y.2)) :
    MultipleHNNFlat.eval A0 B0 phi0
        (expansionWord rules hne letters hreduced) =
      (letters.map (factorModel rules)).prod
proof:
:= by
  simpa [MultipleHNNFlat.eval, expansionWord] using
    expansion_eval rules hne letters

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorProduct_u
statement:
theorem factorProduct_u (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) :
    (letters.map (factorModel datum.F)).prod =
      toHNN (FreeGroup.lift (uBasis datum) (FreeGroup.mk letters))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGroup.lift_mk, map_list_prod]
  congr 1
  rw [List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨q, sign⟩ _
  rw [factorModel_u]
  cases sign <;> simp <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.factorProduct_v
statement:
theorem factorProduct_v (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (letters : List (Basis × Bool)) :
    (letters.map (factorModel datum.E)).prod =
      toHNN (FreeGroup.lift (vBasis datum) (FreeGroup.mk letters))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGroup.lift_mk, map_list_prod]
  congr 1
  rw [List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨q, sign⟩ _
  rw [factorModel_v]
  cases sign <;> simp <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.uExpansion_eval
statement:
theorem uExpansion_eval (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis) :

:= by

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.toWord_ne_nil_of_ne_one

private theorem toWord_ne_nil_of_ne_one {w : FreeGroup Basis} (hw : w ≠ 1) :

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.uLift_ne_one
statement:
theorem uLift_ne_one (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) {w : FreeGroup Basis}

:= by
  have hflat := MultipleHNNFlat.eval_ne_one A0 B0 phi0
    (uExpansion datum w) (uExpansion_toList_ne_nil datum hw)

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.uLift_not_mem_DE3_of_ne_one

theorem uLift_not_mem_DE3_of_ne_one (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.Uc_eq_uLift_range
statement:
theorem Uc_eq_uLift_range (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold Uc
  rw [FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.Vc_eq_vLift_range
statement:
theorem Vc_eq_vLift_range (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    Vc datum = MonoidHom.range (FreeGroup.lift (vBasis datum))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Vc
  rw [FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]

name: Undecidability.BorisovBaseRange.Undecidability.BorisovAssertionIV.assertionIV
statement: theorem assertionIV (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) : AssertionIV datum
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { u_free := uLift_injective datum
      v_free := vLift_injective datum
      correspondence := ?_ }
  let uEquiv : FreeGroup Basis ≃*
      MonoidHom.range (FreeGroup.lift (uBasis datum)) :=
    MonoidHom.ofInjective (uLift_injective datum)
  let vEquiv : FreeGroup Basis ≃*
      MonoidHom.range (FreeGroup.lift (vBasis datum)) :=
    MonoidHom.ofInjective (vLift_injective datum)
  let uCast : Uc datum ≃*
      MonoidHom.range (FreeGroup.lift (uBasis datum)) :=
    MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (Uc_eq_uLift_range datum)
  let vCast : Vc datum ≃*
      MonoidHom.range (FreeGroup.lift (vBasis datum)) :=
    MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (Vc_eq_vLift_range datum)
  let equiv : Uc datum ≃* Vc datum :=
    uCast.trans (uEquiv.symm.trans (vEquiv.trans vCast.symm))
  refine ⟨equiv, ?_⟩
  intro q
  have hu : uCast ⟨uBasis datum q, uBasis_mem_Uc datum q⟩ =
      uEquiv (FreeGroup.of q) := by
    ext
    rw [MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply]
    simp [uCast]
  have hv : vCast ⟨vBasis datum q, vBasis_mem_Vc datum q⟩ =
      vEquiv (FreeGroup.of q) := by
    ext
    rw [MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply]
    simp [vCast]
  change ((equiv ⟨uBasis datum q, uBasis_mem_Uc datum q⟩ : Vc datum) : G0) =
    vBasis datum q
  simp only [equiv, MulEquiv.trans_apply, hu, uEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    ← hv, vCast.symm_apply_apply]

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_stable
statement:
@[simp] theorem g0Equiv_stable
    (beta : Fin 2) :
    g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.stable beta) =
      BorisovCStage.stable3 beta
proof:
:= by
  rw [g0Equiv_apply]
  fin_cases beta <;>
    simp [BorisovCStage.stable3, BorisovG0HNN.hnnS1,
      BorisovG0HNN.hnnS2]

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_uBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem g0Equiv_uBasis
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.uBasis datum q) =
      BorisovCStage.uBasis datum q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      exact g0Equiv_stable beta
  | inr i =>
      change g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.a datum i) =
        BorisovCStage.a3 datum i
      rw [g0Equiv_apply, toHNN_a]
      rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_vBasis
statement:
@[simp] theorem g0Equiv_vBasis
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.vBasis datum q) =
      BorisovCStage.vBasis datum q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl beta =>
      exact g0Equiv_stable beta
  | inr i =>
      change g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.b datum i) =
        BorisovCStage.b3 datum i
      rw [g0Equiv_apply, toHNN_b]
      rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_uLift
statement:
theorem g0Equiv_uLift
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis) :
    g0Equiv (FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.uBasis datum) w) =
      BorisovCStage.uLift datum w
proof:
:= by
  let f : FreeGroup Basis →* BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3 :=
    g0Equiv.toMonoidHom.comp
      (FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.uBasis datum))
  have hf : f = BorisovCStage.uLift datum := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro q
    simpa [f, BorisovCStage.uLift] using g0Equiv_uBasis datum q
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf w

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_vLift
statement:
theorem g0Equiv_vLift
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (w : FreeGroup Basis) :
    g0Equiv (FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.vBasis datum) w) =
      BorisovCStage.vLift datum w
proof:
:= by
  let f : FreeGroup Basis →* BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3 :=
    g0Equiv.toMonoidHom.comp
      (FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.vBasis datum))
  have hf : f = BorisovCStage.vLift datum := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro q
    simpa [f, BorisovCStage.vLift] using g0Equiv_vBasis datum q
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf w

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.rankFiveFree_of_assertionIV
statement:
theorem rankFiveFree_of_assertionIV
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hIV : AssertionIV datum) :
    RankFiveFree datum where
  u_injective
proof:
:= by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hIV.u_free
    apply g0Equiv.injective
    rw [g0Equiv_uLift, g0Equiv_uLift]
    exact hxy

  v_injective := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hIV.v_free
    apply g0Equiv.injective
    rw [g0Equiv_vLift, g0Equiv_vLift]
    exact hxy

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.rankFiveFree
statement: theorem rankFiveFree (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) : RankFiveFree datum
proof:
:=
  rankFiveFree_of_assertionIV datum (assertionIV datum)

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.baseIntersections
statement:
theorem baseIntersections (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) :
    BaseIntersections datum where
  u_inf_DE
proof:
:= by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx.1 with ⟨w, rfl⟩
      by_cases hw : w = 1
      · subst w
        simp
      · exfalso
        apply uLift_not_mem_DE3_of_ne_one datum hw
        rw [← g0Equiv_apply, g0Equiv_uLift]
        exact hx.2
    · exact bot_le
  v_inf_DE := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx.1 with ⟨w, rfl⟩
      by_cases hw : w = 1
      · subst w
        simp
      · exfalso
        apply vLift_not_mem_DE3_of_ne_one datum hw
        rw [← g0Equiv_apply, g0Equiv_vLift]
        exact hx.2
    · exact bot_le

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_d
statement:
@[simp] theorem g0Equiv_d :
    g0Equiv BorisovIntersections.d = d3
proof:
:= by
  change toHNN presentedD = hnnD
  exact toHNN_presentedD

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_e
statement:
@[simp] theorem g0Equiv_e :

  change toHNN presentedE = hnnE
  exact toHNN_presentedE

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_symm_mem_J_of_mem_J3
statement:
private theorem g0Equiv_symm_mem_J_of_mem_J3
    (beta : Fin 2) {x : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3}
    (hx : x ∈ J3 beta) :
    g0Equiv.symm x ∈ BorisovIntersections.J beta
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3 :=
    (BorisovIntersections.J beta).comap g0Equiv.symm.toMonoidHom
  have hle : J3 beta ≤ K := by
    rw [J3, Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · change g0Equiv.symm d3 ∈ BorisovIntersections.J beta
      rw [← g0Equiv_d]
      simp only [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      simp
    · change g0Equiv.symm e3 ∈ BorisovIntersections.J beta
      rw [← g0Equiv_e]
      simp only [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      simp
    · change
        g0Equiv.symm (BorisovCStage.stable3 beta) ∈
          BorisovIntersections.J beta
      rw [← g0Equiv_stable]
      simp only [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact BorisovIntersections.stable_mem_J beta
  exact hle hx

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_mem_stableCyclic3_of_mem_stableCyclic
statement:
private theorem g0Equiv_mem_stableCyclic3_of_mem_stableCyclic
    (beta : Fin 2) {x : BorisovIntersections.G0}
    (hx : x ∈ BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic beta) :
    g0Equiv x ∈ stableCyclic3 beta
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup BorisovIntersections.G0 :=
    (stableCyclic3 beta).comap g0Equiv.toMonoidHom
  have hle : BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic beta ≤ K := by
    rw [BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic, Subgroup.closure_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    change
      g0Equiv (BorisovIntersections.stable beta) ∈ stableCyclic3 beta
    rw [g0Equiv_stable]
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _)
  exact hle hx

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.stableCyclic3_le_U
statement:
theorem stableCyclic3_le_U (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2) :
    stableCyclic3 beta ≤ U datum
proof:
:= by
  rw [stableCyclic3, Subgroup.closure_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨FreeGroup.of (Sum.inl beta), by
    simp [BorisovCStage.uLift, BorisovCStage.uBasis]⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.stableCyclic3_le_V
statement:
theorem stableCyclic3_le_V (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2) :
    stableCyclic3 beta ≤ V datum
proof:
:= by
  rw [stableCyclic3, Subgroup.closure_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨FreeGroup.of (Sum.inl beta), by
    simp [BorisovCStage.vLift, BorisovCStage.vBasis]⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.stableCyclic3_le_J3
statement:
theorem stableCyclic3_le_J3 (beta : Fin 2) :
    stableCyclic3 beta ≤ J3 beta
proof:
:= by
  rw [stableCyclic3, Subgroup.closure_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  apply Subgroup.subset_closure
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_symm_mem_Uc_of_mem_U
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [← g0Equiv_uLift]
  simp only [g0Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.uBasis datum) w ∈
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (BorisovIntersections.uBasis datum))
  rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]
  exact ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.g0Equiv_symm_mem_Vc_of_mem_V
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [← g0Equiv_vLift]
  simp only [g0Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change FreeGroup.lift (BorisovIntersections.vBasis datum) w ∈
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (BorisovIntersections.vBasis datum))
  rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]
  exact ⟨w, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.U_inf_J3
statement:
theorem U_inf_J3 (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2) :
    U datum ⊓ J3 beta = stableCyclic3 beta
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hyU := g0Equiv_symm_mem_Uc_of_mem_U datum hx.1
    have hyJ := g0Equiv_symm_mem_J_of_mem_J3 beta hx.2
    have hy :
        g0Equiv.symm x ∈ BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic beta := by
      rw [← (BorisovLemmaFourTwo.lemma4_2 datum).1 beta |>.1]
      exact ⟨hyU, hyJ⟩
    have hx' := g0Equiv_mem_stableCyclic3_of_mem_stableCyclic beta hy
    simpa only [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hx'
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨stableCyclic3_le_U datum beta hx, stableCyclic3_le_J3 beta hx⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.V_inf_J3
statement:
theorem V_inf_J3 (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2) :
    V datum ⊓ J3 beta = stableCyclic3 beta
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hyV := g0Equiv_symm_mem_Vc_of_mem_V datum hx.1
    have hyJ := g0Equiv_symm_mem_J_of_mem_J3 beta hx.2
    have hy :
        g0Equiv.symm x ∈ BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic beta := by
      rw [← (BorisovLemmaFourTwo.lemma4_2 datum).1 beta |>.2]
      exact ⟨hyV, hyJ⟩
    have hx' := g0Equiv_mem_stableCyclic3_of_mem_stableCyclic beta hy
    simpa only [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hx'
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨stableCyclic3_le_V datum beta hx, stableCyclic3_le_J3 beta hx⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.cEquiv_uStable
statement:
@[simp] theorem cEquiv_uStable
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (beta : Fin 2) :
    ((cEquiv datum hfree (uStable datum beta) : V datum) :
        BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) =
      BorisovCStage.stable3 beta
proof:
:= by
  simpa [uStable, BorisovCStage.uBasis,
    BorisovCStage.vBasis] using
    cEquiv_on_basis datum hfree (Sum.inl beta)

name: Undecidability.BorisovInputsBridge.cEquiv_mem_J3_iff
statement:
theorem cEquiv_mem_J3_iff
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (beta : Fin 2) (a : U datum) :
    (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ∈ J3 beta ↔
      (cEquiv datum hfree a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ∈ J3 beta
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro haJ
    have haC :
        (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ∈ stableCyclic3 beta := by
      rw [← U_inf_J3 datum beta]
      exact ⟨a.property, haJ⟩
    rcases (Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mp haC) with ⟨n, hn⟩
    have ha : a = (uStable datum beta) ^ n := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hn.symm
    rw [ha, map_zpow]
    change
      (cEquiv datum hfree (uStable datum beta) :
          BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ^ n ∈ J3 beta
    rw [cEquiv_uStable]
    apply stableCyclic3_le_J3 beta
    exact Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩
  · intro hbJ
    have hbC :
        (cEquiv datum hfree a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ∈
          stableCyclic3 beta := by
      rw [← V_inf_J3 datum beta]
      exact ⟨(cEquiv datum hfree a).property, hbJ⟩
    rcases (Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mp hbC) with ⟨n, hn⟩
    have ha : a = (uStable datum beta) ^ n := by
      apply (cEquiv datum hfree).injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [map_zpow]
      change
        (cEquiv datum hfree a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) =
          (cEquiv datum hfree (uStable datum beta) :
            BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3) ^ n
      rw [cEquiv_uStable]
      exact hn.symm
    rw [ha]
    change
      BorisovCStage.stable3 beta ^ n ∈ J3 beta
    apply stableCyclic3_le_J3 beta
    exact Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton.mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot
statement:
private theorem element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot
    {G : Type*} [Group G] {H K : Subgroup G}
    (hinter : H ⊓ K = ⊥) {x : G} (hxH : x ∈ H) (hxK : x ∈ K) :
    x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ (⊥ : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [← hinter]
    exact ⟨hxH, hxK⟩
  simpa using hx

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.cEquiv_preserves_dCyclic
statement:
private theorem cEquiv_preserves_dCyclic
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) (a : U datum) :
    (a : Gamma3) ∈ dCyclic ↔
      (cEquiv datum hfree a : Gamma3) ∈ dCyclic
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have ha1 : (a : Gamma3) = 1 :=
      element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot hinter.u_inf_DE a.property
        (dCyclic_le_DE3 ha)
    have ha' : a = 1 := Subtype.ext ha1
    subst a
    simp
  · intro hpa
    have hpa1 : (cEquiv datum hfree a : Gamma3) = 1 :=
      element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot hinter.v_inf_DE
        (cEquiv datum hfree a).property (dCyclic_le_DE3 hpa)
    have hpa' : cEquiv datum hfree a = 1 := Subtype.ext hpa1
    have ha' : a = 1 := (cEquiv datum hfree).injective (by simpa using hpa')
    subst a
    simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff
statement:
theorem cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) (a : U datum) :
    (a : Gamma3) ∈ dCyclic ↔
      (cEquiv datum hfree a : Gamma3) ∈ dCyclic
proof:
:=
  cEquiv_preserves_dCyclic datum hfree hinter a

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.cEquiv_preserves_eCyclic
statement:
private theorem cEquiv_preserves_eCyclic
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) (a : U datum) :
    (a : Gamma3) ∈ eCyclic ↔

proof:

  · intro ha
    have ha1 : (a : Gamma3) = 1 :=
      element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot hinter.u_inf_DE a.property
        (eCyclic_le_DE3 ha)

    subst a
    simp
  · intro hpa
    have hpa1 : (cEquiv datum hfree a : Gamma3) = 1 :=
      element_eq_one_of_mem_inf_bot hinter.v_inf_DE
        (cEquiv datum hfree a).property (eCyclic_le_DE3 hpa)
    have hpa' : cEquiv datum hfree a = 1 := Subtype.ext hpa1

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.CD_le_generatedWithStable_d
statement:
private theorem CD_le_generatedWithStable_d
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) :
    CD datum hfree ≤
      generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) dCyclic
proof:
:= by
  rw [CD, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · have hc : x = c datum hfree := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    have ht : (HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree) ∈
        generatedWithStable
          (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) dCyclic := by
      apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      exact Or.inr rfl
    simpa [c] using
      (generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) dCyclic).inv_mem ht
  · have hd : x = of3 datum hfree d3 := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    apply Or.inl
    exact ⟨d3, Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp), rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.CD_eq_generatedWithStable_d
statement:
theorem CD_eq_generatedWithStable_d
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (_hinter : BaseIntersections datum) :
    CD datum hfree =
      generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree)
        dCyclic
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact CD_le_generatedWithStable_d datum hfree
  · rw [generatedWithStable, Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      let K : Subgroup Gamma3 := (CD datum hfree).comap (of3 datum hfree)
      have hdK : dCyclic ≤ K := by
        rw [dCyclic, Subgroup.closure_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        change of3 datum hfree d3 ∈ CD datum hfree
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        simp
      exact hdK ha
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst x
      have hc : c datum hfree ∈ CD datum hfree := by
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        simp
      simpa [c] using (CD datum hfree).inv_mem hc

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.dRestrictedEquivCD_of_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem dRestrictedEquivCD_of_coe
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) (x : dCyclic) :
    ((dRestrictedEquivCD datum hfree hinter (HNNExtension.of x) :
        CD datum hfree) : Gamma2 datum hfree) =
      of3 datum hfree (x : Gamma3)
proof:
:= by
  change
    ((restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable dCyclic
        (cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff datum hfree hinter)
        (HNNExtension.of x) :
      generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree)
        dCyclic) : Gamma2 datum hfree) = _
  exact restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable_coe dCyclic
    (cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff datum hfree hinter) (HNNExtension.of x)

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.dRestrictedEquivCD_t_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem dRestrictedEquivCD_t_coe
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) :
    ((dRestrictedEquivCD datum hfree hinter
        (HNNExtension.t : DRestricted datum hfree hinter) :
      CD datum hfree) : Gamma2 datum hfree) = HNNExtension.t
proof:
:= by
  change
    ((restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable dCyclic
        (cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff datum hfree hinter)
        (HNNExtension.t : DRestricted datum hfree hinter) :
      generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree)
        dCyclic) : Gamma2 datum hfree) = _
  exact restrictedEquivGeneratedWithStable_coe dCyclic
    (cEquiv_mem_dCyclic_iff datum hfree hinter)
      (HNNExtension.t : DRestricted datum hfree hinter)

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.dRestrictedEquivCD_inv_t_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem dRestrictedEquivCD_inv_t_coe
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) :
    ((dRestrictedEquivCD datum hfree hinter
        ((HNNExtension.t : DRestricted datum hfree hinter)⁻¹) :
      CD datum hfree) : Gamma2 datum hfree) = c datum hfree
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_inv]
  change
    (((dRestrictedEquivCD datum hfree hinter
        (HNNExtension.t : DRestricted datum hfree hinter) :
      CD datum hfree) : Gamma2 datum hfree))⁻¹ = _
  rw [dRestrictedEquivCD_t_coe]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.CE_le_generatedWithStable_e
statement:
private theorem CE_le_generatedWithStable_e
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) :
    CE datum hfree ≤
      generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) eCyclic
proof:
:= by
  rw [CE, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · have hc : x = c datum hfree := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    have ht : (HNNExtension.t : Gamma2 datum hfree) ∈
        generatedWithStable
          (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) eCyclic := by
      apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      exact Or.inr rfl
    simpa [c] using
      (generatedWithStable
        (A := U datum) (B := V datum) (phi := cEquiv datum hfree) eCyclic).inv_mem ht
  · have he : x = of3 datum hfree e3 := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    apply Or.inl

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.exists_leftContext_of_mem_CD
statement:
theorem exists_leftContext_of_mem_CD
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) {x : Gamma2 datum hfree}
    (hx : x ∈ CD datum hfree) :
    ∃ L : LeftContext datum hfree, leftValue datum hfree L = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := CD_le_generatedWithStable_d datum hfree hx
  rcases exists_reducedWord_of_mem_generatedWithStable dCyclic
      (cEquiv_preserves_dCyclic datum hfree hinter) hx' with
    ⟨w, hw, hhead, hcoeff⟩
  exact ⟨⟨w, hhead, hcoeff⟩, hw⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovContextNormalForm.exists_rightContext_of_mem_CE
statement:
theorem exists_rightContext_of_mem_CE
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum) {x : Gamma2 datum hfree}
    (hx : x ∈ CE datum hfree) :
    ∃ R : RightContext datum hfree, rightValue datum hfree R = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := CE_le_generatedWithStable_e datum hfree hx
  rcases exists_reducedWord_of_mem_generatedWithStable eCyclic
      (cEquiv_preserves_eCyclic datum hfree hinter) hx' with
    ⟨w, hw, hhead, hcoeff⟩
  exact ⟨⟨w, hhead, hcoeff⟩, hw⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.full_relator_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FP.evalWord, presentedGenerator] using
    (Borisov.presentation datum).relator_eq_one i

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.g0_relators
proof:
:= by
  rintro r ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · change Word.eval (g0Generator datum)
      (BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator 0) = 1
    simpa [BorisovIntersections.presentation, Borisov.presentation,
      BorisovIntersections.sDRelator, Borisov.s_d_relator,
      BorisovIntersections.dWord, BorisovIntersections.s1Word,
      Borisov.dWord, Borisov.s1Word, g0Generator] using
      full_relator_eq_one datum 0
  · change Word.eval (g0Generator datum)
      (BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator 1) = 1
    simpa [BorisovIntersections.presentation, Borisov.presentation,
      BorisovIntersections.sERelator, Borisov.s_e_relator,
      BorisovIntersections.eWord, BorisovIntersections.s1Word,
      Borisov.eWord, Borisov.s1Word, g0Generator] using
      full_relator_eq_one datum 1
  · change Word.eval (g0Generator datum)
      (BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator 2) = 1
    simpa [BorisovIntersections.presentation, Borisov.presentation,
      BorisovIntersections.sDRelator, Borisov.s_d_relator,
      BorisovIntersections.dWord, BorisovIntersections.s2Word,
      Borisov.dWord, Borisov.s2Word, g0Generator] using
      full_relator_eq_one datum 2
  · change Word.eval (g0Generator datum)
      (BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator 3) = 1
    simpa [BorisovIntersections.presentation, Borisov.presentation,
      BorisovIntersections.sERelator, Borisov.s_e_relator,
      BorisovIntersections.eWord, BorisovIntersections.s2Word,
      Borisov.eWord, Borisov.s2Word, g0Generator] using
      full_relator_eq_one datum 3

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.gamma3ToPresented_positive3
statement:
@[simp] theorem gamma3ToPresented_positive3 (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    gamma3ToPresented datum (positive3 w) =
      Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
        (presentedGenerator datum 3) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [positive3, Thue.evalPositive, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      rw [ih]
      fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [commute_iff_eq]
  have h' : a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = (a * b)⁻¹ :=
    mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp (by simpa [mul_assoc] using h)
  have hi := congrArg Inv.inv h'
  simpa only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using hi.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_c_commutes_stable
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta
  · have h := full_relator_eq_one datum 4
    have h' :
        (presentedGenerator datum 2)⁻¹ *
            (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
            presentedGenerator datum 2 * presentedGenerator datum 4 = 1 := by
      simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.s1Word, Borisov.cWord] using h
    simpa using commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h'
  · have h := full_relator_eq_one datum 5
    have h' :
        (presentedGenerator datum 3)⁻¹ *
            (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
            presentedGenerator datum 3 * presentedGenerator datum 4 = 1 := by
      simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.s2Word, Borisov.cWord] using h
    simpa using commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h'

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_c_conjugates_stable
statement:
private theorem presented_c_conjugates_stable (beta : Fin 2) :
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
        presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3) *
        presentedGenerator datum 4 =
      presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := presented_c_commutes_stable datum beta
  calc
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3) *
          presentedGenerator datum 4 =
        (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          (presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3) *
            presentedGenerator datum 4) := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4 *
            presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3)) := by
          rw [h.eq]
    _ = presentedGenerator datum (if beta = 0 then 2 else 3) := by simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_c_simulation
statement:
private theorem presented_c_simulation (i : Fin 3) :
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
        presentedGenerator datum 0 ^ (i.val + 1) *
        Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) (datum.F i) *
        presentedGenerator datum 1 ^ (i.val + 1) *
        presentedGenerator datum 4 =
      presentedGenerator datum 0 ^ (i.val + 1) *
        Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) (datum.E i) *
        presentedGenerator datum 1 ^ (i.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : Word.eval (presentedGenerator datum)
      (Borisov.simulationRelator datum i) = 1 := by
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [Borisov.presentation] using full_relator_eq_one datum 6
    · simpa [Borisov.presentation] using full_relator_eq_one datum 7
    · simpa [Borisov.presentation] using full_relator_eq_one datum 8
  rw [Borisov.simulationRelator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff] at hrel
  simpa [Borisov.dWord, Borisov.eWord, Borisov.cWord, mul_assoc] using hrel

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_c_conjugates_basis
statement:
private theorem presented_c_conjugates_basis (q : RuleBasis) :
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
        gamma3ToPresented datum (uBasis datum q) *
        presentedGenerator datum 4 =
      gamma3ToPresented datum (vBasis datum q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | inl betaIndex =>
      fin_cases betaIndex
      · simpa [uBasis, vBasis, stable3] using
          presented_c_conjugates_stable datum (0 : Fin 2)
      · simpa [uBasis, vBasis, stable3] using
          presented_c_conjugates_stable datum (1 : Fin 2)
  | inr i =>
      simpa [uBasis, vBasis, a3, b3, map_mul, map_pow, mul_assoc] using
        presented_c_simulation datum i

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_c_conjugates_uLift
statement:
private theorem presented_c_conjugates_uLift
    (x : FreeGroup RuleBasis) :
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
        gamma3ToPresented datum (uLift datum x) *
        presentedGenerator datum 4 =
      gamma3ToPresented datum (vLift datum x)
proof:
:= by
  have heq :
      (MulAut.conj (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹).toMonoidHom.comp
          ((gamma3ToPresented datum).comp (uLift datum)) =
        (gamma3ToPresented datum).comp (vLift datum) := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro q
    simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply, uLift, vLift] using
      presented_c_conjugates_basis datum q
  simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply] using DFunLike.congr_fun heq x

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.c_lift_condition
statement:
private theorem c_lift_condition (a : U datum) :
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
        gamma3ToPresented datum (a : Gamma3) =
      gamma3ToPresented datum (cEquiv datum hfree a : Gamma3) *
        (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases a.property with ⟨x, hx⟩
  let ax : U datum := ⟨uLift datum x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  have hax : a = ax := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hx.symm
  subst a
  have hphi : ((cEquiv datum hfree ax : V datum) : Gamma3) =
      vLift datum x := by
    simp [ax, cEquiv, rangeEquiv_apply_range]
  calc
    (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          gamma3ToPresented datum (ax : Gamma3) =
        ((presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
            gamma3ToPresented datum (uLift datum x) *
            presentedGenerator datum 4) *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ := by
            simp [ax, mul_assoc]
    _ = gamma3ToPresented datum (vLift datum x) *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ := by
            rw [presented_c_conjugates_uLift datum x]
    _ = gamma3ToPresented datum (cEquiv datum hfree ax : Gamma3) *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ := by rw [hphi]

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_t_commutes_c
statement:
private theorem presented_t_commutes_c :
    Commute (presentedGenerator datum 5) (presentedGenerator datum 4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := full_relator_eq_one datum 9
  have h' :
      (presentedGenerator datum 5)⁻¹ *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          presentedGenerator datum 5 * presentedGenerator datum 4 = 1 := by
    simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.tWord, Borisov.cWord] using h

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_t_commutes_d

    Commute (presentedGenerator datum 5) (presentedGenerator datum 0)
proof:

  have h' :
      (presentedGenerator datum 5)⁻¹ *
          (presentedGenerator datum 0)⁻¹ *
          presentedGenerator datum 5 * presentedGenerator datum 0 = 1 := by
    simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.tWord, Borisov.dWord] using h

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.CD_le_t_centralizer
statement:
private theorem CD_le_t_centralizer :
    CD datum hfree ≤
      (Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 5}).comap
        (gamma2ToPresented datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CD, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  change gamma2ToPresented datum hfree x ∈
    Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 5}
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff]
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · have hxc : x = c datum hfree := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    rw [gamma2ToPresented_c]
    exact (presented_t_commutes_c datum).eq.symm
  · have hxd : x = of3 datum hfree d3 := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    rw [gamma2ToPresented_of3, gamma3ToPresented_d3]
    exact (presented_t_commutes_d datum).eq.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.gamma2ToPresented_positive2

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.tStageToPresented_conjugatedT

@[simp] theorem tStageToPresented_conjugatedT (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    tStageToPresented datum hfree (conjugatedT datum hfree w) =
      (Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) w)⁻¹ *
        presentedGenerator datum 5 *
        Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) w
proof:
:= by
  change tStageToPresented datum hfree
      ((toTStage datum hfree (positive2 datum hfree w))⁻¹ *
        tLetter datum hfree *
        toTStage datum hfree (positive2 datum hfree w)) = _
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, tStageToPresented_of,
    tStageToPresented_t, gamma2ToPresented_positive2]

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_k_commutes_c
statement:
private theorem presented_k_commutes_c :
    Commute (presentedGenerator datum 6) (presentedGenerator datum 4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := full_relator_eq_one datum 11
  have h' :
      (presentedGenerator datum 6)⁻¹ *
          (presentedGenerator datum 4)⁻¹ *
          presentedGenerator datum 6 * presentedGenerator datum 4 = 1 := by
    simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.kWord, Borisov.cWord] using h
  exact commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h'

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_k_commutes_e

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.presented_k_commutes_p
statement:
private theorem presented_k_commutes_p :
    Commute (presentedGenerator datum 6)
      ((Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P)⁻¹ *
        presentedGenerator datum 5 *
        Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
          (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P)
proof:
:= by
  have h := full_relator_eq_one datum 13
  have h' :
      (presentedGenerator datum 6)⁻¹ *
          ((Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
            (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P)⁻¹ *
            presentedGenerator datum 5 *
            Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
              (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P)⁻¹ *
          presentedGenerator datum 6 *
          ((Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
            (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P)⁻¹ *
            presentedGenerator datum 5 *
            Thue.evalPositive (presentedGenerator datum 2)
              (presentedGenerator datum 3) datum.P) = 1 := by
    simpa [Borisov.presentation, Borisov.kWord, Borisov.pWord,
      Borisov.tWord, mul_assoc] using h
  exact commute_of_inverse_commutator_eq_one h'

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.CE_le_k_centralizer
statement:
private theorem CE_le_k_centralizer :
    CE datum hfree ≤
      (Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 6}).comap
        (gamma2ToPresented datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CE, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  change gamma2ToPresented datum hfree x ∈
    Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 6}
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff]
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · have hxc : x = c datum hfree := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    rw [gamma2ToPresented_c]
    exact (presented_k_commutes_c datum).eq.symm
  · have hxe : x = of3 datum hfree e3 := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    rw [gamma2ToPresented_of3, gamma3ToPresented_e3]
    exact (presented_k_commutes_e datum).eq.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModelInjective.KSubgroup_le_k_centralizer
statement:
private theorem KSubgroup_le_k_centralizer :
    KSubgroup datum hfree ≤
      (Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 6}).comap
        (tStageToPresented datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KSubgroup, generatedWith, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  change tStageToPresented datum hfree x ∈
    Subgroup.centralizer {presentedGenerator datum 6}
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff]
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rw [tStageToPresented_of]
    have hmem := CE_le_k_centralizer datum hfree ha
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hmem
  · have hx' : x = conjugatedT datum hfree datum.P := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    rw [tStageToPresented_conjugatedT]
    exact (presented_k_commutes_p datum).eq.symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.cEquiv_on_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cEquiv_on_basis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (q : RuleBasis) :
    ((cEquiv datum hfree
        ⟨uBasis datum q, ⟨FreeGroup.of q, by simp [uLift]⟩⟩ : V datum) : Gamma3) =
      vBasis datum q
proof:
:= by
  let source : U datum :=
    ⟨uBasis datum q, ⟨FreeGroup.of q, by simp [uLift]⟩⟩
  let canonical : U datum :=
    ⟨uLift datum (FreeGroup.of q), ⟨FreeGroup.of q, rfl⟩⟩
  have hsource : source = canonical := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [source, canonical, uLift]
  change ((cEquiv datum hfree source : V datum) : Gamma3) = _
  rw [hsource]
  change vLift datum
      ((equivRangeOfInjective (uLift datum) hfree.u_injective).symm canonical) =
    vBasis datum q
  have hy :
      (equivRangeOfInjective (uLift datum) hfree.u_injective).symm canonical =
        FreeGroup.of q := by
    apply hfree.u_injective
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((equivRangeOfInjective (uLift datum) hfree.u_injective).apply_symm_apply
        canonical)
  rw [hy]
  simp [vLift]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.of3_injective
statement:
theorem of3_injective (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) :
    Function.Injective (of3 datum hfree)
proof:
:=
  HNNExtension.of_injective (cEquiv datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.c_conjugates_basis
statement:
theorem c_conjugates_basis (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (q : RuleBasis) :
    (c datum hfree)⁻¹ * of3 datum hfree (uBasis datum q) * c datum hfree =
      of3 datum hfree (vBasis datum q)
proof:
:= by
  let uq : U datum :=
    ⟨uBasis datum q, ⟨FreeGroup.of q, by simp [uLift]⟩⟩
  have ht := HNNExtension.t_mul_of (φ := cEquiv datum hfree) uq
  change HNNExtension.t * HNNExtension.of (uBasis datum q) * HNNExtension.t⁻¹ =
    HNNExtension.of (vBasis datum q)
  rw [ht]
  simp [uq, cEquiv_on_basis]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.c_commutes_stable
statement:
theorem c_commutes_stable (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (beta : Fin 2) :
    Commute (of3 datum hfree (stable3 beta)) (c datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [commute_iff_eq]
  have h := c_conjugates_basis datum hfree (Sum.inl beta)
  change (c datum hfree)⁻¹ * of3 datum hfree (stable3 beta) * c datum hfree =
    of3 datum hfree (stable3 beta) at h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x => c datum hfree * x) h
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hc

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.c_simulation

    (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) (i : Fin 3) :

      of3 datum hfree (b3 datum i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [uBasis, vBasis] using
    c_conjugates_basis datum hfree (Sum.inr i)

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.positiveFree_eq_eval
statement:
theorem positiveFree_eq_eval (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    positiveFree w =
      Thue.evalPositive (FreeGroup.of 0) (FreeGroup.of 1) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w ih =>
      calc
        positiveFree (i :: w) = FreeGroup.of i * positiveFree w := by
          simp only [positiveFree, List.map_cons]
          change FreeGroup.mk ((i, true) :: w.map fun k => (k, true)) =
            FreeGroup.mk [(i, true)] * FreeGroup.mk (w.map fun k => (k, true))
          rw [FreeGroup.mul_mk]
          rfl
        _ = FreeGroup.of i *
              Thue.evalPositive (FreeGroup.of 0) (FreeGroup.of 1) w := by
          rw [ih]
        _ = Thue.evalPositive (FreeGroup.of 0) (FreeGroup.of 1) (i :: w) := by
          fin_cases i <;> simp [Thue.evalPositive]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.stableProjection3_positive
statement:
theorem stableProjection3_positive (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    stableProjection3 (positive3 w) = positiveFree w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact FreeGroup.one_eq_mk
  | cons i w ih =>
      have hcons : positive3 (i :: w) =
          (if i = 0 then s1_3 else s2_3) * positive3 w := by
        simp [positive3, Thue.evalPositive]
      rw [hcons, map_mul, ih]
      rw [positiveFree_eq_eval, positiveFree_eq_eval]
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Thue.evalPositive]

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.positiveLetters_reduced
statement:
private theorem positiveLetters_reduced (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    FreeGroup.IsReduced (w.map fun i => (i, true))
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [FreeGroup.IsReduced]
  | cons i w ih =>
      cases w with
      | nil => simp [FreeGroup.IsReduced]
      | cons j w =>
          change List.IsChain (fun a b : Fin 2 × Bool =>
            a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2)
              ((i, true) :: (j, true) :: w.map fun k => (k, true))
          rw [List.isChain_cons]
          exact ⟨by simp, ih⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.positiveFree_injective
statement: theorem positiveFree_injective : Function.Injective positiveFree
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hreduce := FreeGroup.reduce.sound huv
  have hu := (positiveLetters_reduced u).reduce_eq
  have hv := (positiveLetters_reduced v).reduce_eq
  rw [hu, hv] at hreduce
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin 2 => (i, true)) := by
    intro i j h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  exact hinj.list_map hreduce

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.DE3_le_projection_ker
statement:
theorem DE3_le_projection_ker :
    DE3 ≤ MonoidHom.ker stableProjection3
proof:
:= by
  rw [DE3, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with (rfl | hx)
  · simp
  · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx ▸ stableProjection3_e

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.lemma4_zero_c
statement:
theorem lemma4_zero_c
    (P Q : List (Fin 2)) (L R : Gamma3)
    (hL : L ∈ DE3) (hR : R ∈ DE3)
    (heq : (positive3 P)⁻¹ * L * positive3 Q * R = 1) :
    P = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hmap := congrArg stableProjection3 heq
  have hL1 : stableProjection3 L = 1 := DE3_le_projection_ker hL
  have hR1 : stableProjection3 R = 1 := DE3_le_projection_ker hR
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv, map_one, stableProjection3_positive,
    hL1, hR1, mul_one] at hmap
  have hpq : positiveFree P = positiveFree Q :=
    inv_mul_eq_one.mp hmap
  exact positiveFree_injective hpq

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.dCyclic_le_DE3
statement: theorem dCyclic_le_DE3 : dCyclic ≤ DE3
proof:
:= by
  rw [dCyclic, Subgroup.closure_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.eCyclic_le_DE3
statement: theorem eCyclic_le_DE3 : eCyclic ≤ DE3
proof:

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.lemma4_of_context_lists_nil
statement:
theorem lemma4_of_context_lists_nil
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (P Q : List (Fin 2))
    (L : LeftContext datum hfree) (R : RightContext datum hfree)
    (hLnil : L.word.toList = []) (hRnil : R.word.toList = [])
    (heq : Lemma4Equation datum hfree P Q L R) :
    ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q P
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      (positive3 P)⁻¹ * L.word.head * positive3 Q * R.word.head = 1 := by
    apply of3_injective datum hfree
    simpa [Lemma4Equation, positive2, leftValue, rightValue,
      HNNExtension.NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod, hLnil, hRnil,
      map_mul, map_inv, of3] using heq
  have hPQ : P = Q :=
    lemma4_zero_c P Q L.word.head R.word.head
      (dCyclic_le_DE3 L.head_mem) (eCyclic_le_DE3 R.head_mem) hbase
  subst P
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.equation_iff_factorization
statement:
theorem equation_iff_factorization
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (P L Q R : G) :
    P⁻¹ * L * Q * R = 1 ↔ P = L * Q * R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply inv_mul_eq_one.mp
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    group

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.thueStep_rule_forward
statement:
theorem thueStep_rule_forward
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (l r : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    ThueStep (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E)
      (l ++ datum.F i ++ r) (l ++ datum.E i ++ r)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨l, r, datum.F i, datum.E i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.thueStep_rule_backward
statement:
theorem thueStep_rule_backward
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (l r : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3) :
    ThueStep (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E)
      (l ++ datum.E i ++ r) (l ++ datum.F i ++ r)
proof:

  exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.borisovLemma4_of_pinchReduction
statement:
theorem borisovLemma4_of_pinchReduction
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum)
    (hpinch : PinchReduction datum hfree) :
    BorisovLemma4 datum hfree
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q L R heq
  generalize hn : contextComplexity datum hfree L R = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing Q L R with
  | h n ih =>
      rcases hpinch P Q L R heq with hzero | hstep
      · have hsum : L.word.toList.length + R.word.toList.length = 0 := by
          simpa [contextComplexity] using hzero
        have hlens := Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hsum
        have hLnil : L.word.toList = [] :=
          List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hlens.1
        have hRnil : R.word.toList = [] :=
          List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hlens.2
        exact lemma4_of_context_lists_nil datum hfree P Q L R hLnil hRnil heq
      · rcases hstep with ⟨Q', L', R', hQQ', heq', hlt⟩
        apply hQQ'.trans
        have hlt' : contextComplexity datum hfree L' R' < n := by
          simpa [hn] using hlt
        exact ih (contextComplexity datum hfree L' R') hlt'
          Q' L' R' heq' rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovCStage.cExponent_c
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cExponent_c
    (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (hfree : RankFiveFree datum) :
    cExponent datum hfree (c datum hfree) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [c, cExponent]

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.eval_positiveWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_positiveWord (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree) (Borisov.positiveWord w) =
      cStageToFinal datum hfree (positive2 datum hfree w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Borisov.positiveWord, Word.eval_substitutePositive,
    eval_s1Word, eval_s2Word]
  change
    (w.map fun i => if i = 0 then modelS1 datum hfree else modelS2 datum hfree).prod =
      cStageToFinal datum hfree
        (of3 datum hfree
          ((w.map fun i => if i = 0 then s1_3 else s2_3).prod))
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i w ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, map_mul]
      rw [ih]
      fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.inverse_commutator_eq_one
statement:
private theorem inverse_commutator_eq_one {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {a b : G} (h : Commute a b) : a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h.eq]
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_d_four_mul_s1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [modelD, modelS1, map_mul, map_pow] using
    congrArg (cStageToFinal datum hfree)
      (congrArg (of3 datum hfree) gamma3_d_four_mul_s1)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_e_mul_s1
proof:
:= by

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.conjugation_of_transport
statement:
private theorem conjugation_of_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (d s : G) (h : d ^ 4 * s = s * d) :
    s⁻¹ * d ^ 4 * s = d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    s⁻¹ * d ^ 4 * s = s⁻¹ * (d ^ 4 * s) := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = s⁻¹ * (s * d) := by rw [h]
    _ = d := by simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.conjugation_e_of_transport
statement:
private theorem conjugation_e_of_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (e s : G) (h : e * s = s * e ^ 4) :
    s⁻¹ * e * s = e ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  calc
    s⁻¹ * e * s = s⁻¹ * (e * s) := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = s⁻¹ * (s * e ^ 4) := by rw [h]
    _ = e ^ 4 := by simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_c_commutes_s1
statement:
private theorem model_c_commutes_s1 :
    Commute (modelS1 datum hfree) (modelC datum hfree)
proof:
:=
  (c_commutes_stable datum hfree 0).map (cStageToFinal datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_c_commutes_s2
statement:
private theorem model_c_commutes_s2 :
    Commute (modelS2 datum hfree) (modelC datum hfree)
proof:
:=
  (c_commutes_stable datum hfree 1).map (cStageToFinal datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_c_simulation
statement:
private theorem model_c_simulation (i : Fin 3) :
    (modelC datum hfree)⁻¹ *
        modelD datum hfree ^ (i.val + 1) *
        Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
          (Borisov.positiveWord (datum.F i)) *
        modelE datum hfree ^ (i.val + 1) * modelC datum hfree =
      modelD datum hfree ^ (i.val + 1) *
        Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
          (Borisov.positiveWord (datum.E i)) *
        modelE datum hfree ^ (i.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (cStageToFinal datum hfree)
    (c_simulation datum hfree i)
  rw [eval_positiveWord, eval_positiveWord]
  simpa [a3, b3, positive2, modelC, modelD, modelE,
    cStageToFinal, map_mul, map_inv, map_pow, mul_assoc] using h

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_t_commutes_c
statement:
private theorem model_t_commutes_c :
    Commute (modelT datum hfree) (modelC datum hfree)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : c datum hfree ∈ CD datum hfree :=
    Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have h := (centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff
    (CD datum hfree) (c datum hfree)).2 hc
  exact h.symm.map (toFinalStage datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_t_commutes_d

    Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have h := (centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff
    (CD datum hfree) (of3 datum hfree d3)).2 hd
  exact h.symm.map (toFinalStage datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.mapped_CE_mem_K
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.subset_closure
  exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_k_commutes_c
statement:
private theorem model_k_commutes_c :
    Commute (modelK datum hfree) (modelC datum hfree)
proof:
:= by

    Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hmem := mapped_CE_mem_K datum hfree hc
  exact ((centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff
    (KSubgroup datum hfree) (toTStage datum hfree (c datum hfree))).2 hmem).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_k_commutes_p
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : conjugatedT datum hfree datum.P ∈ KSubgroup datum hfree := by
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    exact Or.inr rfl
  exact ((centralizerOf_commute_stable_iff
    (KSubgroup datum hfree) (conjugatedT datum hfree datum.P)).2 hmem).symm

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.model_relators
proof:
:= by
  rintro r ⟨i, rfl⟩
  change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
    ((Borisov.presentation datum).relator i) = 1
  fin_cases i
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.s_d_relator Borisov.s1Word) = 1
    rw [Borisov.s_d_relator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      conjugation_of_transport _ _ (model_d_four_mul_s1 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.s_e_relator Borisov.s1Word) = 1
    rw [Borisov.s_e_relator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      conjugation_e_of_transport _ _ (model_e_mul_s1 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.s_d_relator Borisov.s2Word) = 1
    rw [Borisov.s_d_relator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      conjugation_of_transport _ _ (model_d_four_mul_s2 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.s_e_relator Borisov.s2Word) = 1
    rw [Borisov.s_e_relator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      conjugation_e_of_transport _ _ (model_e_mul_s2 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.s1Word Borisov.cWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_c_commutes_s1 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.s2Word Borisov.cWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_c_commutes_s2 datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.simulationRelator datum 0) = 1
    rw [Borisov.simulationRelator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using model_c_simulation datum hfree 0
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.simulationRelator datum 1) = 1
    rw [Borisov.simulationRelator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using model_c_simulation datum hfree 1
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.simulationRelator datum 2) = 1
    rw [Borisov.simulationRelator, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using model_c_simulation datum hfree 2
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.tWord Borisov.cWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_t_commutes_c datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.tWord Borisov.dWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_t_commutes_d datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.kWord Borisov.cWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_k_commutes_c datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.kWord Borisov.eWord) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    exact inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_k_commutes_e datum hfree)
  · change Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Word.commutator Borisov.kWord (Borisov.pWord datum)) = 1
    simp only [Word.eval_commutator]
    have hp : Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree) (Borisov.pWord datum) =
        finalConjugatedT datum hfree datum.P := by
      rw [Borisov.pWord, Word.eval_product]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil,
        Word.eval_inverse, eval_positiveWord, eval_tWord, mul_one]
      simp [modelT, finalConjugatedT, conjugatedT, conjugatedStable,
        centralizerOf, toTStage, tLetter, cStageToFinal, map_mul, map_inv,
        mul_assoc]
    simpa [hp] using inverse_commutator_eq_one (model_k_commutes_p datum hfree)

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.toFinalModel_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFinalModel_of (i : Fin 7) :
    toFinalModel datum hfree (PresentedGroup.of i) = modelGenerator datum hfree i
proof:
:= by
  simp [toFinalModel]

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.toFinalModel_evalWord
statement:
theorem toFinalModel_evalWord (w : Borisov.BorisovWord) :
    toFinalModel datum hfree ((Borisov.presentation datum).evalWord w) =
      Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [FP.evalWord, Word.map_eval]
  apply congrArg (fun q : Fin 7 → FinalStage datum hfree => Word.eval q w)
  funext i
  exact toFinalModel_of datum hfree i

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.eval_testWord
statement:
theorem eval_testWord :
    Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree) (Borisov.testWord Q) =
      (finalConjugatedT datum hfree Q)⁻¹ * (modelK datum hfree)⁻¹ *
        finalConjugatedT datum hfree Q * modelK datum hfree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Borisov.testWord, Word.eval_commutator]
  simp only [Word.eval_product, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
    List.prod_nil, Word.eval_inverse, eval_positiveWord, eval_tWord,
    eval_kWord, mul_one]
  simp [finalConjugatedT, conjugatedT, conjugatedStable, centralizerOf,
    toTStage, tLetter, modelT, modelK, cStageToFinal, map_mul, map_inv,
    mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.BorisovFinalModel.criterion_converse_of_borisov_inputs
statement:
theorem criterion_converse_of_borisov_inputs
    (hinter : BaseIntersections datum)
    (hlemma4 : BorisovLemma4 datum hfree)
    (Q : List (Fin 2)) :
    (Borisov.presentation datum).wordProblem (Borisov.testWord Q) →
      ThueEq (Thue.systemOf datum.F datum.E) Q datum.P
proof:
:= by
  intro hword
  have hpresented : (Borisov.presentation datum).evalWord
      (Borisov.testWord Q) = 1 :=
    ((Borisov.presentation datum).wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one
      (Borisov.testWord Q)).mp hword
  have hmodel := congrArg (toFinalModel datum hfree) hpresented
  have hmodel' : Word.eval (modelGenerator datum hfree)
      (Borisov.testWord Q) = 1 := by
    rw [← toFinalModel_evalWord datum hfree]
    simpa using hmodel
  have htest :
      (finalConjugatedT datum hfree Q)⁻¹ * (kLetter datum hfree)⁻¹ *
          finalConjugatedT datum hfree Q * kLetter datum hfree = 1 := by
    rw [eval_testWord] at hmodel'
    simpa [modelK] using hmodel'
  exact model_test_eq_one_imp_thueEq datum hfree hinter hlemma4 Q htest

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.uBasis_mem_Uc
statement:
theorem uBasis_mem_Uc (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    uBasis datum q ∈ Uc datum
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨q, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.vBasis_mem_Vc
statement:
theorem vBasis_mem_Vc (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (q : Basis) :
    vBasis datum q ∈ Vc datum
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨q, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.stable_mem_J
statement: theorem stable_mem_J (beta : Fin 2) : stable beta ∈ J beta
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.subset_closure
  simp

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.other_ne
statement: private theorem other_ne (beta : Fin 2) : other beta ≠ beta
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases beta <;> decide

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.letter_is_stable_of_no_other
statement:
private theorem letter_is_stable_of_no_other
    (w : FreeGroup Basis) (beta : Fin 2)
    (h : ∀ gamma : Fin 2, gamma ≠ beta → ¬ UsesStable w gamma)
    (letter : Basis × Bool) (hletter : letter ∈ w.toWord) :
    letter.1 = Sum.inl beta
proof:
:= by
  cases hq : letter.1 with
  | inl gamma =>
      by_cases hgb : gamma = beta
      · simp [hgb]
      · exact (h gamma hgb ⟨letter, hletter, by simp [hq]⟩).elim
  | inr i =>
      exact
        (h (other beta) (other_ne beta)
          ⟨letter, hletter, by simp [hq]⟩).elim

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.toWord_eq_nil_of_no_stable
statement:
private theorem toWord_eq_nil_of_no_stable
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (h : ∀ gamma : Fin 2, ¬ UsesStable w gamma) :
    w.toWord = []
proof:
:= by
  cases hw : w.toWord with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons letter tail =>
      have hletter : letter ∈ w.toWord := by simp [hw]
      cases hq : letter.1 with
      | inl gamma => exact (h gamma ⟨letter, hletter, by simp [hq]⟩).elim
      | inr i => exact (h 0 ⟨letter, hletter, by simp [hq]⟩).elim

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.freeGroup_eq_one_of_no_stable
statement:
private theorem freeGroup_eq_one_of_no_stable
    (w : FreeGroup Basis)
    (h : ∀ gamma : Fin 2, ¬ UsesStable w gamma) : w = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FreeGroup.mk_toWord (x := w), toWord_eq_nil_of_no_stable w h]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.lift_mk_mem_stableCyclic
statement:
private theorem lift_mk_mem_stableCyclic
    (basis : Basis → G0) (beta : Fin 2) (letters : List (Basis × Bool))
    (hletters : ∀ letter ∈ letters, letter.1 = Sum.inl beta) :
    FreeGroup.lift basis (FreeGroup.mk letters) ∈
      Subgroup.closure ({basis (Sum.inl beta)} : Set G0)
proof:
:= by
  let C := Subgroup.closure ({basis (Sum.inl beta)} : Set G0)
  have hgen : basis (Sum.inl beta) ∈ C := by
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    simp
  induction letters with
  | nil => exact C.one_mem
  | cons letter tail ih =>
      rcases letter with ⟨q, sign⟩
      have hq : q = Sum.inl beta := hletters (q, sign) (by simp)
      subst q
      have iht : FreeGroup.lift basis (FreeGroup.mk tail) ∈ C :=
        ih (by
          intro letter hletter
          exact hletters letter (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hletter))
      cases sign
      · simpa [C] using C.mul_mem (C.inv_mem hgen) iht
      · simpa [C] using C.mul_mem hgen iht

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.lift_mem_stableCyclic
statement:
private theorem lift_mem_stableCyclic
    (basis : Basis → G0) (w : FreeGroup Basis) (beta : Fin 2)
    (h : ∀ gamma : Fin 2, gamma ≠ beta → ¬ UsesStable w gamma) :
    FreeGroup.lift basis w ∈
      Subgroup.closure ({basis (Sum.inl beta)} : Set G0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FreeGroup.mk_toWord (x := w)]
  apply lift_mk_mem_stableCyclic basis beta w.toWord
  intro letter hletter
  exact letter_is_stable_of_no_other w beta h letter hletter

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic_le_Uc
statement:
private theorem stableCyclic_le_Uc (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (beta : Fin 2) : stableCyclic beta ≤ Uc datum
proof:
:= by
  unfold stableCyclic
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  subst g
  exact uBasis_mem_Uc datum (Sum.inl beta)

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic_le_Vc
statement:
private theorem stableCyclic_le_Vc (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (beta : Fin 2) : stableCyclic beta ≤ Vc datum
proof:
:= by
  unfold stableCyclic
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  subst g
  exact vBasis_mem_Vc datum (Sum.inl beta)

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.stableCyclic_le_J
statement:
private theorem stableCyclic_le_J (beta : Fin 2) :
    stableCyclic beta ≤ J beta
proof:
:= by
  unfold stableCyclic
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  subst g
  exact stable_mem_J beta

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.Uc_inf_J
statement:
theorem Uc_inf_J (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2)
    (hIV : AssertionIV datum) (hV : AssertionV datum hIV) :
    Uc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    have hgU := hg.1
    change g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (uBasis datum)) at hgU
    rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure] at hgU
    rcases hgU with ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact lift_mem_stableCyclic (uBasis datum) w beta
      (fun gamma hne => hV.u_mem_J w beta gamma hg.2 hne)
  · intro g hg
    exact ⟨stableCyclic_le_Uc datum beta hg, stableCyclic_le_J beta hg⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.Vc_inf_J
statement:
theorem Vc_inf_J (datum : Thue.StandingDatum) (beta : Fin 2)
    (hIV : AssertionIV datum) (hV : AssertionV datum hIV) :
    Vc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    have hgV := hg.1
    change g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (vBasis datum)) at hgV
    rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure] at hgV
    rcases hgV with ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact lift_mem_stableCyclic (vBasis datum) w beta
      (fun gamma hne => hV.v_mem_J w beta gamma hg.2 hne)
  · intro g hg
    exact ⟨stableCyclic_le_Vc datum beta hg, stableCyclic_le_J beta hg⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.Uc_inf_DE
statement:
theorem Uc_inf_DE (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hIV : AssertionIV datum) (hV : AssertionV datum hIV) :
    Uc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    have hgU := hg.1
    change g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (uBasis datum)) at hgU
    rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure] at hgU
    rcases hgU with ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hw : w = 1 := freeGroup_eq_one_of_no_stable w (hV.u_mem_DE w hg.2)
    subst w
    simp
  · exact bot_le

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.Vc_inf_DE
statement:
theorem Vc_inf_DE (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hIV : AssertionIV datum) (hV : AssertionV datum hIV) :
    Vc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    have hgV := hg.1
    change g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (vBasis datum)) at hgV
    rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure] at hgV
    rcases hgV with ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hw : w = 1 := freeGroup_eq_one_of_no_stable w (hV.v_mem_DE w hg.2)
    subst w
    simp
  · exact bot_le

name: Undecidability.BorisovIntersections.lemma4_2
statement:
theorem lemma4_2 (datum : Thue.StandingDatum)
    (hIV : AssertionIV datum) (hV : AssertionV datum hIV) :
    (∀ beta : Fin 2,
      Uc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta ∧
      Vc datum ⊓ J beta = stableCyclic beta) ∧
    Uc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥ ∧ Vc datum ⊓ DE = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, Uc_inf_DE datum hIV hV, Vc_inf_DE datum hIV hV⟩
  intro beta
  exact ⟨Uc_inf_J datum beta hIV hV, Vc_inf_J datum beta hIV hV⟩

name: Undecidability.BorisovG0HNN.presented_s1D
statement:
private theorem presented_s1D :
    presentedS1⁻¹ * presentedD ^ 4 * presentedS1 = presentedD
proof:
:= by
  have h := BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator_eq_one (0 : Fin 4)
  change Word.eval (fun i : Fin 4 =>
      (PresentedGroup.of i : BorisovIntersections.G0))
    (BorisovIntersections.presentation.relator 0) = 1 at h
  have h' : Word.eval (fun i : Fin 4 =>
      (PresentedGroup.of i : BorisovIntersections.G0))
      (BorisovIntersections.sDRelator BorisovIntersections.s1Word) = 1 := by
    simpa [BorisovIntersections.presentation] using h
  change Word.eval (fun i : Fin 4 =>
      (PresentedGroup.of i : BorisovIntersections.G0))
      (Word.relation
        (Word.product [Word.inverse BorisovIntersections.s1Word,
          Word.pow BorisovIntersections.dWord 4,
          BorisovIntersections.s1Word])
        BorisovIntersections.dWord) = 1 at h'
  rw [Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff] at h'
  rw [presentedD_eq_of, presentedS1_eq_of]
  simpa [BorisovIntersections.dWord, BorisovIntersections.s1Word,
    mul_assoc] using h'

  change Word.eval (fun i : Fin 4 =>
      (PresentedGroup.of i : BorisovIntersections.G0))
      (Word.relation
        (Word.product [Word.inverse BorisovIntersections.s1Word,
          BorisovIntersections.eWord, BorisovIntersections.s1Word])
        (Word.pow BorisovIntersections.eWord 4)) = 1 at h'
  rw [Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff] at h'
  rw [presentedE_eq_of, presentedS1_eq_of]

    mul_assoc] using h'
