name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_prefix_congr
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa
  | cons x l ih =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
      unfold firstNormal
      split <;> simp_all

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_housekeeping
statement:
theorem firstNormal_housekeeping
    (l r : List A₂) (i : Fin 4) :
    firstNormal (l ++ housekeepingF i ++ r) =
      firstNormal (l ++ housekeepingE i ++ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc]
  apply firstNormal_prefix_congr l
  fin_cases i <;> simp [housekeepingF, housekeepingE]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstStep_rule
statement:
private theorem firstStep_rule (i : Fin 4) (l r : List A₂) :
    FirstStep (l ++ housekeepingF i ++ r) (l ++ housekeepingE i ++ r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨l, r, i, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstStep_prefix
statement:
theorem firstStep_prefix (l : List A₂) {X Y : List A₂}
    (h : FirstStep X Y) : FirstStep (l ++ X) (l ++ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l', r, i, rfl, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨l ++ l', r, i, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstEq_prefix
statement:
theorem firstEq_prefix (l : List A₂) {X Y : List A₂}
    (h : FirstEq X Y) : FirstEq (l ++ X) (l ++ Y)
proof:
:=
  h.lift (l ++ ·) (fun _ _ hstep => firstStep_prefix l hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.pushE_reachable
statement: theorem pushE_reachable (W : List A₂) : FirstEq (e :: W) (pushE W)
proof:
:= by
  induction W using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | singleton x => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | cons_cons x y rest ih _ =>
      fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y
      · exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          (firstStep_rule 0 [] rest)).trans (firstEq_prefix [a] ih)
      · exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          (firstStep_rule 1 [] rest)).trans (firstEq_prefix [b] ih)
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          (firstStep_rule 2 [] rest)).trans (firstEq_prefix [a] ih)
      · exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          (firstStep_rule 3 [] rest)).trans (firstEq_prefix [b] ih)
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_reachable
statement: theorem firstNormal_reachable (W : List A₂) : FirstEq W (firstNormal W)
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | nil => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | cons x W ih =>
      have htail : FirstEq (x :: W) (x :: firstNormal W) := by
        simpa only [List.singleton_append] using firstEq_prefix [x] ih
      by_cases hx : x = e
      · subst x
        exact htail.trans (by simpa using pushE_reachable (firstNormal W))
      · simpa [firstNormal, hx] using htail

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.eCount_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem eCount_nil : eCount [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.eCount_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem eCount_append (X Y : List A₂) :
    eCount (X ++ Y) = eCount X + eCount Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [eCount]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.eCount_replicate_a
statement:
@[simp] theorem eCount_replicate_a (n : ℕ) :
    eCount (List.replicate n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold eCount
  rw [List.count_eq_zero]
  simp [a, e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.eCount_ae
statement: @[simp] theorem eCount_ae : eCount [a, e] = 1
proof: := by decide

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstStep_eCount
statement:
theorem firstStep_eCount {X Y : List A₂} (h : FirstStep X Y) :
    eCount X = eCount Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, r, i, rfl, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i <;> simp [housekeepingF, housekeepingE, eCount, a, b, e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstEq_eCount
statement:
theorem firstEq_eCount {X Y : List A₂} (h : FirstEq X Y) :
    eCount X = eCount Y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.trans (firstStep_eCount hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_eCount
statement:
theorem firstNormal_eCount (W : List A₂) :
    eCount (firstNormal W) = eCount W
proof:
:=
  (firstEq_eCount (firstNormal_reachable W)).symm

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.liftBinary_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftBinary_cons (x : Fin 2) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    liftBinary (x :: W) = liftBit x :: liftBinary W
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.liftBinary_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftBinary_append (X Y : List (Fin 2)) :
    liftBinary (X ++ Y) = liftBinary X ++ liftBinary Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftBinary]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.eCount_liftBinary
statement:
@[simp] theorem eCount_liftBinary (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    eCount (liftBinary W) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold eCount
  rw [List.count_eq_zero]
  simp [liftBinary, liftBit, e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.liftBit_injective
statement: theorem liftBit_injective : Function.Injective liftBit
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Fin.ext
  exact congrArg (fun z : A₂ => z.val) h

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.liftBinary_injective
statement: theorem liftBinary_injective : Function.Injective liftBinary
proof:
:=
  liftBit_injective.list_map

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.encode_computable
statement: theorem encode_computable (u : ℕ) : Computable (encode u)
proof:
:= by
  have hlift : Primrec liftBinary :=
    Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
      ((Primrec.dom_finite liftBit).comp₂ Primrec₂.right)
  have hwithA : Primrec fun W : List (Fin 2) => liftBinary W ++ [a] :=
    Primrec.list_append.comp hlift (Primrec.const [a])
  exact (Primrec.list_append.comp hwithA
    (Primrec.const (List.replicate u e))).to_comp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.encode_ne_nil
statement: theorem encode_ne_nil (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) : encode u W ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  simp [encode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.encode_eCount
statement:
@[simp] theorem encode_eCount (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    eCount (encode u W) = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [show encode u W =
    liftBinary W ++ ([a] ++ List.replicate u e) by simp [encode]]
  rw [eCount_append, eCount_liftBinary]
  simp [eCount, a, e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.pushE_replicate_e
statement:
@[simp] theorem pushE_replicate_e (u : ℕ) :
    pushE (List.replicate u e) = e :: List.replicate u e
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u =>
      cases u with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ u =>
          rw [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_succ]
          simp [pushE, e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_replicate_e
statement:
theorem firstNormal_replicate_e (u : ℕ) :
    firstNormal (List.replicate u e) = List.replicate u e
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u ih =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, firstNormal_e_cons, ih]
      exact pushE_replicate_e u

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_liftBinary_append
statement:
theorem firstNormal_liftBinary_append (W : List (Fin 2)) (T : List A₂) :
    firstNormal (liftBinary W ++ T) =
      liftBinary W ++ firstNormal T
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x W ih =>
      rw [liftBinary_cons, List.cons_append]
      fin_cases x
      · change firstNormal (a :: (liftBinary W ++ T)) =
          a :: (liftBinary W ++ firstNormal T)
        rw [firstNormal_a_cons, ih]
      · change firstNormal (b :: (liftBinary W ++ T)) =
          b :: (liftBinary W ++ firstNormal T)
        rw [firstNormal_b_cons, ih]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_encode
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstNormal_encode (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    firstNormal (encode u W) = encode u W
proof:
:= by
  unfold encode
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  rw [firstNormal_liftBinary_append]
  simp only [List.singleton_append, firstNormal_a_cons,
    firstNormal_replicate_e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.stage₂_side_eCount
statement:
theorem stage₂_side_eCount (L M : List A₂)
    (hLM : eCount L = eCount M) (i : Fin 5) :
    eCount (stage₂F L i) = eCount (stage₂E M i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change List.count (2 : Fin 3) [2, 0, 0] = List.count 2 [0, 2]
    decide
  · change List.count (2 : Fin 3) [2, 0, 1] = List.count 2 [1, 2]
    decide
  · change List.count (2 : Fin 3) [2, 1, 0] = List.count 2 [0, 2]
    decide
  · change List.count (2 : Fin 3) [2, 1, 1] = List.count 2 [1, 2]
    decide
  · change eCount L = eCount M
    exact hLM

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.stage₂Step_eCount
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, r, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, hwords⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  have hsides := stage₂_side_eCount L M hLM i
  rcases hwords with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa [eCount, Nat.add_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun n => eCount l + n + eCount r) hsides
  · simpa [eCount, Nat.add_assoc] using
      (congrArg (fun n => eCount l + n + eCount r) hsides).symm

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.stage₂Eq_eCount
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.trans (stage₂Step_eCount L M hLM hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.hasARun_prefix
statement:
theorem hasARun_prefix (p : List A₂) {k : ℕ} {W : List A₂}
    (h : HasARun k W) : HasARun k (p ++ W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p ++ l, r, ?_⟩
  simp only [List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.hasARun_of_le
statement:
theorem hasARun_of_le {m n : ℕ} {W : List A₂} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (h : HasARun n W) : HasARun m W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨l, List.replicate (n - m) a ++ r, ?_⟩
  calc
    l ++ List.replicate n a ++ r =
        l ++ List.replicate (m + (n - m)) a ++ r := by
          rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hmn]
    _ = l ++ List.replicate m a ++
        (List.replicate (n - m) a ++ r) := by
          simp only [List.replicate_add, List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.pushE_replicate_even
statement:
theorem pushE_replicate_even (k : ℕ) (W : List A₂) :
    pushE (List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ W) =
      List.replicate k a ++ pushE W
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 + 2 * k by omega,
        List.replicate_add]
      change pushE (a :: a :: (List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ W)) =
        a :: (List.replicate k a ++ pushE W)
      rw [pushE_aa, ih]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.pushE_singleton_hasARun
statement:
theorem pushE_singleton_hasARun (x : A₂) (k : ℕ) (W : List A₂) :
    HasARun k (pushE (x :: List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ W))
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨[], pushE (x :: W), by simp⟩
  | succ k =>
      have hrep :
          List.replicate (2 * (k + 1)) a ++ W =
            a :: (List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ (a :: W)) := by
        rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 1 + 2 * k + 1 by omega,
          List.replicate_add, List.replicate_add]
        simp only [List.replicate_one,
          List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      change HasARun (k + 1)
        (pushE (x :: (List.replicate (2 * (k + 1)) a ++ W)))
      by_cases hx : x = e
      · subst x
        apply hasARun_of_le (by omega : k + 1 ≤ 2 * (k + 1))
        refine ⟨[e, e], W, ?_⟩
        calc
          pushE (e :: (List.replicate (2 * (k + 1)) a ++ W)) =
              e :: e :: (List.replicate (2 * (k + 1)) a ++ W) := by
                rw [hrep]
                simp [pushE, a, e]
          _ = [e, e] ++ List.replicate (2 * (k + 1)) a ++ W := by
                simp
      · rw [hrep]
        have hpush : ∀ Z : List A₂,
            pushE (x :: a :: Z) = a :: pushE Z := by
          intro Z
          have hxe : x ≠ (2 : A₂) := by simpa [e] using hx
          simp [pushE, hxe, a, e]
        rw [hpush, pushE_replicate_even]
        refine ⟨[], pushE (a :: W), ?_⟩
        simp only [List.nil_append]
        rw [show k + 1 = Nat.succ k by omega, List.replicate_succ]
        simp only [List.cons_append]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.pushE_hasARun_half
statement:
theorem pushE_hasARun_half {k : ℕ} {W : List A₂}
    (h : HasARun (2 * k) W) : HasARun k (pushE W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, rfl⟩ := h
  induction l using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      rw [pushE_replicate_even]
      exact ⟨[], pushE r, by simp⟩
  | singleton x =>
      exact pushE_singleton_hasARun x k r
  | cons_cons x y l ih _ =>
      by_cases hxy : x ≠ e ∧ y ≠ e
      · rw [show x :: y :: l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r =
            x :: y :: (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r) by simp]
        change HasARun k (if x ≠ e ∧ y ≠ e then
          y :: pushE (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r)
          else e :: x :: y :: (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r))
        rw [if_pos hxy]
        exact hasARun_prefix [y] ih
      · rw [show x :: y :: l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r =
            x :: y :: (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r) by simp]
        change HasARun k (if x ≠ e ∧ y ≠ e then
          y :: pushE (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r)
          else e :: x :: y :: (l ++ List.replicate (2 * k) a ++ r))
        rw [if_neg hxy]
        apply hasARun_of_le (by omega : k ≤ 2 * k)
        exact ⟨[e, x, y] ++ l, r, by simp [List.append_assoc]⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_replicate_a_append
statement:
theorem firstNormal_replicate_a_append (n : ℕ) (W : List A₂) :
    firstNormal (List.replicate n a ++ W) =
      List.replicate n a ++ firstNormal W
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ]
      simp only [List.cons_append, firstNormal_a_cons, ih]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.firstNormal_hasARun_scaled
statement:
theorem firstNormal_hasARun_scaled (X Y : List A₂) (k : ℕ) :
    HasARun k (firstNormal
      (X ++ List.replicate (2 ^ eCount X * k) a ++ Y))
proof:
:= by
  induction X generalizing k with
  | nil =>
      rw [eCount_nil, pow_zero, one_mul, List.nil_append,
        firstNormal_replicate_a_append]
      exact ⟨[], firstNormal Y, by simp⟩
  | cons x X ih =>
      by_cases hx : x = e
      · subst x
        change HasARun k (pushE (firstNormal
          (X ++ List.replicate (2 ^ eCount (e :: X) * k) a ++ Y)))
        simpa [eCount, pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm,
          Nat.mul_left_comm] using
            (pushE_hasARun_half (ih (k := 2 * k)))
      · have hi := hasARun_prefix [x] (ih (k := k))
        simpa [eCount, hx, firstNormal] using hi

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.noAAA_not_hasARun_three
statement:
theorem noAAA_not_hasARun_three {W : List A₂} (h : NoAAA W) :
    ¬ HasARun 3 W
proof:
:= by
  simpa [NoAAA, HasARun] using h

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.longRunRequirement_two_power
statement:
theorem longRunRequirement_two_power (u : ℕ) :
    LongRunRequirement u (2 * 2 ^ u)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y hnormal
  by_contra hbound
  have hlt : eCount X < u := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hbound
  have hpow : 2 ^ (eCount X + 2) ≤ 2 ^ (u + 1) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hscale : 2 ^ eCount X * 4 ≤ 2 * 2 ^ u := by
    calc
      2 ^ eCount X * 4 = 2 ^ (eCount X + 2) := by
        rw [pow_add]
        congr
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (u + 1) := hpow
      _ = 2 * 2 ^ u := by simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hrep :
      List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u) a ++ Y =
        List.replicate (2 ^ eCount X * 4) a ++
          (List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u - 2 ^ eCount X * 4) a ++ Y) := by
    calc
      List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u) a ++ Y =
          List.replicate
            (2 ^ eCount X * 4 + (2 * 2 ^ u - 2 ^ eCount X * 4)) a ++ Y := by
              rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hscale]
      _ = List.replicate (2 ^ eCount X * 4) a ++
          (List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u - 2 ^ eCount X * 4) a ++ Y) := by
            simp only [List.replicate_add, List.append_assoc]
  have hfour : HasARun 4
      (firstNormal (X ++ List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u) a ++ Y)) := by
    rw [List.append_assoc, hrep, ← List.append_assoc]
    exact firstNormal_hasARun_scaled X
      (List.replicate (2 * 2 ^ u - 2 ^ eCount X * 4) a ++ Y) 4
  exact noAAA_not_hasARun_three hnormal
    (hasARun_of_le (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) hfour)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.phi₂_residual_long_context
statement:
theorem phi₂_residual_long_context {run : ℕ} {W : List A₂}
    (hshape : LongShape run W) (l : List (Fin 2)) (R : List A₂) :
    ∃ middle,
      phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ W ++ (0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ R) =
        phi₂ l ++ List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [a, e] ++ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨middle, rfl⟩ := hshape
  refine ⟨middle, ?_⟩
  have hblock :
      rho₂ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [b]) ++ [(0 : Fin 2)] =
      rho₂ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [a, e]) := by
    simp [rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, b, e, List.append_assoc]
  calc
    phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [b]) ++
        (0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ R) =
        phi₂ (l ++ (rho₂ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [b]) ++
          [(0 : Fin 2)]) ++ rho₂ R) := by
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    _ = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [a, e]) ++
          rho₂ R) := by rw [hblock]
    _ = phi₂ l ++ (List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [a, e]) ++ R :=
      phi₂_context_rho₂ l _ R
    _ = phi₂ l ++ List.replicate run a ++ middle ++ [a, e] ++ R := by
      simp only [List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.long_aligned_of_decoded_reachable
statement:
theorem long_aligned_of_decoded_reachable {u run : ℕ}
    {L M X : List A₂} {W : List (Fin 2)}
    (hLM : eCount L = eCount M)
    (hX : eCount X = u)
    (hNoAAA : ReachableNoAAA L M X)
    (hRun : LongRunRequirement u run)
    (hshapeL : LongShape run L)
    (hshapeM : LongShape run M)
    (hdecode : ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X (phi₂ W)) :
    ∀ l r,
      (W = l ++ rho₂ L ++ r ∨ W = l ++ rho₂ M ++ r) →
      rho₂ (phi₂ r) = r
proof:
:= by
  intro l r hocc
  rcases rho₂_phi₂_reconstruct r with hexact | hresidual
  · exact hexact
  · have hnormal : NoAAA (firstNormal (phi₂ W)) :=
      hNoAAA (phi₂ W) hdecode
    have hform : ∃ middle,
        phi₂ W = phi₂ l ++ List.replicate run a ++
          middle ++ [a, e] ++ phi₂ r := by
      rcases hocc with hocc | hocc
      · obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle⟩ :=
          phi₂_residual_long_context hshapeL l (phi₂ r)
        refine ⟨middle, ?_⟩
        calc
          phi₂ W = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ L ++ r) := congrArg phi₂ hocc
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ L ++
              (0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by rw [hresidual]
          _ = _ := hmiddle
      · obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle⟩ :=
          phi₂_residual_long_context hshapeM l (phi₂ r)
        refine ⟨middle, ?_⟩
        calc
          phi₂ W = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ M ++ r) := congrArg phi₂ hocc
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ M ++
              (0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by rw [hresidual]
          _ = _ := hmiddle
    obtain ⟨middle, hform⟩ := hform
    rw [hform] at hnormal
    have hleft : u ≤ eCount (phi₂ l) := by
      apply hRun (phi₂ l) (middle ++ [a, e] ++ phi₂ r)
      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using hnormal
    have hcount := stage₂Eq_eCount L M hLM hdecode
    rw [hX, hform] at hcount
    simp only [eCount_append, eCount_replicate_a, eCount_ae,
      Nat.add_zero] at hcount
    omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.final_decode_and_aligned
statement:
theorem final_decode_and_aligned {u run : ℕ}
    {L M X : List A₂} {W : List (Fin 2)}
    (hLM : eCount L = eCount M)
    (hX : eCount X = u)
    (hNoAAA : ReachableNoAAA L M X)
    (hRun : LongRunRequirement u run)
    (hshapeL : LongShape run L)
    (hshapeM : LongShape run M)
    (hfinal : ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) (rho₂ X) W) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X (phi₂ W) ∧
      ∀ l r,
        (W = l ++ rho₂ L ++ r ∨ W = l ++ rho₂ M ++ r) →
        rho₂ (phi₂ r) = r
proof:
:= by
  induction hfinal with
  | refl =>
      have hdecode :
          ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X (phi₂ (rho₂ X)) := by
        rw [phi₂_rho₂]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      exact ⟨hdecode, long_aligned_of_decoded_reachable hLM hX hNoAAA
        hRun hshapeL hshapeM hdecode⟩
  | tail hab hbc ih =>
      have hstep : ThueEq (stage₂System L M) (phi₂ _) (phi₂ _) :=
        phi₂_step_of_long_aligned L M ih.2 hbc
      have hdecode := ih.1.trans hstep
      exact ⟨hdecode, long_aligned_of_decoded_reachable hLM hX hNoAAA
        hRun hshapeL hshapeM hdecode⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.longRuleAlignedFrom_of_invariants
statement:
theorem longRuleAlignedFrom_of_invariants {u run : ℕ}
    {L M X : List A₂}
    (hLM : eCount L = eCount M)
    (hX : eCount X = u)
    (hNoAAA : ReachableNoAAA L M X)
    (hRun : LongRunRequirement u run)
    (hshapeL : LongShape run L)
    (hshapeM : LongShape run M) :
    LongRuleAlignedFrom L M X
proof:
:= by
  intro W hfinal
  exact (final_decode_and_aligned hLM hX hNoAAA hRun
    hshapeL hshapeM hfinal).2

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.rho₂_iff_of_priority_invariants
statement:
theorem rho₂_iff_of_priority_invariants {u run : ℕ}
    {L M X : List A₂}
    (hLM : eCount L = eCount M)
    (hX : eCount X = u)
    (hNoAAA : ReachableNoAAA L M X)
    (hRun : LongRunRequirement u run)
    (hshapeL : LongShape run L)
    (hshapeM : LongShape run M) (Y : List A₂) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X Y ↔
      ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) (rho₂ X) (rho₂ Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply rho₂_iff_of_longRuleAligned
  exact longRuleAlignedFrom_of_invariants hLM hX hNoAAA hRun
    hshapeL hshapeM

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.width_gt_two
proof:
:= by
  have hp := Padding.p_pos F E
  have hmul (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : 2 < k * (n + 5) := by
    calc
      2 < n + 5 := by omega
      _ = 1 * (n + 5) := by simp
      _ ≤ k * (n + 5) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hk
  constructor
  · exact hmul _ hp
  · simpa [Precompression.rightWidth, Padding.q] using
      hmul (Padding.p F E + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.longShape_of_prefix_and_last
statement:
private theorem longShape_of_prefix_and_last
    {W : List Priority.A₂} {run : ℕ}
    (hprefix : ∃ tail, W = List.replicate run a ++ tail)
    (hlength : run < W.length)
    (hlast : ∃ init, W = init ++ [b]) : LongShape run W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := hprefix
  have htail_ne : tail ≠ [] := by
    intro hempty
    subst tail
    rw [htail] at hlength
    simp at hlength
  have hlastW : W.getLast? = some b := by
    obtain ⟨init, rfl⟩ := hlast
    simp
  have hlastTail : tail.getLast? = some b := by
    calc
      tail.getLast? = (List.replicate run a ++ tail).getLast? :=
        (List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ htail_ne).symm
      _ = W.getLast? := congrArg List.getLast? htail.symm
      _ = some b := hlastW
  obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp hlastTail
  exact ⟨middle, by rw [htail, hmiddle, List.append_assoc]⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.transposedShape
statement:
private theorem transposedShape
    (rows : Fin (t n r) → List (Fin 2)) (width : ℕ)
    (hwidth : 2 < width)
    (hlength : ∀ i, (rows i).length = width)
    (hstarts : ∀ i, ∃ tail, rows i = (0 : Fin 2) :: 0 :: tail)
    (hends : ∀ i, ∃ init, rows i = init ++ [(1 : Fin 2)]) :
    LongShape (2 * t n r) (liftBinary (transpose width rows))
proof:
:= by
  apply longShape_of_prefix_and_last
  · obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := transpose_starts_two_columns rows
      (Nat.le_of_lt hwidth) hstarts
    refine ⟨liftBinary tail, ?_⟩
    rw [htail, liftBinary_append]
    simp [liftBinary, liftBit, a]
  · simp only [liftBinary, List.length_map, transpose_length]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hwidth (t_pos n r)
  · exact liftBinary_transpose_ends_b rows (t_pos n r) (by omega)
      hlength hends

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.leftShape
statement:
theorem leftShape (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) :
    LongShape (2 * t n r) (leftLong F E)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [leftLong] using transposedShape (paddedLeftRows F E)
    (Precompression.leftWidth F E) (width_gt_two F E).1
    (paddedLeftRows_length F E) (paddedLeftRows_starts_aa F E)
    (paddedLeftRows_ends_b F E)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.rightShape
statement:
theorem rightShape (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) :
    LongShape (2 * t n r) (rightLong F E)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rightLong] using transposedShape (paddedRightRows F E)
    (Precompression.rightWidth F E) (width_gt_two F E).2
    (paddedRightRows_length F E) (paddedRightRows_starts_aa F E)
    (paddedRightRows_ends_b F E)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.stage₂F_housekeepingIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₂F_housekeepingIndex (L : List Priority.A₂)
    (i : Fin 4) :
    stage₂F L (housekeepingIndex i) = housekeepingF i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [stage₂F, housekeepingF, housekeepingIndex] <;> decide

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.stage₂E_housekeepingIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₂E_housekeepingIndex (M : List Priority.A₂)
    (i : Fin 4) :
    stage₂E M (housekeepingIndex i) = housekeepingE i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [stage₂E, housekeepingE, housekeepingIndex] <;> decide

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.firstStep_to_thueStep
statement:
theorem firstStep_to_thueStep (L M : List Priority.A₂)
    {X Y : List Priority.A₂} (h : FirstStep X Y) :
    ThueStep (stage₂System L M) X Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, s, i, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨l, s, housekeepingF i, housekeepingE i,
    ⟨housekeepingIndex i, by simp⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.firstEq_to_stage₂Eq
statement:
theorem firstEq_to_stage₂Eq (L M : List Priority.A₂)
    {X Y : List Priority.A₂} (h : FirstEq X Y) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X Y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.tail (firstStep_to_thueStep L M hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.firstEq_paddedTransposeLast_expand
statement:
private theorem firstEq_paddedTransposeLast_expand
    (u width : ℕ) (rows : Fin (2 ^ u) → List (Fin 2))
    (j : Fin (2 ^ u)) (z : Fin 2) (tail : List (Fin 2))
    (hlen : ∀ i, (rows i).length = width) :
    FirstEq
      (List.replicate u e ++
        liftBinary (paddedTransposeLast width rows j z ++ expand u tail))
      (liftBinary (rows j ++ z :: tail) ++ List.replicate u e)
proof:
:= by
  have hpad : 2 ^ u ∣ (paddedTransposeLast width rows j z).length := by
    refine ⟨width + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using paddedTransposeLast_length rows j z
  have htotal : 2 ^ u ∣
      (paddedTransposeLast width rows j z ++ expand u tail).length := by
    rw [List.length_append]
    exact Nat.dvd_add hpad (expand_length_dvd u tail)
  have hthin :
      thin u (paddedTransposeLast width rows j z ++ expand u tail) =
        rows j ++ z :: tail := by
    rw [thin_append_of_dvd u _ _ hpad,
      thin_paddedTranspose_last u width rows j z hlen, thin_expand]
    simp
  have h := firstNormal_reachable
    (List.replicate u e ++
      liftBinary (paddedTransposeLast width rows j z ++ expand u tail))
  rw [firstNormal_replicate_e_liftBinary u _ htotal, hthin] at h
  exact h

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.append_zero_eq_cons
statement:
private theorem append_zero_eq_cons (right : List (Fin 2)) :
    ∃ z tail, right ++ [0] = z :: tail
proof:
:= by
  cases right with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, [], rfl⟩
  | cons z tail => exact ⟨z, tail ++ [0], rfl⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.encode_append_eq
statement:
private theorem encode_append_eq (u : ℕ) (X Y : List (Fin 2)) :
    encode u (X ++ Y) = liftBinary X ++ encode u Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [encode, List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.simulate_row
statement:
private theorem simulate_row (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (t n r)) (left right : List (Fin 2)) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System (leftLong F E) (rightLong F E))
      (encode (u n r) (left ++ paddedLeftRows F E j ++ right))
      (encode (u n r) (left ++ paddedRightRows F E j ++ right))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, tail, hright⟩ := append_zero_eq_cons right
  let leftBlock := paddedTransposeLast
    (Precompression.leftWidth F E) (paddedLeftRows F E) j z ++
      expand (u n r) tail
  let rightBlock := paddedTransposeLast
    (Precompression.rightWidth F E) (paddedRightRows F E) j z ++
      expand (u n r) tail
  have liftBinary_nil : liftBinary [] = [] := rfl
  have hleft : FirstEq
      (List.replicate (u n r) e ++ liftBinary leftBlock)
      (encode (u n r) (paddedLeftRows F E j ++ right)) := by
    have h := firstEq_paddedTransposeLast_expand
      (u n r) (Precompression.leftWidth F E)
      (paddedLeftRows F E) j z tail (paddedLeftRows_length F E)
    have hrow : paddedLeftRows F E j ++ z :: tail =
        (paddedLeftRows F E j ++ right) ++ [0] := by
      rw [← hright]
      simp
    rw [hrow] at h
    convert h using 1 <;>
      (simp [leftBlock, encode, liftBinary_append, liftBit, a,
        liftBinary_nil, List.append_assoc]; try rfl)
  have hright' : FirstEq
      (List.replicate (u n r) e ++ liftBinary rightBlock)
      (encode (u n r) (paddedRightRows F E j ++ right)) := by
    have h := firstEq_paddedTransposeLast_expand
      (u n r) (Precompression.rightWidth F E)
      (paddedRightRows F E) j z tail (paddedRightRows_length F E)
    have hrow : paddedRightRows F E j ++ z :: tail =
        (paddedRightRows F E j ++ right) ++ [0] := by
      rw [← hright]
      simp
    rw [hrow] at h
    convert h using 1 <;>
      (simp [rightBlock, encode, liftBinary_append, liftBit, a,
        liftBinary_nil, List.append_assoc]; try rfl)
  have hlong : ThueEq (stage₂System (leftLong F E) (rightLong F E))
      (List.replicate (u n r) e ++ liftBinary leftBlock)
      (List.replicate (u n r) e ++ liftBinary rightBlock) := by
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
    refine ⟨List.replicate (u n r) e ++
        liftBinary (List.replicate (t n r - 1 - j.val) 0),
      liftBinary (List.replicate j.val 0 ++ [z] ++ expand (u n r) tail),
      leftLong F E, rightLong F E, ⟨4, by simp [stage₂F, stage₂E]⟩, ?_⟩
    left
    constructor <;>
      simp [leftBlock, rightBlock, paddedTransposeLast,
        leftLong, rightLong, liftBinary_append, List.append_assoc]
  have hinner : ThueEq (stage₂System (leftLong F E) (rightLong F E))
      (encode (u n r) (paddedLeftRows F E j ++ right))
      (encode (u n r) (paddedRightRows F E j ++ right)) :=
    (thueEq_symm (firstEq_to_stage₂Eq _ _ hleft)).trans
      (hlong.trans (firstEq_to_stage₂Eq _ _ hright'))
  simpa [encode_append_eq, List.append_assoc] using
    thueEq_context (liftBinary left) [] hinner

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Compression.simulate_binary
statement:
theorem simulate_binary (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    {X Y : List (Fin 2)} (h : ThueEq (binarySystem F E) X Y) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System (leftLong F E) (rightLong F E))
      (encode (u n r) X) (encode (u n r) Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hstep ih =>
      rcases hstep with ⟨left, right, x, y, ⟨j, hrow⟩, hwords⟩
      injection hrow with hx hy
      subst x
      subst y
      rcases hwords with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ih.trans (simulate_row F E j left right)
      · exact ih.trans (thueEq_symm (simulate_row F E j left right))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem rho₂_cons (x : A₂) (W : List A₂) :
    rho₂ (x :: W) = rho₂Letter x ++ rho₂ W
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho₂]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem rho₂_append (X Y : List A₂) :
    rho₂ (X ++ Y) = rho₂ X ++ rho₂ Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho₂]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_computable
statement: theorem rho₂_computable : Computable rho₂
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id
    ((Primrec.dom_finite rho₂Letter).comp₂ Primrec₂.right)).to_comp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂Aux_rho₂_reverse_append
proof:
:= by
  induction W generalizing Z with
  | nil => simp [rho₂]
  | cons x W ih =>
      rw [rho₂_cons, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc, ih]
      fin_cases x
      · simp only [rho₂Letter]
        rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
        simp [a]
      · simp only [rho₂Letter]
        rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
        simp [b]
      · simp only [rho₂Letter]
        rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
        simp [e]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_rho₂
statement: @[simp] theorem phi₂_rho₂ (W : List A₂) : phi₂ (rho₂ W) = W
proof:
:= by
  have h := phi₂Aux_rho₂_reverse_append W []
  simp only [List.append_nil] at h
  rw [phi₂, h]
  simp [phi₂Aux]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_append_rho₂
statement:
theorem phi₂_append_rho₂ (X : List (Fin 2)) (W : List A₂) :
    phi₂ (X ++ rho₂ W) = phi₂ X ++ W
proof:
:= by
  have h := phi₂Aux_rho₂_reverse_append W X.reverse
  have h' := congrArg List.reverse h
  simpa [phi₂, List.reverse_append] using h'

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_context_rho₂
statement:
theorem phi₂_context_rho₂ (l : List (Fin 2)) (X Y : List A₂) :
    phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ X ++ rho₂ Y) = phi₂ l ++ X ++ Y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ X ++ rho₂ Y) =
        phi₂ (l ++ (rho₂ X ++ rho₂ Y)) := by rw [List.append_assoc]
    _ = phi₂ (l ++ rho₂ (X ++ Y)) := by rw [rho₂_append]
    _ = phi₂ l ++ (X ++ Y) := phi₂_append_rho₂ l (X ++ Y)
    _ = phi₂ l ++ X ++ Y := by rw [List.append_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_context_of_encoded_block
proof:
:= by
  subst block
  exact phi₂_context_rho₂ l X Y

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂Reverse_cons
statement:
private theorem rho₂Reverse_cons (x : A₂) (W : List A₂) :
    rho₂Reverse (x :: W) = (rho₂Letter x).reverse ++ rho₂Reverse W
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho₂Reverse, rho₂]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.fin₂_cases
statement: private theorem fin₂_cases (x : Fin 2) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.fin₃_cases
statement: private theorem fin₃_cases (x : Fin 3) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = 2
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂Aux_c
statement:
@[simp] private theorem phi₂Aux_c (Z : List (Fin 2)) :
    phi₂Aux ((1 : Fin 2) :: Z) = a :: phi₂Aux Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
  simp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂Aux_dd
statement:
@[simp] private theorem phi₂Aux_dd (Z : List (Fin 2)) :
    phi₂Aux ((0 : Fin 2) :: 0 :: Z) = e :: phi₂Aux Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
  simp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂Aux_dc
statement:
@[simp] private theorem phi₂Aux_dc (Z : List (Fin 2)) :
    phi₂Aux ((0 : Fin 2) :: 1 :: Z) = b :: phi₂Aux Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [phi₂Aux.eq_def]
  simp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂Reverse_a
statement:
@[simp] private theorem rho₂Reverse_a (W : List A₂) :
    rho₂Reverse (a :: W) = (1 : Fin 2) :: rho₂Reverse W
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rho₂Letter, a] using rho₂Reverse_cons a W

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂Reverse_b
statement:
@[simp] private theorem rho₂Reverse_b (W : List A₂) :
    rho₂Reverse (b :: W) = (0 : Fin 2) :: 1 :: rho₂Reverse W
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rho₂Letter, b] using rho₂Reverse_cons b W

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂Reverse_e
statement:
@[simp] private theorem rho₂Reverse_e (W : List A₂) :
    rho₂Reverse (e :: W) = (0 : Fin 2) :: 0 :: rho₂Reverse W
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rho₂Letter, e] using rho₂Reverse_cons e W

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂Aux_reconstruct
proof:
:= by
  induction Z using List.twoStepInduction with
  | nil => exact Or.inl (by simp [phi₂Aux, rho₂Reverse, rho₂])
  | singleton x =>
      rcases fin₂_cases x with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [phi₂Aux.eq_def, rho₂Reverse, rho₂])
      · exact Or.inl (by
          rw [phi₂Aux_c, rho₂Reverse_a]
          simp [phi₂Aux, rho₂Reverse, rho₂])
  | cons_cons x y xs ih ih₁ =>
      rcases fin₂_cases x with rfl | rfl
      · rcases fin₂_cases y with rfl | rfl
        · rcases ih with h | h
          · exact Or.inl (by
              rw [phi₂Aux_dd, rho₂Reverse_e]
              exact congrArg ((0 : Fin 2) :: 0 :: ·) h)
          · exact Or.inr (by
              rw [phi₂Aux_dd, rho₂Reverse_e]
              simpa only [List.cons_append] using
                congrArg ((0 : Fin 2) :: 0 :: ·) h)
        · rcases ih with h | h
          · exact Or.inl (by
              rw [phi₂Aux_dc, rho₂Reverse_b]
              exact congrArg ((0 : Fin 2) :: 1 :: ·) h)
          · exact Or.inr (by
              rw [phi₂Aux_dc, rho₂Reverse_b]
              simpa only [List.cons_append] using
                congrArg ((0 : Fin 2) :: 1 :: ·) h)
      · have htail := ih₁ y
        rcases htail with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (by
            rw [phi₂Aux_c, rho₂Reverse_a]
            exact congrArg ((1 : Fin 2) :: ·) h)
        · exact Or.inr (by
            rw [phi₂Aux_c, rho₂Reverse_a]
            simpa only [List.cons_append] using congrArg ((1 : Fin 2) :: ·) h)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_phi₂_reconstruct
statement:
theorem rho₂_phi₂_reconstruct (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    rho₂ (phi₂ W) = W ∨ (0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ W) = W
proof:
:= by
  have h := phi₂Aux_reconstruct W.reverse
  rcases h with h | h
  · left
    have := congrArg List.reverse h
    simpa [phi₂, rho₂Reverse] using this.symm
  · right
    have := congrArg List.reverse h
    simpa [phi₂, rho₂Reverse] using this.symm

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.base_rule_step
statement:
private theorem base_rule_step (U V : List (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 3)
    (l r : List (Fin 2)) :
    ThueStep (baseSystem U V)
      (l ++ baseF U i ++ r) (l ++ baseE V i ++ r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨l, r, baseF U i, baseE V i, ⟨i, rfl⟩,
    Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_rule
statement:
theorem rho₂_rule (L M : List A₂) (i : Fin 5) :
    ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M))
      (rho₂ (stage₂F L i)) (rho₂ (stage₂E M i))
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (by simpa [rho₂, rho₂Letter, stage₂F, stage₂E, baseF, baseE, a, b, e] using
        base_rule_step (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M) 1 [] [])
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (by simpa [rho₂, rho₂Letter, stage₂F, stage₂E, baseF, baseE, a, b, e] using
        base_rule_step (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M) 1 [] [(0 : Fin 2)])
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (by simpa [rho₂, rho₂Letter, stage₂F, stage₂E, baseF, baseE, a, b, e] using
        base_rule_step (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M) 0 [] [])
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (by simpa [rho₂, rho₂Letter, stage₂F, stage₂E, baseF, baseE, a, b, e] using
        base_rule_step (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M) 0 [] [(0 : Fin 2)])
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (by simpa [rho₂, rho₂Letter, stage₂F, stage₂E, baseF, baseE, a, b, e] using
        base_rule_step (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M) 2 [] [])

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_step
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, r, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, h⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa only [rho₂_append] using
      thueEq_context (rho₂ l) (rho₂ r) (rho₂_rule L M i)
  · simpa only [rho₂_append] using
      thueEq_context (rho₂ l) (rho₂ r) (thueEq_symm (rho₂_rule L M i))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_forward
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hbc ih => exact ih.trans (rho₂_step L M hbc)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_ne_nil
statement: theorem rho₂_ne_nil {W : List A₂} (hW : W ≠ []) : rho₂ W ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  cases W with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons x W =>
      fin_cases x <;> simp [rho₂, rho₂Letter]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.stage₂_rule_step
statement:
private theorem stage₂_rule_step (L M : List A₂) (i : Fin 5)
    (l r : List A₂) :
    ThueStep (stage₂System L M)
      (l ++ stage₂F L i ++ r) (l ++ stage₂E M i ++ r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨l, r, stage₂F L i, stage₂E M i, ⟨i, rfl⟩,
    Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_short_rule
statement:
theorem phi₂_short_rule (L M : List A₂) (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 2)
    (l r : List (Fin 2)) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M)
      (phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) i ++ r))
      (phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) i ++ r))
proof:
:= by
  rcases rho₂_phi₂_reconstruct r with hr | hr
  · rcases fin₃_cases i with hi0 | hi1 | hi2
    · have hF : baseF (rho₂ L) 0 = rho₂ [e, b, a] := by
        simp [baseF, rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, b, e]
      have hE : baseE (rho₂ M) 0 = rho₂ [a, e] := by
        simp [baseE, rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, e]
      subst i
      have hleft := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseF (rho₂ L) 0) [e, b, a] (phi₂ r) hF
      have hright := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseE (rho₂ M) 0) [a, e] (phi₂ r) hE
      rw [hr] at hleft hright
      rw [hleft, hright]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        (stage₂_rule_step L M 2 (phi₂ l) (phi₂ r))
    · have hF : baseF (rho₂ L) 1 = rho₂ [e, a, a] := by
        simp [baseF, rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, e]
      have hE : baseE (rho₂ M) 1 = rho₂ [a, e] := by
        simp [baseE, rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, e]
      subst i
      have hleft := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseF (rho₂ L) 1) [e, a, a] (phi₂ r) hF
      have hright := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseE (rho₂ M) 1) [a, e] (phi₂ r) hE
      rw [hr] at hleft hright
      rw [hleft, hright]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        (stage₂_rule_step L M 0 (phi₂ l) (phi₂ r))
    · subst i
      exact (hi rfl).elim

  · rcases fin₃_cases i with hi0 | hi1 | hi2
    · have hF : baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)] = rho₂ [e, b, b] := by
        simp [baseF, rho₂, rho₂Letter, b, e]
      have hE : baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)] = rho₂ [b, e] := by
        simp [baseE, rho₂, rho₂Letter, b, e]
      subst i
      have hleft := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) [e, b, b] (phi₂ r) hF
      have hright := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) [b, e] (phi₂ r) hE
      have hleft' :
          phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++ r) =
            phi₂ l ++ [e, b, b] ++ phi₂ r := by
        calc
          phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++ r) =
              phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++
                ((0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r))) := by rw [hr]
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ (baseF (rho₂ L) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) ++
                rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by simp only [List.append_assoc,
              List.singleton_append]
          _ = phi₂ l ++ [e, b, b] ++ phi₂ r := hleft
      have hright' :
          phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++ r) =
            phi₂ l ++ [b, e] ++ phi₂ r := by
        calc
          phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++ r) =
              phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++
                ((0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r))) := by rw [hr]
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ (baseE (rho₂ M) 0 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) ++
                rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by simp only [List.append_assoc,
              List.singleton_append]
          _ = phi₂ l ++ [b, e] ++ phi₂ r := hright
      rw [hleft', hright']
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        (stage₂_rule_step L M 3 (phi₂ l) (phi₂ r))
    · have hF : baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)] = rho₂ [e, a, b] := by
        simp [baseF, rho₂, rho₂Letter, a, b, e]
      have hE : baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)] = rho₂ [b, e] := by
        simp [baseE, rho₂, rho₂Letter, b, e]
      subst i
      have hleft := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) [e, a, b] (phi₂ r) hF
      have hright := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
        (baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) [b, e] (phi₂ r) hE
      have hleft' :
          phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++ r) =
            phi₂ l ++ [e, a, b] ++ phi₂ r := by
        calc
          phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++ r) =
              phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++
                ((0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r))) := by rw [hr]
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ (baseF (rho₂ L) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) ++
                rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by simp only [List.append_assoc,
              List.singleton_append]
          _ = phi₂ l ++ [e, a, b] ++ phi₂ r := hleft
      have hright' :
          phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++ r) =
            phi₂ l ++ [b, e] ++ phi₂ r := by
        calc
          phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++ r) =
              phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++
                ((0 : Fin 2) :: rho₂ (phi₂ r))) := by rw [hr]
          _ = phi₂ (l ++ (baseE (rho₂ M) 1 ++ [(0 : Fin 2)]) ++
                rho₂ (phi₂ r)) := by simp only [List.append_assoc,
              List.singleton_append]
          _ = phi₂ l ++ [b, e] ++ phi₂ r := hright
      rw [hleft', hright']
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        (stage₂_rule_step L M 1 (phi₂ l) (phi₂ r))
    · subst i
      exact (hi rfl).elim

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_long_rule_aligned
statement:
theorem phi₂_long_rule_aligned (L M : List A₂)
    (l r : List (Fin 2)) (hr : rho₂ (phi₂ r) = r) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M)
      (phi₂ (l ++ baseF (rho₂ L) 2 ++ r))
      (phi₂ (l ++ baseE (rho₂ M) 2 ++ r))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
    (baseF (rho₂ L) 2) L (phi₂ r) (by simp [baseF])
  have hright := phi₂_context_of_encoded_block l
    (baseE (rho₂ M) 2) M (phi₂ r) (by simp [baseE])
  rw [hr] at hleft hright
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
    (stage₂_rule_step L M 4 (phi₂ l) (phi₂ r))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.phi₂_step_of_long_aligned
statement:
theorem phi₂_step_of_long_aligned (L M : List A₂)
    {X Y : List (Fin 2)}
    (haligned : ∀ l r,
      (X = l ++ rho₂ L ++ r ∨ X = l ++ rho₂ M ++ r) →
      rho₂ (phi₂ r) = r)
    (h : ThueStep (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) X Y) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) (phi₂ X) (phi₂ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, r, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, hXY⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  rcases fin₃_cases i with hi0 | hi1 | hi2
  · subst i
    rcases hXY with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact phi₂_short_rule L M 0 (by decide) l r
    · exact thueEq_symm (phi₂_short_rule L M 0 (by decide) l r)
  · subst i
    rcases hXY with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact phi₂_short_rule L M 1 (by decide) l r
    · exact thueEq_symm (phi₂_short_rule L M 1 (by decide) l r)
  · subst i
    rcases hXY with ⟨hX, rfl⟩ | ⟨hX, rfl⟩
    · have hr := haligned l r (Or.inl (by simpa [baseF] using hX))
      rw [hX]
      simpa [baseF, baseE] using phi₂_long_rule_aligned L M l r hr
    · have hr := haligned l r (Or.inr (by simpa [baseE] using hX))
      rw [hX]
      simpa [baseF, baseE] using
        thueEq_symm (phi₂_long_rule_aligned L M l r hr)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_reflect_of_longRuleAligned
statement:
theorem rho₂_reflect_of_longRuleAligned (L M X Y : List A₂)
    (hsafe : LongRuleAlignedFrom L M X)
    (h : ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) (rho₂ X) (rho₂ Y)) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X Y
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ {W : List (Fin 2)},
      ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) (rho₂ X) W →
      ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X (phi₂ W) := by
    intro W hW
    induction hW with
    | refl =>
        rw [phi₂_rho₂]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | tail hab hbc ih =>
        exact ih.trans (phi₂_step_of_long_aligned L M
          (fun l r hocc => hsafe _ hab l r hocc) hbc)
  simpa using aux h

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.rho₂_iff_of_longRuleAligned
statement:
theorem rho₂_iff_of_longRuleAligned (L M X : List A₂)
    (hsafe : LongRuleAlignedFrom L M X) (Y : List A₂) :
    ThueEq (stage₂System L M) X Y ↔
      ThueEq (baseSystem (rho₂ L) (rho₂ M)) (rho₂ X) (rho₂ Y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨rho₂_forward L M,
    rho₂_reflect_of_longRuleAligned L M X Y hsafe⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Embedding.target_undecidable
proof:
:= by
  apply not_computablePred_of_manyOneReducible h
  exact ⟨f.encode, f.encode_computable, fun Q => f.thueEq_iff Q P⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.has_undecidable_three_rule_system_of_compression
statement:
theorem has_undecidable_three_rule_system_of_compression
    (hcompression : CompressionTheorem)
    (seed : FiniteFixedTargetSeed) : HasUndecidableThreeRuleSystem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₃, V₃, hU₃, hV₃, reduction, hnonempty⟩ :=
    hcompression seed.alphabetSize seed.relationCount
      seed.alphabetSize_pos seed.relationCount_pos seed.F seed.E
  refine ⟨U₃, V₃, reduction.encode seed.P, hU₃, hV₃,
    hnonempty seed.P, ?_⟩
  exact reduction.target_undecidable seed.P seed.undecidable

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.liftWord_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftWord_append (X Y : List (Fin n)) :
    liftWord (X ++ Y) = liftWord X ++ liftWord Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftWord]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.liftWord_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftWord_length (W : List (Fin n)) :
    (liftWord W).length = W.length
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftWord]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.projectLetter_pad
statement: @[simp] theorem projectLetter_pad : projectLetter (pad (n := n)) = none
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectLetter, pad]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.projectLetter_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem projectLetter_lift (x : Fin n) :
    projectLetter (liftLetter x) = some x
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectLetter, liftLetter]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem decode_append (X Y : List (Fin (n + 1))) :
    decode (X ++ Y) = decode X ++ decode Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [decode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_liftWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem decode_liftWord (W : List (Fin n)) :
    decode (liftWord W) = W
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x W ih => simp [liftWord, decode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_replicate_pad
statement:
@[simp] theorem decode_replicate_pad (k : ℕ) :
    decode (List.replicate k (pad (n := n))) = []
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [decode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.F_length_lt_p
statement:
theorem F_length_lt_p (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r) :
    (F i).length < p F E
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : max (F i).length (E i).length ∈
      List.ofFn (fun j => max (F j).length (E j).length) :=
    List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hle : (F i).length ≤ sideBound F E :=
    List.le_max_of_le hmem (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
  simp only [p]
  omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.E_length_lt_p
statement:
theorem E_length_lt_p (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r) :
    (E i).length < p F E
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : max (F i).length (E i).length ∈
      List.ofFn (fun j => max (F j).length (E j).length) :=
    List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hle : (E i).length ≤ sideBound F E :=
    List.le_max_of_le hmem (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
  simp only [p]
  omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.p_pos
statement: theorem p_pos (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) : 0 < p F E
proof:
:= by
  simp [p]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.p_le_q
statement: theorem p_le_q (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) : p F E ≤ q F E
proof:
:= by
  simp [q]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_encode
statement:
@[simp] theorem decode_encode (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (W : List (Fin n)) : decode (encode F E W) = W
proof:
:= by
  simp [encode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.encode_computable
statement:
theorem encode_computable (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) :
    Computable (encode F E)
proof:
:= by
  have hlift : Primrec (liftWord : List (Fin n) → List (Fin (n + 1))) :=
    Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
      ((Primrec.dom_finite liftLetter).comp₂ Primrec₂.right)
  exact (Primrec.list_append.comp hlift
    (Primrec.const (List.replicate (q F E) (pad (n := n))))).to_comp

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁F_primary
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₁F_primary (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r) :
    stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) =
      liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate (p F E - (F i).length) pad
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage₁F]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁E_primary
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₁E_primary (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r) :
    stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) =
      liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate (q F E - (E i).length) pad
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage₁E]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁F_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₁F_shift (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    stage₁F F E (Fin.natAdd r j) =
      [j] ++ List.replicate (p F E - 1) pad
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage₁F]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁E_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage₁E_shift (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    stage₁E F E (Fin.natAdd r j) =
      [pad, j] ++ List.replicate (q F E - 2) pad
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage₁E]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁F_length
statement:
theorem stage₁F_length (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (i : Fin (r + (n + 1))) : (stage₁F F E i).length = p F E
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.addCases with
  | left i =>
      simp only [stage₁F_primary, List.length_append, liftWord_length,
        List.length_replicate]
      have := F_length_lt_p F E i
      omega
  | right j =>
      simp only [stage₁F_shift, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil, List.length_replicate]
      have := p_pos F E
      omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁E_length
statement:
theorem stage₁E_length (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (i : Fin (r + (n + 1))) : (stage₁E F E i).length = q F E
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.addCases with
  | left i =>
      simp only [stage₁E_primary, List.length_append, liftWord_length,
        List.length_replicate]
      have := E_length_lt_p F E i
      simp only [q]
      omega
  | right j =>
      simp only [stage₁E_shift, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil, List.length_replicate]
      have := p_pos F E
      simp only [q]
      omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁F_pad
statement:
@[simp] private theorem stage₁F_pad (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) :
    stage₁F F E (Fin.natAdd r (pad (n := n))) =
      List.replicate (p F E) pad
proof:
:= by
  rw [stage₁F_shift]
  simp only [List.singleton_append]
  rw [← List.replicate_succ]
  congr 1

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.stage₁E_pad
statement:
@[simp] private theorem stage₁E_pad (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) :
    stage₁E F E (Fin.natAdd r (pad (n := n))) =
      List.replicate (q F E) pad
proof:
:= by
  rw [stage₁E_shift]
  simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  rw [← List.replicate_succ, ← List.replicate_succ]
  congr 1

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.pad_run_step
statement:
private theorem pad_run_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : p F E ≤ k) :
    ThueStep (stage₁System F E)
      (List.replicate k pad) (List.replicate (k + 1) pad)
proof:
:= by
  let rest := k - p F E
  refine ⟨[], List.replicate rest pad,
    stage₁F F E (Fin.natAdd r (pad (n := n))),
    stage₁E F E (Fin.natAdd r (pad (n := n))),
    ⟨Fin.natAdd r (pad (n := n)), rfl⟩, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [List.nil_append, stage₁F_pad, ← List.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [rest]
    omega
  · simp only [List.nil_append, stage₁E_pad, ← List.replicate_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [rest, q]
    omega

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.pad_grow
statement:
private theorem pad_grow (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (k t : ℕ)
    (hk : p F E ≤ k) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (List.replicate k pad) (List.replicate (k + t) pad)
proof:
:= by
  change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (stage₁System F E)) _ _
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero]; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ t ih =>
      have hkt : p F E ≤ k + t := hk.trans (Nat.le_add_right k t)
      have hs := pad_run_step F E (k + t) hkt
      simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using ih.tail hs

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.primary_step
statement:
private theorem primary_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r)
    (s : List (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ThueStep (stage₁System F E)
      (stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s)
      (stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨[], s,
    stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i),
    stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i),
    ⟨Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i, rfl⟩,
    Or.inl ⟨by simp, by simp⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.source_rule_at_suffix
statement:
private theorem source_rule_at_suffix (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (i : Fin r) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
proof:
:= by
  let N := q F E + (E i).length
  let K := q F E + ((F i).length + 1)
  have hpq : p F E ≤ q F E := p_le_q F E
  have h₁raw := thueEq_context (liftWord (F i)) []
    (pad_grow F E (q F E) (E i).length hpq)
  have h₁ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate N pad) := by
    simpa only [List.append_nil, N] using h₁raw
  let rest := N - (p F E - (F i).length)
  have hrest : p F E - (F i).length ≤ N := by
    have := F_length_lt_p F E i
    dsimp only [N]
    omega
  have hleft :
      stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++
          List.replicate rest pad =
        liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate N pad := by
    rw [stage₁F_primary, List.append_assoc, ← List.replicate_add]
    congr 2
    dsimp only [rest]
    omega
  have hright :
      stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++
          List.replicate rest pad =
        liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate K pad := by
    rw [stage₁E_primary, List.append_assoc, ← List.replicate_add]
    congr 2
    have hF := F_length_lt_p F E i
    have hE := E_length_lt_p F E i
    dsimp only [rest, N, K, q]
    omega
  have h₂ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate N pad)
      (liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate K pad) := by
    change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (stage₁System F E)) _ _
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      (hleft ▸ hright ▸ primary_step F E i (List.replicate rest pad))
  have hgrowK := pad_grow F E (q F E) ((F i).length + 1) hpq
  have h₃raw := thueEq_context (liftWord (E i)) [] (thueEq_symm hgrowK)
  have h₃ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate K pad)
      (liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad) := by
    simpa only [List.append_nil, K] using h₃raw
  exact (h₁.trans h₂).trans h₃

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.shift_step
statement:
private theorem shift_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    ThueStep (stage₁System F E)
      (List.replicate k pad ++ [j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (List.replicate (k + 1) pad ++ [j] ++
        List.replicate (q F E) pad)
proof:
:= by
  have hleftTail :
      List.replicate (p F E - 1) (pad (n := n)) ++
          List.replicate 2 (pad (n := n)) =
        List.replicate (q F E) (pad (n := n)) := by
    rw [← List.replicate_add]
    congr 1
  have hrightTail :
      List.replicate (q F E - 2) (pad (n := n)) ++
          List.replicate 2 (pad (n := n)) =
        List.replicate (q F E) (pad (n := n)) := by
    rw [← List.replicate_add]
    congr 1
  have hprefix :
      List.replicate k (pad (n := n)) ++ [pad (n := n), j] =
        List.replicate (k + 1) (pad (n := n)) ++ [j] := by
    rw [List.replicate_add]
    simp only [List.replicate_one, List.singleton_append,
      List.append_assoc]
  let idx := Fin.natAdd r j
  refine ⟨List.replicate k (pad (n := n)),
    List.replicate 2 (pad (n := n)),
    stage₁F F E idx, stage₁E F E idx, ⟨idx, rfl⟩,
    Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · dsimp only [idx]
    rw [stage₁F_shift]
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    rw [hleftTail]
  · dsimp only [idx]
    rw [stage₁E_shift]
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    rw [hrightTail]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using congrArg
      (fun z => z ++ List.replicate (q F E) (pad (n := n))) hprefix.symm

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.shift_letter_aux
statement:
private theorem shift_letter_aux (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (t : ℕ) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (List.replicate t pad ++ [j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
proof:
:= by
  change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (stage₁System F E)) _ _
  induction t with
  | zero => simpa using
      (Relation.ReflTransGen.refl :
        Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (stage₁System F E))
          ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
          ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad))
  | succ t ih =>
      have hs := shift_step F E j t
      simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ih.tail hs

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.shift_letter
statement:
private theorem shift_letter (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ [j] ++
        List.replicate (q F E) pad)
proof:
:=
  shift_letter_aux F E j (q F E)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.expose_suffix
statement:
private theorem expose_suffix (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (W : List (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ W' : List (Fin (n + 1)),
      ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
        (W ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
        (List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ W' ++
          List.replicate (q F E) pad)
proof:
:= by
  induction W with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨[], ?_⟩
      have hg := pad_grow F E (q F E) (q F E) (p_le_q F E)
      simpa only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, ← List.replicate_add] using hg
  | cons j W ih =>
      obtain ⟨W', hW⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨[j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ W', ?_⟩
      have h₁raw := thueEq_context [j] [] hW
      have h₁ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
          ((j :: W) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
          ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ W' ++
            List.replicate (q F E) pad) := by
        simpa only [List.cons_append, List.singleton_append, List.append_nil,
          List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using h₁raw
      have h₂raw := thueEq_context []
        (W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad) (shift_letter F E j)
      have h₂ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
          ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ W' ++
            List.replicate (q F E) pad)
          (List.replicate (q F E) pad ++
            ([j] ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++ W') ++
            List.replicate (q F E) pad) := by
        simpa only [List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using h₂raw
      exact h₁.trans h₂

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.simulate_rule
statement:
private theorem simulate_rule (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (i : Fin r) (l s : List (Fin n)) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (encode F E (l ++ F i ++ s))
      (encode F E (l ++ E i ++ s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W', hW⟩ := expose_suffix F E (liftWord s)
  have h₁raw := thueEq_context (liftWord l ++ liftWord (F i)) [] hW
  have h₁ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (encode F E (l ++ F i ++ s))
      (liftWord l ++ liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++
        W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad) := by
    simpa only [encode, liftWord_append, List.append_nil,
      List.append_assoc] using h₁raw
  have h₂raw := thueEq_context (liftWord l)
    (W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad) (source_rule_at_suffix F E i)
  have h₂ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord l ++ liftWord (F i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++
        W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (liftWord l ++ liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++
        W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad) := by
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using h₂raw
  have h₃raw := thueEq_context (liftWord l ++ liftWord (E i)) []
    (thueEq_symm hW)
  have h₃ : ThueEq (stage₁System F E)
      (liftWord l ++ liftWord (E i) ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad ++
        W' ++ List.replicate (q F E) pad)
      (encode F E (l ++ E i ++ s)) := by
    simpa only [encode, liftWord_append, List.append_nil,
      List.append_assoc] using h₃raw
  exact (h₁.trans h₂).trans h₃

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.simulate_step
statement:
theorem simulate_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    {X Y : List (Fin n)} (h : ThueStep (finiteSystem F E) X Y) :
    ThueEq (stage₁System F E) (encode F E X) (encode F E Y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, s, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, hwords⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  rcases hwords with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact simulate_rule F E i l s
  · exact thueEq_symm (simulate_rule F E i l s)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.simulate
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.trans (simulate_step F E hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.source_rule_step
statement:
private theorem source_rule_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n)) (i : Fin r)
    (l s : List (Fin n)) :
    ThueStep (finiteSystem F E)
      (l ++ F i ++ s) (l ++ E i ++ s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨l, s, F i, E i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_shift_sides
statement:
private theorem decode_shift_sides (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    decode (stage₁F F E (Fin.natAdd r j)) =
      decode (stage₁E F E (Fin.natAdd r j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stage₁F_shift, stage₁E_shift, decode_append, decode_append,
    decode_replicate_pad, decode_replicate_pad]
  simp [decode]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_step
statement:
theorem decode_step (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    {X Y : List (Fin (n + 1))}
    (h : ThueStep (stage₁System F E) X Y) :
    ThueEq (finiteSystem F E) (decode X) (decode Y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨l, s, x, y, ⟨i, hxy⟩, hwords⟩
  injection hxy with hx hy
  subst x
  subst y
  induction i using Fin.addCases with
  | left i =>
      rcases hwords with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (finiteSystem F E))
          (decode (l ++ stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s))
          (decode (l ++ stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s))
        simpa only [decode_append, stage₁F_primary, stage₁E_primary,
          decode_liftWord, decode_replicate_pad, List.append_nil,
          List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using Relation.ReflTransGen.single
            (source_rule_step F E i (decode l) (decode s))
      · change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (finiteSystem F E))
          (decode (l ++ stage₁E F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s))
          (decode (l ++ stage₁F F E (Fin.castAdd (n + 1) i) ++ s))
        have hstep : ThueStep (finiteSystem F E)
            (decode l ++ E i ++ decode s)
            (decode l ++ F i ++ decode s) :=
          ⟨decode l, decode s, F i, E i, ⟨i, rfl⟩,
            Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hpath := Relation.ReflTransGen.single hstep
        simpa only [decode_append, stage₁F_primary, stage₁E_primary,
          decode_liftWord, decode_replicate_pad, List.append_nil,
          List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using hpath
  | right j =>
      rcases hwords with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (finiteSystem F E)) _ _
        have heq := decode_shift_sides F E j
        rw [decode_append, decode_append, decode_append, decode_append, heq]
      · change Relation.ReflTransGen (ThueStep (finiteSystem F E)) _ _
        have heq := decode_shift_sides F E j
        rw [decode_append, decode_append, decode_append, decode_append, heq]

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.decode_thueEq
statement:
theorem decode_thueEq (F E : Fin r → List (Fin n))
    {X Y : List (Fin (n + 1))}
    (h : ThueEq (stage₁System F E) X Y) :
    ThueEq (finiteSystem F E) (decode X) (decode Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact ih.trans (decode_step F E hstep)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Padding.reflect
proof:
:= by
  simpa using decode_thueEq F E h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.family_isAdianRabin
statement:
theorem family_isAdianRabin (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n)
    (hP : ¬ ComputablePred P.wordProblem)
    (hk : P.NormallyGenerates (Word.generator k)) :
    FP.IsAdianRabinFamily (family P k)
proof:
:=
  isAdianRabinFamily_of_wordProblem_reduction P (Compressed.transform P k)
    hP (transform_computable P k) (presentsTrivial_transform_iff P k hk)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.q_ne_one
statement: theorem q_ne_one (z : G) : q z ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  old_mul_beta_ne_one z

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.posBlock_prod
statement:
private theorem posBlock_prod (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    (posBlock z n).prod = outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4 ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [posBlock, posRest, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
        alphaSingleton_prod, baseSingleton_prod, outerLeftBasis, q]
      group
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (posBlock z (n + 1)).prod =
            outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4 * (posBlock z n).prod := by
          simp only [posBlock, posRest, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
            alphaSingleton_prod, baseSingleton_prod, outerLeftBasis, q]
          group
        _ = outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4 *
            outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [ih]
        _ = outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4 ^ (n + 1 + 1) :=
          (pow_succ' _ (n + 1)).symm

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.negBlock_prod_inv
statement:
private theorem negBlock_prod_inv (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    (negBlock z n).prod = (outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [negBlock, negInit, negRest, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
        alphaSingleton_prod, baseSingleton_prod, outerLeftBasis, q, baseOf_inv]
      group
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (negBlock z (n + 1)).prod =
            (negBlock z n).prod * (outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4)⁻¹ := by
          simp only [negBlock, negInit, negRest, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
            alphaSingleton_prod, baseSingleton_prod, outerLeftBasis, q,
            baseOf_inv]
          group
        _ = (outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1) *
            (outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4)⁻¹ := by rw [ih]
        _ = (outerLeftBasis (1 : G) z 4)⁻¹ ^ (n + 1 + 1) :=
          (pow_succ _ (n + 1)).symm

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.leftPowerWord4_ofNat
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord4_ofNat (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    leftPowerWord4 z (Int.ofNat (n + 1))
      (Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) = posBlock z n
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.leftPowerWord4_negSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord4_negSucc (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    leftPowerWord4 z (Int.negSucc n) (by omega) = negBlock z n
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.leftPowerWord4_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord4_prod (w z : G) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (leftPowerWord4 z k hk).prod = outerLeftBasis w z 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
      | succ n =>
          rw [leftPowerWord4_ofNat]
          simpa only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, outerLeftBasis]
            using posBlock_prod z n
  | negSucc n =>
      rw [leftPowerWord4_negSucc]
      simpa only [zpow_negSucc, inv_pow, outerLeftBasis] using negBlock_prod_inv z n

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.posRest_last
statement:
private theorem posRest_last (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    (posRest z n).last = alphaVal 4
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [posRest, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | succ n ih => simpa [posRest] using ih

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.smallWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallWord_prod (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i : SmallIndex) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (smallWord w z hw i k hk).prod = smallBasis w z i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | one => exact leftPowerWord1_prod w z k hk
  | two => exact leftPowerWord2_prod w z k hk
  | three => exact leftPowerWord3_prod w z hw k hk
  | four => exact leftPowerWord4_prod w z k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.smallWord_head
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | one => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord1, smallHeadExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | two => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord2, smallHeadExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | three => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord3, smallHeadExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | four =>
      cases k with
      | ofNat n =>
          cases n with
          | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
          | succ n =>
              rw [show smallWord w z hw .four (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) hk =
                posBlock z n by rfl]
              simp [posBlock, smallHeadExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
      | negSucc n =>
          rw [show smallWord w z hw .four (Int.negSucc n) hk = negBlock z n by rfl]
          simp [negBlock, negInit, smallHeadExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.smallWord_last
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | one => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord1, smallLastExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | two => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord2, smallLastExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | three => simp [smallWord, leftPowerWord3, smallLastExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]
  | four =>
      cases k with
      | ofNat n =>
          cases n with
          | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
          | succ n =>
              rw [show smallWord w z hw .four (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) hk =
                posBlock z n by rfl]
              rw [show smallLastExp .four (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) = 4 by
                simp [smallLastExp]]
              change (posRest z n).last = alphaVal 4
              exact posRest_last z n
      | negSucc n =>
          rw [show smallWord w z hw .four (Int.negSucc n) hk = negBlock z n by rfl]
          simp [negBlock, smallLastExp, alphaVal, alphaSingleton]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.tailTwo_last
statement:
private theorem tailTwo_last (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (tailTwo (G := G) k hk).last = alphaVal 2
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.tailTwo_isAppend
statement:
private theorem tailTwo_isAppend (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    IsAppend (tailTwo (G := G) k hk)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.posRest_isAppend
statement:
private theorem posRest_isAppend (z : G) (n : ℕ) :
    IsAppend (posRest z n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> trivial

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.merge_head_of_isAppend_left
statement:
private theorem merge_head_of_isAppend_left {i j k : OuterIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) i j)
    (v : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) j k)
    (h : u.last * v.head ≠ 1) (hu : IsAppend u) :
    (CoprodI.NeWord.merge u v h).head = u.head
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | singleton => contradiction
  | append => rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.smallWord_isAppend
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | one => trivial
  | two => trivial
  | three => trivial
  | four =>
      cases k with
      | ofNat n =>
          cases n with
          | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
          | succ n => trivial
      | negSucc n => trivial

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.alphaVal_mul_ne_one
statement:
private theorem alphaVal_mul_ne_one (r s : ℤ) (h : r + s ≠ 0) :
    alphaVal r * alphaVal s ≠ (1 : FreeGroup Unit)
proof:
:= by
  unfold alphaVal
  rw [← zpow_add]
  exact FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one (r + s) h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.boundary_sum_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem boundary_sum_ne_zero (i j : SmallIndex) (r s : ℤ)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hex : ¬ Exceptional i r j s) :
    smallLastExp i r + smallHeadExp j s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [Exceptional, smallLastExp, smallHeadExp] at hij hex ⊢ <;>
    split_ifs at * <;> omega

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.boundary_ne_one
statement:
private theorem boundary_ne_one (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i j : SmallIndex) (r s : ℤ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hex : ¬ Exceptional i r j s)
    (v : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha)
    (hv : v.head = alphaVal (smallHeadExp j s)) :
    (smallWord w z hw i r hr).last * v.head ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [smallWord_last, hv]
  exact alphaVal_mul_ne_one _ _ (boundary_sum_ne_zero i j r s hr hs hij hex)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.special24Word_prod
statement:
private theorem special24Word_prod (z : G) (r : ℤ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (right : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha)
    (pf : Prefix right (q z)) :
    (special24Word z r hr pf.tail pf.tail_head).prod =
      (leftPowerWord2 (G := G) r hr).prod * right.prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [pf.prod_eq]
  simp only [special24Word, special24Tail, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.mulHead_prod, alphaSingleton_prod, baseSingleton_prod]
  simp only [leftPowerWord2, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod, alphaSingleton_prod,
    baseSingleton_prod]
  simp only [baseOf]
  group

statement: private theorem negInit_isAppend (z : G) (n : ℕ) : IsAppend (negInit z n)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.evalSmall_eq_map_prod
statement:
private theorem evalSmall_eq_map_prod (w z : G) (l : List (SmallIndex × ℤ)) :
    evalSmall w z l = (l.map fun p ↦ smallBasis w z p.1 ^ p.2).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p l ih => simp [evalSmall, ih]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.exists_small_image
statement:
theorem exists_small_image (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (x : FreeGroup SmallIndex) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ u : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha,
      u.prod = FreeGroup.lift (smallBasis w z) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let y : CoprodI SmallCyclic := (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI SmallIndex).toMonoidHom x
  have hy : y ≠ 1 := by
    intro hy1
    apply hx
    exact (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI SmallIndex).injective (by simpa [y] using hy1)
  let sw : CoprodI.Word SmallCyclic := CoprodI.Word.equiv y
  have hsw : sw ≠ CoprodI.Word.empty := by
    intro he
    apply hy
    calc
      y = (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := SmallCyclic)).symm sw :=
        ((CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := SmallCyclic)).symm_apply_apply y).symm
      _ = (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := SmallCyclic)).symm CoprodI.Word.empty :=
        congrArg _ he
      _ = 1 := rfl
  obtain ⟨i, j, src, hsrc⟩ := CoprodI.NeWord.of_word sw hsw
  let encode : (Σ _ : SmallIndex, FreeGroup Unit) → SmallIndex × ℤ :=
    fun s ↦ (s.1, FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2)
  let l := src.toList.map encode
