  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by
    simpa [l] using src.toList_ne_nil
  have hlexp : ∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    intro heq
    have hsone : s.2 = 1 :=
      FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.injective (by
        simpa [encode, FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt] using heq)
    exact src.toWord.ne_one s hs hsone
  have hlchain : l.IsChain (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≠ q.1) := by
    change (src.toList.map encode).IsChain (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≠ q.1)
    rw [List.isChain_map]
    exact src.toWord.chain_ne.imp (by
      intro p q hpq
      simpa [encode] using hpq)
  obtain ⟨p, rest, hl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hlne
  have hp : p.2 ≠ 0 := hlexp p (by rw [hl]; simp)
  have hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, q.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq
    exact hlexp q (by rw [hl]; simp [hq])
  have hchain : (p :: rest).IsChain (fun a b ↦ a.1 ≠ b.1) := by
    rw [← hl]
    exact hlchain
  let im := imageList w z hw p rest hp hrest hchain
  let cyclicLift : CoprodI SmallCyclic →* MillerLeft G :=
    CoprodI.lift fun i ↦ FreeGroup.lift fun _ ↦ smallBasis w z i
  have heval : cyclicLift src.prod = evalSmall w z l := by
    rw [evalSmall_eq_map_prod]
    simp only [cyclicLift, CoprodI.NeWord.prod, CoprodI.Word.prod, map_list_prod,
      List.map_map, l, encode]
    congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro s hs
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, CoprodI.lift_of]
    have hreconstruct :
        FreeGroup.of () ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2 = s.2 :=
      FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.symm_apply_apply s.2
    calc
      FreeGroup.lift (fun _ ↦ smallBasis w z s.1) s.2 =
          FreeGroup.lift (fun _ ↦ smallBasis w z s.1)
            (FreeGroup.of () ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2) := by
              rw [hreconstruct]
      _ = smallBasis w z s.1 ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2 := by
        rw [map_zpow, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
  have hsrcprod : src.prod = y := by
    change src.toWord.prod = y
    rw [hsrc]
    exact (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := SmallCyclic)).symm_apply_apply y
  have hlift : FreeGroup.lift (smallBasis w z) =
      cyclicLift.comp (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI SmallIndex).toMonoidHom := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    simp [cyclicLift]
  refine ⟨im.word, ?_⟩
  calc
    im.word.prod = evalSmall w z (p :: rest) := im.prod_eq
    _ = evalSmall w z l := by rw [hl]
    _ = cyclicLift src.prod := heval.symm
    _ = cyclicLift y := congrArg cyclicLift hsrcprod
    _ = FreeGroup.lift (smallBasis w z) x := by
      rw [hlift]
      rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.toSmall_injective
statement: theorem toSmall_injective : Function.Injective toSmall
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := fromSmall)
  intro x
  have hcomp : fromSmall.comp toSmall = MonoidHom.id (FreeGroup (Fin 4)) := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [fromSmall, toSmall, smallOfFin, finOfSmall]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.smallLift_comp_toSmall
statement:
theorem smallLift_comp_toSmall (w z : G) :
    (FreeGroup.lift (smallBasis w z)).comp toSmall =
      LeftSplit.tailMap w z
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [toSmall, smallOfFin, smallBasis, LeftSplit.tailMap,
      LeftSplit.tailBasis, outerLeftBasis]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.exists_fin_tail_image
statement:
theorem exists_fin_tail_image (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (x : FreeGroup (Fin 4)) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ u : CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha,
      u.prod = LeftSplit.tailMap w z x
proof:
:= by
  have hy : toSmall x ≠ 1 := by
    intro hy1
    apply hx
    apply toSmall_injective
    simpa using hy1
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_small_image w z hw (toSmall x) hy
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [hu]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (smallLift_comp_toSmall w z) x

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.tailImageFin_prod
statement:
theorem tailImageFin_prod (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (x : FreeGroup (Fin 4)) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    (tailImageFin w z hw x hx).prod = LeftSplit.tailMap w z x
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_fin_tail_image w z hw x hx)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.outerLeftBasis_lift_injective
statement:
theorem outerLeftBasis_lift_injective (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift (outerLeftBasis w z))
proof:
:=
  LeftSplit.outerLeftBasis_injective_of_tailImage w z
    (tailImageFin w z hw) (tailImageFin_prod w z hw)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.transform_old
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_old
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin m) :
    (transform P z w).relator (Fin.castAdd 4 i) =
      oldWord (P.relator i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.transform_additional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_additional
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin 4) :
    (transform P z w).relator (Fin.natAdd m i) =
      additionalRelators z w i
proof:
:= by
  simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.transform_computable
statement:
theorem transform_computable (P : FP n m) (z : Word n) :
    Computable₂ fun w i => (transform P z w).relator i
proof:
:= by
  have holdGenerator : Primrec (@oldGenerator n) := by
    apply Primrec.fin_val_iff.mp
    exact Primrec.fin_val
  have holdLetter : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator n =>
      (oldGenerator x.1, x.2) :=
    Primrec.pair (holdGenerator.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd
  have holdWord : Primrec (@oldWord n) := by
    apply Primrec.of_eq
      (Primrec.list_map Primrec.id (holdLetter.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
    intro w
    rfl
  have hletterInverse : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator (n + 3) =>
      (x.1, !x.2) :=
    Primrec.pair Primrec.fst (Primrec.not.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hinverse : Primrec (@Word.inverse (n + 3)) := by
    apply Primrec.of_eq
      (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_reverse
        (hletterInverse.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
    intro w
    rfl
  have hcommutator : Primrec fun u : Word (n + 3) =>
      Word.commutator u (betaWord n) := by
    apply Primrec.of_eq
      (Primrec.list_append.comp hinverse
        (Primrec.list_append.comp
          (Primrec.const (Word.inverse (betaWord n)))
          (Primrec.list_append.comp Primrec.id
            (Primrec.const (betaWord n)))))
    intro u
    rfl
  have hmiddle : Primrec fun w : Word n =>
      Word.commutator (oldWord w) (betaWord n) :=
    hcommutator.comp holdWord
  let alpha := alphaWord n
  let beta := betaWord n
  let gamma := gammaWord n
  let lhs : Word n → Word (n + 3) := fun w =>
    Word.product
      [Word.inverse (Word.pow alpha 3),
       Word.commutator (oldWord w) beta,
       Word.pow alpha 3]
  let rhs : Word (n + 3) :=
    Word.product
      [Word.inverse (Word.pow gamma 3), beta, Word.pow gamma 3]
  have hlhs : Primrec lhs := by
    apply Primrec.of_eq
      (Primrec.list_append.comp
        (Primrec.const (Word.inverse (Word.pow alpha 3)))
        (Primrec.list_append.comp hmiddle
          (Primrec.const (Word.pow alpha 3))))
    intro w
    simp [lhs, Word.product, beta]
  have hsigma3 : Primrec (@sigma₃ n) := by
    apply Primrec.of_eq
      (Primrec.list_append.comp hlhs
        (Primrec.const (Word.inverse rhs)))
    intro w
    rfl
  apply Primrec₂.to_comp
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry).mp
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry).mpr
  apply Primrec₂.swap
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry₁).mpr
  intro i
  cases i using Fin.addCases with
  | left j =>
      simpa using
        (Primrec.const (α := Word n) (oldWord (P.relator j)))
  | right j =>
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j3 => ?_) j
      · simpa [additionalRelators] using
          (Primrec.const (α := Word n) (sigma₁ n))
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j2 => ?_) j3
        · simpa [additionalRelators] using
            (Primrec.const (α := Word n) (sigma₂ n))
        · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j1 => ?_) j2
          · simpa [additionalRelators] using hsigma3
          · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j0 => ?_) j1
            · simpa [additionalRelators] using
                (Primrec.const (α := Word n) (sigma₄ z))
            · exact Fin.elim0 j0

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.exists_oldHom
statement:
private theorem exists_oldHom (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    ∃ f : P.Group →* (transform P z w).Group,
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        f (PresentedGroup.of i) = PresentedGroup.of (oldGenerator i)
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin n → (transform P z w).Group :=
    fun i => PresentedGroup.of (oldGenerator i)
  have hrel : ∀ i, Word.eval x (P.relator i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    have h := (transform P z w).relator_eq_one (Fin.castAdd 4 i)
    simpa [FP.evalWord, oldWord, x, Function.comp_def] using h
  refine ⟨P.homOfRelators x hrel, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact P.homOfRelators_of x hrel i

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.hom_eq_one_of_normallyGenerates
statement:
private theorem hom_eq_one_of_normallyGenerates
    (P : FP n m) (z : Word n) (hz : P.NormallyGenerates z)
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (f : P.Group →* G)
    (hf : f (PresentedGroup.mk P.relSet (FreeGroup.mk z)) = 1) :
    ∀ g : P.Group, f g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hclosure :
      Subgroup.normalClosure
          ({PresentedGroup.mk P.relSet (FreeGroup.mk z)} : Set P.Group) ≤
        f.ker := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro g hg
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    subst g
    exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr hf
  rw [hz] at hclosure
  intro g
  exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (hclosure (Set.mem_univ g))

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.additional_relator_eq_one
statement:
private theorem additional_relator_eq_one
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin 4) :
    Word.eval
        (PresentedGroup.of : Fin (n + 3) → (transform P z w).Group)
        (additionalRelators z w i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FP.evalWord] using
    (transform P z w).relator_eq_one (Fin.natAdd m i)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem
    (P : FP n m) (z : Word n) (hz : P.NormallyGenerates z) (w : Word n)
    (hw : P.wordProblem w) :
    (transform P z w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin (n + 3) → (transform P z w).Group := PresentedGroup.of
  let a := x (Fin.natAdd n 0)
  let b := x (Fin.natAdd n 1)
  let c := x (Fin.natAdd n 2)

  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_oldHom P z w
  have hwP : Word.eval (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) w = 1 :=
    (P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mp hw
  have hwT : Word.eval x (oldWord w) = 1 := by
    rw [oldWord, Word.eval_mapGenerators]
    calc
      Word.eval (fun i => x (oldGenerator i)) w =
          Word.eval (fun i => f (PresentedGroup.of i)) w := by
            congr 2
            funext i
            exact (hf i).symm
      _ = f (Word.eval (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) w) := by
            symm
            exact Word.map_eval f _ w
      _ = 1 := by rw [hwP, map_one]

  have h₁raw := additional_relator_eq_one P z w (0 : Fin 4)
  have h₂raw := additional_relator_eq_one P z w (1 : Fin 4)
  have h₃raw := additional_relator_eq_one P z w (2 : Fin 4)
  have h₄raw := additional_relator_eq_one P z w (3 : Fin 4)
  have h₁ : a⁻¹ * b * a = c⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * c * b * c := by
    apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
    simpa [additionalRelators, sigma₁, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
      x, a, b, c, mul_assoc] using h₁raw
  have h₂ :
      (a ^ 2)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * a * b * a ^ 2 =
        (c ^ 2)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * c * b * c ^ 2 := by
    apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
    simpa [additionalRelators, sigma₂, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
      x, a, b, c, mul_assoc] using h₂raw
  have h₃ :
      (a ^ 3)⁻¹ *
          ((Word.eval x (oldWord w))⁻¹ * b⁻¹ *
            Word.eval x (oldWord w) * b) * a ^ 3 =
        (c ^ 3)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 3 := by
    apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
    simpa [additionalRelators, sigma₃, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
      x, a, b, c, mul_assoc] using h₃raw
  have h₄ :
      (a ^ 2)⁻¹ * Word.eval x (oldWord z) * b * a ^ 4 =
        (c ^ 4)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 4 := by
    apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
    simpa [additionalRelators, sigma₄, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
      x, a, b, c, mul_assoc] using h₄raw

  have hbConj : (c ^ 3)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 3 = 1 := by
    simpa [hwT] using h₃.symm
  have hb : b = 1 := by
    calc
      b = c ^ 3 * ((c ^ 3)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 3) * (c ^ 3)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [hbConj]; simp
  have hc : c = 1 := by
    simpa [hb] using h₁.symm
  have haConj : (a ^ 2)⁻¹ * a * a ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa [hb, hc] using h₂
  have ha : a = 1 := by
    calc
      a = (a ^ 2)⁻¹ * a * a ^ 2 := by group
      _ = 1 := haConj
  have hzT : Word.eval x (oldWord z) = 1 := by
    simpa [ha, hb, hc] using h₄

  have hfz : f (PresentedGroup.mk P.relSet (FreeGroup.mk z)) = 1 := by
    calc
      f (PresentedGroup.mk P.relSet (FreeGroup.mk z)) =
          f (Word.eval (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) z) :=
            congrArg f (P.evalWord_eq_mk z).symm
      _ = Word.eval (fun i => f (PresentedGroup.of i)) z := Word.map_eval f _ z
      _ = Word.eval (fun i => x (oldGenerator i)) z := by
            congr 2
            funext i
            exact hf i
      _ = Word.eval x (oldWord z) := by
            simp [oldWord, Function.comp_def]
      _ = 1 := hzT
  have hfOne : ∀ g : P.Group, f g = 1 :=
    hom_eq_one_of_normallyGenerates P z hz f hfz
  have hold : ∀ i : Fin n, x (oldGenerator i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    change PresentedGroup.of (oldGenerator i) = 1
    rw [← hf i]
    exact hfOne _
  have hx : ∀ i : Fin (n + 3), x i = 1 := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.addCases hold ?_ i
    intro j
    refine Fin.cases ha (fun j' => ?_) j
    refine Fin.cases hb (fun j'' => ?_) j'
    refine Fin.cases hc (fun j''' => ?_) j''
    exact Fin.elim0 j'''

  exact (transform P z w).presentsTrivial_of_generator_eq_one hx

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_coprodI_neWord
statement:
theorem FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_coprodI_neWord
    {I : Type} {Q : Type} [Group Q] (a : I → Q)
    (hne : ∀ i j
      (u : CoprodI.NeWord (fun _ : I ↦ FreeGroup Unit) i j),
      CoprodI.lift (fun i ↦ FreeGroup.lift fun _ ↦ a i) u.prod ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift a)
proof:
:= by
  have hlift : FreeGroup.lift a =
      (CoprodI.lift fun i ↦ FreeGroup.lift fun _ ↦ a i).comp
        (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI I).toMonoidHom := by
    ext i
    simp
  rw [hlift, MonoidHom.coe_comp]
  exact Function.Injective.comp
    (CoprodI.lift_injective_of_neWord_nontrivial _ hne)
    (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI I).injective

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_reduced_zpow_products
statement:
theorem FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_reduced_zpow_products
    {I : Type} {Q : Type} [Group Q] (a : I → Q)
    (hprod : ∀ l : List (I × ℤ), l ≠ [] →
      (∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ≠ 0) →
      l.IsChain (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≠ q.1) →
      (l.map fun p ↦ a p.1 ^ p.2).prod ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift a)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_coprodI_neWord a
  intro i j u
  let encode : (Σ _ : I, FreeGroup Unit) → I × ℤ :=
    fun s ↦ (s.1, FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2)
  let l := u.toList.map encode
  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by
    simpa [l] using u.toList_ne_nil
  have hlexp : ∀ p ∈ l, p.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    intro heq
    have hsone : s.2 = 1 :=
      FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.injective (by
        simpa [encode, FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt] using heq)
    exact u.toWord.ne_one s hs hsone
  have hlchain : l.IsChain (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≠ q.1) := by
    change (u.toList.map encode).IsChain (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≠ q.1)
    rw [List.isChain_map]
    exact u.toWord.chain_ne.imp (by
      intro p q hpq
      simpa [encode] using hpq)
  have heval :
      (CoprodI.lift fun i ↦ FreeGroup.lift fun _ ↦ a i) u.prod =
        (l.map fun p ↦ a p.1 ^ p.2).prod := by
    simp only [CoprodI.NeWord.prod, CoprodI.Word.prod, map_list_prod,
      List.map_map, l, encode]
    congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro s hs
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, CoprodI.lift_of]
    have hreconstruct :
        FreeGroup.of () ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2 = s.2 :=
      FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.symm_apply_apply s.2
    calc
      FreeGroup.lift (fun _ ↦ a s.1) s.2 =
          FreeGroup.lift (fun _ ↦ a s.1)
            (FreeGroup.of () ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2) := by
              rw [hreconstruct]
      _ = a s.1 ^ FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt s.2 := by
        rw [map_zpow, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
  rw [heval]
  exact hprod l hlne hlexp hlchain

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.of_ne_one
statement:
private theorem of_ne_one {i : LeftIndex} {x : LeftFactor G i} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    CoprodI.of x ≠ (1 : LeftProduct G)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hx
  apply CoprodI.of_injective i
  simpa using h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.of_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem of_inv {i : LeftIndex} (x : LeftFactor G i) :
    CoprodI.of (M := LeftFactor G) (i := i) x⁻¹ =
      (CoprodI.of (M := LeftFactor G) (i := i) x)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  map_inv
    (CoprodI.of (M := LeftFactor G) (i := i) : LeftFactor G i →* LeftProduct G) x

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.old_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem old_inv (g : G) : old (g⁻¹) = (old g)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  of_inv (G := G) (i := LeftIndex.old) g

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.freeGenerator_ne_one
statement: private theorem freeGenerator_ne_one : FreeGroup.of () ≠ (1 : FreeGroup Unit)
proof:
:=
  by simpa only [zpow_one] using
    FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one 1 one_ne_zero

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.beta_ne_one
statement: theorem beta_ne_one : (beta : LeftProduct G) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply of_ne_one
  exact freeGenerator_ne_one

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.betaProjection_old
statement: @[simp] theorem betaProjection_old (g : G) : betaProjection (old g) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact CoprodI.lift_of leftFactorToBeta (i := LeftIndex.old) g

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.betaProjection_beta
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaProjection_beta :
    betaProjection (beta : LeftProduct G) = FreeGroup.of ()
proof:
:= by
  exact CoprodI.lift_of leftFactorToBeta (i := LeftIndex.beta) (FreeGroup.of ())

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.beta_zpow_ne_one
statement:
theorem beta_zpow_ne_one (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (beta : LeftProduct G) ^ k ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one k hk
  simpa using congrArg betaProjection h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.old_mul_beta_ne_one
statement:
theorem old_mul_beta_ne_one (z : G) :
    old z * beta ≠ (1 : LeftProduct G)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply freeGenerator_ne_one
  simpa using congrArg betaProjection h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.beta_mul_old_mul_beta_ne_one
statement:
theorem beta_mul_old_mul_beta_ne_one (z : G) :
    beta * (old z * beta) ≠ (1 : LeftProduct G)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one 2 (by norm_num)
  calc
    (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ (2 : ℤ) =
        FreeGroup.of () * FreeGroup.of () := zpow_two _
    _ = 1 := by simpa using congrArg betaProjection h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.inv_old_mul_beta_inv_mul_beta_inv_ne_one
statement:
theorem inv_old_mul_beta_inv_mul_beta_inv_ne_one (z : G) :
    (old z * beta)⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ ≠ (1 : LeftProduct G)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one (-2) (by norm_num)
  calc
    (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ (-2 : ℤ) =
        (FreeGroup.of ())⁻¹ * (FreeGroup.of ())⁻¹ := by
          simp [zpow_neg, pow_two]
    _ = 1 := by simpa using congrArg betaProjection h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.commutatorWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem commutatorWord_prod (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    (commutatorWord w hw).prod = (old w)⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ * old w * beta
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutatorWord, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton (M := LeftFactor G) (i := LeftIndex.old),
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton (M := LeftFactor G) (i := LeftIndex.beta),
    of_inv (G := G) (i := LeftIndex.old) w,
    of_inv (G := G) (i := LeftIndex.beta) (FreeGroup.of ()), old, beta]
  rw [CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton (M := LeftFactor G) (i := LeftIndex.old) w hw,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton (M := LeftFactor G) (i := LeftIndex.beta)
      (FreeGroup.of ()) freeGenerator_ne_one]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.positivePowerWord_prod
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [positivePowerWord]
  | succ k ih =>
      calc
        (positivePowerWord u hij (k + 1)).prod =
            (positivePowerWord u hij k).prod * u.prod := by
              simp only [positivePowerWord, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod]
        _ = u.prod ^ (k + 1) * u.prod := by rw [ih]
        _ = u.prod ^ (k + 1 + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.positivePowerWord_prod_ne_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [← positivePowerWord_prod u hij]
  intro h
  classical
  have hnormal :
      CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := LeftFactor G) (positivePowerWord u hij k).prod =
        (positivePowerWord u hij k).toWord := by
    change (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := LeftFactor G))
        ((CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := LeftFactor G)).symm
          (positivePowerWord u hij k).toWord) = _
    exact (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := LeftFactor G)).apply_symm_apply _
  rw [h] at hnormal
  have hword : (positivePowerWord u hij k).toWord =
      (CoprodI.Word.empty : CoprodI.Word (LeftFactor G)) := by
    simpa [CoprodI.Word.equiv] using hnormal.symm
  exact (CoprodI.NeWord.toList_ne_nil (positivePowerWord u hij k))
    (by simpa [CoprodI.NeWord.toWord] using congrArg CoprodI.Word.toList hword)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.zpow_ne_one_of_cyclicallyReduced
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat k =>
      cases k with
      | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
      | succ k =>
          simpa only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast] using
            positivePowerWord_prod_ne_one u hij k
  | negSucc k =>
      simpa only [zpow_negSucc] using
        inv_ne_one.mpr (positivePowerWord_prod_ne_one u hij k)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.commutator_zpow_ne_one
statement:
theorem commutator_zpow_ne_one (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ((old w)⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ * old w * beta) ^ k ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← commutatorWord_prod w hw]
  exact zpow_ne_one_of_cyclicallyReduced (commutatorWord w hw) (by decide) k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.baseOf_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem baseOf_inv (x : LeftProduct G) : baseOf x⁻¹ = (baseOf x)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  map_inv
    (CoprodI.of (M := OuterFactor G) (i := OuterIndex.base) :
      LeftProduct G →* MillerLeft G) x

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.baseOf_zpow
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseOf_zpow (x : LeftProduct G) (k : ℤ) :
    baseOf (x ^ k) = baseOf x ^ k
proof:
:=
  map_zpow _ _ _

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.baseSingleton_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseSingleton_prod (x : LeftProduct G) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    (baseSingleton x hx).prod = baseOf x
proof:
:= by
  exact CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton (M := OuterFactor G) (i := OuterIndex.base) x hx

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.alphaSingleton_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem alphaSingleton_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (alphaSingleton (G := G) k hk).prod = outerAlpha ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change (CoprodI.of (M := OuterFactor G) (i := OuterIndex.alpha))
      ((FreeGroup.of ()) ^ k) =
    ((CoprodI.of (M := OuterFactor G) (i := OuterIndex.alpha))
      (FreeGroup.of ())) ^ k
  exact map_zpow _ _ _

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.leftPowerWord1_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord1_prod (w z : G) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (leftPowerWord1 (G := G) k hk).prod = outerLeftBasis w z 1 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftPowerWord1, outerLeftBasis, baseOf_zpow]
  symm
  rw [show outerAlpha⁻¹ * baseOf beta * outerAlpha =
      outerAlpha⁻¹ * baseOf beta * (outerAlpha⁻¹)⁻¹ by group]
  rw [conj_zpow]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.leftPowerWord2_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord2_prod (w z : G) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (leftPowerWord2 (G := G) k hk).prod = outerLeftBasis w z 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftPowerWord2, outerLeftBasis]
  symm
  rw [show (outerAlpha ^ 2)⁻¹ * (baseOf beta)⁻¹ * outerAlpha *
        baseOf beta * outerAlpha ^ 2 =
      (outerAlpha ^ 2)⁻¹ *
        ((baseOf beta)⁻¹ * outerAlpha * ((baseOf beta)⁻¹)⁻¹) *
        (((outerAlpha ^ 2)⁻¹)⁻¹) by group]
  rw [conj_zpow, conj_zpow]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.leftPowerWord3_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftPowerWord3_prod (w z : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (leftPowerWord3 w hw k hk).prod = outerLeftBasis w z 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftPowerWord3, outerLeftBasis, baseOf_zpow]
  symm
  rw [show (outerAlpha ^ 3)⁻¹ *
        baseOf ((old w)⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ * old w * beta) * outerAlpha ^ 3 =
      (outerAlpha ^ 3)⁻¹ *
        baseOf ((old w)⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ * old w * beta) *
        (((outerAlpha ^ 3)⁻¹)⁻¹) by group]
  rw [conj_zpow]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.presentsTrivial_transform_iff
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_iff
    (P : FP n m) (z : Word n)
    (hz : P.NormallyGenerates z) (w : Word n) :
    (transform P z w).presentsTrivial ↔ P.wordProblem w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htrivial
    by_contra hw
    exact transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem P z w hw htrivial
  · exact presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem P z hz w

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.retainedIndex_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem retainedIndex_old (i : Fin m) :
 retainedIndex m (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = Fin.castAdd 4 i
proof: := by simp [retainedIndex]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.retainedIndex_additional
statement:
@[simp] theorem retainedIndex_additional (j : Fin 2) :
 retainedIndex m (Fin.natAdd m j) = Fin.natAdd m (keptAdditionalIndex j)
proof: := by simp [retainedIndex]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.transform_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem transform_old (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n) (i : Fin m) :
 (transform P k w).relator (Fin.castAdd 2 i) =
   thetaWord k (MillerTancer.oldWord (P.relator i))
proof:
:= by
 simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.transform_additional
statement:
@[simp] theorem transform_additional (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n) (j : Fin 2) :
 (transform P k w).relator (Fin.natAdd m j) =
   thetaWord k (MillerTancer.additionalRelators (Word.generator k) w (keptAdditionalIndex j))
proof:
:= by
 simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.inverse_primrec
statement: private theorem inverse_primrec (N : ℕ) : Primrec (@Word.inverse N)
proof:
:= by
  have hletterInverse : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator N => (x.1, !x.2) :=
    Primrec.pair Primrec.fst (Primrec.not.comp Primrec.snd)
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_reverse (hletterInverse.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
  intro w
  rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.thetaWord_primrec
statement: theorem thetaWord_primrec (k : Fin n) : Primrec (thetaWord k)
proof:
:= by
  have hgenerator : Primrec (thetaGenerator k) := Primrec.dom_finite _
  have hletter : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator (n + 3) =>
      bif x.2 then thetaGenerator k x.1 else Word.inverse (thetaGenerator k x.1) :=
    Primrec.cond Primrec.snd (hgenerator.comp Primrec.fst)
      ((inverse_primrec (n + 1)).comp (hgenerator.comp Primrec.fst))
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id (hletter.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
  intro w
  simp only [thetaWord, Word.substitute]
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases x.2 <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.transform_computable
statement:
theorem transform_computable (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) :
    Computable₂ fun w i => (transform P k w).relator i
proof:
:= by
  have hindex : Computable (retainedIndex m) := (Primrec.dom_finite _).to_comp
  have hraw : Computable fun p : Word n × Fin (m + 2) =>
      (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) p.1).relator
        (retainedIndex m p.2) :=
    (MillerTancer.transform_computable P (Word.generator k)).comp
      Computable.fst (hindex.comp Computable.snd)
  exact ((thetaWord_primrec k).to_comp.comp hraw).to₂

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.eval_thetaWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_thetaWord {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → G) (k : Fin n) (w : Word (n + 3)) :
    Word.eval x (thetaWord k w) =
      Word.eval (fun i => Word.eval x (thetaGenerator k i)) w
proof:
:=
  Word.eval_substitute x (thetaGenerator k) w

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.thetaGenerator_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem thetaGenerator_old (k : Fin n) (i : Fin n) :
 thetaGenerator k (MillerTancer.oldGenerator i) = encodedOldGenerator k i
proof:
:= by
 simp [thetaGenerator, MillerTancer.oldGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.thetaGenerator_alpha
statement:
@[simp] private theorem thetaGenerator_alpha (k : Fin n) :
    thetaGenerator k (Fin.natAdd n 0) = aWord k
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.thetaGenerator_beta
statement:
@[simp] private theorem thetaGenerator_beta (k : Fin n) :
    thetaGenerator k (Fin.natAdd n 1) = bWord k
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.thetaGenerator_gamma
statement:
@[simp] private theorem thetaGenerator_gamma (k : Fin n) :
    thetaGenerator k (Fin.natAdd n 2) = cWord k
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.theta_sigma₁_eval_one
statement:
private theorem theta_sigma₁_eval_one {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → G) (k : Fin n) :
    Word.eval x (thetaWord k (MillerTancer.sigma₁ n)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_thetaWord]
  simp only [MillerTancer.sigma₁, MillerTancer.alphaWord,
    MillerTancer.betaWord, MillerTancer.gammaWord,
    aWord, bWord, cWord, qWord, finalOldSlot, Word.eval_relation,
    Word.eval_product, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil,
    Word.eval_inverse, Word.eval_generator, thetaGenerator_alpha,
    thetaGenerator_beta, thetaGenerator_gamma]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.theta_sigma₄_eval_one
statement:
private theorem theta_sigma₄_eval_one {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → G) (k : Fin n) :
    Word.eval x
      (thetaWord k (MillerTancer.sigma₄ (Word.generator k))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_thetaWord]
  simp [thetaGenerator, encodedOldGenerator, MillerTancer.sigma₄,
    MillerTancer.alphaWord, MillerTancer.betaWord, MillerTancer.gammaWord,
    MillerTancer.oldWord, MillerTancer.oldGenerator,
    aWord, bWord, cWord, qWord, eliminatedWord, finalOldSlot,
    Word.product, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.forwardHom_of
statement:
@[simp] private theorem forwardHom_of (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n)
    (i : Fin (n + 3)) :
    forwardHom P k w (PresentedGroup.of i) =
      Word.eval PresentedGroup.of (thetaGenerator k i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [forwardHom]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.raw_sigma₁_eq
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h := (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).relator_eq_one
    (Fin.natAdd m (0 : Fin 4))
  change Word.eval PresentedGroup.of
    ((MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).relator
      (Fin.natAdd m (0 : Fin 4))) = 1 at h
  rw [MillerTancer.transform_additional] at h
  apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
  simpa [MillerTancer.additionalRelators, MillerTancer.sigma₁,
    MillerTancer.alphaWord, MillerTancer.betaWord, MillerTancer.gammaWord,
    Word.product, mul_assoc] using h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.raw_sigma₄_eq
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h := (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).relator_eq_one
    (Fin.natAdd m (3 : Fin 4))
  change Word.eval PresentedGroup.of
    ((MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).relator
      (Fin.natAdd m (3 : Fin 4))) = 1 at h
  rw [MillerTancer.transform_additional] at h
  apply eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one
  simpa [MillerTancer.additionalRelators, MillerTancer.sigma₄,
    MillerTancer.alphaWord, MillerTancer.betaWord, MillerTancer.gammaWord,
    MillerTancer.oldWord, MillerTancer.oldGenerator,
    Word.product, mul_assoc] using h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.eval_thetaGenerator_reverse
statement:
private theorem eval_thetaGenerator_reverse (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n)
    (i : Fin (n + 3)) :
    Word.eval (reverseGenerator P k w) (thetaGenerator k i) =
      (PresentedGroup.of i : (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).Group)
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin (n + 3) → (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).Group :=
    PresentedGroup.of
  let a := x (Fin.natAdd n 0)
  let b := x (Fin.natAdd n 1)
  let c := x (Fin.natAdd n 2)
  let q := c * a⁻¹
  have h₁ := raw_sigma₁_eq P k w
  change a⁻¹ * b * a = c⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * c * b * c at h₁
  have hC : b * q * b * q⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = c := by
    dsimp only [q]
    calc
      b * (c * a⁻¹) * b * (c * a⁻¹)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ =
          b * c * (a⁻¹ * b * a) * c⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
      _ = c := by rw [h₁]; group
  have hA : q⁻¹ * (b * q * b * q⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = a := by
    rw [hC]
    dsimp only [q]
    group
  have h₄ := raw_sigma₄_eq P k w
  change (a ^ 2)⁻¹ * x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k) * b * a ^ 4 =
    (c ^ 4)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 4 at h₄
  have hU : a ^ 2 * (c ^ 4)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 4 * (a ^ 4)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ =
      x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k) := by
    calc
      a ^ 2 * (c ^ 4)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 4 * (a ^ 4)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ =
          a ^ 2 * ((c ^ 4)⁻¹ * b * c ^ 4) * (a ^ 4)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
      _ =
          a ^ 2 * ((a ^ 2)⁻¹ * x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k) * b * a ^ 4) *
            (a ^ 4)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by rw [← h₄]
      _ = x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k) := by group
  let psi := reverseGenerator P k w
  have hbEval : Word.eval psi (bWord k) = b := by
    simp [psi, reverseGenerator, bWord, finalOldSlot, b, x]
  have hqEval : Word.eval psi (qWord n) = q := by
    simp [psi, reverseGenerator, qWord, q, a, c, x]
  have hcEval : Word.eval psi (cWord k) = c := by
    simp [cWord, Word.product, hbEval, hqEval]
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hC
  have haEval : Word.eval psi (aWord k) = a := by
    simp [aWord, Word.product, hqEval, hcEval]
    rw [← hC]
    exact hA
  have huEval : Word.eval psi (eliminatedWord k) = x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k) := by
    simp [eliminatedWord, Word.product, haEval, hbEval, hcEval]
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hU
  change Word.eval psi (thetaGenerator k i) = x i
  cases i using Fin.addCases with
  | left i =>
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i
        change Word.eval psi (thetaGenerator k (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k)) =
          x (MillerTancer.oldGenerator k)
        rw [thetaGenerator_old]
        simp only [encodedOldGenerator, if_pos]
        exact huEval
      · simp [thetaGenerator, encodedOldGenerator, hik, finalOldSlot,
          psi, reverseGenerator, MillerTancer.oldGenerator, x]
  | right j =>
      fin_cases j
      · simpa [thetaGenerator] using haEval
      · simpa [thetaGenerator] using hbEval
      · simpa [thetaGenerator] using hcEval

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.reverseHom_of
statement:
@[simp] private theorem reverseHom_of (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    reverseHom P k w (PresentedGroup.of i) = reverseGenerator P k w i
proof:
:= by
  simp [reverseHom]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.reverse_forward
statement:
private theorem reverse_forward (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n) :
    (reverseHom P k w).comp (forwardHom P k w) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro i
  rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, forwardHom_of, Word.map_eval]
  have hfun : (⇑(reverseHom P k w) ∘
      (PresentedGroup.of : Fin (n + 1) → (Compressed.transform P k w).Group)) =
      reverseGenerator P k w := by
    funext j
    exact reverseHom_of P k w j
  rw [hfun]
  exact eval_thetaGenerator_reverse P k w i

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.forward_reverse
statement:
private theorem forward_reverse (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n) :
    (forwardHom P k w).comp (reverseHom P k w) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro i
  cases i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, reverseHom_of]
      simp [reverseGenerator, map_mul, forwardHom_of, thetaGenerator,
        aWord, bWord, cWord, qWord, finalOldSlot, Word.product, mul_assoc]
  | cast i =>
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i
        rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, reverseHom_of]
        simp [reverseGenerator, forwardHom_of, thetaGenerator,
          bWord, finalOldSlot]
      · rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, reverseHom_of]
        simp [reverseGenerator, forwardHom_of, thetaGenerator,
          encodedOldGenerator, hik, finalOldSlot, MillerTancer.oldGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.presentsTrivial_transform_iff_raw
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_iff_raw (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n) (w : Word n) :
    (Compressed.transform P k w).presentsTrivial ↔
      (MillerTancer.transform P (Word.generator k) w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  rw [FP.presentsTrivial_iff_subsingleton, FP.presentsTrivial_iff_subsingleton]
  exact (transformEquiv P k w).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.symm

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Compressed.presentsTrivial_transform_iff
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_iff (P : FP n m) (k : Fin n)
    (hk : P.NormallyGenerates (Word.generator k)) (w : Word n) :
    (Compressed.transform P k w).presentsTrivial ↔ P.wordProblem w
proof:
:= by
  rw [presentsTrivial_transform_iff_raw]
  exact MillerTancer.presentsTrivial_transform_iff
    P (Word.generator k) hk w

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.conjugate_zpow
statement:
private theorem conjugate_zpow {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (a x : G) (k : ℤ) : (a⁻¹ * x * a) ^ k = a⁻¹ * x ^ k * a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (conj_zpow (a := a⁻¹) (b := x) (i := k))

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block₀_prod
statement:
private theorem block₀_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block₀ k hk).prod = b ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change CoprodI.of (i := (0 : Fin 2)) (Multiplicative.ofAdd k) = b ^ k
  exact CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow 0 k

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.blockTwisted_prod
statement:
private theorem blockTwisted_prod (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (blockTwisted r hr k hk).prod =
      ((g ^ r)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * g * b * g ^ r) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((g ^ r)⁻¹ * b⁻¹ * g * b * g ^ r : R) =
      (g ^ r)⁻¹ * (b⁻¹ * g * b) * g ^ r by group]
  rw [conjugate_zpow, conjugate_zpow]
  simp only [blockTwisted, app, NeWord.singletonZ, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) k]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) (-r),
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (0 : Fin 2) (-1),
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (0 : Fin 2) 1,
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) r]
  simp [b, g]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block₁_prod
statement:
private theorem block₁_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block₁ k hk).prod = elt 1 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [block₁, elt] using blockTwisted_prod 1 (by omega) k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block₂_prod
statement:
private theorem block₂_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block₂ k hk).prod = elt 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [block₂, elt] using blockTwisted_prod 2 (by omega) k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.blockConjugate_prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_zpow]
  simp only [blockConjugate, app, NeWord.singletonZ, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (0 : Fin 2) k]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) (-r),
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) r]
  simp [b, g]
  group

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block₃_prod
statement:
private theorem block₃_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block₃ k hk).prod = elt 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [block₃, elt] using blockConjugate_prod 3 (by omega) k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block₄_prod
statement:
private theorem block₄_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block₄ k hk).prod = elt 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [block₄, elt] using blockConjugate_prod 4 (by omega) k hk

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem block_prod (i : Fin 5) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).prod = elt i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases (block₀_prod k hk) (fun i₁ => ?_) i
  refine Fin.cases (block₁_prod k hk) (fun i₂ => ?_) i₁
  refine Fin.cases (block₂_prod k hk) (fun i₃ => ?_) i₂
  refine Fin.cases (block₃_prod k hk) (fun i₄ => ?_) i₃
  refine Fin.cases (block₄_prod k hk) (fun i₅ => ?_) i₄
  exact Fin.elim0 i₅

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem block_head (i : Fin 5) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).head = headValue i (Multiplicative.ofAdd k)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem block_last (i : Fin 5) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).last = lastValue i (Multiplicative.ofAdd k)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.side_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem side_eq_zero_iff (i : Fin 5) : side i = 0 ↔ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [side]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.block_append_or_zero
statement:
theorem block_append_or_zero (i : Fin 5) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    i = 0 ∨ NeWord.IsAppend (block i k hk)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  all_goals exact Or.inr trivial

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.boundary_ne_one
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals try exact (hij rfl).elim
  all_goals try norm_num [side] at hside
  all_goals
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h
    norm_num [headValue, lastValue] at hh

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.lift_injective
statement: theorem lift_injective : Function.Injective lift
proof:
:= by
  apply CoprodI.lift_injective_of_neWord_nontrivial cyclicMap
  intro i j w
  change lift w.prod ≠ 1
  rw [← (image w).prod_eq]
  exact CoprodI.NeWord.prod_ne_one _

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.freeMap_eq
statement: theorem freeMap_eq : freeMap = lift.comp (CoprodI.intOfFree (Fin 5))
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp [freeMap, lift, cyclicMap, CoprodI.intOfFree]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.freeMap_injective
statement: theorem freeMap_injective : Function.Injective freeMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeMap_eq]
  exact lift_injective.comp (CoprodI.intOfFree_injective (Fin 5))

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.original_rightBasisMap_comp
statement:
theorem original_rightBasisMap_comp :
    (CoprodI.intOfFree (Fin 2)).comp rightBasisMap = freeMap
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [CoprodI.intOfFree, rightBasisMap, rightBasis, freeMap, elt, b, g,
      rightBeta, rightGamma]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.RightNormalForm.original_rightBasisMap_injective
statement: theorem original_rightBasisMap_injective : Function.Injective rightBasisMap
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply freeMap_injective
  rw [← original_rightBasisMap_comp]
  exact congrArg (CoprodI.intOfFree (Fin 2)) h

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.comparison_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_old (P : FP n m) (g : P.Group) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.oldLeft P g) =
      LeftNormalForm.baseOf (LeftNormalForm.old g)
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.comparison_alpha
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_alpha (P : FP n m) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.alphaLeft P) =
      LeftNormalForm.outerAlpha
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparison, Amalgam.alphaLeft, newToMiller]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.comparison_beta
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_beta (P : FP n m) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.betaLeft P) =
      LeftNormalForm.baseOf LeftNormalForm.beta
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparison, Amalgam.betaLeft, newToMiller]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.baseOf_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseOf_mul (P : FP n m)
    (x y : LeftNormalForm.LeftProduct P.Group) :
    LeftNormalForm.baseOf (x * y) =
      LeftNormalForm.baseOf x * LeftNormalForm.baseOf y
proof:
:=
  map_mul
    (CoprodI.of
      (M := LeftNormalForm.OuterFactor P.Group)
      (i := LeftNormalForm.OuterIndex.base) :
      LeftNormalForm.LeftProduct P.Group →*
        LeftNormalForm.MillerLeft P.Group) x y

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.comparison_leftBasis
statement:
theorem comparison_leftBasis (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin 5) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.leftBasis P z w i) =
      LeftNormalForm.outerLeftBasis (P.evalWord w) (P.evalWord z) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Amalgam.leftBasis, LeftNormalForm.outerLeftBasis,
      map_mul, map_inv, map_pow, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.comparison_comp_leftMap
statement:
theorem comparison_comp_leftMap (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    (comparison P).comp (Amalgam.leftMap P z w) =
      FreeGroup.lift
        (LeftNormalForm.outerLeftBasis (P.evalWord w) (P.evalWord z))
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Amalgam.leftMap, comparison_leftBasis]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftBridge.leftMap_injective_of_outerLeftBasis_injective
statement:
theorem leftMap_injective_of_outerLeftBasis_injective
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n)
    (_hw : P.evalWord w ≠ 1)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (FreeGroup.lift
        (LeftNormalForm.outerLeftBasis
          (P.evalWord w) (P.evalWord z)))) :
    Function.Injective (Amalgam.leftMap P z w)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply hinj
  rw [← comparison_comp_leftMap P z w]
  exact congrArg (comparison P) hxy

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.pushout_rightMap_eq
statement: theorem pushout_rightMap_eq : Amalgam.rightMap = rightBasisMap
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Amalgam.rightMap, Amalgam.rightBasis,
      rightBasisMap, rightBasis, Amalgam.betaRight,
      Amalgam.gammaRight, rightBeta, rightGamma]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.pushout_rightMap_injective
statement:
theorem pushout_rightMap_injective :
    Function.Injective Amalgam.rightMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushout_rightMap_eq]
  exact RightNormalForm.original_rightBasisMap_injective

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.transform_not_trivial_of_leftMap_injective
statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_leftMap_injective
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n)
    (hleft : Function.Injective (Amalgam.leftMap P z w))
    (hw : ¬ P.wordProblem w) :
    ¬ (transform P z w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:=
  Amalgam.transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective
    P z w hleft pushout_rightMap_injective hw

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem
statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n)
    (hw : ¬ P.wordProblem w) :
    ¬ (transform P z w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  have hwEval : P.evalWord w ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hw ((P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mpr h)
  have houter :=
    LeftInjective.outerLeftBasis_lift_injective
      (P.evalWord w) (P.evalWord z) hwEval
  have hleft :=
    LeftBridge.leftMap_injective_of_outerLeftBasis_injective
      P z w hwEval houter
  exact transform_not_trivial_of_leftMap_injective P z w hleft hw

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.identifies_basis
statement:
theorem identifies_basis (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin 5) :
    pushLeft P z w (leftBasis P z w i) =
      pushRight P z w (rightBasis i)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := Monoid.PushoutI.of_apply_eq_base
    (diagram P z w) Side.left (FreeGroup.of i)
  have hright := Monoid.PushoutI.of_apply_eq_base
    (diagram P z w) Side.right (FreeGroup.of i)
  change pushLeft P z w ((leftMap P z w) (FreeGroup.of i)) = _ at hleft
  change pushRight P z w (rightMap (FreeGroup.of i)) = _ at hright
  simpa [leftMap, rightMap] using hleft.trans hright.symm

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.identifies_beta
statement:
theorem identifies_beta (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    pushLeft P z w (betaLeft P) = pushRight P z w betaRight
proof:
:= by
  simpa [leftBasis, rightBasis] using identifies_basis P z w (0 : Fin 5)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_old
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessGenerator_old (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin n) :
    witnessGenerator P z w (oldGenerator i) =
      pushLeft P z w (oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [witnessGenerator, oldGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_alpha
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessGenerator_alpha (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    witnessGenerator P z w (Fin.natAdd n 0) =
      pushLeft P z w (alphaLeft P)
proof:
:= by
  simp [witnessGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessGenerator_beta (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    witnessGenerator P z w (Fin.natAdd n 1) =
      pushLeft P z w (betaLeft P)
proof:
:= by
  simp [witnessGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_gamma
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessGenerator_gamma (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    witnessGenerator P z w (Fin.natAdd n 2) =
      pushRight P z w gammaRight
proof:
:= by
  simp [witnessGenerator]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_oldWord_witness
statement:
theorem eval_oldWord_witness (P : FP n m) (z w u : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (oldWord u) =
      pushLeft P z w (oldLeft P (P.evalWord u))
proof:
:= by
  rw [oldWord, Word.eval_mapGenerators]
  have hfun : witnessGenerator P z w ∘ oldGenerator =
      ((pushLeft P z w).comp (oldLeft P) ∘
        (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group)) := by
    funext i
    exact witnessGenerator_old P z w i
  rw [hfun]
  rw [← Word.map_eval ((pushLeft P z w).comp (oldLeft P))
    (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) u]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_oldGenerators_witness
statement:
theorem eval_oldGenerators_witness (P : FP n m) (z w u : Word n) :
    Word.eval
        (fun i => pushLeft P z w (oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i))) u =
      pushLeft P z w (oldLeft P (P.evalWord u))
proof:
:= by
  convert (Word.map_eval ((pushLeft P z w).comp (oldLeft P))
    (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) u).symm using 1 <;>
    simp [Function.comp_def, FP.evalWord]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₁_witness
statement:
theorem eval_sigma₁_witness (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (sigma₁ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma₁, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
  simpa [sigma₁, leftBasis, rightBasis, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
    Word.product, identifies_beta P z w, mul_assoc] using
      identifies_basis P z w (1 : Fin 5)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₂_witness
statement:
theorem eval_sigma₂_witness (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (sigma₂ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma₂, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
  simpa [sigma₂, leftBasis, rightBasis, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
    Word.product, identifies_beta P z w, mul_assoc] using
      identifies_basis P z w (2 : Fin 5)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₃_witness
statement:
theorem eval_sigma₃_witness (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (sigma₃ w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma₃, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
  simpa [sigma₃, leftBasis, rightBasis, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
    Word.product, identifies_beta P z w, eval_oldWord_witness,
    eval_oldGenerators_witness, mul_assoc] using
      identifies_basis P z w (3 : Fin 5)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₄_witness
statement:
theorem eval_sigma₄_witness (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (sigma₄ z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma₄, Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
  simpa [sigma₄, leftBasis, rightBasis, alphaWord, betaWord, gammaWord,
    Word.product, identifies_beta P z w, eval_oldWord_witness,
    eval_oldGenerators_witness, mul_assoc] using
      identifies_basis P z w (4 : Fin 5)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.transformed_relator_eq_one
statement:
theorem transformed_relator_eq_one (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n)
    (i : Fin (m + 4)) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) ((transform P z w).relator i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.addCases with
  | left j =>
      rw [transform_old, eval_oldWord_witness, P.relator_eq_one]
      simp
  | right j =>
      rw [transform_additional]
      fin_cases j
      · exact eval_sigma₁_witness P z w
      · exact eval_sigma₂_witness P z w
      · exact eval_sigma₃_witness P z w
      · exact eval_sigma₄_witness P z w

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessHom_of (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin (n + 3)) :
    witnessHom P z w (PresentedGroup.of i) = witnessGenerator P z w i
proof:
:=
  (transform P z w).homOfRelators_of _ _ i

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective
statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective
    (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n)
    (hleft : Function.Injective (leftMap P z w))
    (hright : Function.Injective rightMap)
    (hw : ¬ P.wordProblem w) :
    ¬ (transform P z w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  intro htrivial
  have hwT : (transform P z w).wordProblem (oldWord w) :=
    htrivial (oldWord w)
  have hwEval : (transform P z w).evalWord (oldWord w) = 1 :=
    ((transform P z w).wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one (oldWord w)).mp hwT
  have heval :
      witnessHom P z w ((transform P z w).evalWord (oldWord w)) =
        Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (oldWord w) := by
    calc
      witnessHom P z w ((transform P z w).evalWord (oldWord w)) =
          Word.eval
            ((witnessHom P z w) ∘
              (PresentedGroup.of :
                Fin (n + 3) → (transform P z w).Group))
            (oldWord w) := Word.map_eval (witnessHom P z w)
              (PresentedGroup.of :
                Fin (n + 3) → (transform P z w).Group)
              (oldWord w)
      _ = Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (oldWord w) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact witnessHom_of P z w i
  have hwWitness : Word.eval (witnessGenerator P z w) (oldWord w) = 1 := by
    rw [← heval, hwEval, map_one]
  rw [eval_oldWord_witness] at hwWitness
  have hdiagram : ∀ s, Function.Injective (diagram P z w s) := by
    intro s
    cases s with
    | left => exact hleft
    | right => exact hright
  have hpushLeft : Function.Injective (pushLeft P z w) :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of_injective hdiagram Side.left
  have holdLeft : Function.Injective (oldLeft P) :=
    Monoid.Coprod.inl_injective
  have hwOld : P.evalWord w = 1 := by
    apply holdLeft
    apply hpushLeft
    simpa using hwWitness
  exact hw ((P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mpr hwOld)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.splitSide_ne
statement:
theorem splitSide_ne {i j : SplitIndex} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    splitSide i ≠ splitSide j
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp_all [splitSide]

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.unitExponent_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem unitExponent_ne_zero (x : FreeGroup Unit) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hx
  apply FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.injective
  change FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt x = 0
  exact hzero

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.zeroImage_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroImage_prod (x : FreeGroup Unit) (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    (zeroImage (G := G) x hx).prod = zeroMap x
proof:
:= by
  let k := FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt x
  have hxrepr : FreeGroup.of () ^ k = x :=
    FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.symm_apply_apply x
  calc
    (zeroImage (G := G) x hx).prod = baseOf (beta ^ k) := by
      simp [zeroImage, k]
    _ = baseOf beta ^ k := baseOf_zpow beta k
    _ = zeroMap (FreeGroup.of () ^ k) := by simp [zeroMap]
    _ = zeroMap x := congrArg zeroMap hxrepr

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.neWord_prod_ne_one
statement:
private theorem neWord_prod_ne_one
    {I : Type} {H : I → Type} [∀ i, Group (H i)]
    {i j : I} (u : CoprodI.NeWord H i j) : u.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hu
  have heq : u.toWord = (CoprodI.Word.empty : CoprodI.Word H) := by
    apply (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := H)).symm.injective
    change u.prod = 1
    exact hu
  have hlist := congrArg CoprodI.Word.toList heq
  exact u.toList_ne_nil (by
    simpa [CoprodI.NeWord.toWord] using hlist)

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.splitLift_injective_of_tailImage
statement:
theorem splitLift_injective_of_tailImage (w z : G)
    (tailImage : ∀ x : FreeGroup (Fin 4), x ≠ 1 →
      CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha)
    (tailImage_prod : ∀ (x : FreeGroup (Fin 4)) (hx : x ≠ 1),
      (tailImage x hx).prod = tailMap w z x) :
    Function.Injective (splitLift w z)
proof:
:= by
  apply CoprodI.lift_injective_of_neWord_nontrivial
  intro i j u hu
  apply neWord_prod_ne_one (image w z tailImage tailImage_prod u).word
  calc
    (image w z tailImage tailImage_prod u).word.prod =
        splitLift w z u.prod :=
      (image w z tailImage tailImage_prod u).prod_eq
    _ = 1 := by
      change (CoprodI.lift (splitFactorMap w z)) u.prod = 1
      exact hu

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.sourceJoin_comp_sourceSplit
statement:
theorem sourceJoin_comp_sourceSplit :
    sourceJoin.comp sourceSplit = MonoidHom.id (FreeGroup (Fin 5))
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [sourceJoin, sourceSplit, splitGenerator, zeroJoin, tailJoin,
      FreeGroup.lift_apply_of] <;>
    exact FreeGroup.lift_apply_of

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.sourceSplit_injective
statement: theorem sourceSplit_injective : Function.Injective sourceSplit
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := sourceJoin)
  intro x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun sourceJoin_comp_sourceSplit x

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.splitLift_comp_sourceSplit
statement:
theorem splitLift_comp_sourceSplit (w z : G) :
    (splitLift w z).comp sourceSplit =
      FreeGroup.lift (outerLeftBasis w z)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [splitLift, sourceSplit, splitGenerator, splitFactorMap,
      zeroMap, tailMap, outerLeftBasis, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of] <;>
    exact FreeGroup.lift_apply_of

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.outerLeftBasis_injective_of_tailImage
statement:
theorem outerLeftBasis_injective_of_tailImage (w z : G)
    (tailImage : ∀ x : FreeGroup (Fin 4), x ≠ 1 →
      CoprodI.NeWord (OuterFactor G) OuterIndex.alpha OuterIndex.alpha)
    (tailImage_prod : ∀ (x : FreeGroup (Fin 4)) (hx : x ≠ 1),
      (tailImage x hx).prod = tailMap w z x) :
    Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift (outerLeftBasis w z))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sourceSplit_injective
  apply splitLift_injective_of_tailImage w z tailImage tailImage_prod
  calc
    splitLift w z (sourceSplit x) =
        FreeGroup.lift (outerLeftBasis w z) x :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (splitLift_comp_sourceSplit w z) x
    _ = FreeGroup.lift (outerLeftBasis w z) y := hxy
    _ = splitLift w z (sourceSplit y) :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun (splitLift_comp_sourceSplit w z) y).symm

name: Undecidability.Gordon.presentsTrivial_transform_iff
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_iff
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n) :
    (transform P data w).presentsTrivial ↔ P.wordProblem w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htrivial
    by_contra hw
    exact transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem P data w hw htrivial
  · exact presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem P data w

name: Undecidability.Gordon.family_isAdianRabin
statement:
theorem family_isAdianRabin
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (hP : ¬ ComputablePred P.wordProblem) :
    FP.IsAdianRabinFamily (family P data)
proof:
:=
  isAdianRabinFamily_of_wordProblem_reduction
    P (transform P data) hP (transform_computable P data)
      (presentsTrivial_transform_iff P data)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.lemma_2_1
statement:
theorem lemma_2_1
    (P : FP n m) (condition : Condition21 P)
    (hP : ¬ ComputablePred P.wordProblem) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → FP 2 (m + 1), FP.IsAdianRabinFamily A
proof:
:=
  ⟨family P condition.toTorsionData,
    family_isAdianRabin P condition.toTorsionData hP⟩

name: Undecidability.Gordon.eval_encodeWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_encodeWord {H : Type*} [Group H]
    (data : TorsionData P) (x : Fin 2 → H) (w : Word n) :
    Word.eval x (encodeWord data w) =
      Word.eval (fun i ↦ Word.eval x (encodedGenerator data i)) w
proof:
:=
  Word.eval_substitute x (encodedGenerator data) w

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_old
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_old (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : Fin m) :
    (transform P data w).relator (Fin.castAdd 1 i) =
      encodeWord data (P.relator i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_additional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_additional (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : Fin 1) :
    (transform P data w).relator (Fin.natAdd m i) =
      additionalRelator data w
proof:
:= by
  simp [transform]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.inverse_primrec
statement: private theorem inverse_primrec : Primrec (@Word.inverse 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hletterInverse : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator 2 ↦
      (x.1, !x.2) :=
    Primrec.pair Primrec.fst (Primrec.not.comp Primrec.snd)
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_reverse
      (hletterInverse.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
  intro w
  rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.encodeWord_primrec
statement:
theorem encodeWord_primrec (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) :
    Primrec (fun w : Word n ↦ encodeWord data w)
proof:
:= by
  have hgenerator : Primrec (encodedGenerator data) :=
    Primrec.fin_app.comp
      (Primrec.const (α := Fin n) (encodedGenerator data)) Primrec.id
  have hletter : Primrec fun x : SignedGenerator n ↦
      bif x.2 then encodedGenerator data x.1
      else Word.inverse (encodedGenerator data x.1) :=
    Primrec.cond Primrec.snd
      (hgenerator.comp Primrec.fst)
      (inverse_primrec.comp (hgenerator.comp Primrec.fst))
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id (hletter.comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
  intro w
  simp only [encodeWord, Word.substitute]
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases x.2 <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.relation_primrec
proof:
:= by
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_append.comp hf
      (Primrec.const (Word.inverse rhs)))
  intro w
  rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.paperCommutator_primrec
statement:
private theorem paperCommutator_primrec (v : Word 2) :
    Primrec fun u : Word 2 ↦ paperCommutator u v
proof:
:= by
  apply Primrec.of_eq
    (Primrec.list_append.comp Primrec.id
      (Primrec.list_append.comp (Primrec.const v)
        (Primrec.list_append.comp inverse_primrec
          (Primrec.const (Word.inverse v)))))
  intro u
  simp [paperCommutator, Word.product]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_computable
statement:
theorem transform_computable (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) :
    Computable₂ fun w i ↦ (transform P data w).relator i
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Primrec fun w : Word n ↦
      paperCommutator (encodeWord data w) (Word.pow alphaWord 2) :=
    (paperCommutator_primrec (Word.pow alphaWord 2)).comp
      (encodeWord_primrec P data)
  have hadditional : Primrec fun w : Word n ↦ additionalRelator data w :=
    relation_primrec hcomm (rightConjugateWord (n + 1))
  apply Primrec₂.to_comp
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry).mp
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry).mpr
  apply Primrec₂.swap
  apply (Primrec.fin_curry₁).mpr
  intro i
  change Fin (m + 1) at i
  cases i using Fin.addCases with
  | left j =>
      simpa using
        (Primrec.const (α := Word n) (encodeWord data (P.relator j)))
  | right j =>
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j' ↦ Fin.elim0 j') j
      apply Primrec.of_eq hadditional
      intro w
      rw [transform_additional]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.additional_relator_eq_one
statement:
private theorem additional_relator_eq_one
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n) :
    Word.eval
        (PresentedGroup.of : Fin 2 → (transform P data w).Group)
        (additionalRelator data w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (transform P data w).evalWord (additionalRelator data w) = 1
  rw [FP.evalWord_eq_mk]
  apply PresentedGroup.one_of_mem
  exact ⟨Fin.natAdd m (0 : Fin 1), by simp⟩

name: Undecidability.Gordon.exists_oldHom
statement:
private theorem exists_oldHom
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n) :
    ∃ f : P.Group →* (transform P data w).Group,
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        f (PresentedGroup.of i) =
          Word.eval PresentedGroup.of (encodedGenerator data i)
proof:
:= by
  let y : Fin n → (transform P data w).Group :=
    fun i ↦ Word.eval PresentedGroup.of (encodedGenerator data i)
  have hrel : ∀ i, Word.eval y (P.relator i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    have hold : Word.eval
        (PresentedGroup.of : Fin 2 → (transform P data w).Group)
        (encodeWord data (P.relator i)) = 1 := by
      change (transform P data w).evalWord
        (encodeWord data (P.relator i)) = 1
      rw [FP.evalWord_eq_mk]
      apply PresentedGroup.one_of_mem
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd 1 i, by simp⟩
    change Word.eval y (P.relator i) = 1
    rw [← eval_encodeWord]
    exact hold
  refine ⟨P.homOfRelators y hrel, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact P.homOfRelators_of y hrel i

name: Undecidability.Gordon.gcd_sq_eq_one
statement:
private theorem gcd_sq_eq_one (data : TorsionData P) :
    Finset.univ.gcd (fun i ↦ data.q i ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.eq_one_iff_not_exists_prime_dvd]
  intro l hl hldiv
  have hallSq : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin data.p)),
      l ∣ data.q i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.dvd_gcd_iff.mp hldiv
  have hall : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin data.p)),
      l ∣ data.q i := by
    intro i hi
    exact hl.dvd_of_dvd_pow (hallSq i hi)
  have hlgcd : l ∣ Finset.univ.gcd data.q :=
    Finset.dvd_gcd hall
  rw [data.gcd_q] at hlgcd
  exact hl.not_dvd_one hlgcd

name: Undecidability.Gordon.presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_transform_of_wordProblem
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n)
    (hw : P.wordProblem w) :
    (transform P data w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin 2 → (transform P data w).Group := PresentedGroup.of
  let a := x 0
  let b := x 1
  let alpha := Word.eval x alphaWord
  let beta := Word.eval x betaWord

  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_oldHom P data w
  have hwP : P.evalWord w = 1 :=
    (P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mp hw
  have hwT : Word.eval x (encodeWord data w) = 1 := by
    rw [eval_encodeWord]
    calc
      Word.eval (fun i ↦ Word.eval x (encodedGenerator data i)) w =
          Word.eval (fun i ↦ f (PresentedGroup.of i)) w := by
            congr 2
            funext i
            exact (hf i).symm
      _ = f (P.evalWord w) := by
            symm
            exact Word.map_eval f _ w
      _ = 1 := by rw [hwP, map_one]

  have hfinal := additional_relator_eq_one P data w
  change Word.eval x
    (Word.relation
      (paperCommutator (encodeWord data w) (Word.pow alphaWord 2))
      (rightConjugateWord (n + 1))) = 1 at hfinal
  rw [Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff] at hfinal
  have hbConj :
      (beta ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * b * beta ^ (n + 1) = 1 := by
    simpa [paperCommutator, Word.product, rightConjugateWord,
      bWord, hwT, alpha, beta, b, x, mul_assoc] using hfinal.symm
  have hb : b = 1 := by
    calc
      b = beta ^ (n + 1) *
          ((beta ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * b * beta ^ (n + 1)) *
            (beta ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [hbConj]; simp
  have halpha : alpha = 1 := by
    simp [alpha, alphaWord, aWord, bWord, b, x, hb]
  have hbeta : beta = a := by
    simp [beta, betaWord, aWord, bWord, alphaWord,
      a, b, x, hb]
  have hencoded (i : Fin n) :
      Word.eval x (encodedGenerator data i) = a ^ data.degree i := by
    simp [encodedGenerator, rightConjugateWord, aWord, bWord,
      alphaWord, betaWord, a, b, x, hb]

  have hcyclicFG (r : FreeGroup (Fin 2)) :
      ∃ k : ℤ,
        PresentedGroup.mk (transform P data w).relSet r = a ^ k := by
    induction r using FreeGroup.induction_on with
    | C1 => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | of i =>
        fin_cases i
        · exact ⟨1, by simp [a, x, PresentedGroup.of]⟩
        · exact ⟨0, by simpa [b, x, PresentedGroup.of] using hb⟩
    | inv_of i _ =>
        fin_cases i
        · exact ⟨-1, by simp [a, x, PresentedGroup.of]⟩
        · exact ⟨0, by
            simpa [b, x, PresentedGroup.of] using congrArg Inv.inv hb⟩
    | mul r s hr hs =>
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hr
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hs
        exact ⟨k + l, by simp [hk, hl, zpow_add]⟩
  have hcyclic : IsCyclic (transform P data w).Group := by
    rw [isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top]
    refine ⟨a, eq_top_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    intro g _
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := PresentedGroup.mk_surjective
      (transform P data w).relSet g
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcyclicFG r
    exact ⟨k, hk.symm⟩
  let : IsCyclic (transform P data w).Group := hcyclic
  let : CommGroup (transform P data w).Group := IsCyclic.commGroup

  have haSq (i : Fin data.p) : a ^ (data.q i ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have hab :
        (Abelianization.of
          (PresentedGroup.of (data.selected i) : P.Group)) ^ data.q i = 1 := by
      rw [← data.exactOrder i]
      exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _
    have hmapped := congrArg (Abelianization.lift f) hab
    have hfi : f (PresentedGroup.of (data.selected i)) ^ data.q i = 1 := by
      simpa using hmapped
    rw [hf, hencoded, data.degree_selected] at hfi
    calc
      a ^ data.q i ^ 2 = (a ^ data.q i) ^ data.q i := by
        rw [pow_two, pow_mul]
      _ = 1 := hfi
  have horderDvd :
      orderOf a ∣ Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin data.p ↦ data.q i ^ 2) := by
    apply Finset.dvd_gcd
    intro i _
    exact orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (haSq i)
  have horder : orderOf a = 1 := by
    rw [gcd_sq_eq_one data] at horderDvd
    exact Nat.dvd_one.mp horderDvd
  have ha : a = 1 := orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp horder
  have hx : ∀ i : Fin 2, x i = 1 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ha
    · exact hb

  exact (transform P data w).presentsTrivial_of_generator_eq_one hx

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.alphaSingleton_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem alphaSingleton_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (alphaSingleton (G := G) k hk).prod = a ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change CoprodI.of (i := LeftIndex.alpha) ((FreeGroup.of ()) ^ k) =
    (CoprodI.of (i := LeftIndex.alpha) (FreeGroup.of ()) : SplitLeft G) ^ k
  exact map_zpow _ _ _

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.betaSingleton_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaSingleton_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (betaSingleton (G := G) k hk).prod = auxiliaryAlpha ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change CoprodI.of (i := LeftIndex.beta) ((FreeGroup.of ()) ^ k) =
    (CoprodI.of (i := LeftIndex.beta) (FreeGroup.of ()) : SplitLeft G) ^ k
  exact map_zpow _ _ _

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.old_one
statement: @[simp] theorem old_one : old (1 : G) = (1 : SplitLeft G)
proof:
:=
  map_one
    (CoprodI.of (M := LeftFactor G) (i := LeftIndex.old) :
      G →* SplitLeft G)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.conjugatePowerA_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugatePowerA_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (conjugatePowerA (G := G) k hk).prod =
      (a * auxiliaryAlpha * a⁻¹) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugatePowerA]
  group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.conjugatePowerAlpha_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugatePowerAlpha_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (conjugatePowerAlpha (G := G) k hk).prod =
      (auxiliaryAlpha * a * auxiliaryAlpha⁻¹) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugatePowerAlpha]
  group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.degreeInt_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold degreeInt
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (hdegree i))

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.oldBlock_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem oldBlock_prod (degree : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i) (x : Fin d → G) (i : Fin d) :
    (oldBlock degree hdegree x i).prod = oldElement degree x i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have oldSingleton_prod_local (g : G) (hg : g ≠ 1) :
      (oldSingleton g hg).prod = old g := rfl
  by_cases hx : x i = 1
  · simp [oldBlock, hx, oldElement]
  · simp [oldBlock, hx, oldElement, oldSingleton_prod_local]
    group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.oldBlock_head
statement:
@[simp] theorem oldBlock_head (degree : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i) (x : Fin d → G) (i : Fin d) :
    (oldBlock degree hdegree x i).head =
      (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ (-degreeInt degree i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x i = 1 <;>
    simp [oldBlock, hx, alphaSingleton, cyclicSingleton] <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.oldBlock_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem oldBlock_last (degree : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i) (x : Fin d → G) (i : Fin d) :
    (oldBlock degree hdegree x i).last =
      (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ degreeInt degree i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x i = 1 <;>
    simp [oldBlock, hx, betaSingleton, cyclicSingleton] <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.commutatorBlock_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem commutatorBlock_prod (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    (commutatorBlock w hw).prod =
      old w * auxiliaryAlpha ^ 2 * (old w)⁻¹ *
        (auxiliaryAlpha ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have oldSingleton_prod_local (g : G) (hg : g ≠ 1) :
      (oldSingleton g hg).prod = old g := rfl
  simp [commutatorBlock, oldSingleton_prod_local]
  group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.positivePowerWord_head
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa [positivePowerWord] using ih

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.positivePowerWord_last
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ => rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_prod
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_prod {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).word.prod = u.prod ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
      | succ n =>
          change (positivePowerWord u hij n).prod =
            u.prod ^ (Int.ofNat (n + 1))
          simpa only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast] using
            positivePowerWord_prod u hij n
  | negSucc n =>
      change (positivePowerWord u hij n).inv.prod = u.prod ^ Int.negSucc n
      simp [positivePowerWord_prod, zpow_negSucc]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_head_pos
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_head_pos {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hpos : 0 < k) :
    (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).headLetter = ⟨i, u.head⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp at hpos
      | succ n =>
          change (positivePacked u hij n).headLetter = ⟨i, u.head⟩
          simp [positivePacked, PackedWord.headLetter]
  | negSucc n => simp at hpos

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_last_pos
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_last_pos {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hpos : 0 < k) :
    (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).lastLetter = ⟨j, u.last⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp at hpos
      | succ n =>
          change (positivePacked u hij n).lastLetter = ⟨j, u.last⟩
          simp [positivePacked, PackedWord.lastLetter]
  | negSucc n => simp at hpos

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_head_neg
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_head_neg {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hneg : k < 0) :
    (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).headLetter = ⟨j, u.last⁻¹⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n => exact (Int.not_lt_of_ge (Int.natCast_nonneg n) hneg).elim
  | negSucc n =>
      change (negativePacked u hij n).headLetter = ⟨j, u.last⁻¹⟩
      simp [negativePacked, PackedWord.headLetter]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_last_neg
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_last_neg {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hneg : k < 0) :
    (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).lastLetter = ⟨i, u.head⁻¹⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n => exact (Int.not_lt_of_ge (Int.natCast_nonneg n) hneg).elim
  | negSucc n =>
      change (negativePacked u hij n).lastLetter = ⟨i, u.head⁻¹⟩
      simp [negativePacked, PackedWord.lastLetter]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerPacked_old
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) (i : Fin d)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw (.old i) k hk =
      cyclicPowerPacked (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_commutator
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerPacked_commutator
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw .commutator k hk =
      cyclicPowerPacked (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.not_pos_of_neg
statement: private theorem not_pos_of_neg {k : ℤ} (hk : k < 0) : ¬ 0 < k
proof: := by omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_headLetter
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerPacked_headLetter
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i : BasisIndex d) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw i k hk).headLetter =
      expectedHead degree w i k
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA =>
      simp [powerPacked, PackedWord.headLetter, conjugatePowerA, alphaSingleton,
        cyclicSingleton, expectedHead, alphaLetter]
  | conjugateAlpha =>
      simp [powerPacked, PackedWord.headLetter, conjugatePowerAlpha, betaSingleton,
        cyclicSingleton, expectedHead, betaLetter]
  | old i =>
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hneg | hpos
      · rw [powerPacked_old,
          cyclicPowerPacked_head_neg
            (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk hneg]
        simp [expectedHead, not_pos_of_neg hneg, oldBlock_last,
          betaLetter]
        rfl
      · rw [powerPacked_old,
          cyclicPowerPacked_head_pos
            (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk hpos]
        simp [expectedHead, hpos, oldBlock_head, alphaLetter]
  | commutator =>
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hneg | hpos
      · rw [powerPacked_commutator,
          cyclicPowerPacked_head_neg
            (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk hneg]
