        simp [expectedHead, not_pos_of_neg hneg, betaLetter,
          commutatorBlock, betaSingleton, cyclicSingleton]
        congr 1
      · rw [powerPacked_commutator,
          cyclicPowerPacked_head_pos
            (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk hpos]
        simp [expectedHead, hpos, oldLetter, commutatorBlock, oldSingleton]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_lastLetter
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerPacked_lastLetter
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i : BasisIndex d) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw i k hk).lastLetter =
      expectedLast degree w i k
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA =>
      simp [powerPacked, PackedWord.lastLetter, conjugatePowerA, alphaSingleton,
        cyclicSingleton, expectedLast, alphaLetter]
  | conjugateAlpha =>
      simp [powerPacked, PackedWord.lastLetter, conjugatePowerAlpha, betaSingleton,
        cyclicSingleton, expectedLast, betaLetter]
  | old i =>
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hneg | hpos
      · rw [powerPacked_old,
          cyclicPowerPacked_last_neg
            (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk hneg]
        simp [expectedLast, not_pos_of_neg hneg, oldBlock_head,
          alphaLetter]
        congr 1
        exact inv_inv _
      · rw [powerPacked_old,
          cyclicPowerPacked_last_pos
            (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk hpos]
        simp [expectedLast, hpos, oldBlock_last, betaLetter]
  | commutator =>
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hneg | hpos
      · rw [powerPacked_commutator,
          cyclicPowerPacked_last_neg
            (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk hneg]
        simp [expectedLast, not_pos_of_neg hneg, oldLetter,
          commutatorBlock, oldSingleton]
        rfl
      · rw [powerPacked_commutator,
          cyclicPowerPacked_last_pos
            (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk hpos]
        simp [expectedLast, hpos, betaLetter, commutatorBlock,
          betaSingleton, cyclicSingleton]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerPacked_prod
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i : BasisIndex d) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw i k hk).word.prod =
      splitBasis degree x w i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA =>
      simpa only [powerPacked, splitBasis] using
        (conjugatePowerA_prod (G := G) k hk)
  | conjugateAlpha =>
      simpa only [powerPacked, splitBasis] using
        (conjugatePowerAlpha_prod (G := G) k hk)
  | old i =>
      simpa [splitBasis] using
        cyclicPowerPacked_prod
          (oldBlock degree hdegree x i) (by decide) k hk
  | commutator =>
      simpa only [powerPacked_commutator, splitBasis,
        commutatorBlock_prod] using
        cyclicPowerPacked_prod (commutatorBlock w hw) (by decide) k hk

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.noncancelling_of_index_ne
statement:
theorem noncancelling_of_index_ne (p q : Σ i, LeftFactor G i)
    (h : p.1 ≠ q.1) : Noncancelling p q
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  exact (h heq).elim

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.alphaLetter_noncancelling
statement:
theorem alphaLetter_noncancelling (r s : ℤ) (h : r + s ≠ 0) :
    Noncancelling (alphaLetter (G := G) r) (alphaLetter s)
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  change (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ r * FreeGroup.of () ^ s ≠ 1
  rw [← zpow_add]
  exact FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one (r + s) h

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.betaLetter_noncancelling
statement:
theorem betaLetter_noncancelling (r s : ℤ) (h : r + s ≠ 0) :
    Noncancelling (betaLetter (G := G) r) (betaLetter s)
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  change (FreeGroup.of () : FreeGroup Unit) ^ r * FreeGroup.of () ^ s ≠ 1
  rw [← zpow_add]
  exact FreeGroup.unitGenerator_zpow_ne_one (r + s) h

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.code_noncancelling
statement:
theorem code_noncancelling (w : G) (p q : LetterCode)
    (h : CodeNoncancelling p q) :
    Noncancelling (codeLetter w p) (codeLetter w q)
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases q
  · contradiction
  · contradiction
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, alphaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, betaLetter])
  · contradiction
  · contradiction
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, alphaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, betaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, alphaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, alphaLetter])
  · exact alphaLetter_noncancelling _ _ h
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, alphaLetter, betaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, betaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, oldLetter, betaLetter])
  · exact noncancelling_of_index_ne _ _ (by
      simp [codeLetter, alphaLetter, betaLetter])
  · exact betaLetter_noncancelling _ _ h

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.degreeInt_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply hinjective
  have h' : (degree i : ℤ) = degree j := by
    simpa [degreeInt] using h
  exact_mod_cast h'

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.expected_code_noncancelling
statement:
private theorem expected_code_noncancelling
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hinjective : Function.Injective degree)
    (i j : BasisIndex d) (r s : ℤ) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    CodeNoncancelling
      (expectedLastCode degree i r) (expectedHeadCode degree j s)
proof:
:= by
  have hdegreeInt : Function.Injective (degreeInt degree) :=
    degreeInt_injective degree hinjective
  by_cases hrp : 0 < r <;> by_cases hsp : 0 < s
  all_goals
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [CodeNoncancelling, expectedLastCode, expectedHeadCode,
        hrp, hsp, degreeInt] at hij ⊢
  all_goals try omega
  all_goals
    have hne := hdegreeInt.ne hij
    simp [degreeInt] at hne
    omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.expected_noncancelling
statement:
theorem expected_noncancelling
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hinjective : Function.Injective degree)
    (w : G) (i j : BasisIndex d) (r s : ℤ) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Noncancelling
      (expectedLast degree w i r) (expectedHead degree w j s)
proof:
:=
  code_noncancelling w _ _
    (expected_code_noncancelling degree hinjective i j r s hij)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.positivePowerWord_isAppend
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact hu
  | succ => trivial

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.inv_isAppend
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | singleton => contradiction
  | append => trivial

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.cyclicPowerPacked_isAppend
statement:
theorem cyclicPowerPacked_isAppend {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) (hij : j ≠ i)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hu : IsAppend u) :
    IsAppend (cyclicPowerPacked u hij k hk).word
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (hk rfl).elim
      | succ n => exact positivePowerWord_isAppend u hij n hu
  | negSucc n => exact inv_isAppend _ (positivePowerWord_isAppend u hij n hu)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.oldBlock_isAppend
statement:
theorem oldBlock_isAppend (degree : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i) (x : Fin d → G) (i : Fin d) :
    IsAppend (oldBlock degree hdegree x i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x i = 1 <;> simp [oldBlock, hx, IsAppend]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.powerPacked_isAppend
statement:
theorem powerPacked_isAppend
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1)
    (i : BasisIndex d) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    IsAppend (powerPacked degree hdegree x w hw i k hk).word
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA => trivial
  | conjugateAlpha => trivial
  | old i =>
      exact cyclicPowerPacked_isAppend _ _ k hk
        (oldBlock_isAppend degree hdegree x i)
  | commutator =>
      exact cyclicPowerPacked_isAppend _ _ k hk (by trivial)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.exists_joinPacked
statement:
theorem exists_joinPacked (u v : PackedWord G)
    (hu : IsAppend u.word)
    (h : Noncancelling u.lastLetter v.headLetter) :
    ∃ q : PackedWord G,
      q.word.prod = u.word.prod * v.word.prod ∧
      q.headLetter = u.headLetter
proof:
:= by
  rcases u with ⟨uf, ul, uw⟩
  rcases v with ⟨vf, vl, vw⟩
  by_cases e : ul = vf
  · subst vf
    let q : PackedWord G :=
      ⟨uf, vl, CoprodI.NeWord.merge uw vw (h rfl)⟩
    refine ⟨q, CoprodI.NeWord.merge_prod uw vw (h rfl), ?_⟩
    change (⟨uf, (CoprodI.NeWord.merge uw vw (h rfl)).head⟩ :
        Σ i, LeftFactor G i) = ⟨uf, uw.head⟩
    cases uw with
    | singleton => contradiction
    | append => rfl
  · let q : PackedWord G := ⟨uf, vl, CoprodI.NeWord.append uw e vw⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (CoprodI.NeWord.append uw e vw).prod = uw.prod * vw.prod
    exact CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.joinPacked_prod
statement:
theorem joinPacked_prod (u v : PackedWord G)
    (hu : IsAppend u.word)
    (h : Noncancelling u.lastLetter v.headLetter) :
    (joinPacked u v hu h).word.prod = u.word.prod * v.word.prod
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_joinPacked u v hu h)).1

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.joinPacked_headLetter
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinPacked_headLetter (u v : PackedWord G)
    (hu : IsAppend u.word)
    (h : Noncancelling u.lastLetter v.headLetter) :
    (joinPacked u v hu h).headLetter = u.headLetter
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_joinPacked u v hu h)).2

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.neWord_prod_ne_one
statement:
private theorem neWord_prod_ne_one {i j : LeftIndex}
    (u : CoprodI.NeWord (LeftFactor G) i j) : u.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hu
  have heq : u.toWord =
      (CoprodI.Word.empty : CoprodI.Word (LeftFactor G)) := by
    apply (CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := LeftFactor G)).symm.injective
    change u.prod = 1
    exact hu
  have hlist := congrArg CoprodI.Word.toList heq
  exact u.toList_ne_nil (by
    simpa [CoprodI.NeWord.toWord] using hlist)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.evalBasis_eq_map_prod
statement:
private theorem evalBasis_eq_map_prod
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (x : Fin d → G) (w : G)
    (l : List (BasisIndex d × ℤ)) :
    evalBasis degree x w l =
      (l.map fun p ↦ splitBasis degree x w p.1 ^ p.2).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p l ih => simp [evalBasis, ih]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftNormalForm.splitBasis_lift_injective
statement:
theorem splitBasis_lift_injective
    (degree : Fin d → ℕ) (hdegree : ∀ i, 0 < degree i)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective degree)
    (x : Fin d → G) (w : G) (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift (splitBasis degree x w))
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.lift_injective_of_reduced_zpow_products
    (splitBasis degree x w)
  intro l hlne hlexp hlchain
  cases l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons p rest =>
      have hp : p.2 ≠ 0 := hlexp p (by simp)
      have hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, q.2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro q hq
        exact hlexp q (by simp [hq])
      let im := imageList degree hdegree hinjective x w hw
        p rest hp hrest hlchain
      rw [← evalBasis_eq_map_prod]
      rw [← im.prod_eq]
      exact neWord_prod_ne_one im.packed.word

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.oldExponent_pos
statement: theorem oldExponent_pos (i : Fin n) : 0 < oldExponent i
proof:
:= by
  simp [oldExponent]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.commutatorExponent_pos
statement: theorem commutatorExponent_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < commutatorExponent n
proof:
:= by
  simp [commutatorExponent]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.conjugate_zpow_right
statement:
private theorem conjugate_zpow_right {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (a x : G) (k : ℤ) : (a * x * a⁻¹) ^ k = a * x ^ k * a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.conjugate_zpow_left
statement:
private theorem conjugate_zpow_left {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (a x : G) (k : ℤ) : (a⁻¹ * x * a) ^ k = a⁻¹ * x ^ k * a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using conjugate_zpow_right a⁻¹ x k

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.blockA_prod
statement:
private theorem blockA_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (blockA k hk).prod = elt (.conjugateA : BasisIndex n) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockA, CoprodI.NeWord.singletonZ, CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow]
  simp [elt, b]
  rw [zpow_mul]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.blockAlpha_prod
statement:
private theorem blockAlpha_prod (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (blockAlpha k hk).prod = elt (.conjugateAlpha : BasisIndex n) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change (blockAlpha k hk).prod = (b * beta * b⁻¹) ^ k
  rw [conjugate_zpow_right]
  simp only [blockAlpha, app, CoprodI.NeWord.singletonZ, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) k]
  simp [b, beta]
  group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.blockU_prod
statement:
private theorem blockU_prod (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 < r) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (blockU r hr k hk).prod = ((beta ^ r)⁻¹ * b * beta ^ r) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_zpow_left]
  simp only [blockU, app, CoprodI.NeWord.singletonZ, CoprodI.NeWord.append_prod,
    CoprodI.NeWord.prod_singleton]
  rw [CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (0 : Fin 2) k,
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) (-r),
    CoprodI.of_int_eq_zpow (1 : Fin 2) r]
  simp [b, beta]
  group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.blockOld_prod
statement:
private theorem blockOld_prod (i : Fin n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (blockOld i k hk).prod = elt (.old i) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockOld, blockU_prod]
  change ((beta ^ oldExponent i)⁻¹ * b * beta ^ oldExponent i) ^ k =
    ((beta ^ (i.1 + 1))⁻¹ * b * beta ^ (i.1 + 1)) ^ k
  rw [show oldExponent i = ((i.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by simp [oldExponent], zpow_natCast]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.blockCommutator_prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockCommutator, blockU_prod]
  change ((beta ^ commutatorExponent n)⁻¹ * b * beta ^ commutatorExponent n) ^ k =
    ((beta ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * b * beta ^ (n + 1)) ^ k
  rw [show commutatorExponent n = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by
    simp [commutatorExponent], zpow_natCast]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.block_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem block_prod (i : BasisIndex n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).prod = elt i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA => exact blockA_prod k hk
  | conjugateAlpha => exact blockAlpha_prod k hk
  | old i => exact blockOld_prod i k hk
  | commutator => exact blockCommutator_prod n k hk

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.block_head
statement:
@[simp] theorem block_head (i : BasisIndex n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).head = headValue i (Multiplicative.ofAdd k)
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.block_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem block_last (i : BasisIndex n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (block i k hk).last = lastValue i (Multiplicative.ofAdd k)
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.side_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem side_eq_zero_iff (i : BasisIndex n) :
    side i = 0 ↔ i = .conjugateA ∨ i = .conjugateAlpha
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> simp [side]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.block_append_or_small
statement:
theorem block_append_or_small (i : BasisIndex n) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    i = .conjugateA ∨ CoprodI.NeWord.IsAppend (block i k hk)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | conjugateA => exact Or.inl rfl
  | conjugateAlpha => exact Or.inr trivial
  | old => exact Or.inr trivial
  | commutator => exact Or.inr trivial

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.goodHead_headValue
statement:
@[simp] theorem goodHead_headValue (i : BasisIndex n) (x : ZMul) :
    GoodHead i (headValue i x)
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> simp [GoodHead, headValue]
  omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.goodLast_lastValue
statement:
@[simp] theorem goodLast_lastValue (i : BasisIndex n) (x : ZMul) :
    GoodLast i (lastValue i x)
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> simp [GoodLast, lastValue]
  omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.boundary_ne_one
proof:
:= by
  change x.toAdd + y.toAdd ≠ 0
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp_all [side, GoodHead, GoodLast, oldExponent, commutatorExponent,
      Fin.ext_iff] <;> omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.lift_injective
statement: theorem lift_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (lift n)
proof:
:= by
  apply CoprodI.lift_injective_of_neWord_nontrivial cyclicMap
  intro i j w
  change lift n w.prod ≠ 1
  rw [← (image w).prod_eq]
  exact CoprodI.NeWord.prod_ne_one _

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.freeMap_eq
statement:
theorem freeMap_eq (n : ℕ) : freeMap n =
    (lift n).comp (CoprodI.intOfFree (BasisIndex n))
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp [freeMap, lift, cyclicMap, CoprodI.intOfFree]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.freeMap_injective
statement: theorem freeMap_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (freeMap n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeMap_eq n]
  exact (lift_injective n).comp (CoprodI.intOfFree_injective (BasisIndex n))

name: Undecidability.Gordon.RightNormalForm.rightBasisMap_comp
statement:
theorem rightBasisMap_comp (n : ℕ) :
    (CoprodI.intOfFree (Fin 2)).comp (rightBasisMap n) = freeMap n
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  cases i <;>
    simp [CoprodI.intOfFree, rightBasisMap, rightBasis,
      rightU, rightB, rightBeta, freeMap, elt, u, b, beta]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.rightBasisMap_injective
statement:
theorem rightBasisMap_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (rightBasisMap n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply RightNormalForm.freeMap_injective n
  rw [← RightNormalForm.rightBasisMap_comp n]
  exact congrArg (CoprodI.intOfFree (Fin 2)) h

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.comparison_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_old (P : FP n m) (g : P.Group) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.oldLeft P g) = MillerTancer.LeftNormalForm.old g
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.comparison_a
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_a (P : FP n m) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.aLeft P) = LeftNormalForm.a
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparison, Amalgam.aLeft, newToSplit]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.comparison_alpha
statement:
@[simp] theorem comparison_alpha (P : FP n m) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.alphaLeft P) =
      LeftNormalForm.auxiliaryAlpha
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparison, Amalgam.alphaLeft, newToSplit]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.comparison_leftBasis
statement:
theorem comparison_leftBasis (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : BasisIndex n) :
    comparison P (Amalgam.leftBasis P data w i) =
      LeftNormalForm.splitBasis data.degree
        (fun j ↦ (PresentedGroup.of j : P.Group)) (P.evalWord w) i
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;>
    simp [Amalgam.leftBasis, LeftNormalForm.splitBasis,
      LeftNormalForm.oldElement, LeftNormalForm.degreeInt,
      LeftNormalForm.a, LeftNormalForm.auxiliaryAlpha,
      map_mul, map_inv, map_pow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.comparison_comp_leftMap
statement:
theorem comparison_comp_leftMap (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    (comparison P).comp (Amalgam.leftMap P data w) =
      FreeGroup.lift
        (LeftNormalForm.splitBasis data.degree
          (fun j ↦ (PresentedGroup.of j : P.Group)) (P.evalWord w))
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Amalgam.leftMap, comparison_leftBasis]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.LeftBridge.leftMap_injective
statement:
theorem leftMap_injective (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (hw : P.evalWord w ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (Amalgam.leftMap P data w)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (FreeGroup.lift
        (LeftNormalForm.splitBasis data.degree
          (fun j ↦ (PresentedGroup.of j : P.Group)) (P.evalWord w))) :=
    LeftNormalForm.splitBasis_lift_injective data.degree
      data.degree_pos data.degree_injective
      (fun j ↦ (PresentedGroup.of j : P.Group)) (P.evalWord w) hw
  intro x y hxy
  apply hinj
  rw [← comparison_comp_leftMap P data w]
  exact congrArg (comparison P) hxy

name: Undecidability.Gordon.amalgam_rightMap_eq
statement:
theorem amalgam_rightMap_eq (n : ℕ) :
    Amalgam.rightMap n = rightBasisMap n
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  cases i <;>
    simp [Amalgam.rightMap, Amalgam.rightBasis,
      Amalgam.rightConjugate, Amalgam.bRight, Amalgam.betaRight,
      rightBasisMap, rightBasis, rightU, rightB, rightBeta]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.amalgam_rightMap_injective
statement:
theorem amalgam_rightMap_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (Amalgam.rightMap n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [amalgam_rightMap_eq n]
  exact rightBasisMap_injective n

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem
statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_not_wordProblem
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n)
    (hw : ¬ P.wordProblem w) :
    ¬ (transform P data w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  have hwEval : P.evalWord w ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hw ((P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mpr h)
  exact Amalgam.transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective P data w
    (LeftBridge.leftMap_injective P data w hwEval)
    (amalgam_rightMap_injective n) hw

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.q_representative
statement:
theorem q_representative (condition : Condition21 P)
    (q : condition.orderValues) :
    condition.q (condition.representative q) = q.1
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp q.property)).2

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalizedQ_injective
statement:
theorem normalizedQ_injective (condition : Condition21 P) :
    Function.Injective condition.normalizedQ
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply condition.valueEquiv.injective
  exact Subtype.ext hij

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalizedQ_pos
statement:
theorem normalizedQ_pos (condition : Condition21 P)
    (i : Fin condition.orderValues.card) :
    0 < condition.normalizedQ i
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < (condition.valueEquiv i).1
  rw [← condition.q_representative (condition.valueEquiv i)]
  exact condition.q_pos _

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalized_exactOrder
statement:
theorem normalized_exactOrder (condition : Condition21 P)
    (i : Fin condition.orderValues.card) :
    orderOf (Abelianization.of
      (PresentedGroup.of (condition.normalizedSelected i) : P.Group)) =
        condition.normalizedQ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [show condition.normalizedSelected i =
      condition.selected
        (condition.representative (condition.valueEquiv i)) from rfl]
  rw [condition.exactOrder, condition.q_representative]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalized_gcd
statement:
theorem normalized_gcd (condition : Condition21 P) :
    Finset.univ.gcd condition.normalizedQ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.gcd_eq_gcd_image]
  have himage :
      Finset.univ.image condition.normalizedQ = condition.orderValues := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · intro hq
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      exact (condition.valueEquiv i).property
    · intro hq
      let q' : condition.orderValues := ⟨q, hq⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := condition.valueEquiv.surjective q'
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hi
  rw [himage]
  have hgcd := condition.gcd_q
  rw [Finset.gcd_eq_gcd_image] at hgcd
  exact hgcd

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalizedQ_le_degreeBound
statement:
theorem normalizedQ_le_degreeBound (condition : Condition21 P)
    (i : Fin condition.orderValues.card) :
    condition.normalizedQ i ≤ condition.degreeBound
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalizedSelected_preimage
statement:
theorem normalizedSelected_preimage (condition : Condition21 P)
    (j : Fin n) (hj : condition.IsNormalizedSelected j) :
    condition.normalizedSelected (condition.normalizedPreimage j hj) = j
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec hj

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.extendedDegree_selected
statement:
theorem extendedDegree_selected (condition : Condition21 P)
    (i : Fin condition.orderValues.card) :
    condition.extendedDegree (condition.normalizedSelected i) =
      condition.normalizedQ i
proof:
:= by
  have hi : condition.IsNormalizedSelected
      (condition.normalizedSelected i) := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [extendedDegree]
  simp only [dif_pos hi]
  congr 1
  apply condition.normalizedSelected.injective
  exact condition.normalizedSelected_preimage _ hi

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.extendedDegree_pos
statement:
theorem extendedDegree_pos (condition : Condition21 P) (j : Fin n) :
    0 < condition.extendedDegree j
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedDegree]
  split_ifs with hj
  · exact condition.normalizedQ_pos _
  · omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.extendedDegree_injective
statement:
theorem extendedDegree_injective (condition : Condition21 P) :
    Function.Injective condition.extendedDegree
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hi : condition.IsNormalizedSelected i
  · by_cases hj : condition.IsNormalizedSelected j
    · rw [extendedDegree, dif_pos hi, extendedDegree, dif_pos hj] at hij
      have hpre : condition.normalizedPreimage i hi =
          condition.normalizedPreimage j hj :=
        condition.normalizedQ_injective hij
      calc
        i = condition.normalizedSelected
            (condition.normalizedPreimage i hi) :=
          (condition.normalizedSelected_preimage i hi).symm
        _ = condition.normalizedSelected
            (condition.normalizedPreimage j hj) := congrArg _ hpre
        _ = j := condition.normalizedSelected_preimage j hj
    · rw [extendedDegree, dif_pos hi, extendedDegree, dif_neg hj] at hij
      have hle := condition.normalizedQ_le_degreeBound
        (condition.normalizedPreimage i hi)
      omega
  · by_cases hj : condition.IsNormalizedSelected j
    · rw [extendedDegree, dif_neg hi, extendedDegree, dif_pos hj] at hij
      have hle := condition.normalizedQ_le_degreeBound
        (condition.normalizedPreimage j hj)
      omega
    · rw [extendedDegree, dif_neg hi, extendedDegree, dif_neg hj] at hij
      apply Fin.ext
      omega

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.identifies_basis
statement:
theorem identifies_basis (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : BasisIndex n) :
    pushLeft P data w (leftBasis P data w i) =
      pushRight P data w (rightBasis n i)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := Monoid.PushoutI.of_apply_eq_base
    (diagram P data w) Side.left (FreeGroup.of i)
  have hr := Monoid.PushoutI.of_apply_eq_base
    (diagram P data w) Side.right (FreeGroup.of i)
  change pushLeft P data w ((leftMap P data w) (FreeGroup.of i)) = _ at hl
  change pushRight P data w (rightMap n (FreeGroup.of i)) = _ at hr
  simpa [leftMap, rightMap] using hl.trans hr.symm

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_a
statement:
@[simp] theorem witnessGenerator_a (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    witnessGenerator P data w 0 = pushLeft P data w (aLeft P)
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_b
statement:
@[simp] theorem witnessGenerator_b (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    witnessGenerator P data w 1 = pushRight P data w bRight
proof: := rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_alpha_witness
statement:
theorem eval_alpha_witness (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) alphaWord =
      pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P)
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      pushLeft P data w (aLeft P * alphaLeft P * (aLeft P)⁻¹) =
        pushRight P data w (bRight ^ 2) := by
    simpa [leftBasis, rightBasis] using
      identifies_basis P data w (BasisIndex.conjugateA : BasisIndex n)
  have h' :
      pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) * pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) *
          (pushLeft P data w (aLeft P))⁻¹ =
        (pushRight P data w bRight) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [map_mul, map_inv, map_pow] using h
  calc
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) alphaWord =
        (pushLeft P data w (aLeft P))⁻¹ *
          (pushRight P data w bRight) ^ 2 *
            pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) := by
              simp [alphaWord, aWord, bWord, mul_assoc]
    _ = pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) := by
      rw [← h']
      group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_beta_witness
statement:
theorem eval_beta_witness (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) betaWord =
      pushRight P data w betaRight
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      pushLeft P data w
          (alphaLeft P * aLeft P * (alphaLeft P)⁻¹) =
        pushRight P data w (bRight * betaRight * bRight⁻¹) := by
    simpa [leftBasis, rightBasis] using
      identifies_basis P data w
        (BasisIndex.conjugateAlpha : BasisIndex n)
  have h' :
      pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) * pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) *
          (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P))⁻¹ =
        pushRight P data w bRight * pushRight P data w betaRight *
          (pushRight P data w bRight)⁻¹ := by
    simpa [map_mul, map_inv] using h
  calc
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) betaWord =
        (pushRight P data w bRight)⁻¹ *
          pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) *
            pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) *
              (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P))⁻¹ *
                pushRight P data w bRight := by
                  simp [betaWord, aWord, bWord, eval_alpha_witness,
                    mul_assoc]
    _ = pushRight P data w betaRight := by
      calc
        (pushRight P data w bRight)⁻¹ *
              pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) *
                pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) *
                  (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P))⁻¹ *
                    pushRight P data w bRight =
            (pushRight P data w bRight)⁻¹ *
              (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) *
                pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) *
                  (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P))⁻¹) *
                    pushRight P data w bRight := by group
        _ = pushRight P data w betaRight := by rw [h']; group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_rightConjugateWord_witness
statement:
theorem eval_rightConjugateWord_witness
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n) (r : ℕ) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (rightConjugateWord r) =
      pushRight P data w (rightConjugate r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightConjugateWord, rightConjugate, bWord,
    eval_beta_witness, witnessGenerator_b, map_mul, map_inv, map_pow,
    mul_assoc]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_encodedGenerator_witness
statement:
theorem eval_encodedGenerator_witness
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n) (i : Fin n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (encodedGenerator data i) =
      pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i))
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      pushLeft P data w
          ((aLeft P ^ data.degree i)⁻¹ *
            oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i) *
              alphaLeft P ^ data.degree i) =
        pushRight P data w (rightConjugate (i.1 + 1)) := by
    simpa [leftBasis, rightBasis] using
      identifies_basis P data w (BasisIndex.old i)
  have h' :
      (pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) ^ data.degree i)⁻¹ *
          pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i)) *
            pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) ^ data.degree i =
        pushRight P data w (rightConjugate (i.1 + 1)) := by
    simpa [map_mul, map_inv, map_pow] using h
  calc
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (encodedGenerator data i) =
        pushLeft P data w (aLeft P) ^ data.degree i *
          pushRight P data w (rightConjugate (i.1 + 1)) *
            (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P) ^ data.degree i)⁻¹ := by
              simp [encodedGenerator, aWord, eval_alpha_witness,
                eval_rightConjugateWord_witness, mul_assoc]
    _ = pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (PresentedGroup.of i)) := by
      rw [← h']
      group

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_encodeWord_witness
statement:
theorem eval_encodeWord_witness (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w u : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (encodeWord data u) =
      pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (P.evalWord u))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_encodeWord]
  have hfun :
      (fun i ↦ Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
        (encodedGenerator data i)) =
        ((pushLeft P data w).comp (oldLeft P) ∘
          (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group)) := by
    funext i
    exact eval_encodedGenerator_witness P data w i
  rw [hfun]
  rw [← Word.map_eval ((pushLeft P data w).comp (oldLeft P))
    (PresentedGroup.of : Fin n → P.Group) u]
  rfl

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_additional
statement:
theorem eval_additional (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
      (additionalRelator data w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
    (Word.relation
      (paperCommutator (encodeWord data w) (Word.pow alphaWord 2))
      (rightConjugateWord (n + 1))) = 1
  rw [Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff]
  calc
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
        (paperCommutator (encodeWord data w) (Word.pow alphaWord 2)) =
        pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (P.evalWord w)) *
          (pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P)) ^ 2 *
            (pushLeft P data w (oldLeft P (P.evalWord w)))⁻¹ *
              ((pushLeft P data w (alphaLeft P)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [show paperCommutator (encodeWord data w)
          (Word.pow alphaWord 2) =
        Word.product [encodeWord data w, Word.pow alphaWord 2,
          Word.inverse (encodeWord data w),
          Word.inverse (Word.pow alphaWord 2)] from rfl]
      rw [Word.eval_product]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
        List.prod_nil, Word.eval_pow, Word.eval_inverse, mul_one]
      rw [eval_encodeWord_witness, eval_alpha_witness]
      group
    _ = pushRight P data w (rightConjugate (n + 1)) := by
      simpa [leftBasis, rightBasis, map_mul, map_inv, map_pow,
        mul_assoc] using
          identifies_basis P data w
            (BasisIndex.commutator : BasisIndex n)
    _ = Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
        (rightConjugateWord (n + 1)) :=
      (eval_rightConjugateWord_witness P data w (n + 1)).symm

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.transformed_relator_eq_one
statement:
theorem transformed_relator_eq_one (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
      ((transform P data w).relator i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.addCases with
  | left j =>
      rw [transform_old, eval_encodeWord_witness, P.relator_eq_one]
      simp
  | right j =>
      rw [transform_additional]
      exact eval_additional P data w

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.witnessHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem witnessHom_of (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)
    (w : Word n) (i : Fin 2) :
    witnessHom P data w (PresentedGroup.of i) =
      witnessGenerator P data w i
proof:
:=
  (transform P data w).homOfRelators_of _ _ i

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective
statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective
    (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P) (w : Word n)
    (hleft : Function.Injective (leftMap P data w))
    (hright : Function.Injective (rightMap n))
    (hw : ¬ P.wordProblem w) :
    ¬ (transform P data w).presentsTrivial
proof:
:= by
  intro htrivial
  have hwT : (transform P data w).wordProblem (encodeWord data w) :=
    htrivial (encodeWord data w)
  have hwEval : (transform P data w).evalWord (encodeWord data w) = 1 :=
    ((transform P data w).wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one
      (encodeWord data w)).mp hwT
  have heval :
      witnessHom P data w
          ((transform P data w).evalWord (encodeWord data w)) =
        Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (encodeWord data w) := by
    calc
      witnessHom P data w
          ((transform P data w).evalWord (encodeWord data w)) =
          Word.eval
            ((witnessHom P data w) ∘
              (PresentedGroup.of : Fin 2 → (transform P data w).Group))
            (encodeWord data w) :=
              Word.map_eval (witnessHom P data w)
                (PresentedGroup.of :
                  Fin 2 → (transform P data w).Group)
                (encodeWord data w)
      _ = Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w)
          (encodeWord data w) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact witnessHom_of P data w i
  have hwWitness :
      Word.eval (witnessGenerator P data w) (encodeWord data w) = 1 := by
    rw [← heval, hwEval, map_one]
  rw [eval_encodeWord_witness] at hwWitness
  have hdiagram : ∀ s, Function.Injective (diagram P data w s) := by
    intro s
    cases s with
    | left => exact hleft
    | right => exact hright
  have hpushLeft : Function.Injective (pushLeft P data w) :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of_injective hdiagram Side.left
  have holdLeft : Function.Injective (oldLeft P) :=
    Monoid.Coprod.inl_injective
  have hwOld : P.evalWord w = 1 := by
    apply holdLeft
    apply hpushLeft
    simpa using hwWitness
  exact hw ((P.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one w).mpr hwOld)
